IV. Huu Y Hanh -

(Fourth element: Huu Y Hanh)

Now I begin to lecture on Huu Y Hanh. Existing Medicine is relying on the Three Jewels, which can give birth to all kinds of merit and virtue.

Paying respects to the Buddha, heaven and earth are one, all things come first, all things come first, all palms, reverence, and reciting questions write:
(Sutra: At that time, Vajragarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva was in the mass, from the place Sit up, pay homage at the Buddha's feet, take off one shoulder of your shirt, put your right knee close to the ground, clasp your hands, reverently, and chant in verse to ask.

Vajragarbha Bodhisattva raised the question. He asked: "The Buddha said this Dharma, it seems that there are some places that are not the same as what was said before, there are some contradictory places, how should we understand it?" Vajra Treasury Bodhisattva himself has mastered it, but he knows that sentient beings in the future may wonder and doubt whether the three vehicles are equal or not? Because, in the Lotus Sutra, the Buddha said: "Only one dharma is true, the second is not true" (Only this one dharma is true, the other two dharmas are not true). In the Vajra Prajna Paramita Sutra, it is also said that the Vajra Sutra is the ultimate, other sutras are not. Why does the Buddha sometimes say one thing, and sometimes another? How should we tolerate it?

pure, is not a sage, is not my child. That person has thrown away the dharma of monks, like ashes. That person should not be in my pure Sangha): This chant means that a monk who breaks the precepts has no merit, loses pure merit, cannot become a sage, nor can he become a saint, is not a container of dharma (dharma weapon), is not my disciple. I am not that person's master, that person is not my disciple. That's what it means.

“The monks' Dharma weapons are like ashes, they do not like to live in the middle of the crowd" (Throw away the Dharma monks like ashes, they should not stay in my pure Sangha): Those who violate the precepts should no longer live with the masses. Every sutra says so. "The three impurities destroy the path, one cannot bear to destroy the superior offerings, and give away things to the Sangha of the four directions, few of them are not heard by the self" ([The person who breaks the precepts] is tainted by the three elements and destroys the path. That person cannot endure the superior offerings. As for the gifts given to the Sangha of the four directions, I also do not allow him to enjoy any part): In the Precepts, the Buddha once said, if a bhikkhu breaks the precepts, will not be able to enjoy the things belonging to the Sangha of the four directions. Even a little bit does not allow that person to enjoy; because it is a superior offering.

“The four basic sins are the most common to commit. Baring them is like giving alms to the sea” (If you commit any of the four basic sins, the Sangha will throw that person away like the sea does not tolerate dead bodies): The sea does not tolerate dead bodies. If you die in the sea, the waves will definitely push your body to shore. That is to say, Bhikkhus who violate the precepts are purged from the pure Bhikkhus. "Yuan Ha Kim preaches that evil is to be endured, to be patient, to be compassionate, to be punished?" (Why now does it say that we should be patient, be compassionate, [but also] prevent punishment for evil to be punished?): But why does this sutra say that? We must endure the evil Bhikkhu, we must have mercy on him, and we should not arbitrarily reprimand or curse him? "It is recommended that you should make offerings to him with compassion, compassion, and evil-mindedness" (Again, you should be diligent in making offerings to him, be merciful, and don't give birth to any malice): You must arouse great compassion to make offerings to that person, have pity on that person, and don't give rise to the slightest bit of malice, because that person is wearing a red kasaya.

“ Respectfully listen to the Dharma teachings, always reap the blessings of great compassion. LThe Sutras of the Sutras for the Salvation of the World: NThe class of equals believes. Mahayana" (Respectfully listen and receive the Dharma spoken by the Buddha; often gain blessings of wisdom and great compassion. In other sutras, the Six Wisdom, life-saver taught: "You must all believe in the Mahayana"): As for the Buddha's teachings, we all respectfully listen and accept; Once you have heard and accepted it, you will definitely receive the blessings of great compassion. Regarding the dharma, we must respect, listen, accept, and protect it. Only then can blessings be achieved. "The Six Wisdoms save the world's salvation" (In other sutras, the Six Wisdoms save the world said): The Buddha has all the Six Wisdoms. The Six Thongs are Thien Eye Thong, Thien Ear Thong, Tha Tam Thong, Suc Mang Thong, Than Tuc Thong Thong, and Gonorrhea Tan Thong. Buddha's End of Asrava is the ultimate asrava, reaching ultimate purity. “The second class should believe in the Mahayana” (You should all believe in the Mahayana) [meaning]: Don't study the Second Vehicle, you must believe in the Mahayana.

“Rightly direct and wonderful Bodhidharma Enlighten the path, let go of the Two Vehicles to liberate” (Rightly upright, wonderful, Bodhi path, should abandon the path to liberation from the Second Vehicle): Liberation in the Second Vehicle is not true liberation, and this is the inconceivable wonderful Bodhi path, do not be greedy for the Lesser Vehicle. "The Clouds and Metal Vehicles preach the three vehicles, universally encourage listeners to maintain, practice and make offerings" (Now why do we talk about the three vehicles, advising everyone to listen, receive, accept, maintain, practice, and make offerings): In this sutra, the Buddha said that the Sravaka Vehicle, the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle, and the Bodhisattva Vehicle, all three vehicles must be skillfully cultivated, advising everyone to listen to the teachings, practice, and make offerings. Why do you say it contradicts before? This verse has such meaning!

“Fundamentals, power of enlightenment on the path of samana, test the sutra of middle existence, residual land of non-existence” (This sutra says the base, power, enlightenment, enlightenment, fruition of samana, but not in other sutras): Now we talk about the Five Roots, Five Powers, Seven Factors of Enlightenment, until attaining the Four Fruits of Samana (Sudayana, Sūda Ham, A). Na Ham, Arhat), this sutra says so. The Mahayana scriptures do not say so. "The Eightfold Path of the Holy Path has no equal, the Three Vehicles accompany the test" (The Eightfold Path of the Holy Path is incomparable, the three Vehicles all practice this path together): The Three Vehicles are equal, all practice the Noble Eightfold Path like that! "If you want liberation, you need to be diligent, it depends on your wish to attain Bodhi."

“The faithful sentient beings are illuminating, gathering the golden teachings without action” (The noble one among sentient beings should illuminate, review, and integrate past and present teachings, so that they do not contradict each other): Buddha is the noble one among all living beings, he should use his wisdom to illuminate. “Hoi” means “tolerance”. The current and previous teachings should not contradict each other! “The spirits of the gods, humans, and Bodhisattvas will attain enlightenment, their hearts will rejoice, and they will attain truth” (Causing the gods, humans, and Bodhisattvas to all attain enlightenment, their hearts will rejoice, and they will attain true truth): Hearing [the current and previous teachings contradict each other] like that, they will not like it. Why? They cannot enlighten, cannot realize the truth, in the end what is right? There is this meaning!

“Mahayana literature on the useful lobe? Mahayana literature on the beneficial lobe? Ten types of liberation of the Sravakayana, literature on the damaged lobe, the useful lobe?” (I heard that Mahayana lobes are useful? I heard that Mahayana lobes are harmed? Ten types of liberation of the Sravakayana, who will benefit? Who will be harmed?) Who will benefit? Who was harmed? The Mahayana is the same, and the Shravakayana is the same. The person being heard speaking and the actor speaking, in the end who benefits? Who will be harmed? "If people listen to the dharma, they will advance? When people listen to the dharma, they will retreat one after another?" (Who listens to the dharma and will advance? Whoever listens to the dharma will retreat?) What must be the case for listening to the dharma to be able to progress higher and advance diligently? Whoever listens to the Dharma will become withdrawn? In this way, doubts and thoughts of blasphemy will arise. Whenever you violate the Dharma, you will retreat, retreat, and fall into hell.

“The clouds and rivers hate all conditioned things, can they quickly dry up like old people” (How can one hate the conditioned things? Quickly dry up, old age and death): All conditioned dharmas, only in this way can we make them know their faults, can we help them avoid the suffering of birth, old age, and illness, death. “Dried out, old age and death” (Dried out, old and dead): “Dried out” means cessation. How to give rise to hatred towards the conditioned? How to end birth and death? All dharmas in the world are conditioned dharmas; Aging and death are also worldly dharmas. How to hate birth, old age, sickness, death, and pray for renunciation?

“Residence requires practicing good people, following the wonderful principles? Ngu ha vehicle?” (Day and night diligently cultivating good deeds, relying on what wonderful principles? What excess sitting?): People who cultivate good karma, Shravakas too, and Bodhisattvas too, ultimately use what principles to be able to “ride”? “Ride” means “control the chariot”. Thanh Van Thua is good? Or good Pratyekabuddha Vehicle? Or is the Bodhisattva Vehicle good? Or should we rely on the Four Noble Truths, the Dharma of cause and effect, and the Six Dharmas?

“The deep and vast energy of four streams, the current savior of the world declares” (Able to overcome the four rapid and deep waterfalls, may the savior of the world declare them all for us): Four waterfalls, the first is the waterfall of Desire, which is the realm of the five desires. Normally speaking, wealth, beauty, fame, eating, drinking, sleeping, and entertainment are the five desires. Very clearly, they are the five roots of hell. They are called the realm of the five desires.

The second type is the Four Formless Realms. The four waterfalls refer to the Four Formless Realms. What four precepts are the Four Precepts? Earth, water, fire, wind. The Formless Realm has no earth, water, fire, or wind. This is the second type. In the Four Formless Realms, there is greed, arrogance, and doubt; Those are the ones that stand out the most. All sentient beings doubt and misunderstand the principles of cultivating Bodhi. If you doubt, you won't believe, everything you encounter will be filled with question marks. But Vajrayana Bodhisattva, on behalf of sentient beings, knows that sentient beings will definitely wonder.

The third type is Ants. View is knowledge. We have a lot of wrong views, wrong views, wrong views, crazy views.

The fourth type, the great Bodhisattva, also has all the basic ignorance and afflictions, and has not yet reached the Noble Enlightenment. Only then can the Miraculous Enlightenment be eliminated, it is very subtle. “Savior of the world now speaks” (Savior, please declare for me): I ask, I hope the Buddha will answer me, teach me, that's the meaning.

(Sutra) At the ear, Buddha reported to Vajragarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva: "Good ear! Good ear! Good man, the golden taste benefits and brings peace to countless sentient beings, to the gods and humans, to the great benefit of the Tathagata, please ask the Tathagata to listen to the profound meaning of the good thoughts, to distinguish and explain. Two, one who cultivates meritorious karma. Three, mixed continuously. Four, depending on evil actions. Five, not seeing, not afraid of the suffering of the future. Six, strong of greed. Seven, strong of anger. Eight, strong of ignorance. Nine, ignorant of mind. "Ten people, evil and evil views. The ten types of Bodhisattvas create karma because they do not have good roots to rely on. They don't have even the slightest good roots, they don't cultivate any blessings, so they still create impure karma continuously, without stopping! Because in the past there were ten types of Non-Yoga as the cause, so they did not cultivate good karma and did not sow good roots.

You have the kind of talent that protects you, you are often careless, you pursue causes and conditions, your mind is confused, and you do not have good conduct. Those who are sick are afflicted with the brain, and seek out words and mantras, due to the cause and effect of the cause and effect of Vo Y Hanh. Like the ten strains of the Immaculate Conception, all sentient beings commit the fundamental sin, manifesting the Dharma in the middle of non-virtuous holy energy, destroying Thi La, and falling to the evil beasts.
There are people whose moral conduct and moral conduct are not corrupted. There are people whose precepts are corrupted but whose precepts are not corrupted. There are people who, although their morality, precepts, precepts, and views are not corrupted, yet rely on the power of their evil conduct, but they are stupid, like a dumb goat. Good and bad dharmas cannot be received, remembered, kept, and cannot understand the meaning of good and bad. Because of that cause and effect, there are people who are not satisfied with all kinds of wealth and objects. Due to the cause and effect of pursuing [those things], there are beings who, due to illness and anxiety, seek all kinds of worship and mantras Such behavior causes sentient beings to commit fundamental sins, not having the holy spirit in the current dharma, destroying Thi La, falling into evil destiniess).

Why do they commit fundamental crimes? Because they have that core, they will of course commit crimes. Ten types of Non-Importance like that cause all sentient beings to commit fundamental sins, not having the holy spirit in the present dharma, so they will break the forbidden precepts and fall into evil destiniess.

(Sutra) Good man! Weaknesses of the Bodhisattva Jāla,'s family conduct is ruined, the mind of mockery is not destroyed, the one type of Non-clothing conduct is perpetrated, the fundamental sin is committed, the evil deeds are deeply dishonored, the mind is noble and lethargic, and one is unaccountable for all evil deeds. The Tathagata, because of his stubborn selfishness, preaches the evil destinies of monks. The reason why it's fake? Compassionate action is like respecting evil karma, that is, revealing it conveniently, not feeling rich, and regretfully repenting. By repenting like this, your sins will be eradicated, forever cutting off the continuity, without any action. Although it is necessary for a monk to practice the Dharma, the stage of emancipation, it is necessary for a monk to possess private tools, not to hear or use it, but because of the three-vehicles of a person, to become a dharma weapon, the Tathagata is compassionate, or one who preaches the Sravaka Vehicle, or one who preaches the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle, or one who preaches the Supreme Vehicle. In the land of existence, the second and third stages of rebirth, the power of right vows is developed, the power of enlightenment is good, all evil karma must be completely destroyed. Either one attains the fruition of Shravaka Vehicle, or one attains the fruition of Pratyekabuddha Vehicle, attains Nirvana, or one attains enlightenment and enters the vast and profound Truth of the Supreme Vehicle. Like the destruction of the world of vision, the person of indestructible views, the eagle knows the ear.
Whenever he encounters any kind of cause that causes him to commit a fundamental sin, he immediately becomes deeply afraid, ashamed, and gives up, and does not repeatedly do evil deeds for the sake of that person. Then he says that there is such a bad karma, and he immediately exposes it, does not dare to hide it, and is ashamed to repent like that, and his sin is eliminated forever [of evil karma], no longer do it. Although in all the dharma activities of monks, they are still expelled and are not allowed to receive all the tools of monks, but because that person becomes a dharma weapon in the three vehicles, the Tathagata is compassionate, either because that person speaks the Dharma of the Sravaka Vehicle, or because that person speaks the Dharma of the Pratyekayana, or because that person speaks the Dharma of the Supreme Vehicle With true vows, through the power of meeting good friends, all evil karma will be destroyed. Either one will attain the fruition of the Sravaka Vehicle, or one will attain the fruit of Pratyekabuddha and attain Nirvana, or there will be a very deep understanding of the Supreme Vehicle. So it will be the same for those whose precepts are corrupted but whose views are not corrupted.)

Next, for each cause [the artifact of Vo Y Hanh] say it again.

Even though he has broken the precepts, in this life, that person can repent and correct his mistakes, and the Buddha preaches the Three Vehicles to that person. In the second or third life, due to the power of generating righteous vows, that person will meet superior friends and all evil karma will be destroyed. Therefore, one can attain the dharma of the Shravaka Vehicle, or one can attain the dharma of the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle, or one can attain the vast and very deep Supreme Vehicle dharma. That's called "precepts are corrupted, views are not corrupted, understanding the heron ear" (that's called precepts are corrupted, views are not destroyed, you should know the same).

The first is “moral conduct corrupts, mocking intentions do not destroy” and “mocking intentions, virtuous conduct does not destroy”, combining both things to explain. “The failure of good conduct” means there is no skillful means. Because you have broken the precepts, there will be no skillful means. Even though the moral conduct has been destroyed, the sense of ridicule is not destroyed, [meaning] that person can still be ashamed, can repent, and can still reveal it. Even though one is an impure monk, one can still reveal remorse and show signs of repentance, and one's sins can be eliminated. Therefore, the Buddha taught: "For poor monks, we must also make offerings and respect", because of this meaning.

Even though a monk cannot attain enlightenment in this life, in the second or third life, the power of his right view will develop. If he meets a good friend to guide him, then all the evil karma he has created will be destroyed. As for attaining the fruition of the Sravaka Vehicle, or attaining the fruition of the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle and then attaining Nirvana, it is not certain, it must depend on the person's practice situation in the second or third life.

“Or there is someone who enlightens into the vast and profound principles of the Supreme Vehicle, such as the world is corrupted, views are not destroyed” (Or there is someone who enlightens and enters the vast and profound principles of the Supreme Vehicle, the precepts are corrupted but the views are not destroyed like that): Although that person breaks the precepts, but his knowledge is not destroyed, he still knows that he is wrong. There are people who do wrong, but don't admit it, and think they did the right thing, which is truly evil. Even though he has broken the precepts, he still has right knowledge, right view, and can repent and change.

(Sutra) Disadvantages of Bodhisattva La, taunting, indestructible conduct, the Tathagata is selfish and persistent, preaching the pursuit of the Four Brahma Pillars of Dharma. Bi refers to the Thanh Van Vehicle energy, or the Pratyekabuddha vehicle energy. Weaknesses of Bodhisattva Jāla's conduct, the mind mocks and destroys, the vehicle is useless, the dharma weapon is not good, Tathagata's taste is helpful and stubborn, he preaches almsgiving. The weakness of Bodhisattva Jāla's view is destroyed, the precepts are not destroyed, the Tathagata, because of the benefit and stubbornness, teaches the dependent origination of the dharma and the spirit of letting go of evil views, in the middle body, entering the Sravaka dharma, or the Pratyekabuddha dharma, or in the residual body, the ability to enter.
(Sutra: If there is a taunting intention of the Bodhisattva, the Tathagata for the benefit of that person, say, seek the Dharma of the Four Brahma Pillars. That person is a dharma weapon of the Thanh Van Vehicle, or a dharma weapon of the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle, but both virtue and mockery are corrupted, then that person is not a dharma weapon in the vehicles. For the sake of that person, the Tathagata praises and gives alms. If he has the dharma vehicle of the Sravaka Vehicle, the precepts are not destroyed, the Tathagata will speak the dharma of dependent origination, causing him to abandon evil views in his present body and enter the Dharma of the Sravaka Vehicle. Pratyekabuddha, or from another body, one can enlighten.)

“If you have the Bodhisattva Jāla's destructive mind, your conduct is indestructible” (If you have the Bodhisattva Jāla's destructive mind, your conduct is indestructible), [that is] although that person does not like Buddhism, does not believe in the Dharma very much (that is the "sabotaging mind"), but he practices without interruption, recites sutras, and recites the recitations as usual. chant, and worship according to the usual rules (that is "indestructible virtue"). His sense of ridicule is destroyed, his faith is not complete, his interest does not arise, but his conduct is not destroyed, he just practices it according to the usual rules. Due to the blessings of the Three Jewels, it is possible for that person to find and restore the sense of ridicule.

Skillful means, means of attaining enlightenment, when you want to cultivate the path, must first have virtue. What is happiness? It is a skillful means. You don't have to bow ten thousand times, you don't have to recite the Hundred Words Mantra[1] ten thousand times, you don't have to recite the Three Jewels Chant ten thousand times. That is cultivating morality in the style of Tantra. In the Sutra teachings, reading, worshiping, repenting, and reciting morning and night are all called virtues. That is the skillful means before cultivating the path, the holy life is the skillful means. Tathagata, in order to help that person achieve benefits, “seeks the Dharma of the Four Brahma Pillars” (says to seek the Dharma of the Four Brahma Pillars). The Four Brahma Pillars are the Four Immeasurable Minds. The Four Immeasurable Minds are love, compassion, joy, and equanimity, and can purify your mind. If it is a dharma weapon of the Sravaka Vehicle, or a dharma weapon of the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle, then that person practices the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle, or practices the Sravaka Vehicle, and will be able to escape suffering. Therefore, for the type of Bhikkhus who are not in the path, that is, the monks who are in the wrong path, the Buddha has created such skillful means to receive them.

“If one lacks the Bodhisattva Jāla virtue, the mocking mind will be destroyed, but the vehicle is not a dharma device” (If the Bodhisattva Jāla virtue and mocking mind are both corrupted, that person is not a dharma weapon in relation to the vehicles): The virtue is corrupted, but the mocking mind is also corrupted. It's the same for the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle, it's the same for the Shravaka Vehicle, it's the same for the Mahayana Buddha Dharma, that person is not a Dharma weapon. How to do this? The Buddha immediately praised that person and said the Dharma of almsgiving: Do many good deeds, give a lot. That is also another method of receiving life.

“If one has a corrupted Mahayana view, the precepts will not be destroyed” (If there is a corrupted Mahayana view, the precepts will not be destroyed), that is, even though the view is not right, that person will not break the precepts. Thus, the Tathagata, in order to protect that person, spoke about the dharma of dependent origination, causing that person to let go of evil views, causing that person to recognize the dharmas that arise from causes and conditions. “If you are present in the middle body, enter the Thanh Van Dharma, or Pratyekabuddha Dharma, or with the residual body, the method of enlightenment” (In the present body, enter the Thanh Van Dharma, or the Pratyekabuddha Dharma, or from another body, you can be enlightened): This life is still not possible, only in the next life can you be enlightened. The fourth type is “precepts are destroyed, views are not destroyed”. As for “perishable precepts, indestructible views” and “perishable precepts, indestructible precepts” can be explained at the same time. Tathagata, in order to bring benefit to that person, immediately "talks about the dependent origination of dharma, the spirit of letting go of evil views" (talks about the dependent origination of dharma to make them abandon evil views). Either one has corrupted views and indestructible precepts, or one has corrupted precepts and indestructible views, both of which are similar; so there is no need to repeat it.

The view is destroyed, the holy dharma is destroyed, the heron does not become a gas. The Tathagata is selfish and persistent, preaching almsgiving. Weaknesses possessing the Bodhisattva Jāla, virtue, mockery, precepts, views are indestructible, children only have evil and forceful conduct, Tathagata is useful and persistent, expounding on the Ten Good Karmas. Weaknesses of Bodhisattva Jāla, although wearing clothes is only good and has force, but accepting is stupid, because it is like a yang, unable to receive good and bad dharmas. The Tathagata, for his own benefit and stubbornness, preaches and recites. Weak species are greedy, sick, and oppressed, while good species are deluded by ants and beasts, Tathagata's benefits are like the same, the one seeking liberation, the one who opens the world of birth and death, enjoys the Sravakayana's Four Noble Truths. The author of the Cessation of Views explains the dependent origination of dharmas. The author of Constant Views, who preaches the three worlds, beings, animals, death, and rebirth, is like the Taoist cycle of endless return and impermanence.
For the sake of that person, the Tathagata praises and says alms. If he has the virtue of the Buddha, his morality, precepts, and views are not destroyed, just because he points to the power of his evil actions, the Tathagata praises and speaks the Ten Virtuous Karmas. If he has the power of his good deeds, he is stupid like a dumb goat, unable to receive good and bad dharmas for the benefit of that person. If there is a person suffering from all kinds of greed Persecuted and confused by the views, the Tathagata, for the sake of those seeking liberation, immediately revealed the Four Noble Truths to them so that they can escape the path of birth and death according to the Shravaka Vehicle. For those who accept the Commentary on Dependent Origination, for the sake of those who accept the Commentary on Dependent Origination, he said that existence, paths in the three worlds, death here, birth there, are like a potter's wheel that rotates endlessly, impermanent, etc.)

“If one has Bodhisattva Gia La, precepts and precepts will be destroyed, the holy dharma will not become a weapon” (If one has Bodhisattva Gia La and views are destroyed, that person will not become a dharma weapon in regard to the holy dharma): Then the Buddha will speak alms for that person, making it possible for that Bo Da La to be able to receive it. help.

“If you have the Bodhisattva Ka La virtue, the derisive mind, precepts, and views are not destroyed” (If you have the Bodhisattva Gia La virtue, the derisive mind, precepts, and views are not destroyed), the moral conduct is also indestructible, the mocking mind is also indestructible, the precepts are also indestructible, and the views are also indestructible. Isn't that very good? But that person has evil friends, corrupt people form gangs, rely on the strength of evil friends, follow evil friends, and they are ruined! For example, Ananda's brother, Devadatta, wasn't his body doomed to hell? He enticed five hundred monks to separate from the Sangha, and those five hundred monks followed him to destroy the harmony of the Sangha. Those five hundred Bhikkhus' views were also incorruptible, their precepts were also incorruptible, their mockery was also incorruptible, but following evil friends, they committed the sin of Icchantika, their faith was not complete!

“If the Bodhisattva Jāla is weak, although it only refers to good deeds with the force of virtue, it is stupid” (If there is the Bodhisattva Jāla, although it still refers to the strength of good conduct, it is stupid): This type is the opposite. There is a type that follows a good friend, but is too stupid, doesn't know anything, can't preach the Dharma, and can't clearly distinguish the meaning, just like a dumb goat. Dumb goats cannot speak. The Buddha used a dumb goat to illustrate that a person does not understand the Buddhadharma at all, nor can he accept what is good dharma or what is bad dharma, and is a monk like a dumb goat.

“ Weakness is due to the race of greed, illness, and oppression, and status is due to the race of ants and deluded beasts. The Tathagata is as beneficial as the market, seeking liberation, the one who at the time opens the vision of birth and death, enjoys the Sravakayana of the Four Noble Truths” (If there are people who are oppressed by all kinds of diseases and greed, there are people who are bewitched by all kinds of knowledge. Tathagata for the benefit Those who seek liberation like that, then for them the teaching of the Four Noble Truths to escape the path of birth and death according to the Shravaka Vehicle) is the dharma of Suffering, Origin, Cessation, and the Path. There are ten types of Bo Dat Gia La. In the eighth type, the ninth and tenth types are mentioned, without mentioning each [separately] at all. That's sometimes said together, sometimes said separately, just follow the scriptures, you'll know right away when you look at it.

For “The person who follows the Commentary on the Perpetual View, he talks about the dependent origination of dharma. The person who follows the Commentary on the Perpetual View, teaches that the three worlds, sentient beings, animals, death, and rebirth” [that is] if for those who follow the Commentary on the Commentary on the Perpetual View, they say the dharma is impermanent, that is: Because [the follower of] the Commentary on the Commentary on the View says that it is over. All things, that is, mountains, rivers, and earth, are immutable and exist forever. People who die will be reborn again. Even though it is life and death, death and death, death and death, life and life, that person still thinks it is eternal. Or for longevity, hope to live a thousand years. These are sentient beings according to the Eternal View. They see all things as indestructible, so their greed increases. But that is a mistake, the three worlds are all impermanent!

Buddha gave an example of “tao gia luan” (a potter's wheel). To make porcelain, there is a wheel (turntable), put the pottery on it, it will rotate like that to mold. [That wheel] moves continuously, [using this object as an example] there is no permanent dharma to achieve. Use this to visualize impermanence.

(Sutra) Good man! Tathagata has no theory, no name, speech, sound, no resultant, no stage of maturity in sentient beings. Trying and slandering Tathagata's teachings of the true Dharma must be a crime, destroying sentient beings' true Dharma, and committing the sin of Void Intercepts. Those who rely on the ego, desire, and benefit of all sentient beings preach the true dharma, those who follow the Shravaka Vehicle preach the true dharma, or those who follow the Pratyekabuddha preach the true dharma, or those who follow the Mahayana preach the true dharma, slander, criticize, hinder, hide, and chant the dharma, are known to blaspheme the true dharma, those who destroy the Noble Eightfold Path, and those who destroy the true dharma of all sentient beings. Like the shi chi, the character practices the great unprofitable conduct, the heron spirit necessarily practices the great unprofitable conduct. If you only care about the Sangha, you will slander the Tathagata's Dharma.
(Sutra: Good man! Tathagata has nothing to say, names, words, sounds are all is Emptiness, no reality, nothing that is not aimed at making sentient beings mature. Therefore, all the sins of destroying the Dharma spoken by the Tathagata, damaging the eyes of sentient beings, are immeasurably more serious sins such as the sin of Non-Continuity, or similar crimes of Non-Continuity, etc. If someone regards the Dharma that I have mentioned to benefit all sentient beings, that is, the Dharma that has been said is based on the Sravakayana, the Dharma that has been said is based on the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle, or the Dharma that has been said is based on the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle. If the dharma is based on the Mahayana, defaming, hindering, obstructing, hiding, even just a single chant, you should know that [that sin] will be called destroying the true Dharma, also called destroying the Noble Eightfold Path, also called destroying the eyes of all sentient beings Hybrid like that).

The names, words and sounds spoken by the Tathagata are all empty, without reality. “No result” means there is no reality, it is all emptiness. Therefore, the appearance of names, words, and sounds are all false, like dreams, illusions, bubbles, and shadows. To say it is Empty, “no result” means there is no reality. “There is no level of maturity for sentient beings” (There is no difference for the maturation of sentient beings): The goal is to help sentient beings achieve enlightenment, for this purpose!

“ Trying to absolutely slander the Tathagata's teachings of the Dharma, destroying sentient beings' eyes of the Dharma, is the sin of the Indeterminate Ones, like the Infinite, level, immeasurable serious crime" (Therefore, all the crimes of slandering the True Dharma as mentioned by the Tathagata, destroying the Dharma eyes of sentient beings, are even more serious than countless serious sins such as the sin of the Indeterminate Dharma. Cockroaches, or similar crimes like Vo Cockroaches, etc.): If you blaspheme the Dharma like that, you will commit a very great crime. Destroying the Dharma as mentioned by the Tathagata will be the same as destroying the Dharma eyes of sentient beings. That is called "committing the crime of destroying the Dharma". Compared to the sins of the world, up to and including crimes similar to the Infinite, countless sins, the crime of destroying the Dharma is the greatest. This is the answer to Vajragarbha Bodhisattva's doubts.

(Kinh) Phục thứ, thiện nam tử! Hữu tứ chủng Tăng, hà đẳng vi tứ? Nhất giả, thắng nghĩa Tăng. Nhị giả, thế tục Tăng. Tam giả, á dương Tăng. Tứ giả, vô tàm quý Tăng. Vân hà danh thắng nghĩa Tăng? Vị Phật Thế Tôn, nhược chư Bồ Tát Ma Ha Tát chúng, kỳ đức tôn cao, ư nhất thiết pháp, đắc tự tại giả, nhược Độc Thắng Giác, nhược A La Hán, nhược Bất Hoàn, nhược Nhất Lai, nhược Dự Lưu. Như thị thất chủng Bổ Đặc Già La, thắng nghĩa Tăng nhiếp. Nhược chư hữu tình, đới tại gia tướng, bất thế tu phát, bất phục ca-sa, tuy bất đắc thọ nhất thiết xuất gia biệt giải thoát giới, nhất thiết yết-ma, bố-tát, tự tứ, tất giai giá khiển, nhi hữu thánh pháp, đắc thánh quả cố, thắng nghĩa Tăng nhiếp. Thị danh thắng nghĩa Tăng. Vân hà danh thế tục Tăng? Vị thế tu phát, bị phục ca-sa, thành tựu xuất gia biệt giải thoát giới. Thị danh thế tục Tăng. Vân hà danh á dương Tăng? Vị bất liễu tri căn bản đẳng tội, phạm dữ bất phạm, bất tri khinh trọng, hủy phạm chủng chủng tiểu tùy, tiểu tội, bất tri phát lộ sám hối sở phạm, xuẩn ngu, lỗ độn, ư vi tiểu tội bất kiến, bất úy, bất y thông minh thiện sĩ nhi trụ, bất thời thời gian, vãng nghệ đa văn, thông minh giả sở thân cận, thừa sự, diệc bất sổ sổ cung kính thỉnh vấn: “Vân hà vi thiện? Vân hà bất thiện? Vân hà hữu tội? Vân hà vô tội? Tu hà vi diệu? Tác hà vi ác?” Như thị nhất thiết Bổ Đặc Già La, á dương Tăng nhiếp. Thị danh á dương Tăng. Vân hà danh vô tàm quý Tăng? Vị nhược hữu tình, vị hoạt mạng cố, quy y ngã pháp, nhi cầu xuất gia. Đắc xuất gia dĩ, ư sở thọ trì biệt giải thoát giới, nhất thiết hủy phạm, vô tàm, vô quý, bất kiến, bất úy hậu thế khổ quả, nội hoài hủ bại, như uế oa loa, bối âm cẩu hạnh, thường háo hư ngôn, tằng vô nhất thật, xan tham, tật đố, ngu si, kiêu mạn, ly tam thắng nghiệp, tham trước lợi dưỡng, cung kính, danh dự, đam miện lục trần, háo nhạo dâm dật, ái dục, sắc, thanh, hương, vị, xúc cảnh. Như thị nhất thiết Bổ Đặc Già La, vô tàm Tăng nhiếp, hủy báng chánh pháp. Thị danh vô tàm quý Tăng.
(Kinh: Lại này, thiện nam tử! Có bốn loại Tăng, những gì là bốn? Một là thắng nghĩa Tăng. Hai là thế tục Tăng. Ba là Tăng dê câm. Bốn là Tăng không hổ thẹn. Thế nào là thắng nghĩa Tăng? Tức là Phật Thế Tôn, hoặc là các vị Bồ Tát Ma Ha Tát đức hạnh tôn quý, cao cả, được tự tại trong hết thảy các pháp, hoặc là Độc Thắng Giác, hoặc A La Hán, hoặc Bất Hoàn, hoặc Nhất Lai, hoặc Dự Lưu. Bảy loại Bổ Đặc Già La như thế thuộc vào thắng nghĩa Tăng. Nếu các hữu tình mang hình tướng tại gia, chẳng cạo râu tóc, chẳng đắp ca-sa, tuy chẳng được thọ hết thảy các biệt giải thoát giới của hàng xuất gia, hết thảy các pháp yết-ma, bố-tát, tự tứ đều bị cấm dự, bị đuổi ra, nhưng người ấy có thánh pháp. Do đắc thánh quả, nên thuộc về thánh nghĩa Tăng. Đó gọi là thắng nghĩa Tăng. Thế nào là thế tục Tăng? Tức là cạo bỏ râu tóc, khoác đắp ca-sa, thành tựu biệt giải thoát giới của hàng xuất gia. Đó gọi là thế tục Tăng. Thế nào Tăng dê câm? Tức là đối với các tội căn bản, chẳng biết rõ có phạm hay chẳng phạm, chẳng biết nặng hay nhẹ, hủy phạm đủ thứ tiểu tùy[2], tiểu tội, chẳng biết phơi bày, sám hối các tội đã phạm, ngu xuẩn, thô lỗ, đần độn, chẳng thấy, chẳng sợ các tội nhỏ nhặt, chẳng nương theo bậc thiện sĩ thông minh để trụ, chẳng thường luôn đến chỗ bậc đa văn, thông minh để thân cận, phụng sự, cũng chẳng nhiều lượt cung kính thưa hỏi: “Thế nào là thiện? Thế nào là bất thiện? Thế nào là có tội? Thế nào là vô tội? Tu pháp gì là tốt nhất? Làm điều gì là ác?” Hết thảy Bổ Đặc Già La như thế thuộc loại Tăng dê câm. Đó là Tăng dê câm. Thế nào là Tăng không hổ thẹn? Tức là nếu có hữu tình vì để nuôi thân mà quy y pháp của ta, cầu xuất gia. Đã được xuất gia, đối với biệt giải thoát giới đã thọ, bèn hủy phạm hết thảy, chẳng hổ, chẳng thẹn, chẳng thấy, chẳng sợ khổ quả trong đời sau, lòng ôm ấp những điều thối nát như con ốc sên dơ bẩn, hành theo hạnh của chó, thường ham chuộng lời rỗng tuếch, chẳng nói một điều nào chân thật, keo kiệt, tham lam, ganh ghét, ngu si, kiêu mạn, lìa ba nghiệp thù thắng, tham đắm lợi dưỡng, cung kính, danh dự, đắm đuối sáu trần, ưa chuộng dâm dật, ái dục, và cảnh thanh, hương, vị, xúc. Hết thảy Bổ Đặc Già La như thế thuộc loại Tăng không hổ thẹn, hủy báng chánh pháp. Đó gọi là Tăng không hổ thẹn).

“Phục thứ, thiện nam tử! Hữu tứ chủng Tăng” (Lại này, thiện nam tử! Có bốn loại Tăng): Kinh văn chẳng nói đến loại Tăng kéo bè, kết đảng. “Hà đẳng vi tứ? Nhất giả, thắng nghĩa Tăng. Nhị giả, thế tục Tăng. Tam giả, á dương Tăng. Tứ giả, vô tàm quý Tăng” (Những gì là bốn? Một là thắng nghĩa Tăng. Hai là thế tục Tăng. Ba là Tăng dê câm. Bốn là Tăng không hổ thẹn). Thắng nghĩa Tăng là gì? “Vị Phật Thế Tôn, nhược chư Bồ Tát Ma Ha Tát chúng, kỳ đức tôn cao, ư nhất thiết pháp đắc tự tại giả” (Tức là Phật Thế Tôn, hoặc các vị Bồ Tát Ma Ha Tát đức hạnh tôn quý, cao cả, được tự tại trong hết thảy các pháp), đó là Thắng Nghĩa Tăng. “Nhược Độc Thắng Giác, nhược A La Hán” (Hoặc là Độc Thắng Giác, hoặc A La Hán), [Độc Thắng Giác] tức là Độc Giác, A La Hán là Vô Sanh. “Nhược Bất Hoàn” tức là Tam Quả Bất Hoàn (A Na Hàm, Anāgāmin). “Nhược Nhất Lai” là Nhị Quả (Tư Đà Hàm, Sakṛdāgāmin). “Nhược Dự Lưu” là thánh nhân Sơ Quả (Tu Đà Hoàn, Srotāpanna). Tu Đà Hoàn, A Na Hàm, Tư Đà Hàm, và A La Hán là quả Tứ Thánh Đế. Lại còn thêm Phật, Bồ Tát, và Độc Giác, tổng cộng bảy loại Bổ Đặc Già La. Phật cũng là một loại chúng sanh. Trong bảy loại Bổ Đặc Già La, Phật, Bồ Tát, Duyên Giác là ba loại, lại còn bốn quả, tức Sơ Quả, Nhị Quả, Tam Quả, và Tứ Quả, là bảy loại Bổ Đặc Già La. Bảy loại này đều thuộc vào Thắng Nghĩa Tăng.

“If sentient beings have the appearance of a lay person” (If sentient beings have the appearance of a lay person), even though they have not yet become a monk, their mind has become a monk, their body has not yet become a monk, “cannot cultivate, cannot obey ca-sa” (does not shave hair, does not apply ka-sa). Even though he has not yet received the liberation precepts of a monk, he is not allowed to participate in all the Dhammas of the Dharma, the Bodhisattva, and the four teachings. That is “control, control” (, prevent, expel [not allow participation]). “There is a holy dharma” (But there is a holy dharma), at home there are also people who attain the supreme state. This type of person also belongs to the category of Thang Nghia Tang. If a layperson attains the state of victory, he is also called Thang Nghia Sangha. "Van ha name of secular Sangha? The position of cultivating, being subdued by ca-sa, achieving renunciation of the monastic world of liberation, gaining the name of secular Sangha" (What is secular Sangha? That is, shaving off the hair and beard, achieving the worldly liberation of monastics is called secular Sangha): Because it does not attain victory, it is called secular Sangha.

What is Sangha like a dumb goat? It is not clear whether basic crimes have been committed or not! Regarding the basic precepts, that person does not know what is a violation and what is not a violation. What is Pham like? In each precept, there are all five conditions, such as the precept of killing: Killing, killing, killing, killing karma (the cause of killing, the way to kill, the conditions that help the killing karma to be accomplished, the karma of killing), until the end of life. “End of life” means killing, that is “crime”. If life has not ended, but there is a cause for killing, meaning we want to kill that person, but there is also a predestined relationship, such as a knife, using an object [to kill], then it is called predestined fate. Killing karma is thinking about the method, that is, thinking about how to kill, either using a knife to cut, or shooting, or using a gun to shoot to death. Create that karma, even think of every possible way. If the subject is killed, you immediately commit this crime. Without these things, if there is a lack of conditions, sin cannot be committed. You must study, if you don't study you won't know. Dumb goat monks do not learn, they do not know what is transgression and what is not transgression, that is called “Dumb goat monk”. That person doesn't learn, and can't tell others!

What is shameful Sangha? For the sake of his life, that person saw that the monk's bowl of rice was too easy to eat, so he came to eat the monk's rice. Even though that person took refuge in Buddhism, after becoming a monk, he also received the precepts of liberation, but all of them were transgressed. That person basically doesn't think about becoming a monk, so all the precepts are broken. If you commit a crime, you don't repent, "no shame, no shame" (no shame, no shame), even thinking that you did the right thing, and you don't see the consequences of suffering in the next life. Internally rotten, “like filthy oa loa”, [meaning dirty] like a stuffed snail or slug, “bei yin dog conduct” is to learn the conduct of a dog. Even though you have learned from dogs, you still speak loudly and tell lies. "Often likes false words, nothing is true" (Often likes false words, never speaks a word of truth): There is no truth in a single sentence, they are all lies.

“ Greedy, jealous, foolish, arrogant” (Greedy, jealous, foolish, arrogant): The three superior karmas of that person are all separated, [that is] for the three superior karmas of body, mouth, and mind, that person is completely separated. Arrogance, ignorance, greed, stinginess, all ten evils are committed. Also greedy for food, respect, honor, greed for the six senses, that is, the realm of the six senses of form, sound, scent, taste, touch, and dharma, not giving up anything. “Desire for lust” (Desire for lust): “Desire for lust” is just asking for enjoyment. To put it simply, “desire, sight, sound, scent, taste, tangible sights. Such as necessarily Bodhisattva Jāla, shameless Sangha, slandering the true Dharma. Tin the name of shameless monks” (desires, sights, sounds, scents, tastes, tactile sights. All Bodakāgaāla like that belong to the type of Sangha who is not ashamed, slandering the Dharma. That is the Sangha without shame. shy).

(Sutra) Good man! To overcome the meaning of the monks, whether in the middle or right, the heron defeats the path of the monks. Ngon Thang Taoist, the weak person follows the eight holy paths, self-sabotage must save the troubles, and the Hei Ling forgives. Try to convince? The Buddha, the World-Honored One, attaining Solitary Enlightenment, the Arhats, like the three races of Bodhisattva Jāla, are separated from all relatives and relatives, and are famous for the Supreme Path.
"Successful path" means that he can rely on the Noble Eightfold Path, overcome all the waters of afflictions, and also save others. How is this? That is, the Blessed One, and Pratyekabuddha, the Arhats, the three types of Bodhisattvas like that have left their relatives, so they are called the Noble Path).

There are four types of monks, plus the type of monks who form groups, forming five types. Because Vajragarbha Bodhisattva asked the Buddha: - Previously, the Buddha said that an impure monk who breaks the precepts is like a dead body in the ocean, thrown out into the sea of ​​Buddhas. All the benefits of the Sangha are not shared with that person, nor can that person have a share. Why did the Buddha still advise his disciples to make offerings and be compassionate towards that person?

The word “good man” here refers to Vajra Treasury Bodhisattva, the Buddha praised Vajra Treasury Bodhisattva. “Thang Nghia” refers to the superior path of monks. Thang Nghia is included in the Shramana path; That's Thang Nghia. “The Supreme Path” includes several types, which type will be the superior Sangha? Simply put, it will be based on the superior path to achieve results. Buddha, World-Honored One, Pratyekabuddha, Sravaka, i.e. Pratyekabuddha and Sravaka, Sravaka is Arahant, those three types of Bodakāra are all Bodakāra sentient beings. Buddha is also a type of Bodhisattva Jāla. They put an end to the afflictions of Thought and Thought. The afflictions are not their relatives. “The Beings” are all afflictions, a total of twenty-five Beings[3] in the three worlds. These things belong to the noun Dharma Form; Here we talk about three types. They have all left afflictions, so they are called Thang Dao monks!

(Sutra) Resurrecting the Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas, without any other conditions, with the absolute knowledge of the unobstructed view of the dharma, Nhat receives benefits and benefits for all sentient beings, and the name of the heron wins the path of the monk. Ky wins the meaning of the Sangha, meets the secular Sangha, whether in the middle or right, the heron market leads the monks. The weak one achieves the world of liberation, the truth and goodness are born differently, he is determined to have the right view of the world, he is willing to change the force of his teachings, he is able to widely and altruistically preach, and to reveal the holy Dharma. If you know like Bo Dac Gia La, the most famous monks are listed as monks. CEnlightenment of the Attainment of the Sutra-Buddhist Fruit of Jāla, the third name CAchieving the Once-returning fruit of the Bicada-Buddhist Jāla, the third name. CCof attaining the Non-Returning Fruit of the Bicada-Buddhist Jāla, the third name four. four. Resurrect the Bodhisattva Mahasattva, the fifth place. Vremains in the First Ground, even the Tenth Ground, until he abides in the ultimate body, testing the stage of the monkhood. If you are weak, you will achieve the emancipation of the precepts, follow the principles of action, be pure and complete, and test the life of a monk. The way of living is the way of life, the way of trying to be famous is the way of life.
(Sutra: There are also Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas who, without relying on conditions, see everything for their wisdom All dharmas are unobstructed and benefit all sentient beings. They are also called "belonging to the superior path of monks". Among the superior monks and secular monks, there are also people who can belong to the category of monks who teach the teachings. If they have the true and good birth and achieve the dharma of liberation, until they have complete right view of the world, they will be able to speak the Dharma according to the wishes of the person who hears the Dharma, and will be able to declare it for others. preach and expound the holy path. You should know that Bodhisattva Mahasattva is called the lowest class of monks. Bodhisattva Mahasattva who attains Stream-entry is called the second one. Bodhisattva Mahasattva who attains the stage of One-return is called the fourth. There are also Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas who are called the fifth, that is, those who reside from the First Stage to the Tenth Stage, up to those who dwell in the ultimate body. belongs to the category of monks. If anyone achieves the dharma of liberation, follows the correct rules, and is completely pure, then those people belong to the category of monks because they use the path to maintain their lives, so it is called the path of monks.

“Bodhisattvas Mahasattvas do not rely on other conditions” (Bodhisattvas Mahasattvas do not rely on other conditions): When Bodhisattvas create benefits for sentient beings, although they have not yet attained enlightenment, in terms of attainment, they are not equal to Sravakas, not equal to Pratyekabuddhas, but in terms of benefiting sentient beings, they are surpass Thanh Van, surpass Doc Giac. There are also those who have great power manifested, He has attained it, returned to manifest, or manifested as ordinary people. “Not dependent on other conditions” (Not relying on other conditions): They are not like other monks, and sometimes they do not become monks. Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas are not necessarily all monks, there are also lay Bodhisattvas. In all dharmas, they can see "Emptiness and Existence are not two", realize the Middle Way, wisdom has the Basic Wisdom, but also the Later Knowledge. Hau Dac Tri is skillful means.

Therefore, they are right knowledge, right view, beneficial beings are not hindered, in Wisdom there are no obstacles. Their purpose is to take care of all sentient beings and save sentient beings. More than half of Bodhisattvas manifest their status as lay people, because they have to save sentient beings. They do not think about themselves, but always think about all sentient beings. Everyone who reads the Samantabhadra Vows, or reads the Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara) Samantabhadra, will see [the Bodhisattvas] becoming Buddhas to save sentient beings, praying for all sentient beings to become Buddhas. That also belongs to the supreme path of monks.

In addition, there is also the superior meaning of Sangha and secular Sangha. The secular Sangha has not yet attained enlightenment, in this world, which includes the First Fruit, the Second Fruit (the Second Fruit still has to return to the world), the Three Fruits do not return to the world, those positions all belong to the secular Sangha. Only when one attains Arahantship is one called Thang Nghia Sangha. Normally speaking, in the Shravaka teachings, according to the A Ham Sutra and the Cau Xa commentary, a person who has attained the First Fruition is considered a saint. Here, [the main scripture] separates to say, other positions belong to Thang Nghia Sangha and Secular Sangha.

There are also “shaman-instructors of photography” (belonging to the type of monk-instructors). “Visible path” is like the Buddha preaching to a group of living beings, either showing Suffering, Origin, Cessation, and the Path, or showing the dharma of the twelve causes and conditions, or showing the Six Paramitas, that is, [showing] the dharmas of the three vehicles. He did not speak in isolation, but only in general. That is the path of a monk, belonging to the good aspect. There are also those who have achieved the dharma of liberation. “True goodness arises differently” is the true goodness of the Bodhisattva Jāla, a sentient being who has achieved liberation, but is not necessarily a monk. “Different birth” means using the dharma to live, from the dharma to transform birth. “Different birth” is explained like that, that is, having been truly liberated, that person can achieve liberation. There are also people who achieve the precepts of liberation. The Particular Liberation Precepts of the good beings are the two hundred and fifty precepts of the Bhikkhu, which are the Particular Liberation Precepts (separate Particular Liberation Precepts)[4]. If you keep one precept, you will be partially liberated. If you keep another precept, you will be partially liberated. That is also considered “other good birth”.

“Truth and goodness” means “liberation”. Even those who have not yet received the Complete Precepts, but have right knowledge and right view. Full of right knowledge, right view, unerring knowledge, knowing that all dharmas are impermanent, knowing that all dharmas are suffering, all dharmas are not self, all dharmas are empty. That is called the Four Dharma Seals. All dharmas are the only True General, that is called “the one true realm”, called “the seal of the dharma”. Using this to confirm, having that kind of knowledge, will be right knowledge, right view. That person seeks to attain Emptiness in Prajna wisdom, but does not fall into the Cessation of Emptiness. He shows that all dharmas exist but does not fall into the Eternal View. That is called right view.

“Arising from crazy views” (Arising from crazy views). That person has the ability to distinguish between right and wrong. Currently, in real life, there are many people who also speak Buddhism; In fact, they still use pagan viewpoints to explain, which are not in accordance with the Buddha's teachings. Such a person does not belong to the category of monks. Does that person have complete Right View or not? Is that person's words Right Speech? Is it consistent with the Buddha's teachings? We must also consider whether that person's verbal karma includes bad language, rude speech, profanity, lying, double-talk or not? Without those things, it is Right Speech. If you have those things, it will not be Right Speech. There are people who have become monks in body but have not become monks in their mind, their greed is still very heavy. That person pretends to be a Buddhist, but what he does is not Buddhism, what he shows is only for himself, for his own five desires, for his own desire for enjoyment.

To give an example, building a pagoda of immeasurable merit, everyone knows, but we must consider what mind that person uses as the driving force. If the mind of fame and profit is the main focus, even if you build a pagoda, there is no merit! As long as that temple exists, that person's karma will forever exist. That temple is destroyed, that person's karma is also destroyed. If one falls into predestined relationships and uses all kinds of dishonest means, even if one builds a pagoda, if one dies, one will definitely fall into hell! Wait until that temple is completely gone, then that karma will be eliminated. That type of pagoda is not necessarily inhabited by monks. There are temples built, but there are no monks in them. Even though it is a lay ashram, it is still not considered a lay person, because the views are not right views. We must rely on wisdom to judge whether this is right knowledge or right view or not! We must rely on ourselves to rely on the teachings to confirm whether it is in accordance with the Buddha's teachings or not, and we will know whether that knowledge is the right view or not.

“Belgian due to the theory of transformation and force of manifestation” (that person, due to the theory of force of manifestation and transformation): The force of transformation and manifestation is magical power. That person attains the Other Mind, so he has a complete type of wisdom, [that is, has the ability] to clearly see what kind of dharma should be spoken about to what kind of living beings [to suit their wishes and preferences], and then reveals that dharma to them (that ability is called “theory”). These things all belong to the category of “theory of force-transformation” . That type of Bodhisattva Jāla [because it has not attained sainthood, so] is the lowest type of monk. What kind of monk is this type of monk? Next, [the main sutra] then clearly points out: “Attesting to the Fruit of Stream Stream in the Bodhisattva Jāla”, the Fruit of Stream Stream is the Initial Fruition. The Saint of First Fruits is Sotapanna. He still has to have seven births and deaths in the heavens or the human world before he can attain Arahantship and will not regress. That is to say, cutting off the eyes, ears, nose, tongue, body, mind, eyes seeing colors, ears hearing sounds, tongue knowing tastes, nose smelling fragrances, odors, body contact, mind discrimination. The eighty-eight pieces of History belonging to Kien Or are finished. To enter the Stream is to join the lineage of saints. This type of sentient beings of the Bodhisattva Jāla is higher than the previous type, which also means that it must be a little higher than the type of “mythology” that promotes the Buddha Dharma. They do not belong to the category of Thang Nghia Sangha, they are only monks.

“Attesting to the Third Fruit of the First Return” (The third fruit of Bodhisattva to attain the First Return is called the third): The third fruit also returned to the human world once, that is, to be reborn in the heavenly world or the human world again, only to be reborn once, he immediately attained the Four Fruits of Arhat, called the fruit of Tu Da. Ham. Bodika Jāla attaining the fruit of Non-Complete is called the fourth. Unreturning is not being born again in the human world, which is called Ana Ham fruit. He has ended the third level of Thinking and Ordination, but still cannot cut off habits, still cannot cut off ignorance. That's called the fourth type.

“The Bodhisattva Mahasattva Mahasattva is called fifth” (There are also Bodhisattva Mahasattvas, called fifth): Depending on the four or five teachings to judge the meaning of the teachings. Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat refers to the Teachings. [The five teachings are] Tieu, Thi, Chung, Don, Vien. [Bodhisattvas mentioned in this passage are] Bodhisattvas in the Small, Early, and General Teachings, because in the next section, it will be mentioned [Bodhisattvas] from the First Level to the Ten Levels, who are also the ultimate bodies. Compared to the attainment of Arhat, [Traditional Bodhisattva] reaches the Seven Grounds equal to Arhat. The Complete Teaching is not like that, the First Pillar Bodhisattva in the Complete Teaching is like that (has attained the level of Arhat). These types of Bodhisattvas are all called monks of the path. A monk who himself has right knowledge, right view, and has understood the Buddha Dharma, he can also benefit sentient beings and help them understand.

“Achieve the precepts of liberation”, with regard to the pure precepts that have been accepted, the person does not violate them, even in doing everything he accepts the rules taught by the Buddha to act. That rule includes all things that should be done and will be done. There are two types of Buddhist precepts: One is Discipline, which means things that cannot be done. There is also Tac Tri, which is what you should do. For example, say a Bhikkhu commits a mistake, everyone must perform the dharma of clearing-ma for him, the Sangha must perform the dharma of clearing-ma, that is called “advocacy” (performing work). What should be done must be done. In temples and pagodas, there are responsibilities that must be shouldered and must be carried out. The contents of Tac Tri are many, all of which are things that monks should do. That's called “rule”.

Buddhism came to China. Zen Master Bach Truong of China established the Thanh Quy Precepts for China, because there were so many people in temples and shrines that it was impossible to follow Buddha's regulations to implement them. Because in our country, there are differences in living situations, so He established a separate Code of Precepts. It's like we wear formal clothes and go to the main hall every morning and night to recite public prayers. When the Buddha was in the world, there was no morning or night practice. Zen Master Bach Truong quoted Mahayana mantras and scriptures, such as waking up in the morning and reciting the Shurangama mantra, in the evening worshiping the Eighteen Eight Buddhas (ie the Red Names of Repentance), or reciting the Amitabha Sutra. That is the light and dark practice, it all belongs to the rules, it all belongs to the precepts.

“Export phase” [5], sweep the land, go to the mountains to cultivate. During the Buddha's lifetime, farming was not allowed because it would harm living beings. [Buddhism] spread to our country, it is impossible not to do so. Because the temples and pagodas are all in the mountains, you don't grow crops yourself, so what do you eat? During Buddha's time in the world, he also established a number of rules. As long as the rules have been set, down to the precepts and restrictions, the things that should be done are done very well, then "pure and complete" will be achieved. That is called “the life of a monk”, that is, using the religion as one's life.

What is not approved is medicine, fortune-telling, and fortune-telling. Now is the time of the end of the Dharma, a monk being a doctor is still very good, very noble, but in Buddhist precepts it is not allowed, it is called "making a living by living wrongly". There are five types of wrong livelihood. [If you say so, surely someone will argue] Isn't the Champa Sutra wrong livelihood? No! The Contemplation Sutra is specifically said by Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva for your cultivating the path. Therefore, when Kien Tinh Bodhisattva invited the Buddha to preach the Dharma, he asked the Buddha: "Dharma-ending beings have especially heavy doubts in their minds. How can we eliminate doubts for living beings?" The Buddha immediately invited Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva to speak, but he himself did not say anything. Because the Buddha has regulated the precepts, that is not allowed! Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva became skillful in means, because he had reached “the one true realm, the two paths of contemplation”. When using Chiem Sat Luan, don't be skeptical. If you use that method to seek fame and fortune, or to read fortunes for others to get money, it will be a violation of the precepts and not allowed! The main purpose of the Contemplation Wheel is for you to contemplate and consider how much you have cut off greed, anger, and ignorance, and whether you are currently enlightened or not? Have you personally attained the status of the Five Products? If you don't know, then you should contemplate a little. Now can we practice two types of contemplation? Because according to the Contemplation Sutra, if when you [contemplate and see] the wheel form is not pure, it means you are not allowed to practice the two types of contemplation, and you will not practice successfully. If you practice, you can easily be relied on by demons. [The purpose of] the wheel of contemplation is to help you cut off demons. It's okay to understand this meaning! Therefore, those monks are all “following the path of monks”, that is, using the path as their life, so they are called “living path”.

(Sutra) To serve Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas, for the sake of receiving, benefiting, and bringing peace to all sentient beings, He seriously practiced Luc Dao Bi Ngan, the path of life and death. Such as the path of victory, the path of enlightenment, the path of life, the three types of monks, the true field of fame and fortune in the world. The monk's reputation is impure, although it is not true, he is destined to fall in the middle of the field of blessings.
All sentient beings, fully practice the Six Dao Bi Ngan, also called "the path of life". These three types of monks, the superior path, the path of life, and the path of life, are called "the world's true field of blessings".

Great Bodhisattva benefits sentient beings, makes all sentient beings enlightened, accepts them, transmits good things, and then they believe. As for giving alms, Bodhisattvas must also practice alms giving and compassion towards sentient beings. Be kind to them, work with them, do good things, do things that benefit them, they will be happy. Only then will you be able to take care of them and save them. One step further is to practice almsgiving, precepts, patience, Meditation, Six Virtues, all the way to Meditation and Prajna. This is also called “the way of life”. In the Mahayana and Hinayana, there is both a monk's path and a monk's path. All three vehicles have these types of monks.

“Like the superior path, the superior path, the three-fold path of life monks, the true worldly meritorious field of fame and fortune” (Such three types of monks, the superior path, the superior path, and the true path of life, are called the true path of merit in the world): Offerings to the monks of the path of enlightenment, the true path of monks, and the superior path That monk, of course, has even greater merit and virtue. These are all true fields of merit in the world.

“Bat residual monks” (Other monks), except for those three types, are all “poor path monks”. An evil monk is a monk who breaks the precepts, the precepts are not pure, or [does not comply with] the pure rules. They are impure towards the Three Jewels and are not genuine. Even though they are not genuine, the Buddha taught to still consider them as the blessed field of Sangha. Why? In the Dharma-Ending Age, the superior path of monks, the direct path of monks, and the life path of monks no longer exist. You have to choose among the poor paths of monks, so you still have to make offerings to them and still have to respect them. That is the answer to Vajragarbha Bodhisattva's question.

(Sutra) If you only have a mindless mind and precious monk Bo Da La, you are in the middle of the true Dharma of Bhikkhuni Da, The title of "corpse" is that of the sea, but it is a waste of energy, an illegal effort. I'm a bad person, I can't call myself a great master, I'm a bad person, I'm a disciple. Having no mind in the Sangha, not becoming a Dharma weapon, claiming the self as a teacher, claiming the self as a relic, recreating an image of the self, giving rise to deep faith. I love the Dharma, the Sangha, the holy world of love, and the heron with deep faith. Do not accept evil views, don't let evil spirits accept evil views, always generously and altruistically proclaim the Dharma, praise, praise, never destroy and slander, always make the right vows; Depending on the crime, forgive and repent, reveal many karmic obstacles, and eliminate them. If you know like Bo Dat Gia La, the power of believing in the Three Jewels of the Holy World, you will overcome hundreds of thousands of thousands of pagans, and quickly enter Nirvana, the Holy King of Turning the Wheel will not be able to access, let alone any other sentient beings? Di Thi Nghia try, Tathagata contemplates all sentient beings, all dharma karma perceives the different characteristics of the dharma, and acts as it is said: "In the middle of the Dharma, the world eliminates the development, being caught by the false ca-sa, the self is not hearing, the Sat-de-benefit is equal to destruction and punishment. If the karma destroys the humiliation, the punishment must necessarily become a monk, planning the crime and retribution as previously preached."
Bhikkhuni Da in my Dharma, called "dead body", should be chased away and thrown away from the sea of pure Sangha, because [that person] is not a Dharma weapon. I do not consider him a great teacher, and he is not a disciple to me. There are monks who are not ashamed and do not become Dharma objects, calling me a teacher, and for my relics and image, I will have deep respect for the Dharma, Sangha and the precepts loved by the saints I, too, have developed deep reverence and faith. By not holding on to evil views, nor allowing others to hold on to evil views, you can widely proclaim my Dharma, praise it, not slander it, and often make righteous vows to renounce, reveal, and repent. Many karmas can be eliminated Although he cannot quickly enter the citadel of Nirvana, the Holy King of Chakravarti is still not comparable to that person. What's more, all sentient beings of other types? Because of this, the Tathagata contemplates all the different dharma karma of sentient beings and says this: "For those who are in my dharma, shave off their hair and beard, and wear ka-sar, I will not allow those like Kshatika, etc. to destroy them. humiliate and punish them. If anyone humiliates and punishes all monastics, they will be subject to retribution as mentioned in the previous section).

Although the monk is not ashamed of being a Dharma weapon, there is still some selection in it. Therefore, the saying "for the poor monks, one must also make offerings", contains such a meaning. Bo Dat Gia La is not ashamed, not ashamed of being someone who has violated the precepts, broken the precepts, but does not repent. Regarding the three vehicles, especially the precepts in the Vinaya of the true dharma, those people also do not practice. “Corpse” is the body of a dead person, the body is not yet rotten. In the ocean of pure mass, it cannot be contained. Those people will be expelled from the Sangha. Although those people are not magic weapons, there are people among them who have some good points. For those people, although they are not disciples of Buddha, there are monks who are not ashamed and still respect Buddha as teacher. Why? They still have deep reverence for the Buddha's relics and form, and for the Dharma "deep reverence" (also profound reverence). Although they are not ashamed and do not become Dharma objects, they still respect the Buddha as their teacher. For the Buddha's relics and form, they still have deep faith, for the precepts they have received, they still have deep faith, have deep and earnest faith and reverence.

What they say is still the true Dharma, helping you eliminate evil and perverse views, teaching you to eliminate Ego Clinging, teaching you to practice Emptiness, not being attached to all dharmas, being able to proclaim Buddha Dharma to all sentient beings, and also being able to “praising and praising, not being slandered, always developing righteousness. vow” (praising, praising, not slandering, always making true vows). After making a vow, “whenever you commit a crime, you will be completely forgiven” (whenever you commit a crime, you will hate it many times), and if you hate it, immediately repent. Because of hatred, there will be no more recidivism. Knowing that you shouldn't do it, you don't do it, but you can still repent, and many karmic obstacles can be eliminated. Although that person committed a lot of crimes and caused a lot of karma, thanks to repentance, he was purified and restored to purity.

First of all, let's talk about monks who are not ashamed. Next, we talk about monks who are not ashamed, should be expelled, have not become a Dharma weapon, but still have signs of repentance. Those monks are still much better than the ninety-five types of pagans, or compared to the secular world! Although at present, those people have not yet been able to attain Nirvana, have not yet been able to attain enlightenment, but their merit, virtue, and wisdom still exist. "The Holy King of Chakravarti is incomparable" (The Holy King of Chakravarti is still incomparable): Even if he is the Holy King of Chakravarti, his merit and wisdom are still not as great as the merit and wisdom of that monk. “What's more, all the other sentient beings” (Let alone all other sentient species)? Other sentient beings cannot compare.

Due to this principle, Tathagata knows the karma, dharma, and differences of all living beings, all sentient beings. It is impossible to say that all the generals are "in a nutshell". To put it in a "hands-on" way, monks who are not ashamed are all profane monks. But among the poor monks, there are still some good people. Every type of living being has an upper, middle, and lower level. In the poor path of monks, there are also high-class, middle-class, and low-class. For this reason, the Buddha said like this: "If the self is in the dharma, the world will eliminate the development, being falsely ca-sa, the self will not hear the Sat-de-loi and destroy humiliation and punishment" (I absolutely do not allow the Sat-de-loi, etc. to humiliate, punish anyone who is in my dharma, shave off hair and beard, put on the ca-sa robe), has such a meaning. Why did the Buddha not allow Kshatriya, the kings, to use worldly laws to punish them? Because they have shaved off their hair and beard, put on the ka-sa robe, and sowed merit and virtue, the appearance of that dharma field still exists. If you humiliate or reprimand them, [i.e. violate] all monastics, you will incur retribution as described in detail in the previous section, which is said a lot in the chapter Vo Y Hanh!

(Sutra) Obediently follow the Dharma, renounce worldliness, renounce the world, develop in the world, be chained-ca-sa, that is, the absolute position Buddhas of the past, future, and present compassionately protect the thoughts. The majesty, form, outfit of ca-sa, and heron represent the past, future, and present, compassionately guarded by the World-Honored Buddhas. Trying to ignore and destroy the world, except cultivating, will be chained to the monks and renunciants, that is, contempt and destruction of all past, future, and present Buddhas and World-Honored Ones. Due to the cause and effect of causes and conditions, wise beings, pitying all sufferings, happily seeking people, heavens, and Nirvana, are not satisfied with contempt and renunciation, except for cultivating and becoming false. Being a mindless Sangha, destroying the forbidden precepts, not achieving the three vehicles of sage and holy dharma, the character firmly clings to evil views,ddthe spiritual ability to accept evil views, the true good Kshatriya, the true brahmin, the true minister, the true layperson, the true monk, the true elder false, true good Phiet-xa, true good Thu-datta-la.
(Sutra: There are people who follow my Dharma, abandon the monastic custom, shave off hair and beard, apply ka-sar All the Buddhas of the past, future, and present will be protected by the compassionate thoughts. The majesty and form worn by the Buddhas will also be protected by the compassionate Buddhas of the past, future, and present. Therefore, to despise and slander a monk who shaves off his beard and hair and wears a red kasaya is to despise and slander all the Buddhas of the past, the future, and the present. Because of that cause, wise people are afraid of suffering and desire The joy of humanity, heaven, and Nirvana, should not be despised or slandered by those who renounce the world, shave off their beard and hair, wear the ka-sa robe. There are monks who are not ashamed, who break the precepts, who do not become the Dharma weapon of the three vehicles of the sages, who firmly grasp evil views, and can even cause others to cling to evil views, that is, for the sake of the true good Kshatriya, the true good Brahman, the true good official, the true good layperson, the true good. monk, the true good man, the true good Phiet-xa, the true good Thu-datta...)

Three Buddhas protect that ka-sa. The ka-sa plate is the form of the dharma-place of all Buddhas. For that reason, for those who have become monks, shave off their beards and hair, wear red kasayas, and do not allow lay people such as kings, ministers, Brahmins, etc. to persecute and humiliate them; On the contrary, you must make offerings to them. Because of that cause and effect, the Buddha said so, and also to answer Vajrayana Bodhisattva. Therefore, all those who want to seek blessings should not despise those who become monks. Regardless of whether that person breaks the precepts, you must still respect and make offerings to that person, then those people will be able to gain merit.

“There is a mindless Sangha, destroys the forbidden precepts, does not become a holy weapon of the three vehicles, the character firmly holds on to evil views, the magical power forgives evil views” (There are monks who are not ashamed, destroy the forbidden precepts, do not become a dharma weapon for the three vehicles of the sages and saints, have firmly grasped evil views, and can still causing others to accept evil views): That is evil knowledge. In the previous section, it was said that there are two types of evil monks. The first type is good (that is, the type that believes in Buddha, Dharma, Sangha, knows shame, repent, does not have evil views) and can still be close to and make offerings. This is about the bad kind. If there are good kings, that is, the true good king, the true Brahman, the true minister, the true layman. “True goodness” means they wish for liberation. Up to the true good of the rich man, the true good of Phiet-xa, the true good of Thu-datta-la, that is, the four types of nature.

(Sutra) Weak male, weak female, theory In this world, there is no father, no mother, no good karma, no evil karma to attain retribution, no ability to attain the holy path and fruition, and all dharmas cannot follow the cause of birth. Or if one clings to words, the Form Realm is permanent, and the Dharma does not change. Or there is an attachment to words, the Formless Realm is permanent, the dharma is non-changing and destructive. Or if you hold on to words, pagans will be able to follow the ascetic practices, and attain ultimate purity. Or if one clings to words, only the Shravaka Vehicle attains ultimate purity, not the Single Enlightenment Vehicle, and not the Mahayana. U Thanh Van Thua, reverence, praise, preaching, preaching. The Single Enlightened Vehicle, the Mahayana, defames, despises, defames, conceals, and is not allowed to publish. Or if one clings to words, only the Single Enlightened Vehicle attains the ultimate purity, non-Sravaka Vehicle, non-Mahayana. The Single Enlightenment Vehicle, reverence, praise, preaching, and enlightenment. The Thanh Van Vehicle, the Mahayana, defamation, contempt, defamation, concealment, unspiritual circulation. Or if there is attachment to words, there is only the Mahayana to attain ultimate purity, there is no Shravaka Vehicle, there is no Single Enlightenment Vehicle.
