U Mahayana dharma, characters for giving birth to faith, teachings for giving birth to faith, characters for reverence, teachings for respecting, characters for praise, teachings for others for praise, characters for description, teachings for others for writing, characters for single chanting, teachings for other chanting, characters for hearing life, teachings for hearing life, characters for thinking, teaching for others thinking, u tha sentient beings, weak vision dharma weapon, weak non dharma weapon, stage of expounding, revealing, explaining the subtle and profound meaning of Mahayana dharma. U Thanh Van Vehicle, up to the Single Enlightenment Vehicle, defamation, contempt, obscenity, concealment, non-spiritual release, self-not giving birth to faith, not-othering-giving-faith, self-not-respecting, not-other-respecting, self-not-revealing, not-other-revealing, self-not-scribbling, not-othering-spelling, self-not-lonely reciting, hearing feeling, thinking, not othering, single-reciting, hearing feeling, thinking, not ridiculing, expounding, explaining the meaning of the two vehicles of the Dharma.
(Sutra: Whether male or female, it says that the worlds have no father, no mother, until there is nothing to bear. Retribution due to good or bad karma, no one can attain the fruition of the holy path, all dharmas do not arise from causes. Or there are those who believe that the Formless Realm is not a permanent dharma, or there are those who believe that the Formless Realm is not a dharma that changes. Or there are those who believe that only the Sravakayana achieves ultimate purity, neither the Single Enlightenment Vehicle nor the Mahayana. For the Sravaka Vehicle, one must respect, praise, proclaim, and reveal. As for the Single-Enlightenment Vehicle, the Mahayana will slander, destroy, hinder, and not allow it to be transmitted. Or there are those who believe that only the Single-Enlightenment Vehicle can achieve ultimate purity, neither the Sravakayana nor the Mahayana hidden, not allowed to be transmitted. Or there are those who believe that only the Mahayana has achieved ultimate purity, not the Shravaka Vehicle, not the Single-Enlightenment Vehicle. Regarding the Mahayana dharma, one has given birth to faith, taught others to have faith, personally respected, taught others to respect, personally praised, taught others to praise, personally copied, taught others to copy, personally recited, taught others to recite, personally listened to, taught others to listen. accept, have thought for yourself, taught others to think. For other sentient beings, whether it is a Dharma weapon or not a Dharma weapon, it is for them to widely speak, reveal and explain the very subtle and profound Mahayana Dharma. For the Sravaka Vehicle and the Single Sense Vehicle, then slander, destroy, obstruct, hide, do not allow it to be spread, do not give rise to trust, prevent others from giving birth to faith, do not respect yourself, hinder others from respecting, do not praise and hinder yourself. afraid of others praising, not copying myself, hindering others from copying, not being able to recite, hear, receive, think, obstructing others from reading, listening, receiving, thinking, not liking to speak widely, explain, explain the Dharma of the Second Vehicle).

This passage talks about evil knowledge with very deep evil nature, very deep wrong views. The king, or the four types of nature seeking liberation, whether male or female, should not learn from those people, should not be close to those evil knowledge. How can those bad people, whether male or female, clearly distinguish their evil views? That person said the world has no father or mother. Nowadays, there are many disobedient people. That is not trusting parents, hurting parents, killing parents. Speaking like that, I'm afraid everyone has heard it, so we don't need to explain in detail. Nowadays, it is common to see the killing of one's father or mother. In the past very few; Currently, karma is getting heavier and heavier.

The argument that there is no cause and effect, [as for] "doing good will be rewarded with good, doing evil will be rewarded with evil", they don't believe it. Because they believe that "the dead is everything", they try their best to create evil, indulge in the five desires, and basically cannot become saints or attain enlightenment. That person thinks that it is deceitful and not truthful. That person believes that all dharmas do not originate from causes, have no cause and effect, and also say that the Form Realm is permanent, eternal and unchanging. Even if the Formless Realm is permanent, it will never change. Or they are attached to the ascetic practices of pagans, such as Brahmins practicing asceticism and swallowing fire, to Brahmins fasting, even bowing to cows and dogs, these are all [evil practices of] pagans, [yet] they say that thanks to those dharmas, they will be able to achieve ultimate purity.

Or there are those who are attached to it and say firmly that: Only the Shravaka Vehicle can achieve ultimate purity, but neither the Single Enlightenment Vehicle nor the Mahayana can. This is due to the attachment to the Shravaka Vehicle, so it slanders the Single Sense Vehicle and slanders the Mahayana. Either believe in the Single Enlightenment Vehicle; Therefore, he slanders the Thanh Van Vehicle, that is, that person is completely unequal to the three vehicle dharma. That person is attached to one vehicle and denies the other two. That person believes in the Thanh Van dharma and then slanders the dharma of cause and effect and slanders the Luc Do dharma. Therefore, the dharma of cause and effect and the Six Degrees will gradually be hidden. Or to say the opposite, that person is attached to the Single Enlightenment Vehicle, and also slanders the Thanh Van Vehicle and the Mahayana. Or that person has an attachment to the Mahayana, slanders the Shravaka Vehicle and the Single Enlightenment Vehicle, does not let others learn, and even causes those dharmas to be hidden and not allowed to spread.

Among the three vehicles, clinging to each other, slandering each other, whoever believes in the vehicle says that it is good, causing others to believe in that dharma, causing the disciples to also not believe in the other vehicles. That person believes [no matter how much] so he reveres; If you do not believe, you will blaspheme. That's how I teach myself, and that's how I teach others. That person himself proclaims that the Sravaka Vehicle is good, praises the Dharma belonging to the Sravaka Vehicle, the A Ham Sutra and the Cau Xa commentary are good, and that the Luc Do ten thousand actions and the twelve causes and conditions are not good. That person said so himself, and also taught others so. That person himself wrote it like that, and also taught others to copy it like that.

There are those who study the Mahayana dharma, study the Lotus Sutra, and say that the Second Vehicle is "burnt, damaged seeds" (burned sprouts, damaged seeds), [not understanding] the Buddha rebuked them, because they did not develop the Bodhi mind. If you accept that statement, it is also a mistake. The Dharma of the Three Vehicles is good, all the Dharma meanings taught by the Buddha are properly explained. Speaking of corresponding fundamentals, all three vehicles are equal. Don't believe in this vehicle, then slander the other vehicle. If we do so, it will destroy Buddhism. Some people even say that only by cultivating almsgiving can one achieve ultimate purity, but maintaining precepts, patience, learning wisdom, are all useless, and cultivating Meditation is useless. Or there are people who are attached to the idea that learning Meditation will be useful, to the point that maintaining precepts, giving alms, being patient, and learning Prajna are all useless, that is, clinging to one dharma and denying other dharmas. The same is true for Luc Do ten thousand virtues, that person accepts one Do in Six Do ten thousand virtues, denying the other five Do!

(Sutra) Or attachment to existence saying: Dprudence in giving alms attains the ultimate purity, non-precepts, non-forbearance, and non-wisdom. Or one clings to the saying: Dby cultivating the forbidden precepts attains ultimate purity, non-generosity, non-forbearance, and non-wisdom. Or one who clings to the saying: Duy to practice calmly and patiently attains the ultimate purity, non-giving, non-precepts, and non-wisdom. Or one who clings to the saying: Ddiligently cultivating to attain ultimate purity, non-giving, non-precepts, non-wisdom. Or one who clings to the saying: Duy practice Tinh Lu to attain ultimate purity, non-giving, non-precepts, non-wisdom. Or one who clings to the saying: Duy practice Prajna to attain ultimate purity, non-giving, non-precepts, non-concentration. Or one accepts the saying: Dby cultivating the worldly race to acquire intellectual skills to attain ultimate purity. Or you accept the saying: Dhe who cultivates the seed of the head of lava, the fire of fire, self-eating and achieving the ultimate purity.
(Sutra: Or there are people who are attached to the idea that: Only by practicing almsgiving can we achieve ultimate purity, not There are those who believe that: Only by cultivating the forbidden precepts can one attain ultimate purity, not giving, not patience, not even wisdom. Or there are those who believe: Only by cultivating patience can one attain ultimate purity, not giving, not morality, not even wisdom. Or there are those who believe: Only by cultivating diligently can one achieve ultimate purity, not giving, not morality, not even wisdom. Or there are people who believe that: Only by cultivating Tinh Lu can one achieve ultimate purity, not charity, not morality, not even wisdom. Or there are people who believe: Only by cultivating Prajna can one achieve ultimate purity, not charity, not morality, not even Concentration. Or there are people who believe: Only by cultivating skillful professions and wisdom as the world usually does can one achieve ultimate purity Only by gathering stones, throwing ourselves into the fire, starving ourselves, etc. can we achieve ultimate purity).

“Or there are those who cling to the saying: Only cultivating alms-giving attains the ultimate purity, without precepts, without patience” (Or there are those who cling to the idea that: Only by cultivating alms-giving can one achieve ultimate purity, not precepts, not patience), neither Precepts, nor Psāparamita, nor Forbearance. Paramita, even it is not Prajnaparamita. Or there are people who believe that: Only by cultivating the forbidden precepts can one achieve ultimate purity, that is, by practicing Thi La Paramitas, one can achieve ultimate purity, the other Paramitas are not good. That is what the Buddha rebuked, because it is an evil attachment, an evil view. That's called being attached to wrong views. There is even less need for outsiders to say anything else, either they practice all kinds of [asceticism] such as throwing themselves down and gathering stones, throwing themselves into fire, and fasting. They think that cultivating these virtues will be the ultimate. That's crazy talk. Here, to give an example, “heading the rock” (throwing down to gather rocks) means climbing to the top of the mountain, jumping off the cliff, thinking that jumping down will attain enlightenment. At Nga Mi mountain, there is Xa Nhai (mountain of renunciation). In the Lotus Sutra, Bodhisattva Miraculous Joy burns his own body. These are not permanent dharmas. You should not follow that rule. The Mahayana scriptures refer to these cases as being due to specific causes and conditions. As for the stories of throwing oneself off a cliff, jumping into a fire, and fasting as pagans say, one thinks that doing so will be able to achieve ultimate purity. That's a mistake!

(Sutra) Good man! Such as breaking the precepts, turning evil deeds, false dharma weapons, similes or true good dharma weapons of all sentient beings, and spirits holding evil views. Due to the madness of overturning all evil views, destroying the true good Kshat-de-li king, the most righteous and good Thu-datta-la class, weak men, weak women, possessing pure faith, precepts, literature, equanimity, wisdom, transforming the Kshat-de-li-king into Chien-tà-la, the nirvana Phiet-xa, Thu-datta-la class becoming Chien-dà-la. Trying illegal weapons, breaking the precepts, purifying the Sat-de-loi Chien-tu-la class, master disciples, cutting off the roots of goodness, the will to fall into the Intermittent Hell. Good man! Like the cause of a corpse, bloating, and suffocation, those who come to see and see the suffocation stage, depending on the basis of contact with the suffocation of a corpse, or the evil encounter, depending on being contaminated by the filth factor. Just like the true good king of the Sat-de-li king, the true good will of the Thu-datta-la class, weak men, weak women, depending on their closeness, breaking the precepts, evil deeds, illegal weapons of the Sangha, or bad association, or co-religion, or same career, depending on being polluted and contaminated by evil views. Such as this, such as this, the spirit of the true goodness of the Sat-de-li king, the mother-in-law is the true good-natured Beast-atta-la-class, the weak male, the weak female, withdraws from pure faith, precepts, literature, equanimity, wisdom, becomes Chien-tà-la, becomes a disciple, destroys the good roots, the mother-in-law is destined to fall into the Intermittent Hell.
(Sutra: Dear good man! Such an evil act is not Dharma. using all kinds of means to seduce and deceive sentient beings who are truly good people, making them cling to evil views. Those people, due to crazy evil views, destroy the true good of Kshat-de-li, up to the real good of Thu-datta, etc. Whether male or female, all pure faith, morality, equanimity, and wisdom [are all withdrawn], transforming Kshat-de-li into Chien-dala, up to Phiet-xa. Thu-da-la, etc., into Chien-do-la. The Buddha broke the precepts, and the Sat-de-loi Chien-do-la, etc., both teachers and students lost their good roots, and will fall into the Void Hell! Like a swollen, cracked, and stinking corpse, everyone who comes to see it will be overwhelmed by the stench Cracked, stinky, or passed by, all are contaminated. The true good King of Kshatriya to the true good of Thudattala, etc., whether male or female, if they are close to monks who break the precepts, do bad deeds, or associate with, or live together, or have the same career, will be tainted by evil views. Just like that, just like that, it will cause the true good Kshatriya That is, until the true goodness of Thu-datta-la, etc., whether male or female, withdraws from pure belief, precepts, literature, equanimity, wisdom, and becomes Chien-tala, both teacher and student will cut off their good roots, until they will fall into the Hell of No Interruptions).

This is the summary. Bhikkhus who break the precepts and conduct evil deeds are not Dharma objects, that is, they are not Dharma containers. They are a group of false knowledge, wrong views, liars, deceivers, and deceivers. For those who are truly good in the Dharma, for those who truly practice, who truly have right knowledge and right views, those evil monks will advise them to raise evil views and advise them to abandon right views. Those people themselves, due to their crazy evil views, will destroy good kings, good merchants, and even good people of lowly natures. Thu-datta is the lowly nature, the lowest of the four natures. [Those evil monks] all caused those people to develop evil views.

In India, racial caste composition is extremely serious. The Venerable Uu Ba Ly is the most observant of precepts, and was originally a barber for the emperor in the royal court. When Venerable Ananda became a monk, the Buddha told Ananda to bow at the feet of Venerable Upalya. Ananda did not bow, saying: "This is the servant who specializes in shaving my hair, how can I bow to him?" The Buddha said: "Everyone who enters Buddhism is equal. He is a Venerable, who left home earlier than you, has attained Arhatship, you should worship him." For Buddha, all dharmas are equal. Buddha saves all sentient beings without distinction of class, they are all equal. Therefore, the Buddha spoke about all dharmas according to the basis.

The Dharma of the Three Vehicles, the Hinayana is the Dharma of the Four Noble Truths, the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle is the Dharma of the twelve causes and conditions, the Bodhisattva Vehicle is the Dharma of the Six Virtues of All Virtues, these are all given the general idea. The Vinaya Pitaka also contains Mahayana principles. Such as reciting Amitābha Buddha is the meaning of Mahayana, this is said in the precepts. There are dharmas that teach us to learn well, but here we are talking about evil-natured monks, monks who break the precepts, they guide sentient beings, causing them to let go of faith, precepts, wisdom, and almsgiving, transforming the true good Kshatriya king into the Kshatriya king. Or the true good Phiet-xa, Thu-datta-la are all transformed into the Chien-dala ward, they are all transformed into the evil-nature ward, following the conduct of the evil bhikkhus. Bhikkhus who break the precepts are not a Dharma weapon, they have guided those people to become evil.

Devadharma taught King Ajatasatru to kill his father, taught him to usurp the emperor's throne, which is the crime of Five Negatives. Devadatta wanted to replace the Buddha, immediately rolled a rock over the Buddha, attempted to crush the Buddha to death, and threw it at the Buddha's feet, causing the Buddha's body to bleed, he immediately fell into hell. That is a sign of evil nature. Here, the Bhikkhu who breaks the precepts is not a Dharma weapon, but also those who follow him and believe in him, so they give rise to evil views. The Kshatriya king Chien-tala up to Thudatta-la Chien-dala all became people with evil nature. “When a teacher meets a disciple, he cuts off the good roots” (Both the teacher and the disciple cut off the good roots): Regardless of whether the teacher or his disciple cuts off the good roots.

“Repentance of the true goodness of the Kshatriya-king, the true goodness of Thu-datta-la-class, weak men, weak women, withdrawing from pure faith, precepts, literature, equanimity, wisdom” (Causing the true good of the Kshat-de-li-king to the true good of Thu-datta-la, etc., whether male or female, to renounce seven pure beliefs, precepts, literature, equanimity, wisdom): Equanimity is giving, Hue is wisdom, Literature is listening to the Dharma. All pure precepts, listening to the Dharma, and wisdom are all abandoned, becoming evil natures of Lambdala, good roots are cut off, and will fall into the Hell of No Interruptions. Therefore, the Buddha told Vajragarbha Bodhisattva, I say "you should make offerings" with a choice, not without a choice! Regarding the two sides of good and evil, we must distinguish the general outline: Even though they are all bad monks, among the bad monks, there are still some people who are good. This means that by relying on the Three Jewels, relying on goodness to practice, one can attain enlightenment. If you retire and fall to Non-Year, you practice, but have no merit, and fall to the rank of Non-Yāhāh. The chapter on Non-Virtuality and the chapter on Existence of Virtue must be combined to talk about it. Why don't you follow the Three Jewels and not follow the Three Jewels? Because you do not have right knowledge and right view, you will fall into the Hell of No Interruption. Relying on the Three Jewels, having right knowledge and right view, will be a monk in the path of enlightenment, life in the path of a monk, or victory in the path of a monk, with this meaning. After talking about evil people, Buddha preached about good people.

(Sutra) Good man! Contemplations such as the Sat-di-benefit of countless sentient beings, close to them such as breaking the precepts, evil deeds, illegal weapons, Sangha, withdrawing must have good dharmas, one is destined to fall into the Infinite Hell. If you seek to attain the sublime miracle of rebirth, Nirvana, you will be close to me, I will be close to you, I will make offerings to the superior monks, the four teachings, I will listen to the teachings of the Three Vehicles of the Dharma, or I will ask for enlightenment and the life of the monks. Weaknesses like the Three Paths of Samanas, in the middle of an impure path of Samanas, even though they obey the precepts, they have right views, they are completely mocked, they are close to the monks, they are willing to be close to them, they accept things, they make offerings, they are told, they listen to the texts of the three essential dharmas, they don't like to be close to them, they admit things, they make offerings to the monks, they make offerings to the monks, they make fun of them, and they meet them. Even though the precepts are destroyed, children have no wrong views, mockery of the mind, the practice of morality, the foundation of the foundation, the ability to practice the arts, the four precepts, the hearing of the Shravaka Vehicle, the Single Enlightenment Vehicle, the Mahayana Dharma, and the disapproval of the Dharma. Abiding in the three vehicles, indulge in ridicule at will, vow to be diligent, follow the one vehicle, indulge in excess, and do not destroy it lightly. Disadvantages of the three vehicles, depending on the most contemptuous destruction, the most low-minded, the most chanting, do not like to be close, or have bad relationships, or stay together, or work together. If you are not close friends, or have bad relationships, or are in the same relationship, or have the same career, you are destined to fall into the Uninterrupted Hell.
(Sutra: Dear good man! You should contemplate countless sentient beings like Kshatriya. etc. like that, being close to a monk who breaks the precepts and commits evil deeds is not such a dharma weapon, he will lose all good dharmas, and will fall into the Hell of No Intermittent. Therefore, those who want to achieve the sublime joy of heavenly birth or attain Nirvana, must be close to, make offerings to, and make offerings to the superior monks to inquire and listen to the important dharma in the three vehicles, or seek the enlightenment of the monks, or if there are no three types of path Such monks should pray to those who are corrupt in their precepts, but have right views and are full of mockery and conduct. You should come close to them, make offerings, ask questions, and listen to the important Dharma of the three vehicles. You should not be close to, receive offerings from, or make offerings to those whose moral conduct, mocking thoughts, and views are all corrupted. For those who, although their precepts are corrupted, but do not have wrong views, [but still have] mockery, their conduct, and views are all complete, you should go to those who have corrupt moral conduct and views. That, sir, listen to the Sravakayana dharma, the Pratyekayana dharma, and the Mahayana dharma, do not despise the three vehicles, make a vow to study one vehicle diligently, and do not despise the three vehicles, even if it is just a single chant, or live in the same place, or do the same work sharing the same place, or working in the same career, will all fall into the Hell of No Interruption).

In the previous section, we talked about the ten evil wheels. Whenever there is a wheel, not only will you withdraw from good dharma in this life, but the good dharma you have practiced in many lifetimes will also be withdrawn. “One thought of anger arises in the mind, hundreds of thousands of barrier doors open”. Not only will you withdraw, but in the future you will encounter obstacles. Arousing a thought of anger, giving rise to greed, is itself stupid, containing ignorance. If there is no Ignorance, the light of wisdom will shine, the person will not be greedy, nor will he be angry. Those are the two paths of good and evil.

For many lifetimes, many lifetimes up to now, why can't we attain enlightenment, we keep moving forward and backward? In this life, when you meet good knowledge, you advance for a while, then, when you meet evil knowledge, you retreat again. Just keep going forward, backward, backward, forward like that, it will take a long time! Repent, practice, recite Buddha's name, holy name, or recite Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, or recite Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, whatever you do at will is progress. If you can maintain it at the time of death, if you have Sufficient Life Wisdom, in the next life, you will know what you did in your previous life, you will not do evil anymore, at least in this life you must practice Sufficient Life Wisdom. What should you do if you wish to achieve the sublime joy of being born in heaven, or attain Nirvana? One should "be close to, be in favor of, and make offerings to the superior monks". Now is the Dharma-Ending Age, where can one find anyone who has attained Arhatship, or can still see Buddha? No way! How do you do this? It's okay to find one among the poor monks, but don't look for any monk who breaks the precepts, has bad conduct, has wrong knowledge, or has wrong views. That person will lead you to hell!

Since there is no superior path of monks, then finding the path of monks is not easy! Now we neither realize nor attain that wisdom. The life of a monk is the same! “The weakness of the three paths of monks” means that the superior path of monks does not exist, you cannot see the path of monks, nor can you meet the destiny of monks, so what can you do? “You should pray to the middle path of the monks” (You should pray to the unclean path of the monks). Nowadays, even poor monks are difficult to meet. Even though an evil monk breaks the precepts, he has right view and his knowledge is not corrupted. Breaking the precepts, Buddha can still save; If you break your view, there is no way for Buddha to save you! That person doesn't believe, no matter what you say, that person still doesn't believe! Even though a crazy view arises, that person still has an interest in the Buddha's teachings, and still has a mind of desire. Virtue is skillful means, one must practice it. Virtue is the means of the path. Now we read the sutras, worship, repent, and even recite the holy names, all of which are considered religious practices.

Then you should “be close to, acknowledge, make offerings to, tell, and listen to the essential dharmas of the three vehicles” (close to, acknowledge, make offerings to, ask questions, hear and receive the important dharmas in the three vehicles). You won't be able to see the path of a monk, you won't be able to see the destiny of a monk, and you won't even be able to see the path of a monk! How to do this? In the end, even the poor monks were not encountered, there were no people wearing kasa, the dharma was destroyed! The Dharma has truly been destroyed, even if you want to request a set of sutras, you won't be able to find them. Don't you see that there are so many Dharma Jewels right now! When the dharma ceases, there is nothing immediately! We don't know what power it was from, there's nothing left! That's how it is in Mainland China. In many pagodas and temples, Kinh Lau Museums are all sealed. The sutra is in there, but you don't dare look at it, nor can you take it out! If you watch it, it will be illegal and a crime. That's what we talked about before. King Chien-la-king practices the Chien-dala law, which is evil, you have no choice! Even though that monk (an evil monk) broke the precepts, his knowledge was still very good and he had no wrong views. Then that person has a mocking mind (a mind that likes Buddha's teachings), a mocking mind will yearn, have a heart of joy, have a heart of joy towards Buddhism, and also practice the virtues. "If you want to listen to the Sravakayana dharma, listen to the Sravakayana dharma, and learn about the Mahayana dharma, don't destroy it." (You should go to that person, ask questions, listen and accept the Sravakayana dharma, the Single-Enlightenment Vehicle dharma, and the Mahayana dharma, don't destroy it), you must have respect for that person.

“In the three vehicles, freely mock, make a vow to be diligent” (In the three vehicles, make a wish to be diligent, make a vow to be diligent), in the three vehicles, whatever dharma you like, then practice that dharma! “Study one vehicle at your discretion” (Study one vehicle at your discretion), it is not certain, you have very deep and thick conditions for any cause, so you study that dharma, this must depend on the conditions. I hope to study the Thanh Van Vehicle dharma, but I have not come across the A Ham Sutra, nor the Cau Xa Commentary. How will I study it again? At the same time, you meet a teacher, but that teacher has never studied the Cau Xa commentary, nor the A Ham Sutra, what dharma will he tell you? Whatever Dharma he studies, you will study that Dharma. When I was in Xiamen, restoring the Min Nan Buddhist Academy[6] at Nam Putuo Temple, at that time I was the Head of Teaching Department, where could I go to invite a professor? [Buddhism in mainland China] has been interrupted [for nearly forty years]. The students were twenty-something years old, we were over seventy years old at that time. You want to find a teacher in your forties or fifties, but there is none!

In the past, the Southern Buddhist Academy practiced the Only Consciousness School, but currently, if you want to invite a teacher to teach the Eight Conscious Rules and Chant, there is no one who can teach, they have never studied. [The teachers] some studied the four teachings, some studied the five teachings, some studied the Pure Land, and then preached the Amitabha Sutra. How to do it? Whoever knows something, will teach it. Therefore, teaching is very complicated. The curriculum was not enough, so I invited a few professors from Xiamen University, old professors, to teach. Literature is also studied, we also have English and Japanese classes, which means teaching is very complicated. Why is that? Depending on fate! If you want to decide what subject to study, how do you do it without [a teacher]? There must also be textbooks, and students must have books. Without books, how can I study? Use ronéo printing, borrow a few copies from the library, find someone to reprint them, use them for teaching!

Three Vehicle Sutras, whatever you want to study, you can study together, don't despise or slander. But with an evil person, you should not be close to him or associate with him. If you get close and socialize with him, you will be miserable! Therefore, when studying the Three Vehicles, or when studying the Sutra teachings, we should sow blessings and not blaspheme other vehicles. No matter what shaman preaches the sutra, he should praise and rejoice, and should not be slanderous. You should not comment on whether he preaches good sutras or bad sutras. If you have a relationship with that person, if you're happy then you can come and listen, if you're not happy then you can't listen, there's nothing wrong at all! If you blaspheme, seek trouble for yourself without any reason, you will make yourself guilty. There is no crime, but you want to confess your sins, what is wrong? Whether towards people or towards dharma, in your mind you always have Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha, the Three Jewels. We teach the Sutra on Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma, [in that sutra it is said] reciting the Buddha, reciting the Dharma, reciting the Sangha, the merit is very great. When you recite the Dharma, the Tripitaka, twelve sets of all the sutras and dharmas taught by the Buddhas of the ten directions are all in it, without any choice. All the great monks can lead to your love. Because there are ordinary Sangha, you can think of the saintly Sangha. Because there is a holy Sangha, you can think of Buddha and sow merit.

(Sutra) Good man! Trying to, weak desire in the middle of the three vehicles, following the one vehicle, seeking to escape birth and death, mocking happiness, fearing danger and suffering, accepting the Tathagata's teaching of the true dharma, or relying on the Shravaka Vehicle's preaching of the true dharma, or following the Pratyekayana's teaching of the true dharma, or following the Mahayana preaching the true dharma, universal faith and reverence, living things are destroyed, obstructed, hidden one, the summer solstice is one chant, always agreeing Respect, recite alone, listen to texts, and diligently work diligently to pray for enlightenment. Blaspheming the three vehicles, depending on one dharma person, not agreeing to stay together, one's will is complete, not liking being close to one, four words, listening to the dharma. If sentient beings, depending on the three vehicles, blaspheme the one vehicle, or allow close contacts to blaspheme the three vehicles, the four precepts, hearing feelings, due to the test of causes and conditions, they will fall into the Intermittent Hell, experience great suffering, and difficult existence will occur.
(Sutra: Good man! Therefore, if anyone wants to be in the three vehicles, rely on a certain vehicle To seek freedom from birth and death, to enjoy peace, and to be weary of suffering and danger, one should follow the Dharma taught by the Tathagata, or follow the Dharma taught in the Shravaka Vehicle, or rely on the Dharma taught in the Mahayana, have deep and profound devotion, do not be tempted to slander, obfuscate, or conceal even a single chant. Whoever blasphemes any dharma in the three vehicles, do not stay with that person, even for just one night, or be close to someone who blasphemes the three vehicles. Because of that cause and effect, you will definitely fall into the Hell of No Intermittent, suffering great suffering, with difficulty escaping.)

Therefore, “good man! In the middle of the three vehicles of desire, depending on the one vehicle, seek to escape birth and death, rejoice in peace” (good man! Want to be among the three vehicles, rely on a certain vehicle to seek escape from birth and death, enjoy peace and happiness). You hate the danger, you hate leaving this society. If you want to escape birth and death, you must obey the Dharma as taught by the Tathagata, or follow the Dharma as said in the Shravaka Vehicle, or follow the Dharma as said in the Single Enlightenment Vehicle, or obey the Dharma as said in the Mahayana, with deep, complete devotion. “Spectrum” is all-pervading depth, not a shallow knowledge, but a very deep belief. If you attain the four levels of Arhatship, your magical powers are unhindered, and you can know things for eighty thousand great kalpas, quite good! But you do not abide in that Concentration, that is a Bodhisattva.

But please, please “destroy, obsess, and hide living things” (don't give birth to the heart of slander, obscenity, or concealment). If you slander, obfuscate, or hide it, it is because of jealousy. That person believes in that dharma, only wishes to propagate that dharma, is afraid that others will also propagate it, or sees that the temple has many disciples, that person becomes afraid, will destroy it, and cause trouble. That is a characteristic of the Dharma Ending period, and is also a characteristic of the present time. Not only monastics, but also lay people. Here, I won't give an example, everyone can understand it, we can encounter it every day, but we should not do [that]. The dharmas taught in the three vehicles are all good. If your vow is not steadfast and your views are not right, your vow will not be right! You have no right vow; [because], without right view, you will not be able to give rise to right aspiration. Bang gate, evil destinies, you want to escape the ocean of suffering, it's impossible!

If it is “blaspheming the three vehicles of dharma, depending on the one dharma, do not agree to coexist” (one who slanders any dharma in the three vehicles of dharma, should not live together). Currently, that “standing” right, the Sangha no longer exists. Like Nam Putuo Pagoda, there are more than five hundred people there. If you see someone who is bad and expel that person, he will report you to the Religious Affairs Department. I said: "That person broke the precepts." They said: "I don't see what that person did wrong. How could a monk be involved with a woman? It's not illegal!" How do you do this? We still have to invite that person to stay! Coming to this era, you should know the times, know what era you are in, know the limits, know what kingdom you are in. You also have to know cause, know fate, know dharma, and know karma. If you have wisdom, you must depend on conditions, that is called “depending on conditions”. But you yourself should not change. If others are drinking, we will also drink, if others are looking for women, we will also look for them, or if women [see] others looking for men, we will also look for them! There are also many women and lay people at the Buddhist Academy; That's how it is in this Dharma Ending era society. If you [imitate] doing so, you will fall into the Hell of No Interruptions, with no time to escape!

(Kinh) Is it worth trying? Good man! In the past, cultivating the Bodhisattva practice, diligently seeking to attain the supreme wisdom. HOr you request the Shravaka Vehicle to expound the Dharma, the lower will is one chant, the heart is free, self-attachment, blood, flesh, skin, bones, head, rot, marrow, brain. Hor the one who requests the Pratyekabuddha to preach the true Dharma, the summer will is one chant, the breath is released by oneself, self-appropriation, blood, flesh, skin, bones, head, rot, marrow, brain. Hor the person who requests the practitioner from the Mahayana preaches the Dharma, the summer solstice recites one chant, the mind releases the energy of one's own body, vitality, blood, flesh, skin, bones, head, rot, marrow, and brain. As for suffering, in the middle of the three vehicles, in the summer I hope to attain the one reciting the Dharma, deeply rejoicing, reverently accepting and maintaining, as the theory of practice, for no time at all, for immeasurable kalpas, practicing asceticism is necessarily difficult, and finally attaining the ultimate wisdom. Serving the benefit and happiness of sentient beings, preaching and teaching the three vehicles of the Dharma. Di for meaning, do not accept blasphemy, obscenity, concealment, chant one in the summer solstice, always accept reverence, sing alone, listen to literature, accept steadfast labor and pray for realization.
(Sutra: For what reason? Good man! I practiced the Bodhisattva practice in the past, when I was diligent. Purely seeking to attain Supreme Wisdom HOr because of the request based on the dharma spoken in the Shravaka Vehicle, even if it's just a single verse, even let go of one's own hands, feet, blood, flesh, skin, bones, head, eyes, marrow, brain. Or because of the request based on the dharma spoken in the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle, even if it's just one verse, even let go of one's own hands, feet, blood, flesh, etc. One's own skin, bones, head, eyes, marrow, and brain. Or because of praying according to the Dharma taught in the Mahayana, even if it's just a single verse, even letting go of one's own hands, feet, blood, flesh, skin, bones, head, eyes, marrow, and brain, working hard like that to pray in the three vehicles, even if only one chant is obtained, then one will be filled with deep joy, respectfully accept and practice according to the teachings, and never give up for countless lifetimes. Practice all difficult ascetic practices, until you attain ultimate ultimate wisdom. Again, for the sake of the peace and happiness of sentient beings, proclaim and reveal the true Dharma of the three vehicles. Because of that meaning, do not slander, obfuscate, or hide even a single verse of reciting it, you should always revere it, read it, listen to it, and make the right vow to steadfastly seek realization.

For what reason? “Good man! In the past, I practiced Bodhisattva conduct, diligently sought to attain unsurpassed wisdom” (Hey good man! When I in the past practiced Bodhisattva conduct, diligently sought to attain unsurpassed wisdom): The Buddha used himself as evidence to say: In the past, when he practiced the Bodhisattva path, he hoped to attain Buddha's wisdom. At that time, [the Original Master was still a Bodhisattva], in order to invite the Buddha to recite a verse, he sacrificed his life to make offerings to the Buddha. Everyone who reads the story of Sakyamuni Buddha [will see] a lot of stories like that. For the sake of one verse, give up your life, or for the sake of half a verse, give up your hands, feet, blood, flesh, skin, bones, head, eyes, marrow, and brain. Just pray for the Dharma, your mind will be filled with joy, and you will respectfully accept and maintain it. If you sacrifice your life, arms, and legs in exchange for something like that, your respectful heart, your trusting mind, and your pursuit of enlightenment will be very strong.

Now if we listen to the sutra here, I am not saying to let go of hands and feet, just spend two or three days in seclusion to practice. Think about it, if you talk like that, you can't let go, [keep complaining] there's no time! Can you still let go of your hands and feet, or let go of your head and eyes? We don't have that power. Why? It is necessary to have steadfast faith. You have to be steadfast in your pure faith and mind to be able to do it. We say every day that we must "practice in six times", that's what the scriptures say, we really can't do it ourselves! Be ashamed!

When worshiping, I wonder if my friends think about it or not? You should be ashamed of your current body. Everyone is very protective of themselves, paying attention to their body, what to eat to make the body a little stronger, a little stronger, and if there is any illness, get it checked immediately. In fact, we should focus our attention outward on how to achieve ourselves and make everyone achieve each other. Once we have achieved it, in the future we can escape the ocean of suffering together. Don't pay all your attention to your body! No one is immortal, no one's body can be preserved forever! You want to maintain it like that forever, it's impossible! Immortal? If this world were immortal, it would already be unable to contain its population!

To leave this suffering, one must practice asceticism. It's difficult to do but can be done, what should we do? When it comes to what we can do, can we do it by praying to Buddha and chanting sutras? You can't say that, I'm at work and reciting Buddha's name is fine! It's okay if you don't say it out loud! It's okay to think about it in your mind! Please take good care of your own thoughts! As in the text of the lower volume of the Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma [taught], every day for twelve periods, you must pay attention to your own thoughts. Whenever a thought arises, pay attention, why does that thought arise? That is called “practicing”.

Therefore, regarding the three vehicles of the Dharma, do not slander or suppress it, not even a single sentence can enlighten you. You also have to respect, read, and listen. However, sometimes the Buddha reprimanded the reading and chanting, rebuked the listening and receiving. For example, the Buddha reprimanded Ananda: “Ananda is in need and strong, not free from evil thoughts” (Even though Ananda remembers, he cannot help but fall into evil thoughts). Because Venerable Ananda heard the Dharma every day, but when he encountered Ms. Ma Dang Gia, he had no choice but to easily develop wrong views. But if we respectfully listen, read and recite, there will immediately be Buddhas from the six directions protecting and reciting our thoughts. East, West, South, North, above, below, six directions Buddhas, not just one direction, first name a few as representatives and then say “innumerable numbers” (as many as grains of sand in the Ganges River).. Countless numbers of Buddhas in the six directions all protect you.

Everyone reading Amitabha Sutra, do you pay attention or not? I haven't been reborn in this life, so it's okay! If it is not born in this life, it will definitely be born in the next life. If you have not yet been born in the next life, you can still be born in the next life. [That sutra] has three sentences: "weakness of birth", which means being born in the world of Ultimate Bliss. “Weak metal birth”, in this life I recite, I will be able to be born in the world of Ultimate Bliss. If you have been born, if you are being born, you can definitely be reborn in this life. It's okay if I don't get reborn, the Buddhas of the six directions protect and remember me. “Weaknesses are born”, in the future they will definitely arise.

If you recite Amitābha Buddha, recite the Amitabha Sutra, and make that vow, “you will reach the Pure Land”, you haven't reached it yet, it's okay! You haven't bought a plane ticket yet, but a few days later you can buy it again. There's always a plane and you can fly to your destination. If the plane doesn't take off, you have no choice. We can all board the boat to the Pure Land forever, because it arises in your own mind.

Therefore, there are those who say: "Master! I cannot be reborn, what should I do?" I said: "What are you afraid of? If you cannot be born, you will be reborn in the next life. If you have not yet been born in the next life, you will be born in the next life. The Buddhas of the six directions are protecting you, you will definitely be able to be reborn! If you cannot be reborn, Śākyamuni Buddha will become a liar." The Amitabha Sutra said very clearly: “Weakness is born, weakness is born, weakness is born”, went first to prove it to you. There are many people in this life who are reborn. Now we can't go. If we can't go, we'll have to wait for the next plane. It's all the same! Therefore, we must have such faith, have such strong and diligent vows, and have the mind to seek enlightenment. That's the main thing.

(Sutra) Good man! Such as the Three Vehicles, the main essence of the Dharma, necessarily past, future, present past and present, all Buddhas speak in the same way, the mighty divine power together protects, the desire to transcend all sentient beings in birth and death, great suffering, the desire to introduce the Three Jewels of nature, the spirit is not cut off. Thi tries, tries the three vehicles of the Dharma, accepts universal faith and respect, living things are profaned, destroyed, obstructed, hidden one. Those who blaspheme, obstruct, hide one of the three vehicles of the Dharma, chant one in the lower will, and are determined to fall into the Uninterrupted Hell.
The past, the future, and the present are more numerous than the sands of the Ganges River, speaking together, using the power of the mighty and powerful spirit to protect all sentient beings, because they want to continue the prosperity of the Three Jewels' nature. Therefore, in regard to the three vehicles of the Dharma, you should all believe in it completely, do not be tempted to slander, obscure, or conceal it reciting verses, you will definitely fall into the Avīci Hell (Relentless Hell)).

“Good man! Such is the essence of the Dharma from the three vehicles, necessarily in the past, future, and present beyond the Buddhas of the Ganga sa” (Good man! The Dharma arises primarily in the three vehicles like that, said by all Buddhas in the past, future, and present more than the sands of the Ganges River): Not only Shakyamuni Buddhist nuns said such words, but the past, present, and future Buddhas as numerous as the sands of the Ganges River all said the same, using "great divine power combined with protection" (great divine power and protection). What do the Buddhas protect in the past, present, and future? Protecting those who believe in the Dharma that emerges from the three vehicles, allowing all sentient beings to escape the great suffering of birth and death, and also being able to “bring the Three Jewels to their true nature, their spirit is not interrupted” (continuing the prosperity of the Three Jewels' nature, making it unbreakable). The nature of the Three Jewels will not be cut off, it will make it possible for all sentient beings to leave suffering. "Your Majesty, in the three vehicles of the Dharma, one should universally believe in and revere" (Therefore, in the three vehicles of the Dharma, one should believe and revere completely).

In the end, if you believe in the Shravaka Vehicle, the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle, the Bodhisattva Vehicle, you should not have a mind of slander, do not have a mind that is obscured or hidden. Don't consider what you believe or admire as right, consider everything else as wrong. The disease is very big, very serious; That's called karma. What shape does karma take? That's it. If you hide the Dharma of the Three Vehicles, you will definitely fall into the Hell of No Interruptions.

(Sutra) Second recovery, good man! In the future, in the Buddha's realm, the Kshatriya-chien-dala, brahmin-Chen-dala, chief minister-Chen--la-la, layman--Chan---la-la, recluse--Chan----la-la, rich man--Chan-----la-, Phiet-sac-----------Chan----------la, Thu-datta-----------Chan------------la, weak man, weak woman, blind, stupid, lacking in intelligence. Arrogant, arrogant, arrogant, rude, rude, indifferent, not afraid of the suffering of the future, eager to kill, stubborn and wrong, jealous, greedy, increasing good friends, close to evil friends, not disparaging the three vehicles of the holy dharma. Or if you rarely practice the Shravaka Vehicle, it is convenient for the Buddhas to together protect and uphold the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle, the Supreme Vehicle, to slander, destroy, obsess, conceal, and not leave behind. Or if you rarely practice the Single Enlightenment Vehicle, it is convenient for the Buddhas to jointly protect and uphold the Sravaka Vehicle, the Supreme Vehicle, to slander, destroy, obstruct, conceal, and not leave behind. Or if you rarely practice the Supreme Vehicle, it is convenient for the Buddhas to jointly protect and uphold the Sravaka Vehicle, the Single Enlightenment Vehicle, to slander, destroy, obsess, hide, and not leave the spirit behind. Those who seek fame and fortune recite it like a saying: "I believe in the Mahayana, I believe in the Mahayana party, I only listen to practice, I accept and maintain the Mahayana, I don't mock the Sravakas, the Single Enlightenment Vehicle, I don't mock the Two Vehicles and study closely." Such a lie claims to be of the Mahayana level of human beings, due to ignorance, arrogance and power, such as slandering, destroying, hiding the three vehicles of the true dharma, not leaving behind the spirit, increasing the habit of cultivating the three vehicles of dharma, slandering, destroying the disgrace, and the spirit of no authority.
(Sutra: Come here, good man! In the future life, where In this Buddha land, there is the Kshatriya Chendala, the brahmin Chondula, the chief minister Chontala, the layman Chontala, the monk Chien-dala, the rich man Chien-dala, the Phai-sama Chien-dala, the Thudatta-la Ram-dala, whether male or female, arrogant, foolish, conceited, intelligent, aggressive, free-spirited. Poor, rude, vulgar, not seeing, not afraid of suffering in the next life, fond of killing, even wrong views, jealous, stingy, greedy, hating good friends, being close to bad friends, are not the Dharma weapons to become holy in the three vehicles. Or by hearing and accepting a little of the Sravakayana dharma, they immediately slander, disparage, obstruct, hide, and not allow the transmission of the Pratyekabuddha Dharma and the Supreme Vehicle Dharma, which are the dharmas that are jointly protected by the Buddhas. Either by hearing and practicing a little of the Pratyekayana dharma, one immediately slanders, disparages, obscures, hides, and does not allow the transmission of the Sravakayana dharma and the Supreme Vehicle of the Buddhas, which are jointly protected by the Buddhas. Or by hearing and practices by a little of the Supreme Vehicle, one immediately slanders, disparages, obscures, and hides, and does not allow the transmission of the Sravakayana dharma and the Pratyekayana dharma, which are jointly protected by the Buddhas. For the sake of fame and profit, one chants like this: "I am a Mahayana, belonging to the Mahayana clique, only like to hear and practice the Mahayana, do not like the sravaka and pratyekabuddha dharma, do not like to be close to those who study the dharma of the 2nd vehicle." Falsely claiming to be a Mahayana person like that, due to the power of their own ignorance and arrogance, they slander, obscure, hide the dharma of the three yanas, do not allow it to be passed down, are jealous of those who practice the dharma of the 3 yanas, slander and humiliate them, making those people have no power.

“ Hoai smart arrogance” (Holds the pride of being smart), that is, someone who is not smart. “Arrogance” is a sign of unintelligence. Consider yourself intelligent, because that person thinks he or she is stronger than others. Obviously not as good as others, but still claiming to be better than others, even though everywhere is inferior to others! Let's ask ourselves carefully, everyone suffers from this habit, often looking down on others, always feeling that they are quite good. That is Ego Clinging. Actually, when you see others are always better than anyone else, then you are the best. That person also did not perceive this, he himself was stupid, still thinking that he was very smart. That person has that arrogant mind.

“Ky nhanh phuc” (That person's nature is aggressive, stubborn), “dung” is very difficult to tame and obey. We see a buffalo, or a horse, or a donkey, beaten with a whip and tied tightly to a post, but it still does not change its nature. Falling as an animal, its nature becomes more aggressive and rebellious. “Rude manners” [means] acting very disrespectfully and speaking very rudely and vulgarly! Why did that person do that? That person is not afraid of the next life, does not believe in cause and effect. Such a person is not a Dharma weapon in the three vehicles. For the Shravaka Vehicle, the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle, and the Bodhisattva Vehicle, they are not dharma objects. Or it's because of hearing the dharma of Sravakayana, listening to the dharma of Suffering, Origin, Cessation, and the Path and then destroying [other dharmas]. They heard a little of the Thanh Van dharma, thought they were terrible, and slandered the Pratyekayana and Upper Vehicle dharmas very vehemently.

Buddhism in the countries of Lan Kha (Sri Lanka) and Thailand is very good. We have many disciples who study abroad there. It was pure Buddha Dharma when the Buddha was alive, but for Chinese Mahayana and Tibetan Tantric Buddhism, they absolutely did not believe it. Chinese people who study the Mahayana dharma, especially those who study Zen Buddhism, throw it behind their heads when it comes to precepts and listening to sutras. When I was in Co Son, the Zen Hall had a dispute with our school. It wasn't a fight of reason, but a fight for profit! Whichever route has the most items will have a more comfortable life! Worrying about fighting for these things, forgetting the three vehicles like that!

Regarding the three vehicle dharma maintained by the Buddhas, they heard the sravaka vehicle dharma, then slandered the pratyekabuddha dharma and blasphemed the Mahayana dharma. When they heard the Pratyekayana dharma, they immediately slandered the Sravakayana dharma and the Mahayana dharma. After hearing the Mahayana Dharma, he immediately slandered the Sravaka and Soccekabuddha Dharma, hoping to hide those Dharmas and not let them remain. But there is a basic condition that “those who seek fame and profit, chant like this” (for those who seek fame and profit, chant like this): Their innermost feelings are for fame and profit, not for the Dharma. [They claim] they are Mahayana, belonging to the Mahayana sect. Thanh Van Thua is the Thanh Van Thua gang. The Single Sense Vehicle is a clique of the Single Sense Vehicle. Pulling factions together to fight, [crying]: "You are all the same, we are one party. We are all Mahayana. Those Single Sense Vehicles are Second Vehicles. We are different from them, get rid of them!" Forming factions to fight against those with different views and attacking [the opponent] is superstition. If you become several parties, won't you attack each other? Having attacked each other, hoping to live together in peace will not be possible! If we lift ourselves up, we have to push others down, that's how it is!

A liar claims to be Mahayana like that, adding the word Tra (lie) because that person is not Mahayana. If that person is truly Mahayana, truly a Bodhisattva, he will not slander any dharma. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva propagates Ksitigarbha's Dharma and does not slander Avalokiteśvara. Avalokitesvara also came here to help him praise him. Vajra Treasury Bodhisattva is Emptiness, Emptiness Treasury Bodhisattva is also Emptiness. That person is not a Mahayana, but a disguised Mahayana, not a true Mahayana. Due to the power of one's own ignorance and arrogance, that person definitely has strength and social power. Because that person gathers factions to attack others, there are still quite a few people who believe in him. The closer the end of the Dharma comes, the more people believe in him. Being a good person is no longer possible. Nowadays, we can't talk about [being a good person] anymore! You say black magic is not good, but is there any country without gangsters, any party without dark people? This time is the end of Dharma. Those people pretend to be Mahayana people. Everyone must pay attention to the word Tra, they are not real Mahayana people. Because of their power, they slandered, obstructed, and hid the three-vehicle dharma, not allowing it to be passed down, and were jealous of those who practiced the three-vehicle dharma. Anyone who propagates the Dharma will be hated. Nowadays, pagans are jealous, ninety-six types of pagans are extremely jealous of the Buddha! [Here, those falsely claiming to be Mahayana] defame and humiliate [those who study the three vehicles], making them no longer powerful.

(Sutra) Good man! All past, future, and present Buddhas, World-Honored Ones, up to Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas, for the benefit of all sentient beings, their great compassionate power protects both things. The first person, because of desire, introduces the Three Jewels of the nature of the dragon, is eternally spiritual, renounces the world, and cultivates in the world, and is subdued by ca-sa. The two and three vehicles derive from the Four Noble Truths corresponding to the true Dharma. As shown in the two things, only Buddha, World-Honored One, attains the great Bodhisattva's good protection, the ability to protect the Sravakas, the Doctrine of the Enlightened One class, the hundred thousand herons na-data-many Great Brahma Heavenly Kings, the ability to protect the Heavenly Emperor Thich King, the four great continents of the Chakravartin King.
(Sutra: O good man! All the past, future, and present Buddhas, World-Honored Ones And the Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas, in order to benefit all sentient beings, use their great compassion to protect two things: One, because they want to continue the prosperity of the Three Jewels, never stop, renounce the world, shave off hair and beard, and wear ka-sa. Two, the important dharmas in the three vehicles such as the Four Noble Truths, etc., correspond to the true dharma. Only the Buddha, the World-Honored One and the great Bodhisattva can skillfully protect them, not the Shravakas and Solitaries. Winning Enlightenment, etc., are not the hundreds of thousands of Na-du-da that the Great Brahma Heavenly King and Heavenly Emperor Thich King, the Chakravartin Kings in the four great continents can protect).

The great Bodhisattvas and Buddhas, for the benefit of all sentient beings, use their great compassion to protect two things. “The first one, the desire to introduce the dragon of the Three Jewels, is eternally spiritual, renunciates, renounces the world, cultivates, is subdued by the ca-sa” (One is because he wants to continue the prosperity of the Three Jewels, the nature of the Three Jewels is always unceasing, renounces the world, shaves off his hair and beard, and wears the ca-sa). That is to use the power of great compassion to protect the first thing, that is, to make the Three Jewels often be passed down without end, often without being broken. How can we make the nature of the Three Jewels unbroken? Must protect monks to abbot the Three Jewels. The monks themselves are like that, they shave off their hair and beard, put on their ka-sar, and still don't discuss whether they keep the precepts or not. Keeping the precepts is even better! As long as they can put on the ka-sa, renounce their monastic customs, and shave off their hair and beard, they have done that first step, and that is already very good!

“Secondly, the three vehicles of weak emergence from the Four Noble Truths correspond to the Dharma” (Secondly, the important dharmas of emergence from the three vehicles such as the Four Noble Truths, etc., correspond to the Dharma): The second point is to maintain the three vehicles of weak emergence, that is, the important path to the world [in the three vehicles]. Regardless of the Sravaka Vehicle, Pratyekabuddha Vehicle, or Bodhisattva Vehicle, the first thing is to establish separation from the mind, must have the mind to leave the three realms of suffering. Without that mind, nothing can happen. Centrifugal discharge is the common point of the three vehicles. The Four Noble Truths, i.e. Suffering, Origin, Cessation, and Path, are the Four Noble Truths. Thanh Van Thua says that Suffering, Origin, Cessation, and Path, we ourselves have attained, that is, achieving Nirvana is enough. The Bodhisattva Vehicle is completely different. Even though there are so many people, we will only be able to escape until they have all escaped. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva waited until they all became Buddhas before he became a Buddha, hoping to fulfill all his responsibilities of saving sentient beings. That is “corresponding to all Dharma”. Suffering, Origin, Cessation, and the Path are the dharma of the Four Noble Truths, the Sravaka Vehicle, the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle, that is, the Single Enlightenment Vehicle, must all be complete.

“Two things like that” (Two things like that) only Buddhas, World-Honored Ones and great Bodhisattvas can skillfully protect, not Shravakas and Pratyekabuddhas can do it, nor hundreds of thousands of na-du-da Great Brahma Heavenly King and Heavenly Emperor Thich Thien, the Chakravartin Kings in the four great continents can protect can maintain. Only Buddha and great Bodhisattvas can protect.

(Sutra) In the future, try to save the Buddha, be the Kshatriya-king of the Lamb, view If he attains renunciation in the dharma child, he will become a monk, be deceived by the ca-sa, the means of the four spheres will be too lost, will have the fate of the race, will be cursed, will be humiliated, or will be the family's staff, or will be locked up in prison, or will take personal tools, or will escape from the ca-sa, will the spirit be returned to the world, will be the cause of the family's family, or will be destroyed, or will be tortured, or will be deprived of food, or will harm the body and life. (Sutra: In the future life, in this Buddha land, there will be King Sat-de-loi When the Lamb sees a person following my Dharma to become a monk, to shave off his hair and beard, to wear a kasaya, he uses all means to uncover the mistakes that person has made, using all kinds of conditions to reprimand, curse, humiliate him, or beat him with whips, sticks, or put him in prison, or deprive him of necessary items, or strip him of his kasaya, force him to return to the secular world, order him to do all kinds of household chores, or arrogantly command him to serve him, or abuse his power to chase him away, or cut him off. food, or harming one's life. That King Sat-de-li-Chan-t-la used the power of his own ignorance and arrogance to humiliate and punish my disciples who were protected by the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas with great compassion. He slandered and destroyed my very profound Dharma protected by the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas with the same great compassion. It obstructed and hid the Dharma of the Three Vehicles jointly protected by Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, so that it could not be saved. transmission).

This paragraph is about the End of Dharma. There is an evil king, Chiên-do-la (Caṇḍāla) which means "evil, without good faith". He saw monks, that is, monks who shaved off their beards and hair, and relied on Buddhism to become monks, so he dug into their various mistakes. “Four killings” is to search for and dig up mistakes that have been made. Use all causes and conditions to rebuke, scold, humiliate, and even use whips and sticks to beat monastics. Those things belong to punishment! Or put them in jail. In the past, there was also this kind of situation. Both the Ming Dynasty and the Manchu Qing Dynasty had it. Everyone saw that old man Tu Bach and master Ham Son had both been imprisoned. Old man Tu Bach died in prison. During the Manchu Qing period, lamas and monks also [suffered] a lot. Most recently, Bat Chi Dau Da, also known as Te Thien, was also imprisoned. During the Dharma Ending period, this phenomenon always existed!

At that time, the good roots of sentient beings are thin and few, and those who become kings have merit. Due to the ripening of merit from many lifetimes, that person becomes a king. During the Dharma-Ending Age, he saw people becoming monks, saw people relying on Buddhism to become monks, and then he looked for their mistakes. Master Ham Son and old man Tu Bach were implicated by Queen Mother Hoang, because the emperor [Van Lich, aka Minh Than Tong] and Queen Mother Hoang had a conflict. The Queen Mother respected them as teachers and offered them a lot of money to build a temple. The king [due to his love of Taoism] immediately used that excuse to put them in prison. In prison, we monastics are not allowed to talk to each other, and the cells are different. After that, let out work, no matter how strict, when let out for air, you can also chat. I know they are blessed by Buddha and Bodhisattva. If you say it out loud, it will make everyone feel very inconceivable. In it, contains the inspiration and blessings of Buddha and Bodhisattva.

This type of story is sometimes caused by Compound Karma, called Life Impairment. At that time, everyone committed Communal Karma. Our persecutors are also a group. So the victims are also a group of people. Regardless of whether they are at home or a monk, they are all victims. Due to your past karma, you must suffer. Spend all your debt and receive blessings, depending on your merit, depending on how you repay! Actually, when that time comes, seeing that everything is Emptiness, it will be okay! Looking from the appearance (appearance), it seems very bad, but looking from the essence, because it has been received, there will be no more. That is also the essence of Practice [of the Four Noble Truths].

Therefore, in the Dharma Ending period, that evil king saw people wearing ca-sa and was not very happy, using all kinds of conditions to scold, curse, humiliate, even use whips, put them in prison, confiscate all the things needed by the mass of monks in temples and pagodas, making it impossible for them to live, and not allowing them to become monks anymore. Or force them to undress and return to secular life. Not only did they return to secular life, but they also forced them to do the things of lay people. Or arrogantly order them to be servants, treating them as lowly servants. Or extreme abuse of power. "Abuse of power and renunciation" means not relying on the Buddha's regulations, not relying on the Sangha to attain renunciation, but abuse of power and renunciation.

Or cut off their food, or harm their lives. That evil king, due to his own stupidity, used the power of arrogance to humiliate the monastic disciples, to the point of defamation and destruction. That means destroying the Sangha, destroying the Dharma. If there is no Sangha, no Dharma, Buddha statues will also be destroyed. That is destroying the Three Jewels. If that person destroys the Mahayana Dharma protected by the Buddhas of the three worlds, it will be obscured and hidden, and the Dharma cannot be passed down. For example, in Taiwan, using the image of Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara) to advertise on the streets is all like that. The packaging with His image printed on it was torn and thrown all over the street. So, although it is not the destruction of the dharma, doing it that way is not very different from Mainland China, and is fundamentally disrespectful. That karma is also great, people use Buddhist literature to propagate, magazines also widely use [images of Buddha and Bodhisattva]. Speaking of which, we have friends who believe in Buddha. When you see Buddha images in those magazines, what do you feel? So many things were thrown around! Even at sutra printing factories, publications [with images of Buddha and Bodhisattva] were damaged and thrown all over the ground. What is that for? The merit of printing sutras and the loss of merit are almost equivalent, both are phenomena of destroying Buddha Dharma. Isn't it protected by the Buddhas of the three worlds? Why is it still destroyed? The karma of sentient beings is greater than Buddha's power. If the Buddha's power was not greater than Buddha's power, Buddha would have saved us all! Because our karma hinders us, we cannot overcome it, so we cannot pass it on!

Huu Linh Ky is suffering from a terrible illness, suffering from dizzy spells, being unable to speak, suffering from all kinds of suffering and poison, painful and painful suffering, and his final life is destined to be reborn in the Great Hell of Intermittent Hell.

Those people are not even the dharma weapon of the Shravaka, the Single-Enlightened Second Vehicle, let alone the dharma weapon of the supreme Mahayana! Those people commit great sins against all three generations of Buddhas, and also commit great sins against all three generations of Thanh Van Those Kshatriyas of Chien-tà-la as well as those of Phiet-xa, Thu-datta-la-Chan-tà-la, whether male or female, due to evil karma, give rise to crazy views, damage, and cut off all the good roots they originally had. Even though they practice many blessings of alms, in the future life, they will be born in the demon world or the animal world, enjoying rich and happy results, but in their bodies, they will not be able to give rise to the poor good roots in the Form Realm. and the Formless Realm, not to mention being able to sow the seed of Omniscience which is of no use in the Sravakas, Solitary Enlightenment, and the Supreme Vehicle? It also causes those people to have tongue disease for many days and nights, to be speechless, to suffer extreme, unbearable pain and suffering, and will certainly be reborn in the Great Hell of No Intermittent.

What does this paragraph say? That evil king, those evil people, those evil people, even the great ministers, officials, both men and women, because they are stupid, have no wisdom, are arrogant, complacent, call themselves Mahayana, study Mahayana dharma, want to blaspheme the Shravaka dharma, blaspheme the Pratyekabuddha dharma, and not even allow it to be passed down. The Buddha said that such people don't even have "Sravakas, Pratyekabuddhas, Two Vehicles"! Without good roots, how can they enter the unsurpassed Mahayana Dharma? It can only be a crime of blasphemy. But that person, in order to “seek gain, respect, honor”, deceives “the stupid and miscellaneous species of the world” (deceives and deceives the foolish species in the world).. “The miscellaneous species” refers to sentient beings, referring to humans. For this purpose, those people say they study the Mahayana, do not need the Second Vehicle method, do not need the twelve causes and conditions of Thanh Van and Pratyekabuddha, so they do not allow the circulation of any [Second Vehicle] method, gradually they will be lost. That is slandering the True Dharma of Tathagata's Second Vehicle.

“Like visionaries are foolish, arrogant, arrogant, jealous, and greedy” (Such people are foolish, arrogant, arrogant, jealous, stingy, greedy), due to those causes and conditions, they destroy our dharma vision, causing it to quickly be hidden. Dharma is the wisdom eye of the Buddhas, also the dharma eye of the Buddhas. It is very difficult for you to understand these dharmas! Being able to hear the name is not easy. Currently, there are many names of sutras that we have not heard of. Because no one talks about them, you will not hear them. Like the Great Collection of Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra, not to mention our lay friends and monastics, many people who hear the name of this sutra are very surprised! Never heard of it, and no one criticized it. In the past, the great virtues would not have proposed it, no one would have said it. Because at that time, there were many prejudices and attachments, thinking that this was a Hinayana dharma, [that] Ksitigarbha Sutras were all about ghosts and spirits, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva in hell did not recognize him as a great Bodhisattva. Now is the time of the end of the Dharma, all phenomena are present. You have never heard of it, how can you learn it? Can't study!

As for the Second Vehicle dharma, [in China], it only [mentions] the A Ham Sutra and the Cau Xa commentary. When I became a monk, I studied these dharmas very little. Later, due to our interactions with Sri Lanka and Thailand, we also sent monks to study abroad in those countries, or from Japan. They value the A Ham Sutra and Southern Buddhism and do not slander them. Previously, Southern Traditional Buddhism could not be spread to the Mainland. Mainland China only had Zen Buddhism, so when Zen Buddhism was most prosperous, many dharmas were hidden. Why? At the time Tam Vu destroyed the Buddha, no study was allowed, no practice was allowed, there was no way, you were not allowed to become a monk! The Venerable Monks then retired to the mountains, only able to meditate, without any scriptures to read. Therefore, when Zen Buddhism flourished, at that time, many sutras were hidden.

Therefore, the monarch has a very important relationship. If the king is a disciple of the Three Jewels and strongly promotes Buddhism, the people can easily sow blessings! But for the sake of fame, gain, deception, and deception of the world, they proposed to destroy the Second Vehicle Dharma. The Dharma of the Second Vehicle is also protected by the Buddhas of the three times, [yet] they (the evil kings) do not allow it to be studied, and will commit a very serious sin. What retribution will there be? The limbs are disabled, lacking, suffering from all kinds of serious and difficult diseases. Those evil-natured people, whether male or female, due to creating that evil view, creating that bad karma, give rise to crazy views. The upside down view is "considering the dharma as illegal, considering the illegal as dharma". Inverted knowledge causes all good roots to first and foremost be reduced until they are completely destroyed. All good roots, including good roots sown and blessings cultivated in the past, are destroyed in this life. When planting good roots and cultivating blessings here, it will be very difficult.

Accumulated merit is also very easy to lose, not solid. The Buddha called those living beings “mao path ordinary people”, [implying] like hairs in the air, there is no need for strong winds or storms, just a little breeze will blow you away, because you cannot concentrate! There are people who, although they have evil nature, have a little good root to develop and have blessings through practicing almsgiving. Because of that blessing, they will be able to enjoy it, but that person will be born into the path of ghosts, or into the path of being born in the realm of animals. Whether one is a buffalo or horse, or one turns into a mass of people and is born in an animal species, that person will also enjoy the blessings and fruits of happiness!

In India, “huthe statue of fragrant elephants wearing peanuts”, in this country, we can also see. Like the Mongol kings, their mounts were horses, and those horses enjoyed much more pleasure than the serfs! A horse always has two slaves taking care of it, they are called “horsemen” (horse herders). When we were in the Northeast, at that time, there were no cars, no planes, bandits and soldiers all rode horses. High-ranking generals from the commander up, their horses are well fed and cared for by horse herders. That's called "giving birth to blessings". Elephants in India are very miserable, they have to carry a lot of heavy loads, but there are elephants that have good fortune, especially "the incense-shaped statue of happiness", which has that meaning!

Even though they have that blessing, that person still falls into the devil's path, that's how the demon king's great power is like that. Such types of living beings, in this present life, do not have good roots to be born in heaven. [The scriptures talk about] The Form Realm and the Formless Realm are heavenly beings, they do not have that blessing. Even if you have little merit and virtue, how can you sow the good roots of Sravaka, Pratyekabuddha, and Supreme Vehicle? Up to the good roots of Omniscience, those people have no good roots of Buddha Dharma, no good roots of Sravakas and Pratyekabuddhas. Unsurpassed, useless, omniscient wisdom, those seeds of good roots do not exist. At the same time, due to defamation of the Dharma in the present life, those people will have tongue disease, because defamation of the Dharma is all caused by the mouth. When encountering retribution, you will be "suffering from a terrible illness, unable to speak for many days" (suffering from the illness for many days and nights, unable to speak, unable to speak), unable to speak. "Suffering all the poisonous sufferings, pain and suffering, the final life will definitely be born in the great hell of Infinite Intermittent" (suffering the poisonous sufferings, extreme pain, unbearable, the final life will definitely be born in the great hell of Uninterrupted Hell), after death, one will fall into hell!

The karma vehicle and the single-enlightened vehicle uses the dharma of liberation because the robes. just.

Those who have the dignity of becoming a monk, shave their beards, and wear red ka-sa are the form of liberation of the sages, are also the dharma of liberation, the form of liberation is used by all people of the Shravaka Vehicle, and are also the dharma of liberation, the form of liberation is enjoyed by all those of the Solitary Vehicle. The Enlightenment Vehicle is also the dharma of liberation and is used by all those who belong to the Mahayana.
