Why do we have to say that? “Try to take refuge in the Dharma, but instead of cultivating, you will have the appearance of a monk's ca-sa” (Those people will take refuge in my Dharma, shave off their hair and beard, wear a red ca-sa, and have the appearance of becoming a monk). That type of appearance represents the appearance of a monk who has become a monk. Dignity, action, even a piece of ka-sa of monks, covering the ka-sa, shaving off hair and beard is "liberation of the form". The appearance of the dharma field means “establishing the Dharma”. When you see those people, you think of the Buddha and the Dharma. The Buddha preached to teach us liberation, not bondage. Currently, our bodies and minds have all kinds of bondage, especially the bondages in the body are especially serious and cannot be freed! Greed, anger, ignorance, arrogance, doubt, Body View, Boundary View, Precepts, Precepts, Wrong Views, even killing, stealing, sexual misconduct, lies, all of these things bind our bodies, making it impossible to achieve liberation!

If it is “The Mahayana branch of humanity uses the dharma for liberation as the stage of liberation” (It is the field for Mahayana people to receive the dharma for the stage of liberation): Almsgiving, precepts, patience, Meditation, wisdom, these dharmas are all the field of appearance of the Mahayana. If you follow that, you will be able to be liberated and become a Bodhisattva. If you follow Suffering, Origin, Cessation, and Path to practice, you will be able to become Thanh Van. Contemplation of all dharmas that arise, contemplation of all dharmas of complete destruction, contemplation of all dharmas that cycle through good and evil, cause and effect and retribution in the world, will belong to the dharma of the Single Enlightenment Vehicle. The Dharma of each vehicle can help you achieve liberation. If you truly accept and maintain it, you will have a supreme sense of liberation. Just like eating, you will crave a certain flavor, and when you eat it you will feel pleasure. If you don't like the taste, you won't feel comfortable eating it. There are people who can't eat chili. If you give them a bowl of food seasoned with chili, they will die of misery, it doesn't feel right! That person is a Hinayana Dharma weapon and if you speak about the Mahayana Dharma to that person, it will be very inappropriate.

Currently, this country all speaks the Mahayana dharma, but no one listens to the Hinayana dharma. You point out all the phenomena in objective life, but they don't listen. Even speaking according to the precepts, speaking according to the particular precepts of liberation, they feel it is too binding and inappropriate. Why do they believe in Mahayana Dharma? They do not really believe, but because the Mahayana dharma is convenient. We, as disciples of Buddha, should know: All the dharmas spoken by the Buddha are spoken in response to the basis, that is, [the listener knows] whatever the basis is, then tell them that dharma. If it is not true to the fundamentals, it is a mistake. How can we be true to our fundamentals? [During the Dharma-Ending Age], from that person himself (the one who preaches the sutras, preaches the Dharma), from that person's language and writing obstacles, and also the dharma obstacle, that person does not know what dharma should be said to this object. Therefore, that person can only preach this sutra. If you listen to this dharma and take advantage of it, that means you correspond to this dharma. If you don't use it, you may not listen. Why is there such a situation? Because everyone's blessings are fragile!

When Buddha was alive, we did not meet. Until after the Buddha entered Nirvana, there were still great Arhats in the world, and we never met them! At the end of the Dharma, everything will be gone! However, I can still feel the end of the Dharma, there are Buddha statues, scriptures, and monks wearing robes. If another two thousand years pass, there is no need for ten thousand years, I'm afraid that two thousand years later, those [forms] will no longer exist, and will gradually be cut off.

Currently, printing technology is very developed, we print so many scriptures, why wouldn't there be? At that time, the scriptures will disappear on their own. Due to karma, when opened, they will all be original scriptures without words, turning into Vo Tu Thien Thu (heaven's books without words)! Why are there no words? Either because of the climate, or because of the humidity, rotting, the words are no longer there! Or the ink is smeared all over. This story is related to blessings.

Inspired by you, gathered by yourself, “tap” means “gathered”. It's you who feels it, gathers it, and suffers it yourself. That is the worldly cause and effect, the two Noble Truths of Suffering and the Origin, the worldly cause and effect, caused by the karma you have created, in which there is joy, but suffering is the majority. Reflecting on our real life, even if you have wealth, you cannot avoid getting sick, nor can it make your thoughts very happy. There are people who have a lot of wealth. If you talk to that person, [you will see] that person is completely unhappy. In his mind, that person is not liberated, he is called “servant of money”, not the owner of money. There is a Chinese proverb that says “the god who protects wealth”, that person protects money, even though he himself does not dare to use it. For parents, wives and children, they do not dare to leave. The guardian of wealth is like that! Can that person still give alms to outsiders? No way!

Listening to the Dharma is also inconceivable! If you want to leave suffering, “leave suffering and be happy”, you must practice the path of renunciation. By cultivating the path, you will be able to attain it. What is it that you will attain? To attain nirvana, that is “leaving suffering”. Realizing the Noble Truth of the Path and the Noble Truth of Extinction, that is, cause and effect beyond the world. This type of dharma is very good for our present life. For the Six Paramitas, all the virtues, up to the Prajnaparamita, it seems that you can still sow good roots, but you cannot receive them. Why? If you are a person with merit and wisdom, you will be able to enjoy it; Those who do not have wisdom will not be able to enjoy it. In the Second Vehicle Dharma, there are many meditation practices. If you meditate, your body and mind are very calm. It is not easy for you to enter Mahayana Meditation. Why can't we enter Mahayana Meditation? In everyday life, whatever you do, you must use meditation. According to the Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma Sutra, the practice of Meditation is that every thought never leaves the Three Jewels. That's Dinh. If you can recite without leaving the [Three Jewels], that is Concentration. Once you leave, it will not be Concentration, it will already be out of Concentration! Coming out of Samadhi will mean doing other things, doing worldly things. The world has good, evil, and indeterminacy (no good, no evil). If you don't do things that hurt others, you are neither good nor evil. Doing good deeds and benefiting others is called goodness. If you do evil things and cause harm to others, that is evil. Usually, use this to make a judgment. Mahayana Concentration is "Na Gia is always in Concentration" (Buddha is always in Concentration), Na Gia Concentration is not easy, isn't it because of having planted good roots for countless lifetimes, it will be very difficult to attain Concentration!

In the Mahayana dharma, we need to worship, regardless of the ritual, it is all Mahayana. Regardless of the sutras, whenever it comes to repentance, you must contemplate and dedicate the Dharma realm to sentient beings. That is the dharma that belongs to the Mahayana. Whenever you can participate in repentance, Great Compassion Repentance is the same, but Medicine Master Repentance, Contemplation Repentance, for any method of repentance, if you have not planted good roots in countless Buddhas, you will not be able to meet them. When you bow, you won't be brave enough to participate. After bowing, that's it, three days of fishing, two days of drying nets, that's what it means! But if you bow once, you will gain merit once. If you bow for a long time, you will be liberated, without obstacles, but it is a very difficult thing. It is still impossible to say what the future will be like, but right now, while you are praying, many obstacles can arise. You want to worship, but you can't take care of your family members, you have to take care of your children. The time for repentance has been set, but then you have to make dinner and take your children to school! "No, I have to worship." So you won't be able to do it, and you won't be able to pray and repent. Obstacles will arise in your home. You must follow the worldly dharma and be able to practice the worldly dharma, causing all causes and conditions to ripen, and that good root is not easy!

If I say this, you probably won't believe it. Do you see that our monks and nuns are brave and diligent in their practice? Take me right away to say, I'm not like that, I can't do it. The guardian god cannot resist the evil force! We say "demons fear evil people", butchers hold scalpels, all demons are afraid, even ghosts and gods do not dare to get close to that person. Understand this principle,

you'll see!

Those people should stay away from those evil things, leave evil friends, and stay close to good friends. Almsgiving, precepts, patience, diligence, meditation, wisdom, those six subjects, you can achieve any of them, but you must persevere in practice. Practicing all six disciplines together is even more wonderful! But now, with regard to Luc Paramitas, we have committed a mistake. What's the defect? Without diligence and leisure, you will not be able to practice successfully in any subject. We don't have faith, why? A person who has diligent faith and diligence, as soon as he hears this Dharma, then resolutely carries it out, can also eliminate all obstacles, and would rather give up his life and life and still practice, only then can he be considered to have steadfast faith. Otherwise, it cannot be considered to have faith. Whenever he encounters challenges, he does not do anything and has no faith. Faith is still a fragile hair, as soon as the wind blows, it shakes. Whenever he has faith, he will eliminate all obstacles.

When each person becomes a monk, he has to go through many difficulties. The past and present are both like that, beard and hair do not fall out that easily. If you say you can become a monk, you can become a monk immediately, there will be many obstacles. After becoming a monk, there are still many obstacles that cause you to return to the world. Karma is discovered like that. Even if you don't want to return to this world, you can't. It will make you also willing to return to the world. Having become a monk and having learned so many dharmas, why do you still want to return to the world? That's because karma found out. Once karma is discovered, one will retreat from the path. Don't get close to those people! Therefore, practicing the Six Paramitas, diligently practicing the Six Paramitas, can reach the other shore, can transcend, and overcome birth and death.

We always hope to have magical powers. To have magical powers, you must think of a means, then find a secret to have magical powers. It is said that if you recite a mantra, you will have magical powers; I heard that somewhere there was a method that would make you rich and make your body healthy, so you came immediately. The result is a mistake, nothing! You pray for it yourself, you can pray for it yourself, you pray to gain magical powers, but if you have magical powers if you fall, you will be lost. The Six Thong Immortals in India are pagans, not Buddhists. In the past, when they came to worship, they all flew down from the air. One time the king made offerings to them and invited those immortals. The king thought about offering offerings and praying, and immortals from all over flew to him. The king planned to test their moral strength, so he sent his maids to pay their respects. As soon as we came into contact, there was a pagan who was very steadfast, practiced well, had no problems, had no thoughts in his mind, [received the offerings then] flew away. There are pagans, when the palace maids bow and hug a person's feet, because their hands are very soft, that person is touched. As soon as I think, I can't fly and immediately lose my magical powers!

Everyone knows Venerable Ananda. One day, when he went to beg for alms, he went to a prostitute and Ma Dang Gia saw him. Because the two of them had a predestined relationship in the past five hundred lives, she would not be willing to marry him, so she asked her mother to use an evil spell. Her mother said: "Don't do it! This is the master's disciple. Furthermore, Ananda is very famous, my magic spells don't work, I have to use Brahma's magic spells." The girl kept pleading; otherwise, will commit suicide. Her mother was reluctant and used a spell to make Ananda confused. As soon as he was confused, the Buddha immediately knew and sent Manjushri Bodhisattva there to recite the Shurangama mantra, also the Lang Gia mantra. For that mantra, you can recite one sentence “sat dat multi bowl dat ra” and that's enough, you don't need to memorize the entire mantra. You won't be able to remember it all, just focus on "all dat multi bowl dat ra". If practiced effectively, this mantra will destroy that evil mantra. That's because His past karmic conditions were ripe, so he appeared like that. Ma Dang Gia followed him to the Buddha and said: "If I don't have you, I will die. Buddha must save me." The Buddha immediately preached to her, “contemplating the body as impure, contemplating feelings as suffering, contemplating the impermanence of the mind”. As soon as she said that Dharma, she opened her mind to explain it and immediately attained Arhatship.

From the status of a prostitute, one can attain Arahantship, not to mention the story of the dragon girl in the Lotus Sutra becoming a Buddha right in the body of a dragon. That's because she accumulated good roots in the past. If you only look at the real situation, you will think it is impossible, because you do not see the real situation clearly. If you want to practice supernatural powers, recite a mantra, go into seclusion for a hundred days, and only pray for supernatural powers. There is a method, but I don't want to learn that method! What is true supernatural power? What is “God”? God is your natural mind, also your present thought. “Pine” is expanded wisdom. Wisdom is wisdom. Spirit is about the natural mind (natural mind), Wisdom is about wisdom nature, that is, your own mind is open to wisdom, karma is eliminated, you will be clear. That understanding is "true understanding".

If you practice the Six Paramitas, how should you practice? Must repent! Repentance is repentance, not once or twice, it must be repented many times. Repent of bad karma to purify it, good karma will grow, you should be diligent in making the right vows accordingly. Make the right vow to become a Buddha and to benefit sentient beings. Reciting the Pure Hanh chapter, Pham Hanh chapter, and Samantabhadra Vow chapter is learning to make vows. Right vow: Quite a few vows do not depart from the ten great vows of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva. Many vows are excerpted from there. If you can make such a vow, then you can enter the land and achieve it. The current body can achieve the dharma weapon of the Shravaka Vehicle, achieve the dharma weapon of the Single Enlightened Vehicle, achieve the non-retreating seed of the Single Enlightened Vehicle, or the non-retreating seed of the Mahayana. The Single Enlightenment Vehicle is deeper than the [Sravaka Vehicle], the Mahayana is even deeper. We sow good roots, sow seeds that can keep us from retreating. In the present life, you can attain the state of the three vehicles. You should practice well and study well. If you have not attained it in this life, you can attain it in the future.

If you vow to be born in the Pure Land, you should not withdraw your mind. Even in this life, the next life, or the life after that, you will definitely be able to be reborn, because there are Buddhas in the six directions to protect your rebirth. Book eighty-one of the Mahayana Buddha Avatamsaka Sutra is the Samantabhadra Vow leading to the Pure Land. Everyone who recites the Samantabhadra Vow will be of the highest quality. Whoever recites Samantabhadra's Prayer will be born in the world of Ultimate Bliss.

When the Sutra on Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma is preached in the lower volume, it says “the Realm of One Truth, two types of contemplation of the path”. If you don't succeed in cultivating, you won't be able to advance. How? This will be nice! If you really have no way to recite my name (Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva) [in the way of contemplation], then every day by reciting ten thousand sentences, I will make you achieve it. This can be done, that is skillful means. Don't look for pagan sects! According to the heretical sect, you will not be able to enter. Not only can you not enter, but you can also be relied on by demons! Whenever you are dependent on demons, you will be miserable and fall into the path of demons!

The Three Vehicles practice like that, "don't be arrogant, falsely claim the Mahayana, slander the Sravakas, the Single-Enlightenment Vehicle. The self-centered immortals of the Mahayana dharma practice the practitioner" (don't be arrogant, arrogantly call the Mahayana, slander the Sravakas and the Single-Enlightened Vehicles. In the past, I was only for others' sake. belonging to the Mahayana dharma equipment for solid practice): That is what the Buddha himself said. Now I do not say contradictions, even the three yana dharmas say it, absolutely not contradictory, but true to the foundation!"

Losing the early merits, holding on to delusion and evil views, impure ways, non-dharma weapons, and not punishing them? And tell me to listen to their teachings, the wonderful dharma of the three vehicles, good medicine, true liberation, leading to tranquil Nirvana? Why does another sutra say, only the Mahayana liberates, preventing the study of the Two Vehicles, but now it talks about the three vehicles? Pity all sentient beings, make them abandon evil and evil karma, For the benefit of peace and happiness, please speak to eliminate doubts. For the sake of Sat-tara, to the extent of Thu-atta-la, forbid the mind to turn upside down, afraid of being tainted with a great sin.

Buddha repeated this meaning again. In front of the crowd, Vajragarbha Bodhisattva asked the Buddha. Vajrayana Bodhisattva asked how? "Van Ha recommends making offerings and breaking the evil precepts", that is, asking the Buddha why he advised people to make offerings to Bhikkhus who break the precepts? “That do-da merit” (Losing the early-da merit): Eliminating Tran Sa afflictions is called “do-da”. “Do-da” (Dhuta, dau-da) is a type of asceticism, that is, a type of asceticism for those who practice religion. “Holding on to ignorance and evil views” (Hold by delusion and evil views): Those Bhikkhus are not dharma weapons, causing the religion, that is, the religion that they practice, up to the Buddha's teachings, to be polluted and impure. “I do not listen to punishment” (But punishment is not allowed): Why do I tell you not to punish those monks, but also to make offerings to them? In the previous section explained. Among those poor monks, there are also people who can preach the Dharma. Therefore, from them, you can also hear the wonderful Dharma of the three vehicles. After hearing it, you will be able to be liberated. It is the medicine of liberation, the good path to move towards Nirvana and tranquility, which is also the Bodhi path. Therefore, for poor monks, there is no need to choose to make offerings because of this reason! Other sutras do not say so.

“Ha co-residual sutras, the first Mahayana liberation, the value of learning the Two Vehicles, the golden teachings of the three vehicles? Ai introspection of all sentient beings, the spirit of letting go of evil and evil karma” (Why do other sutras only say one Mahayana path of liberation, prohibiting the study of dharma Second Vehicle, now the Buddha speaks of three vehicles? Because of his compassion for sentient beings, causing them to abandon evil karma): There are places (in other sutras) where it is said that the One Vehicle of the Mahayana is liberation. When you prevent you from learning other vehicles, it is to prevent that type of energy (Mahayana energy) from falling into the Second Vehicle. In the past, the sutras taught like that, but now we speak of the three vehicles, that is, Sravaka, Pratyekabuddha, and Bodhisattva Vehicle, all saying the same thing, out of pity for sentient beings, causing all sentient beings to abandon evil karma, "gain benefits and peace", so we are willing to speak for them, to eliminate their doubts.

“For the sake of Kshatriya, up to Thudattala, unheard-of brain, terrible sin” (For the sake of Kshatriya up to Thudatta, I do not allow those people to be mentally disturbed, lest they be infected with great sin): I do not let them tell their faults. monks for fear of committing a great sin. "That's the phat, be ca-sa, the Buddha's dharma-place" (Shave your hair, apply ca-sa, that is the dharma-place of the Buddhas): As long as someone shaves their beard and hair, the appearance of a bhikkhu is shown, that is the dharma-place of the Buddhas. "All Buddhas protect and protect the path of liberation" (All Buddhas protect the clothes of the path of liberation): I protect that person because I protect the field of the path of liberation, protect the red ka-sa.

Without faith, chanting the Mahayana, without words, without benefit!
Nirvana is like a good medicine that cures all diseases. Breaking the rules and doubts also destroys the suffering of others. If you become a Bodhisattva or a Buddha, you are still allowed to preach the Dharma. If you respect the Three Jewels, you will abandon the evil deeds. If you fall into the land of La Sat, each of you will be able to cross the sea and be free from danger evil views, through belief, escape from the afflictions of La Sat. Such a form of liberation, the Buddhas together protect, do not have the mind to break the Sangha, stay away from heavy evils, happy to seek true liberation, protect the air, attain liberation, how difficult is it to be ignorant, to claim Mahayana, to be ignorant of the Second Vehicle, to understand Mahayana? For example, someone with blind eyes cannot see such faith. If you don't have the strength to drink a pond or a river, how can you swallow the ocean? If you don't practice the Second Vehicle, how can you learn the Mahayana? If you don't believe in the Mahayana, it's useless.

“Even though he broke the rules of doubt, he won't be able to pay the eternal price of liberation” (Even though he broke the rules of doubt, he won't ever prevent liberation): Don't see that person now breaking the precepts, not cultivating the path, he's an evil person, an impure path! That person is not forever unliberated, that person can definitely be liberated. When that person lets go of evil views, he will quickly move towards Bodhi and will definitely attain Bodhi very quickly. Just like good medicine, even though it is rotten, can still cure diseases. Bhikkhus have to look in the trash to find medicine to drink, but to drink spoiled medicine, that is prescribed by the Buddha: "If a Bhikkhu is sick, he must find spoiled medicine to drink." If you drink corrupted medicine, thanks to Buddha's blessings, you will be cured.

“If you break the rules of ritual, you have the ability to destroy others' suffering” (A person who does not keep the rules of ritual like that can also destroy the suffering of others): Don't see that person as an evil monk, that person can still destroy the suffering of others. Others can still sow blessings in that person. "If you do not listen to the Buddha's teachings, it is because of the Bodhisattva, the Bodhisattva" (It is not allowed for that Bodhisattva to participate in the Bodhisattva and Bodhisattva): Even though that person is not allowed to listen to the monks reciting the precepts, and is not entitled to enjoy the offerings made to the Sangha, that person is still allowed to preach the Dharma to sentient beings. Why? When that person preaches the Dharma, he will gain merit and eliminate karma. The listener also has merit. That is the decisive thing, there is no doubt!

“ If one takes refuge in the Three Jewels, claiming oneself as a great master, one can release all evil energy and overcome all heretics” (If one respects the Three Jewels, calls oneself a great master, one can abandon evils, much better than heretics): Just by taking refuge in me, that person calls me a great master, letting go of evils, then one will be stronger than heretics. very much. "Like falling into a La Sat Chu, the people will be terrified" (Like falling on the shores of La Sat, the merchants will be terrified): The merchants went [into the sea] to collect treasures, came to the wrong place of La Sat, and were afraid to death. If “the beasts have one fur, they will be able to escape the sea” (if each person holds the fur of the divine beast, they will cross the sea and escape): That beast is very large, just holding a strand of its fur can float on the sea to escape. "Like this, breaking the false precepts, abandoning all evil and wrong views, by having one faith in the cause, escapes the afflictions of La Sat" (The one who breaks the precepts is the same, by abandoning evil views, using faith as the cause, escapes the afflictions of the La Sat): "One faith" means that person still has faith. Because you have such faith, you can also be liberated.

“Such a sign of liberation, all Buddhas protect it” (Such a sign of liberation, all Buddhas together protect and maintain): That person puts on the ka-sa, shows such a sign of liberation, all Buddhas protect and maintain that sign of liberation. "If you don't mind breaking the Sangha's precepts, you won't be able to break the precepts" (If you don't mind breaking the Sangha's precepts, you can leave the serious evil things): You should not be deranged when you break the precepts, you can also escape the ocean of suffering.

“The people of many blessings, wishing for true liberation, are equally protective of non-dharma objects” (People with many blessings, fond of seeking true liberation, will equally protect dharma objects and non-dharma objects): Equal protection, regardless of dharma objects or non-dharma objects. If you wish for true liberation, treat monks who break the precepts and keep the precepts equally. Only this sutra says so, other sutras rarely say so. If you study the precepts, you will see complete disagreement.

The Great Collection of Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra is the especially compassionate sutra of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. “It is like the eyes are damaged” [that is, if] the eyesight is damaged, “cannot see all forms” (cannot see all colors): Eyes cannot see any color! "If faith is destroyed, it is impossible to understand Mahayana" (Similarly, those whose faith is impaired will not be able to understand Mahayana): Faith does not exist, how can one believe in Mahayana?

“ Powerless to moisten the river, enormous power to swallow the ocean?” (Without the power to drink up ponds and rivers, how can one swallow the sea?): Even river water cannot be swallowed, how can one swallow ocean water? It's impossible! If “you do not practice the Second Vehicle, you cannot study the Mahayana?”, [that is] you do not study the Second Vehicle, learn the Mahayana dharma right away, how can you learn? It must be "first to believe in the Second Vehicle dharma, to be able to believe in the Mahayana dharma" (first believe in the Second Vehicle dharma to be able to believe in the Mahayana dharma): These are in order. "If you don't have faith in reciting the Mahayana, there's no use for it" (If you don't have faith, reading and reciting the Mahayana is just empty talk, with no benefit): If you don't have faith, what's the benefit of reciting Mahayana sutras?

Dharma. That person is destined to fall into the Void. Therefore, you should contemplate the situation, do not speak arrogantly, be cruel, or be cowardly.
