Or do you fall back on the ego of all monks, weak in dharma weapons, weak in dharma weapons, full of anger, insults, humiliation, opportunism, contemptuous laughter, slanderous species, hidden good, positive evil, generous talk even giving rise to contempt and arrogance, types that touch the mind. Such people, unholy dharma objects, are truly foolish, are too clever and arrogant, are destined to die, fall into the three evil beasts, receive countless kinds of powerful monks, are difficult to endure suffering and poison, are shocked by countless hundreds of thousands of na-data-many lifetimes, and are unable to overcome the human body, as previously preached.
(Sutra: At that time, the World-Honored One told the Vajra Pitaka Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat said: - Good man! I use the Buddha's eye to look at the worlds, and see that in the future life, in this Buddha land, there will be countless hundreds of thousands of na-du-da Kshatriya Chien-dala, Brahmin-Chan-d-la, official Chi-m-d-la, lay people--Chan-d-la, rich people. Chien-dà-la, monk Chien-dà-la, Phiet-xa-chên-tà-la, Thu-datta-la Chien-tà-la, whether male or female, rarely sow good roots, although they are human, they follow evil friends, give rise to wrong views, create evil deeds, and destroy our very deep, supreme Dharma. Regarding our dharmas that "make afflictions not burn, destroy [afflictions] burn" do not give rise to heart. believe, or with regard to the Dharma corresponding to the Thanh Van Vehicle that I have spoken, they will slander, despise, destroy, obstruct, hide, and not allow it to be transmitted. Or regarding the Dharma corresponding to the Single Enlightenment Vehicle that I have spoken about, they will slander, despise, destroy, obstruct, hide, and not allow it to be transmitted. Or, regarding the Dharma corresponding to the Supreme Vehicle that I have spoken about, they will slander, despise, destroy, obstruct, hide, and not allow it to be transmitted Those who become monks and take refuge in my Dharma, whether it is a Dharma weapon or not a Dharma device, often do many things of anger, scolding, cursing, humiliating, criticizing, sarcasm, contempt, contempt, all kinds of slander, hiding good things, showing off bad habits, in general, to the point of arousing contempt, all kinds of insults, and confusion. People like that are not the Dharma weapons of the saints, they are truly stupid, arrogant and intelligent. until the end of life, falling into the three evil destiniess, suffering immeasurable sufferings and poisons, strong, unbearable, going through countless hundreds of thousands of verses and many kalpas, it is difficult to regain a human body as described in detail in the previous section).

In the previous section, it was said: Whenever you create karma to blaspheme the Three Jewels, blaspheme the Dharma spoken by the Buddha, sometimes it is Mahayana, sometimes it is Pratyekayana, sometimes it is Shravakayana. Curse each other, until those who become monks, either those who keep the precepts and practice well, or those who do not practice and break the precepts, all harm them, causing all kinds of harm to arise. Doing so will create a lot of negative karma; In the above section, there were many types of sentient beings who turned to the Buddha to repent. The Buddha immediately gave them a prediction, saying: You must repent until you face Buddha Lo Chi [the last Buddha] of the thousand Buddhas [of the Good Life] to be able to repent and purify the negative karma accumulated in your previous life. In this world, the time it takes for a thousand Buddhas [to appear one after another] is also very long. In the previous section, I mentioned the three thousand great worlds and the small and middle kalpas, one is about place, the other is about time. There is another way to say it: Twenty small kalpas is one middle kalpa. That is, [each stage] "construction, existence, destruction, emptiness" lasts twenty small kalpas. Remaining is twenty small kalpas, Destruction is twenty small kalpas, Emptiness is twenty small kalpas. The structure of the earth cannot be formed in such a short time at all!

Current scientists say that planets are formed by nebula formation. If the effect of that connection is achieved, it is called Thanh Kiep. How long does it take? Buddhist scriptures say twenty small kalpas. Scientists don't say how many lifetimes it takes; Depending on that planet gradually from small to large. From baby to adult, [gradual development] like that. Why, when this earth was completed, viewed from the outside, that is, viewed from a spaceship, the planet was blue. “No” of course there is none. Otherwise they wouldn't see it, otherwise there would be no form at all. Why is our globe blue? The earth is surrounded by water, the earth rotates. As a whole, only the sea can be seen, only the water can be seen. Therefore, from the outside, it will be blue. Regarding "formation, existence, destruction, emptiness", we are now in the Eternal Life, [because the earth] has achieved it a long time ago. Although there are many earthquakes, water disasters, and fires, it is not yet time for the earth to be destroyed. These are the three major disasters. When there is a great disaster, the earth will begin to deteriorate.

The Ksitigarbha Sutra teaches: Creating karma on this earth, when the earth is damaged, does that mean we will no longer suffer in hell on earth? Is it not so, [sinners suffering in hell] will move to another world. Who moved? Your own karma shifts. That world is ruined, then it changes to another world. Wait until this world is completed, because you belong to this world, if you commit a sin, you still have to return to this world. So, creation, existence, destruction, and emptiness, each stage goes through twenty small kalpas. How is “Life” determined? It is also based on human lifespan to judge. “Construction” is not an instant success, nor is destruction an immediate destruction, each stage goes through a process of twenty small kalpas. If we use the number of years to calculate, how many billions of years will it take? If we have repented of our sins and are pure, we will be able to increase our faith. Now we are in the stage of increasing our faith, we can only say faith, we can only increase our faith at any time. But our faith is not steadfast, it still has no roots. That faith can

destroyed at any time, no need to wait for the next generation.

Currently, there are many religious friends whose faith can be destroyed at any time, arise and change, do not give rise to a godly mind, that is, do not meet good knowledge. Although Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, and Arhats are still in this world, you are ungainly, and because of your ungodliness, you cannot see them. Since we are in this world, out of fifty, sixty billion people, how many people are we capable of contacting or knowing? Everyone [present here] is from Taiwan, Taiwan has two thousand three hundred thousand people, how many people do you know? You calculate it, it's not much! Why? They are ungrateful to you. Even though they are on the same earth, belonging to the same living conditions, but they are undesired, meaning they have no fate to come into contact with them. Even cats, dogs, animals, or ants, you see are all conditioned! You don't see too many of [living beings]! Even the visible fate does not exist. Even the grace of hearing is absent. Ksitigarbha Sutra teaches a lot that when others suffer because of their karma, you don't see it. Because you don't have a relationship with that person, you also don't hear it. Even the fate of seeing or hearing is absent. Why? Because you don't have that karma. You think we have that karma and hope to escape it, but we can't escape it, we absolutely cannot escape it!

At the time of the Mainland civil war, there was a group of people who came to Taiwan, some of whom did not leave. People in the same family, some people come here one or two people, some people stay in the Mainland, all of these things are predestined. Someone was about to get on the boat, almost there, the boat sank! I have a friend who believes in Buddhism very much. Previously, he worked as an expert in Ningbo, and later became president of Liaoning province. That whole boat was full of people from the Kuomintang, all characters from the chief level[24] and above, carrying a lot of assets. Maybe he brought too much gold, the boat was too heavy, and as soon as he left Shanghai port, when he reached the border with Ningbo, it sank! I went to Beijing to find his younger brother. I asked him what happened and he told me: "My brother's entire family, even my sister-in-law and her children, all drowned." His younger brother did not go, and because he did not go, he stayed in Beijing. That fate is due to their different destinies!

There was a time when I told my friends: "You give birth to nine children, one mother gives birth to nine children, each of the nine children is different. Each child has their own destiny, there is no need to worry too much." Because you don't have that fate, you won't be able to force it! Once you have that predestined relationship, you will naturally become mature. According to that karmic condition, if you repent and purify your sins, the Buddha predicted that when Rucika comes to the world, those people will be able to repent and purify their sins and be able to end their afflictions. Having eliminated afflictions, one can achieve Arhatship, or attain the supreme merit of samadhi. Those Sravakas and Bodhisattvas happily worshiped the Buddha, received the prediction, they were happy, and no longer fell into the three realms! For every Buddha who appears in this world, they will definitely be met; otherwise, the Buddha would not have spoken. One thousand Buddhas appeared in the world, in each Buddha, you repented like that and said the same thing.

After the Buddha finished predicting for those people, he told Vajragarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva: "Good man! I use the Buddha's eye to see that in this Buddha land in the future life, there will be immeasurable, countless hundreds of thousands of verses of na-du-da Kshat-de-ri of Lamb-tu-la-king. [Number of] hundreds of thousands of verse-chi. That na-du-da, not only the Lamba-king, that is, the evil king, but also the evil Brahmins, the evil officials, the evil laymen, the evil bourgeois, even the evil monks, breaking the monks' precepts, corrupting monks, monks cursing monks even more ferociously, monks destroying temples and shrines even more fiercely. Those people are ghosts and nephews sent by Ba Tuan, destroying Buddhism with all their might At first, looking at the parties, even in our Buddhism, when a party or organization or group collapses, how do they collapse first? It's not because of the outside [involved] attacks on each other. It's the same with Buddhism. When Buddhism is about to be destroyed, who destroys it? The disciples all have their share, destroying each other. At that time, the Buddhadharma no longer exists. Therefore, talking about the Lambs is not rare at all, they always exist! Even in the business world of the four types, Phiet-xa is a trader or a farmer, Thu-datta-la is a butcher, that is, those who create bad karma, whether male or female, have very few good roots, absolutely no good roots There are only a few people who sow good roots, before and after. If they are lay followers, in the beginning they do not eat salty foods, there are people who are born without eating salty foods, or after becoming monks, they abstain from eating salty foods and no longer eat salty foods, and when they are old, they eat salty foods again!

There are many people who practice, normally very diligent in applying their efforts, but when they are about to pass away, all karmic obstacles are discovered, but they do not keep the precepts. Many careers are not done! Due to being tormented by illness, hearing people say that eating meat can cure the disease, that person immediately eats meat. Whatever you want that person to do, that person will immediately commit it! When it comes to karma, we cannot control ourselves, we cannot control ourselves. I have seen many Dharma friends, who practiced hard in the mountains all their lives, and when they were about to die, they still could not let go, and all their karmic obstacles were discovered. That's called “throwing away all your previous efforts”. Even though you have sown seeds, you have sown merit, but you throw away all your previous efforts. This is not a rare or strange thing at all! Using the Buddha's eye to contemplate, [you will see] that when the End of the Age comes, those people's good roots are not complete, not deep, and they have planted too few [good roots]. Even though you have a human body and reincarnate as a human, you can still become a disciple of the Three Jewels.

In the Dharma-Ending Age, in the Three Jewels, especially among the four disciples, i.e. Bhikkhus, Bhiksunis, Upasakas, Upasams, those who truly develop the Bodhisattva mind are great Bodhisattvas, there are also those who truly develop the Sravaka's mind, become Arhats, and there are also those who truly develop the Bodhisattva mind. is Asura. They stir up good karma, drag you down, drag you down into the three realms, and turn you into a demon king. Why are they drawn right into the Three Jewels? Because those who belong to the Three Jewels, more or less, have good roots, until old age, when they decline, they still have blessings, the blessings from previous practice are still there, that person may not fall into the three paths, transfer to the demon world, become a demon, a demon (ma child, demon nephew), increasing his team (Ba Tuan). He only looks for disciples in the Three Jewels, because those people are qualified to be born in heaven. To be born into the team of Ba Tuan, you also need to have the Ten Good Karmas. Without the Ten Good Karmas, one cannot be born there. Even though they are ghosts, ghosts still have blessings. Without blessings, how can we enjoy it? It's okay to understand this principle!

Because the purpose of our practice is not to do evil. We do good deeds all our lives, but at the time of our death we do evil, or we are seduced by evil friends, or our relatives in the past, they have very heavy evil karma. Those people can entice you, wanting to pull you into that path to spend time with them. Even though he has a human body, he is turned around by evil people, giving rise to wrong knowledge and wrong views. There are many people among our disciples, whether in Taiwan or Mainland, who are like that! When they have a dangerous relationship, when they have to choose, they use their physical eyes to consider which path will be beneficial, [they do not hesitate, immediately choose that path]: colluding with the powerful, colluding with the wealthy, colluding with mandarins, bullying good monks. Since I became a monk, I have seen too many stories like this. That person can do many evil deeds, create bad karma, and destroy the very profound Dharma of the Buddha. In Buddhism, no matter what Dharma, it is the end of birth and death, it is "leaving suffering and being happy", it is all about ending afflictions. Regarding the dharmas spoken by the Buddha, you don't make any distinction, Explicit, Secret, Great, Small, as long as you achieve a little bit, depending on that dharma to do, you will be able to achieve, be able to be liberated, and be able to end afflictions!

No matter how profound and beautiful the Buddha Dharma is, if you can't practice it, if you don't have the slightest bit of enjoyment, then it won't have anything to do with you. How can it be done? You can't even recite the Buddha's name, you can't persevere in one breath, let alone a very deep visualization! As for practice, how can you practice properly? Faith like that cannot be cultivated, faith cannot be achieved! So what will it be like? The Dharma spoken by the Buddha cannot arise and flourish. It can only cause the Buddha Dharma to gradually be destroyed and cannot flourish. Dharma is like fire, when it burns, it makes others feel warm. If it gradually disappears, after it has been destroyed, it will cause you to not have faith and love. Without faith, a happy mind cannot arise.

“Or the ego speaks evilly about the Sravakayana corresponding to the Dharma, slanders, and destroys” (Or about the Dharma corresponding to the Sravravyana that I have said, slander and destroy): There are people who hear Suffering, Origin, Cessation, and the Path, and immediately develop their mind. They hear and see that the world is suffering. Where does suffering come from? Because you have created karma, because you have created the cause of suffering. Your evil will stop, your suffering will stop. If you do your best to do (create karma), suffering will never stop. This principle is very simple, everyone knows it, but it is very difficult to implement. The Shravaka Vehicle is like that, but so is the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle. In the previous section, the [Great Collection Sutra] said very clearly, especially with regard to illegal weapons, there is a choice. Vajrayana Bodhisattva said that illegal weapons are destructive, so why did the Buddha teach to still respect them? Still want everyone to respect and make offerings to those people? Because those people can still make merit.

In the Dharma-Ending Age, if you want to find a pure monk, you can't find one! Master Nguoi Ich said so, and so did shaman Hoang Nhat. Great Master Nguoi Ich has renounced the monkhood and received the precepts again. Actually, the first time He did not attain precepts, so there was no such thing as “retiring precepts”. At the end of the Ming Dynasty and the beginning of the Qing Dynasty, if you wanted to find five pure monks, you would not be able to find them. There must be five precepts for you to attain the precepts. Great Master Nguoi Ich also said: "From the Southern Song period onwards, there were no five pure monks", which means our times are quite evil!

Buddha said that in the future life, in this Buddha realm, there will be immeasurable, countless, quite a number, over millions of millions. Not only in this world, not only Nam Thiem Bo Chau, but also many Sa Ba worlds, many continents. “Buddha land” in the main sutra refers to which Buddha land? The world of Sa Ba Buddha Land is not a small land of our Nam Thiem Bo Chau, that's why there are so many. Counting all the people in Nam Thiem Bo Chau, there is not a million, because one million is ten billion, is there a number of ten billion [Chien-tu-la king] or not? He talked about King Chien-dala, each country had only one king of Chien-dala. Yet he destroys the Dharma. Regarding the three vehicles, whether it is the Shravaka Vehicle, the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle, or the Supreme Vehicle, he slanders, despises, obfuscates, hides, and does not allow transmission. Even for monastics in my dharma, whether it is a dharma weapon or not a dharma weapon, "a lot of anger, insults, humiliation, scorn, contempt, slander of all kinds, hidden good, positive evil" (doing many things of anger, reprimand, cursing, humiliating, slandering, stinging, scorning, all kinds of slander, hiding good things, revealing evil).

Those people are inherently stupid. “Ignorant” here means they do not understand Buddhism. That is foolishness. They think they are very smart. Regarding worldly dharma, they create conspiracies, tricks, and political fights, thinking themselves very smart, but regarding Buddhist dharma, they are not smart! Therefore, “stupid” is said in that way. For that reason, they destroy the Three Jewels and destroy the Three Jewels. Until after their death, they fall into the three evil realms, suffering countless kinds of intense, unbearable suffering! All types of punishments endure immeasurable amounts of suffering. Everyone who recites the Ksitigarbha Sutra will know. You say we suffer in all kinds and ways in the human world. However, we do not have scenes of cutting, burning, or suffering like that! We reflect a little on our own inner suffering, no matter who you are, unless you have already cut off your afflictions. Breaking Kien Or, still suffering because of Tu Or. Once Tu Or is completely cut off, there is still the suffering of Tran Sa and Vo Minh. Is there anyone who doesn't suffer? Only Buddhas and Buddhas do not suffer and achieve ultimate happiness; Other than that, it's all suffering. The Second Vehicle suffers the suffering of Parting and Ending Birth and Death, that is, the life span has each stage, death here, birth there, [and then] birth here, death there. This is called the suffering of Parting and Death. After attaining the fruition of the Second Vehicle, there is the suffering of Change, Birth and Death, and ignorance remains in the Truth. Darkness, Change of Birth and Death, suffering, it is necessary to cut off twenty types of suffering in order, to reach the shore of the Three Virtues, in order to truly attain the Dharmakaya, that suffering can be destroyed. Otherwise, you will always be in Suffering.

Therefore, suffer countless kinds of suffering. According to the results [of suffering], the more you suffer, the more difficult it is to do good. When people are oppressed by suffering, kindness cannot arise, they can only think of ways to relieve suffering: "If I want to relieve suffering, I must bring disaster to others!" In prison, we think like that. There are people who stalk every day and report [to the prison guards] for what? That person wants to relieve his own suffering, intending to replace it with someone else. There is a slogan there: "If you want to create happiness, you must create it on the suffering of others. Otherwise, it will not be possible to create it!" We said, if those people do not harm anyone for three days, they will walk around sullenly, unable to swallow their food, speechless! That person does not harm others, there will be no way, his spirit is gloomy. He has become accustomed to evil deeds. Thus, he endured suffering, suffered immeasurable suffering, strong and unbearable poison. How long does it take? Immeasurable hundreds of thousands of sentences-chi na-du-multiple kalpas, that many! We don't say it's a great kalpa, even if it's calculated in small kalpas, that time is still extremely long! During that long period of time, hoping to restore your human body is very difficult! Cannot be restored. In the previous part, I said a lot, I said it thoroughly, I won't repeat it again!

(Sutra) Good man! Like all sentient beings, in the middle of the Great Intermittent Hell, they will experience all the heavy sufferings, they will not receive such sufferings as they despise evil people, they will be arrogant, they will pay arrogances, they will obey evil friends, they will create evil and unwholesome karma, they will circulate birth and death, it is difficult to be saved, they will always deal with birth and death, and they will experience all the sufferings!
suffer heavy suffering, do not accept the body of such a cowardly, evil, arrogant, arrogant person, obey evil friends, create such evil, unwholesome karma, circulate in birth and death, difficult to be saved, often in samsara, suffering from sufferings).

Suppose you escape from prison, but your six senses are not perfect, until you are born, you will spend your whole life harming people and creating karma. After committing a crime, you have to return, that is, go back to hell. We often say “there is no hell”, but because of one's karma, one will see that there is! In Northeast China, an event like this happened: At that time, I was very young, so I went with others to see it. There was a small child, not very old, only eighteen or nineteen years old, who suddenly ran back and forth in his own house, refusing to come out when anyone called him. Wait until it finishes running and then fall to the ground. At first glance, the lower half of its body was blistered, very scary! After that, he said that the land, we only saw a normal land, nothing was there, but he saw it was all fire, no matter how he could escape! By the time it really ran out of strength and collapsed to the ground, the fire was gone! Someone else pulled it out, and the whole body was blistered and burned completely black. What karma is that? Can't explain. Our district is not too big; At that time, Shenyang was called Phung Thien[25]. The journalist of Phung Thien Tan Van newspaper went there for an interview, but didn't know the reason, so he wrote like that.

We see that Buddhist scriptures record many stories. If you go to many places, you can verify many stories in Buddhist scriptures. For example, the border area between Tibet and the provinces of Qinghai, Sichuan, and Gansu, no one cares about. In that area, the Di tribe, the Tibetan tribe, the Black Son tribe, the Di tribe alone have ninety-six types, not just one type, they include the Black Di, Bach Di, Hoa Di, quite a few tribes. Those people completely do not understand human morality, their way of speaking is different from ours. If they were people in that place, living in that place, they would continue to fight. This clan fights that clan, there is never a day without fighting. This family fights with another family, fighting to the point of becoming unjust families. Every fight lasts for hundreds of years, still fighting, never ending!

How do we know that person is our unjust partner? If I kill a person in your family, first there will be a conflict, and in the middle, another clan will come to reconcile, there will be no more fighting! Therefore, he compensated, paid a lot of money, but there were items that were not of great value, such as an umbrella, a wooden bowl, and something to clean. Then, give them those three items. That family kept the wooden bowl and wooden umbrella carefully. Later, when children are born, regardless of whether they are male or female, they will tell them: "You must remember the person who murdered your uncle or father, and when you grow up, you must tell the story!" Thus, from generation to generation, killing and killing again, each family collects a lot of wooden bowls, piles them up in cabinets, and uses them as educational tools to increase the psychology of hatred.

When such a person suffers endless suffering, he never knows how to crawl out of hell? Then immediately go back in. You want to be that kind of person, that kind of bad person. Is there anything worth being arrogant and arrogant about? People like that all follow evil friends, “methods of types gather, objects cluster together” (methods are divided into species, things are divided according to each characteristic). Seeing what kind of people you hang out with, it seems to be a natural thing, people are naturally divided like that. All parties and factions are like that; Black path and white path are all like that. Evil people will do evil things, all of which are bad karma. Unwholesome karma will of course circulate in samsara, it is difficult to be saved, it is often in samsara and suffering. Buddha said that for such people, Buddha has no way to save them! “It is difficult to be gentle, often dealing with birth and death, experiencing sufferings” (Difficult to be gentle, often in samsara, suffering from sufferings). All of this is to visualize Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's great vows, for the sake of many difficult people, he made great vows. Therefore, He entered hell. There are people who have fallen into hell, escaped hell and then returned. Their evil deeds pile up, there is no way to calculate them. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva went down to hell to save them, so it is called the Ksitigarbha Mahabodhisattva Sutra. If everyone reads the Ksitigarbha Sutra, the Contemplation Sutra, and the Mahabodhi Sutra of the Ten Wheels, they must be grateful and feel the special great kindness of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva towards us.

(Sutra) At the ear time, the assembly of immeasurable, countless great wisdom sentient beings, ascending the throne, paying homage to the Buddha, united Palming, towards the Buddha, with compassion and falling tears, he said to the Buddha: "World-Honored One! The true contemplation is like the worldly living beings, although in the stage of planning it is difficult to gain the right body, I am far from right belief, far from the right vow, far from right mockery, far away from the right view, far away from good knowledge, far away from the good time, far away from the good place, far away from the pure precepts, far away from the right concentration, far away from the right wisdom. Like these living beings, even though it is difficult to gain pride in the human body during the planning stage, I am due to ignorance and arrogance. Trying hard, creating such a serious crime, slandering the Buddha's teachings of the Dharma, inciting the mind of the World-Honored One to become a monk and a disciple. To the previous World-Honored One, with sincerity, make a sincere vow:The Buddha-level person will pass through the cycle of birth and death, and will attain liberation in the future, always vowing not to be enlightened like evil conditions, determined not to create such a mortal sin, and never to destroy the Buddha's true Dharma. The heron does not touch the minds of monks, it does not destroy the Dharma eyes of sentient beings, it does not destroy the Three Jewels' nature, it is only the wish that the World-Honored One, who is sensitive enough to accept the self, will be able to do so as he has vowed.
(Sutra: At that time, in the assembly there were immeasurable, countless great wisdom beings love,

from his seat, he stood up, bowed at the Buddha's feet, clasped his hands, turned towards the Buddha, cried sadly and said to the Buddha: "Venerable World-Honored One! Contemplating the living beings in the world like that, although it is difficult to attain a human body, they are far away from right belief, far away from right vows, far away from right intention, far away from ridicule. Away from right view, away from good knowledge, away from good times, away from good places, away from pure precepts, away from right concentration, away from right wisdom. Even though it is difficult for living beings to attain a human life, due to their ignorance, arrogance, and serious crimes as mentioned above, they slander the Dharma spoken by the World-Honored One, insulting and confusing the World-Honored One's monastic disciples. We make a true vow: From now on through life and death until we are liberated, we always vow not to encounter such evil fates, to resolve not to commit such serious crimes, to not defame the Dharma of the Buddhas, not to offend or upset those who have become monks, not to blind the Dharma eyes of sentient beings, nor to destroy the nature of the Three Jewels."

Who committed the above crimes? In this assembly, there are immeasurable, countless, not hundreds, thousands, ten thousand, but immeasurable, countless. Therefore, there is a group of sentient beings with great wisdom, of course they have all developed Bodhi mind. Those living beings stood up from their seats, bowed to the Buddha, and cried in pain. Is there anyone who feels sad without shedding tears? Crying sadly is worse than just crying! Therefore, shedding tears is still a sentient being. Love brings tears; Whenever I feel moved, I shed tears. Anger arose, it burned like crazy, and it foamed at the mouth. The feelings were so deep that tears flowed. Those two types are both not good and not natural!

Out of compassion for sentient beings, they saw that the Buddha had said above that many evil people had suffered such sins, [so they answered]: We contemplate, that is, observe correctly, observe and consider with certainty, then we call it the Truth. Observing according to the Truth, observing from the essence, relying on the teachings taught by the Buddha to properly observe all living beings in the world, [then saw that] although they attain human life, it is so difficult. Buddha said how difficult it is to become a human being? The Buddha gave an example: "Losing a human body is like the great earth, gaining a human body is like the claws of the upper world". That means you will once have a human body like the dust clinging to your fingernails, just a little like that; Losing a human body is as much as the soil in the great earth. Dear friends! Why are we given human form? For many lifetimes, there has been a certain predestined relationship with the Three Jewels, that is, in this life we ​​have the opportunity to meet here, everyone to study together, not just one lifetime, but ten lifetimes, hundreds of lifetimes, having planted good roots in many Buddhas.

If you use real-life situations to compare the Buddha's teachings, compare with what wise people said, [you will realize] how difficult it is to have a human life, [but now we] consider it not worth a penny, it's ruined! Losing our human body this time, hoping to be human again, is not like what we say, or as others say "Once you die, there's nothing left". There is no such thing as comfort, after death there is nothing left? Killing people, setting fires, creating so much evil karma, do you not have to suffer [consequences], are there no [consequences]? Impossible! Therefore, people in this world, why are there people who are rich and have a lot of money? Some people enjoy that much, some people are that poor? They have wasted this rare human body! If they really destroy it further, then they use their bodies to create karma, what karma is it creating? Create your own hell, hell is created by yourself!

So you are far from good times and good places. What are the good times? When the Buddha appeared in the world, you were not yet born. When the Buddha was in this world, wherever he was born, you were not born there. Where good and knowledgeable people go, you don't go there. You are very far away from them, born in a border area, not listening to the Buddha Dharma, not hearing the true Dharma. After that, create karma again. This is like what was said in the previous section, destroying the Buddha, destroying the Dharma, destroying the Sangha, persecuting the Dharma weapons and not the Dharma weapons, slandering the Dharma spoken by the Buddha, insulting and disturbing the monks' disciples of the World-Honored One, now we have a feeling of great panic!

(Sutra) At that time, the assembly gathered together and served countless hundreds of thousands of verses with the wisdom of sentient beings. He stood up, bowed to the Buddha, joined his palm, and respectfully said to the Buddha: "Venerable World-Honored One! This alchemist, towards the previous World-Honored One, with sincerity, made a true vow: Nhe who is at the same level of the golden cycle of birth and death, the mother-in-law attains the Dharma of Forbearance, the intermediate stage, always vows not to deal with the kingly positions, often vows not to deal with the positions of government officials, often wishes not to deal with the position of monks in all countries, often wishes not to deal with the position of the city, hamlet, gathering, town la chief, often wishes not to treat the positions of military generals, often wishes not to treat the positions of injured masters, often wishes not to treat the most Always vowing not to punish the wealthy, lay people, or monks, always vowing not to punish the head monks, always vowing not to punish the head of the family, always vowing not to punish the false position, always vowing not to punish the rich and noble position. If only one attains the Dharma of Forbearance, I will be treated like you, I will block the Buddha Dharma from bad names, create serious crimes, slander the teachings of the Buddhas, and touch your mind. If the Buddha becomes a disciple, if he destroys the Dharma eyes of living beings, he will destroy the Three Jewels' nature and cause harm to the minds of countless sentient beings. Because of his concentration, he will fall into the Infinite Hell, reincarnate in the evil realms, and only the World-Honored One will be able to accept the Buddha's teachings.
(Sutra: At that time, in the assembly there were countless hundreds of thousands of sentient verses of na-data wisely, stood up from his seat, bowed at the Buddha's feet, clasped his hands, and respectfully said to the Buddha: "World-Honored One! We now before the World-Honored One, with sincere hearts, make a sincere vow: From now on, we will circulate in samsara, until we have attained Dharma-Forbearance, in the midst of that, always vowing not to hold the positions of kings, often vowing not to hold the positions of ministers, often vowing not to hold the positions of national teachers, often vowing not to hold the positions of national masters, often vowing not to hold the positions of kings, holding positions of leadership in cities, hamlets, villages, and towns, often vowing not to hold the positions of generals in the army, often vowing not to hold positions of business managers, often vowing not to hold positions of leaders in places of worship, temples, religious houses, often vowing not to hold the positions of heads of the bourgeoisie, lay people, or monks, often vowing not to hold positions of chief monks, often vowing not to hold positions of patriarchs, often vowing not to hold positions of judgment, until I vow not to keep all the rich and noble positions. Until we attain Dharma-Forbearance, if we keep such positions, we will be called evil causes in the Buddha Dharma, create serious crimes, destroy the Dharma spoken by the Buddhas, insult and upset the monastic disciples of the Buddhas, will surely blind the Dharma eyes of sentient beings, will also destroy the nature of the Three Jewels, and will also harm and upset countless sentient beings. Therefore, we will definitely fall into hell Infinite, circulating in the evil destinies, it is difficult to escape. We respectfully hope that the World-Honored One will have mercy on us and accept the vows that we have made like that."

What do the people in the congress hope to do? Don't be an emperor! Complete contrast to ordinary people. There are many people in the future who want to be kings, but these people are completely opposite, hoping not to be kings, hoping not to be ministers, hoping not to be teachers of state. A person who becomes a monk to become a teacher of the emperor is called “national teacher”. “I always vow to be the leader of a city, a hamlet, a gathering place, or a town leader” [meaning] the village chief (village chief), village chief, district chief, district chief, I don't want any of those positions. “I often vow not to hold the position of military generals” (I often vow not to hold the position of general in the army): Thousands of times, I will not lead the army, nor will I be a general. Why? In the past, there was a poem about someone who was a general: “One general attacks a city, ten thousand bones dry”, [that is] you become a general, until you reach the position of general, you will create a lot of karma. Saying “ten thousand” is just saying a rough amount, I don't know how many people have to be killed! That karma is very big, so I don't want to be a general.

Also “I always vow to be indifferent to the owners”, [that is] not to be a business owner. Here, there are a few Dharma friends who are business owners (owners of factories and businesses); Why don't you want to be in the position of business owner? We can think of this! We have relatives who are our bosses, and there are also a few business owners here. Think about it, being a business owner is so miserable! Not to mention the dark underworld (gangsters, gangsters) harassing you, the authorities harassing and bullying you. The predestined monk also came to you, because if you have money, you will suffer even more!

Everyone even knows that there is a thing about forced fate! In the Northeast, major pagodas were repaired. Everyone who has seen Anh Tran Hoi Uc Luc knows. There is an old general Chau Tu Kieu, who in the past was a general in Hei Long Jiang. During the Republic of Korea period, he was only the chief commissioner of the Xian Te Commissioner's Association, and he asked Chiang Kai-shek to let him keep that position. He said he wanted to do charity work, but it turned out to be forced. How coercive? His long-time friends were all so charmed that they were pale in fear! He also repaired many temples and helped many accidents. People have so many accidents! Once the Yellow River caused a flood, he immediately came to the rescue. In Northeast China, he enchanted Truong Hoc Luong[26], enchanting tens of thousands of burdens of sorghum. People needed food, he delivered it to them one by one. His number of karma was very large, he went to Shanghai to karma for his friends. A funny thing is that he sat waiting in the living room of his friend's house, while the homeowner sat in the bathroom and did not dare to come out. How to do this? He went to the bathroom and roared: "Get out now! I don't have much money! It's only ten thousand dong! Ten thousand dong is enough, you can chase me away!" At that time, the ocean[27] was huge!

There was a time when he had many charms, but he was very poor and had nothing. As a very moral person, he will do anything that anyone does not dare to do. His wife was fifteen years older than her husband, everyone thought it was impossible! His wife is the maid in the house. His parents died early in his family, he was an only child, everyone else left, the maid raised him. When you grow up, how will you calculate your maid's needs? He said: "You and I are married and that's it!" The maid said: "How is this possible! I am much older than you!" He said: "If not, I can't repay you!" After that, he asked the maid to marry him. Once married, he is absolutely indifferent, and has many children!

Talk about this person's personal ethics. In the past, when he was a general, he was called “Chau thu” (butcher named Chau). Do you know why they are called “Chau Tu Phu”? His name is Chau Khanh Nam, nickname is Chau Tu Kieu, he kills too many people! Later, he repented, put down the butcher's knife, and immediately became a Buddha. He said: "I can kill people, but I can also save people." He provided disaster relief, I don't know how many people he helped. Later, he was closest to the old magician Dam Hu. He and we can talk freely to each other. He said: "I save more people than I kill, I can atone for my mistakes!" We told him: "It cannot be redeemed! The Buddhist scriptures do not say that redemption is possible! That is, if you kill those people, you must repay them one by one; if you save others, each of them will repay you. There is no redemption!" “Is there any way to redeem it?” I said: "You practice Khong Quan. Since it is Emptiness, there will be no such thing as the saved and the saved. Since there are no saved people, neither the killer nor the killed will exist, both will be resolved! Everything will be non-existent." That is it about the mind of repentance (repentance with the mind), all dharmas are only consciousness. Mind-only, you must use this to meditate, all sins do not exist, are empty, sin is inherently empty, only created by the mind.

This method of contemplation is not easy to practice, it is very easy to say. We preach the Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma Sutra, the lower volume explains this Contemplation technique. Everyone, let's see if this practice of Contemplation is difficult or easy? But it's not urgent, there is a method. Finally, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva teaches us a method, by reciting His name, we will be able to practice that Contemplation. Every time you recite, you visualize Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva as Emptiness, as your own mind, that's it! Now let's talk about the place we don't want to go, first let's talk about suffering. Suffering still happens, how to get rid of suffering? They said: I don't want to hold the position of chief monk, nor do I want to be a merchant, I don't want to do big business, or be a boss, nor do I want to be a temple master who governs from the temple, nor do I want to be a Duong Gia in a monastery, I don't need any of those things. I don't even want to hold the leadership positions of the wealthy, lay people, or monks!

We monastics vow to become shamans[28] very few. From those who graduated from the Buddhist Institute, it is very difficult to find one or two masters. Being a magician is very difficult and has a lot of karma. If you say one wrong sentence, rejecting "there is no cause and effect", you will fall into hell. Don't you know how to say something wrong? But I already have such great knowledge, how do I do it? Suppose everyone did not propagate the Buddha Dharma, wouldn't that mean that the Dharma would be destroyed? The Dharma is destroyed, all sentient beings cannot be saved, because they do not have the Dharma eye. Isn't such a crime great? The crime of committing a crime by propagating the Dharma and the crime of falling into hell [for having become a monk without propagating the Dharma], which crime is greater? At that time, I considered both sides, "before the gates of hell, Sangha, east", why? As everyone can imagine, I won't say any more!

During the Song Dynasty, Zen Master Chan Hiet served as a monk at Dung Tuyen Pagoda in Co Son, preached sutras, propagated the Dharma, and had very high morality. More than a thousand people listened to the sutra, at least a few hundred people, the merit was very great. Later, when he got sick, he moved to a house near the cremation ground. It can also be said that that house is a place to bury dead bodies. If you are seriously ill, can't be cured, and can't survive, you should be carried there. Being carried there, the cold air caused him to wake up and see that he was in Nirvana. Nirvana is immortal; Carry it there, wait for it to be burned. After that, he recovered from his illness, so he wrote a poem to teach those who preach the Dharma: “Preaching the Dharma, commenting on the Dharma, is pitiful” (Preaching the Dharma, commenting on the Dharma, is pitiful), [meaning] preaching the sutras, preaching the Dharma, discussing the principles, speaking the principles clearly, but not realizing it yourself is a truly pitiful matter. “Retribution to the body lying on the Nirvana Duong” (About to die lying on the Nirvana Duong): From morning to night, waiting for death in Nirvana Duong. “The door has no guests, but no chi” (The door has no guests, but no paper): When you are a great magician, there are many disciples, this person comes to visit, that person comes to visit. Once you reach Nirvana, there will be no one. There wasn't even a single guest. Paper-wrapped windows, at that time during the Song Dynasty, were all used to cover the windows with paper to block the wind (called “paper-draping”). The wind blew and tore the window paper, and no one came to tape the windows of Nirvana. What is the purpose of the house containing the dead? There's no one in charge, so the wind blows into the place! “The lotus is cold, the body is dew” (Cold ash fills the furnace, the mat is stained with dew): Nirvana Road had to light the furnace, it was very cold, but no one came to light the fire, it was all cold ash. As for the mat, because the windows were not covered with paper, the wind blew wildly, carrying dew that drenched the mat.

“Sickness reveals the suffering of the body” (Once you are sick, you know the suffering of the body): Wait until you are sick, then you will know that your body is the most miserable, having a body is the most miserable! “When you are healthy, you are always busy because others are busy): When your body is healthy, you do not practice, you just go help this person, bless this person, pray for the influence of that person, recite sutras or pray for that person, always busy with other people's matters. Is that true or not? Correct! At that time, He uttered pitiful words, telling those who preached the Dharma, not to forget themselves, that was the meaning. The last two sentences are intended to say: He did it, so later on it was called Chan Hiet (truly stopped). “The old monk has his own method of calming the mind”: We always have a method to calm the mind. “The Eight Sufferings of the Eight Sufferings Come Together, It Doesn't Matter” These two sentences say that he attained enlightenment in Nirvana.

For that reason, when the Venerable Ones saw that kind of situation, they said thousands of times, don't be a teacher, don't be a leader. Even no matter what you do, whether you are a leader of a monk, or a leader or leader of lay people, you do not make or make such vows. There are also all the positions of monks, businessmen, up to trial, judging whether it is fair or not, that could be referring to the position of lawyer [or judge]. “I often vow not to judge hypocrisy” (I often vow not to hold the position of being a judge): Or to be a judge, a judge, or to hold a position of wealth and honor. In general, I don't want any noble position or being respected by others. Before we attain the Dharma of Forbearance, when we have not attained enlightenment, if we keep those positions, we will definitely give birth to evil causes in the Buddha Dharma, and will create all kinds of sins. Therefore, I do not wish to destroy the nature of the Three Jewels, nor wish to destroy the Buddha's Dharma, nor do I wish to harm countless sentient beings. "Due to the intention of falling into the Unintermittent Hell, revolving around evil beasts, difficult and unexpected existences arise, only the World-Honored One's wish" (Therefore, we will definitely fall into the Unintermittent Hell, revolving in the evil destinies, it is difficult to escape. We respectfully request that the World-Honored One) please be merciful and receive us, allowing us to fulfill this vow we have made! I will be an ordinary practitioner, believing in the Three Jewels. That's another kind of person!

At the level of the human race, the Buddha's throne arose, he bowed to the Buddha, he was proud, he was sympathetic, he exchanged all manner of things, he palmed his hands, he respectfully spoke to the Buddha: "World-Honored One, the self without beginning of birth and death will come again, stupidity, arrogance, giving rise to evil karma, or evil body karma, or evil speech karma, or evil mental karma, self-action, instructing others, seeing the text according to the joy, like the sins of the Buddha, the gold and the Buddha's money, deep and precious treasures, revealing repentance, indifference. Feelings are hidden, vowing to completely destroy the past, forever undoing, protecting the future from all sins. The second and third herons are like the theory. "The ego is determined to make a sincere vow: Twith the golden nirvana of birth and death after the sacrifice, in the intermediate period, always vow not to meet with evil knowledge, pray not to be enlightened by evil causes and conditions. Set in the moment of enlightenment, vow not to be arbitrary, decide not to create as the previous theory of evil, karma, spiritual beings, ego. Long and long, I wish that the World-Honored One would be indifferent and receive the same level of selfhood, so that he can fulfill his vow."
(Sutra: At that time, all the great assemblies came to attend the dharma conference, heaven, dragon, medicine Xoa, Kien Dat Phuoc (Gandhata), non-human beings, etc. all stood up from their seats, bowed at the Buddha's feet, mourned, felt passionately, shed tears, clasped their hands, respectfully said to the Buddha: "Venerable World-Honored One! From the beginning of birth and death until now, we have been foolish, arrogant, arrogant, giving rise to evil karma, either in the body, or in the speech, or in the mind. Do it yourself, teach others to do it, and when you hear it, you will be happy. Such sins are deeply shameful to the Buddha. We reveal our repentance and do not dare to hide them. We vow to completely eliminate them. From now on, we will never do them again, to prevent all sins in the future." The second and third time, we also said the same thing. "We sincerely make the true vow, from now until the end of life and death in the next life, during that time, always vow not to encounter evil sentient beings. Consciousness, I also pray that I will not encounter evil causes and conditions. Even if I encounter them, I vow not to follow them and decide not to create evil karma as mentioned above and not make us suffer in the long night. We hope that the World-Honored One will have mercy on us and accept the vow that we have made like that."

This is crying out loud. “Hao” means to cry loudly. “The worldly exchange, palm palm, respectfully said to the Buddha: - Venerable World-Honored One, the ego without beginning of birth and death will return, stupidity, arrogance, giving rise to evil karma, or evil body karma, or evil speech karma, or evil mental karma” (Tears welled up, clasped hands, respectfully said to the Buddha: “Venerable World-Honored One! From beginningless birth and death until now, we have been foolish, arrogant, arrogant, giving rise to evil karma, or evil karma in the body, or evil karma in the mouth, or evil karma in the mind”): The three karmas are all about creating evil, it's okay to create evil yourself, and even teach others! “Seeing and writing according to joy, like seeing all the sins, gold to the Buddha, deep and precious, revealing repentance, not feeling rich, vowing to be completely destroyed, leaving behind the past, forever undoing” (Seeing and hearing with joy, such sins, now before the Buddha, are deeply ashamed, revealing repentance, not daring to hide, vowing to be completely eliminated. From now on, never do them again): Vow to do no more: do those evil things. “Protect against future sins” (Prevent all sins in the future), “Second, third, heron like thi thuyet” (said the same thing the second time, the third time). “Thu Thi” means that each type makes such a vow, it is also that they make almost the same vows, most of them are the same. Basically, when the magician Huyen Trang translated, he did not repeat the translations too much in the similarities, but added the words “second, third”, that's the general meaning! What do you wish for? May we never encounter evil knowledge, they will drag us into hell. I don't want to encounter evil causes like that. “If we meet, we vow not to agree” (If we meet, we vow not to agree): Decide not to create bad karma as mentioned in the previous section. "The spiritual object of the ego will endure suffering for a long time. I only wish that the World-Honored One, who is sensitive and accepts the ego, will make such a vow" (Do not let us suffer in the long night. We hope that the World-Honored One will have mercy on us and accept the vow that we have made like that).

(Sutra) At the time of the ear, the World-Honored One preached to the great assembly: "Good disaster! Good disaster! Good disaster! The suffering of the future, the profound realization of repentance, the profound liberation of life and death, the attainment of fearless Nirvana, and the fulfillment of the ten good men, the power of the Bodhisattva and Mahasattva, attaining innocence, the right path of Dharma and forbearance death! NMay Bodhisattvas Mahasattvas, not before the internal body, not before the external body, not before the internal and external body, not before the past body, not before the future body, not before the present body, the first name Dharma, the Bodhisattva Mahasattva level's power to attain the innocent path of Dharma Ring”.
(Sutra: At that time, the World-Honored One told all the great people who had come to attend: “Good How good! You can face the suffering in the next life, see it and feel deep repentance. Now you want to escape the deep waterfall of birth and death, and want to enter Nirvana without fear, so you make this vow. There are ten types of dharma that can help Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas achieve the path of innocence Good men! If Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas are not attached to the internal body, are not attached to the external body, are not attached to the inside and outside of the body, are not attached to the past body, are not attached to the future body, and are not attached to the present body, then this is called the first dharma that can cause Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas to attain the sinless path of Dharma forbearance."

Above there are many types of living beings like that, for each type, the Buddha summarized: “Good ear! Good ear”, [meaning] the vows that people make are very good! “If the next generation suffers from the suffering of the next generation, you will understand it deeply”, [meaning] you can clearly understand the suffering in the next life, and even contemplate very deeply, giving rise to fear. Therefore “repentance revealed”. At present, "the alchemy of desire to save birth and death is profound and vast" (now you want to cross the deep and wide waterfall of birth and death): The sea of ​​suffering of birth and death is both deep and wide, like a fast-flowing waterfall, hoping to enter "the city of fearless Nirvana" (the citadel of Nirvana without fear): Without fear, entering the citadel of Nirvana, that is, attaining enlightenment, becoming a Buddha will not be afraid. Therefore, “make such a vow. Good men! With ten types of dharma, the spirit of Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas of the level, attain the sinless right path of Dharma forbearance” (make such a vow. Hey good men! There are ten types of dharma, which can make Bodhisattvas and Ma Ha Tats attain the sinless right path of Dharma forbearance): Do we want to attain Dharma forbearance or not? That is the right path to achieve Dharma Forbearance and attain enlightenment.

“What are the ten levels? Good men! Weakness for the Bodhisattvas Mahasattvas, not before the internal body, not before the external body, not before the internal and external body, not before the past body, not before the future body, not before the present body, the first name” (What are the ten? Good men! If you Bodhisattvas! Mahasattva not being attached to the internal body, not being attached to the external body, not being attached to the inside or outside of the body, not being attached to the past body, not being attached to the future body, not being attached to the present body, is called the first dharma): Don't be attached to your body. Your body is impermanent. Use the body to represent what? Represents physical dharma. All tangible things, all things that have form, will be destroyed. In particular, sentient beings, due to too much Ego View, consider themselves as the main essence. Why? This body of mine needs to be enjoyed, my body must be comfortable, always talent, beauty, fame, eating, drinking, sleeping, all for this body! First of all, get rid of Personality View. Inside the body, outside the body, all bodies must be destroyed. This is the method of the first type, that is, cutting off Body View. That is the physical dharma.

Because in the following section, we will talk about Feeling, Perception, Action, and Consciousness. Will talk about Form, Sound, Smell, Taste, Touch, until Form, Feeling, Thought, Action, Consciousness. Point out Form, Feeling, Thought, Action, and Consciousness as representatives. That is the first dharma. After that, the three realms are eliminated again, that is, the Desire Realm, the Form Realm, and the Formless Realm, a total of ten dharmas, including those dharmas. “Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat's spiritual energy attains the innocent path of Dharma Forbearance” (Can cause Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat to attain the innocent path of Dharma Forbearance). That is the first dharma, allowing all Bodhisattvas to become Buddhas.

(Sutra) Good man! Weakness of Bodhisattvas Mahasattvas, not before internal feelings, not before external feelings, not before internal and external feelings, not before past feelings, not before future feelings, not before present feelings, the second name Dharma, Bodhisattva Mahasattva level's spiritual power plans to attain the innocent path of Dharma forbearance. Good man! NMay the Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas of the level, not before internal thoughts, not before external thoughts, not before internal or external thoughts, not before past thoughts, not before future thoughts, not before present thoughts, the third Dharma name, have the power of Bodhisattva Mahasattva level to attain the innocent path of Dharma forbearance. Good man! NMay the Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas of the rank of Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas, not before internal actions, not before external actions, not before internal and external actions, not before past actions, not before future actions, not before present actions, the four dharma names, have the power of Bodhisattva Mahasattva level to attain the innocent path of Dharma forbearance. Good man! Nmay the Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas of the level, not prior to internal consciousness, not prior to external consciousness, not prior to internal or external consciousness, not prior to past consciousness, not prior to future consciousness, not prior to present consciousness, the five dharma names, the Bodhisattva Mahasattva class, with the power of the Bodhisattva Mahasattva class, attain the innocent path of Dharma. Ring.
(Sutra: Come, good man! If Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas do not accept internal feelings, do not accept External feelings, not accepting internal and external feelings, not accepting past feelings, not accepting future feelings, not accepting present feelings, is called the second dharma, which can cause Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas to attain the innocent path of Dharma forbearance. If Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas do not accept internal thoughts, do not accept external thoughts, do not accept internal and external thoughts, do not accept past thoughts, do not accept future thoughts, and do not accept present thoughts, this is called the third dharma. Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas attain the innocent path of Dharma-Forbearance. If Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas do not accept internal actions, do not accept internal and external actions, do not accept past actions, and do not accept present actions, this is called the fourth dharma, which can cause Bodhisattvas and Ma-Ha-sattvas to attain the innocent path of Dharma-Forbearance. Not accepting external consciousness, not accepting internal or external consciousness, not accepting past consciousness, not accepting future consciousness, not accepting present consciousness, is called the fifth dharma, which can help Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas achieve the sinless path of Dharma-Forbearance).

“Good man! Weakness of the Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas of the same level, not before internal feelings, not before external feelings, not before internal and external feelings, not before past feelings, not before future feelings, not before present feelings, the second Dharma” (Again, good man! If the Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas do not accept the internal Feeling, not accepting external feeling, not accepting internal or external feeling, not accepting past feeling, not accepting future feeling, not accepting present feeling, is called the second dharma): These are Form, Feeling, Perception, Action, Consciousness. These five dishes were all mentioned in the previous section; However, the text has changed a bit. It includes eight consciousnesses, I will only explain a little in general. Regarding the things called the Five Aggregates, i.e. Form, Feeling, Perception, Actions, Consciousness, Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara), because he has practiced Prajna deeply, sees that the Five Aggregates are all Empty, that is, Form, Feeling, Perception, Actions, and Consciousness [are all Empty]. Now the Buddha teaches us: As long as you don't have attachments, that's called "practicing Contemplation". At the same time, you should not be attached to this form, you should not be attached to that form, then you will be able to gradually achieve achievements. That is called “the main path of Dharma-Forbearance”.

Even though you may not be attached to the Five Aggregates, but using wisdom to illuminate Emptiness, we still have not achieved it! Because you must go one step further, knowing that the Five Aggregates are empty. How can we not be attached or greedy? You must practice Emptiness. That is another meaning. You use Contemplation as mentioned in the above section. The Great Collection of Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra teaches us to practice Contemplation and Contemplation. If you practice well, you will be able to achieve it!

(Sutra) Good man! Weak Bodhisattva Mahasattva class, no matter before trying the world, ranked first in the six dharmas, with the power of Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat class, to attain the innocent path of Dharma forbearance. Good man! Weaknesses of the Bodhisattvas Ma Ha Tat, who have not been before others, who are famous and have lost the Dharma, have the power of the Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat class to attain the innocent path of Dharma forbearance. Good man! Nmay the Bodhisattvas Mahasattvas of the level, not before the Desire Realm, the number one of the eight dharmas, have the power of the Bodhisattva Mahasattva level to attain the innocent path of Dharma forbearance. Good man! Weaknesses of Bodhisattvas Ma Ha Tat, not before the Form Realm, the nine dharmas, have the power of the Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat class to achieve the innocent path of Dharma forbearance. Good man! Weak Bodhisattvas Ma Ha Tat, not before the Formless Realm, the top ten dharmas, with the power of Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat, achieving the innocent path of Dharma forbearance.
(Sutra: Come, good man! If you You If Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas do not accept this life, it is called the sixth dharma, which can cause Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas to attain the sinless path of Dharma and Forbearance. Again, good man! If Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas do not accept other lives, it is called the seventh dharma If the Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas do not accept the Formless Realm, then it is called the ninth dharma, which can make the Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas attain the innocent path of Dharma and Patience. If the Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas do not accept the Formless Realm, then it is called the tenth dharma Bodhisattva Mahasattva attained the sinless path of Dharma forbearance).

“Good man! If the Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas are not as good as you, try it first” (Hey good man! If the Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas are not attached to this life): You will not be attached to anything in this life, “not before” is not attached. That is the sixth dharma. "The spirit energy of Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas attains the innocent path of Dharma-Forbearance. Good man! If the Bodhisattvas and Ma-Ha-sattvas are incomparable to others" (Can cause the Bodhisattvas-Ma-Ha-sattvas to attain the innocent path of Dharma-Forbearance. Good man! If the Bodhisattvas-Ma-Ha-sattvas are not attached to other lives): Don't be attached to this life, but also don't be attached to other lives. The past is the same, the future is the same, don't be attached to it. That is called “not accepting the three lifetimes”. Past, future: The past is over, there is no need to think about it anymore, is the present possible? [The present] immediately becomes the past, turning into three lifetimes of Emptiness! The future hasn't come yet, why are you thinking about it? In the end, how? Everything must be planned. That's a mistake! The plan is not made by you! You don't know how your own karma is arranged, no one can arrange it for themselves. It seems like you made the arrangements for yourself, but in reality, you are blindly preoccupied, the arrangements have already been made!

What you do is what you will suffer. Unless the present is changing, how is it changing? You have heard the Buddhadharma and can still practice it. Now every day you chant Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, consider Him as a life-saving king appearing, hold Him tightly and not let go, chant like that! The minimum change is not to receive the third lesson! Hearing the title Ksitigarbha King, you will not fall into the three categories. Some people say, "If you are dreaming, chanting Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will not be spiritual!" It's not that the recitation in the dream is not effective, it's that when you wake up, the recitation is not effective, because you don't reciting with your mind. If you recite with your mind, you will be spiritual. If you recite while sleeping, the dream scene will no longer exist. [Due to reciting the Bodhisattva], you hope that life and death will still be possible, let alone dreaming! Must believe!

“Good man! Weakness of the Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas of the highest level, not before the Desire Realm, the eighth dharma” (Again, good man! If the Bodhisattvas and Ma Ha Tats are not attached to the Desire World, it is called the eighth dharma): The world we live in is called the Desire World. The Desire Realm has six heavens and the human world, there are also animals, hungry ghosts, and hell, all of which belong to the Desire Realm. “Not attached to the Form Realm”: [The Form Realm] has eighteen heavens, [not attached to the Form Realm] is called the ninth dharma. “The spirit energy of Bodhisattvas Ma Ha Tats attains the innocent path of Dharma Forbearance. Good man! Weaknesses of Bodhisattvas Ma Ha Tats, not before the Formless Realm” (Can cause the Bodhisattvas Ma Ha Tats to attain the innocent right path Dharma Forbearance. Good man! If the Bodhisattvas Ma Ha Tats do not cling to the Formless Realm). The Formless Realm is Emptiness. The Formless Realm is already Emptiness, so what else can we do? Having reached the Formless Realm of Heaven, it is Arhat Dinh. Arhat Dinh does not develop Bodhi mind. At a certain point, they will waver and develop Bodhi mind again.

Therefore, do not be attached to the Formless Realm. “For the sake of the tenth dharma, the Bodhisattva-Maha-Sattva's spirit is at the same level as achieving the innocent path of Dharma-Forbearance” (It is called the tenth dharma, it can make Bodhisattvas-Ma-Ha-sattvas achieve the innocent path of Dharma-Forbearance), and can become Buddha. If you don't even have attachments to the Three Realms, of course you will achieve success and not suffer.

(Sutra) “Good men! Dharma, Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat's spirit is equal to the plan to attain the innocent path of Dharma and Forbearance. When the World-Honored One taught the Dharma, when the assembly gathered together, the Bodhisattva Mahasattva Bodhisattva Mahasattva's seventy-two hundred verses simultaneously attained the Dharma of Non-Birth Forbearance. The Bodhisattva of the eighty-four hundred na-du-da Bodhisattvas attained the Dharma of Forbearance. Receiving countless hundreds of thousands of Thanh Vans, she will forever end all afflictions and become an Arhat. To serve hundreds of thousands of na-du-da sentient beings, the immortals develop the mind, the golden mind develops the Supreme Perfect Enlightenment mind, the Tathagata wisdom, abides without retreat. Infinite beings, innumerable sentient beings, immortals develop the mind, golden nuns develop the mind of Single Enlightenment Vehicle. Infinite beings, innumerable sentient beings, the immortals generate the mind, the golden nuns generate the Sravakayana mind.
(Sutra: “Good men! These are called the ten dharmas that can make Bodhisattvas Ma Ha I attained the sinless path of Dharma-Forbearance." When the World-Honored One spoke this Dharma to the assembly, in the assembly, there were seventy-two hundred thousand verse-chi Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas who simultaneously attained the Non-Birth-Dharma-Forbearance. There were also eighty-four hundred thousand na-du-da Bodhisattvas who attained the Dharma-Forbearance. There were also immeasurable hundreds of thousands of Sravakas, until they forever cut off all afflictions and became Arhats. There were also hundreds of thousands of na-du-da assemblies. born, who previously did not develop the mind, now have developed the mind of Supreme Perfect Enlightenment, residing in an unchangeable position in the mind of the Tathagata. Again, there are countless, countless sentient beings who have not developed the mind before, but now have developed the mind of the Single Enlightenment Vehicle.

When the Buddha spoke that Dharma, there were seventy-two hundred thousand verses of Bodhisattva Mahasattva at the same time attaining the No Birth Dharma of Forbearance, that is, attaining the first stage. Hearing that, everyone prayed for blessings. They have entered the earth, but we still haven't entered it. Can we believe it or not? I hope everyone believes that we believe in the Wusheng Dharma of Forbearance, which is not entry at all. We can believe in the Infinite Dharma of Forbearance, and in the future we will definitely be able to attain it. Faith is the mother of all merits. If you can believe, you will be able to enter.

In addition, there are eighty-four hundred thousand na-du-da Bodhisattvas who have attained the Dharma of Patience. “To serve hundreds of thousands of immeasurable Sravakas, one will forever destroy all afflictions and become Arhats. To serve hundreds of thousands of Na-du-da sentient beings, the immortals will develop the mind, to develop the mind of Supreme Perfect Enlightenment” (There are also countless hundreds of thousands of Sravakas, to forever destroy all afflictions, to become Arhats. There are also hundreds of thousands of Na-du-da sentient beings who have not previously generated the mind, and now have developed the mind of Void. Supreme Chief Enlightenment): I also wish to become a Buddha, that is to develop my mind. The Bodhisattva has just aroused the mind of Bodhi, “The wisdom of the Tathagata, abides in the position of non-regression” (staying in the position of non-regression in the wisdom of the Tathagata): Anyone who develops the mind can also abide in the position of Non-regression. The Tathagata's wisdom is a position that does not regress, reaching the First Pillar will not regress. If the Seven Pillars are reached, the Seven Pillars are the Non-Regressing. The First Pillar is the Non-Regressive Mind, the Seven Pillars is the Non-Regressive Position, that is, the Non-Regressive position. They believe in all the Buddha's wisdom, we can definitely attain enlightenment.

There are countless countless sentient beings who have just now developed their mind, what kind of mind is that? Not becoming a Buddha. “Generating the Single Enlightened Mind. To serve countless, countless sentient beings, the first person will develop the mind” (Generating the Single Enlightened Mind. There are countless, countless sentient beings who have not developed the mind before), and now they have developed the mind, what is it? It is enough for me to accept birth and death, that is, to develop the “Sravaka mind”.

(Sutra) At the time, the World-Honored One reported to the assembly: “If all sentient beings can attain the Dharma of Forbearance, deal with it. Sat-de-loi is empowered with the king's throne, takes advantage of the race to win great wealth, takes care of the race of riches and noble positions, makes the self a promise, and leaves behind sentient beings." Vajragarbha Bodhisattva said to the Buddha: "World-Honored One! If all sentient beings attain the Dharma of Forbearance, should the Kshatriya-tathagata be empowered with the king's throne, take advantage of the race to overcome great wealth and karma, obtain the wealth and honor of the race, and be determined not to promise to deal with it, for the heron to promise to be da?"
(Sutra: At that time, the World-Honored One told the assembly again: “If sentient beings have attained the Dharma Forbearance, at the throne of Kshatriya, receiving the empowerment of great karmic wealth, and belonging to the positions of wealth and luxury, I approve, not other sentient beings." Vajrayana Bodhisattva said to the Buddha: "World-Honored One! If sentient beings have not yet attained the Dharma of Forbearance, for the empowerment of the throne of Kshatriya, to receive the great wealth of superior karma, and the status of wealth and luxury, it will definitely not be possible. allowed, or also allowed?”)

Having attained the Dharma of Forbearance, “undertook the initiation of the kingship of Kshat-de-loi, received the superlative race of great wealth, received the seed of wealth and position, the self-promised, non-residual sentient beings” (at the throne of Kshat-de-loi, received the empowerment of great wealth, and belonged to the noble positions" I accept all luxury, not other sentient beings): As Kshatriya, in addition to the karma-creating kings and lords of Chendala, there are also those who have attained the Dharma of Non-Birth forbearance, and are Bodhisattvas ascending to the stage. Those who want to manifest and manifest, immediately take the initiation at the king's throne. They receive that royal position, they should enjoy it, I (Buddha) allow it, but other sentient beings will not be able to! Vajragarbha Bodhisattva immediately asked the Buddha: “World-Honored One! If sentient beings have not yet attained the Dharma of Forbearance, then the Kshat-de-benefits empowerment of the kingship, receive the seed of great wealth and karma, and have the surplus of the race of wealth and noble positions, do not promise to deal with it” (World-Honored One! If sentient beings have not yet attained the Dharma of Forbearance, then receive the empowerment of the king of the Kshat-de-benefits, enjoy the great and superior properties, and all kinds of grounds. If you are rich or wealthy, it will definitely not be allowed): Definitely not allowed, “vi e promised da?”, or it can also be allowed. That is, except for those who have attained the Dharma of Forbearance, does the Buddha also allow it? If they have not yet attained the Dharma of Forbearance, is there any means to allow them to be initiated into the Sat-de-li at the king's throne?

(Sutra) The World-Honored One wrote: - All sentient beings, who have attained the Dharma of Patience, are capable of practicing the Ten Good Karmas. Dao and heron encouraged sentient beings to accept scholars, and I promised to give Sat-de-loi the kingship initiation, to receive the seed to win great wealth, and to obtain the wealth and honor of the seed. If all beings are in a position to attain the Dharma and Forbearance, he will not practice the Ten Virtuous Karmas, and will encourage sentient beings to learn and be strong in power. He will receive the throne of the Kshatriya king, receive the great wealth of the race, receive the title of the rich and noble race, the name of the Kshatriya-king of the Kshatriya, and be honored by the rich race and be crowned the King of the Kshatriya. destroy the Dharma lamp, destroy the Three Jewels. The group of disciples who became monks, all kinds of people are confused, tortured, punished, snatched clothes and bowls, inheritance and property, returned to the world, taxes, history, were forced to go to prison, and even ended their lives. You fall into the doctrine of the wonderful Dharma, slander, despise, obsess, conceal, not leave behind, and take away the Great Things of the Sangha. Like the people of the world who are falling into the No Intermittent Hell, experiencing extreme suffering, reincarnating with evil beasts, difficult times arise.
