(Sutra: The World-Honored One said: - If sentient beings have not attained the Dharma of Forbearance, they can practice the Ten The Path of Good Karma, also advises sentient beings to receive and learn from it, I also allow them to hold the throne of Sat-de-benefits empowerment, enjoy great wealth and other noble karma, and if sentient beings have not yet attained the Dharma of Forbearance, but do not receive and practice the Ten Good Karmas, and do not advise sentient beings to diligently receive, learn to follow, and use strong force to hold the throne of Sat-de-benefits and receive the empowerments. With great wealth and great karma, and holding positions of great wealth and wealth, [those people] are called Kshat-de-li Chien-tà-la kings and other noble positions of Chien-dà-la kings. [They] are foolish, arrogant, destroy and disturb my very deep Dharma, destroy the light of the Dharma, destroy the nature of the Three Jewels, [they use] all kinds of chaos, beatings, and destruction. Interrogate, punish, take away their robes, bowls, inheritance, property, force them to return to the secular world, tax them, force them to do forced labor, imprison them in prison, until their lives are destroyed. For the wonderful Dharma that I have mentioned, I despise, destroy, cover up, hide, do not allow them to be passed down, and take away the belongings of the Tathagata and the Sangha. Such people will all fall into the Hell of No Intermittent, suffering extreme suffering, wandering in evil and difficult paths. can exit).

“The World-Honored One wrote: If sentient beings have not yet attained the Dharma of Forbearance” (The World-Honored One said: “If sentient beings have not attained the Dharma of Forbearance”): That person has not attained the Dharma of Non-Birth Dharma of Forbearance, has not yet attained that position, but that person can receive and practice the Ten Virtuous Karma Paths. We can all do this, but we have not yet been able to do it. Using the Ten Virtuous Karmas to prevent your three karmas of body, mouth, and mind is absolutely not deaf or mute! Some people say: "I won't say anything, I will preserve my verbal karma." But can a dumb person or a dumb monk become enlightened? Being mute doesn't create karma. If you can't speak, how can you say anything? That's not what it means! Don't say wrong words, say words of praise for the Three Jewels. You say a lot of good words, don't say bad words to anyone, that's okay. It's not that you don't speak, you should speak a lot of Buddhist scriptures. To others, talk a lot about the Three Jewels and cause and effect.

Furthermore, you can see the afflictions of sentient beings, or from love movies, [you will see] the afflictions of love are especially heavy, heading towards the path of death. Karma is still very deep, we cannot suppress our desires. Whichever angle you look at, whichever pair of glasses you wear, it will appear like that, that's absolute. Wearing colored glasses to see, of course [seeing everything] has that color! Therefore, "by accepting the Ten Good Karmas, he encourages living beings to receive scholars, I promise to grant him the throne of Kshatriya, to receive the seed to win great wealth, and to obtain the wealth and honor of the race. If sentient beings are in a position to attain the Dharma of Forbearance, he does not practice the Ten Good Karmas, to encourage all living beings to learn, to be powerful" (receive and practice the Ten Good Karmas) The Path of Karma, I also advise sentient beings to receive and learn the Ten Virtuous Karmas, I also allow that person in the throne of Kshatriya to receive initiation and enjoy all kinds of great karmic wealth and other noble positions. If sentient beings have not yet attained the Dharma of Forbearance, but do not receive and practice the Ten Virtuous Karmas and advise sentient beings to diligently receive, learn, and use strong power): What force is that? As you grow, you will be born in heaven, even attain enlightenment, and even become a human in the future. You will learn from life to life. The Buddha also accepted them to enjoy all kinds of great karma (huge properties and treasures). [Such a person] becomes a king, there is no problem, he will not create karma, and can enjoy all kinds of wealth.

Trái lại, nếu Sát-đế-lợi, “Chiên-đồ-la vương, cập dư chủng chủng phú quý tôn vị Chiên-đồ-la vương, ngu si, kiêu mạn, hủy hoại, nhiễu loạn ngã thậm thâm pháp, diệt chánh pháp đăng, đoạn Tam Bảo chủng” ([Sát-đế-lợi] Chiên-đồ-la vương và các loại địa vị Chiên-đồ-la vương sang cả phú quý khác, ngu si, kiêu căng, ngạo mạn, hủy hoại, nhiễu loạn pháp rất sâu của ta, diệt đèn chánh pháp, đoạn chủng tánh Tam Bảo): Pháp ấy giống như đèn trí huệ trong xã hội, có ngọn đèn ấy thì mới có thể tỏa ra quang minh, trừ khử hắc ám. That person has completely destroyed the nature of the Three Jewels. “Ư ngã xuất gia chư đệ tử chúng, chủng chủng não loạn, chủy khảo, hình phạt, đoạt kỳ y bát” (Đối với các đệ tử xuất gia của ta, đủ mọi cách não loạn, đánh đập, tra khảo, hành hình, trừng phạt, tước đoạt y bát của họ): Những dụng cụ cần thiết cho cuộc sống của người tu đạo là cơ nghiệp của họ, đều tước đoạt hết, họ làm sao sống sót nổi? Or force them to return to secular life, or tax them, or force them to do forced labor. “Hệ bế lao ngục, nãi chí đoạn mạng. Ư ngã sở thuyết vi diệu pháp nghĩa, phỉ báng, khinh hủy, chướng tế, ẩn một, bất linh lưu bố” (Giam cầm trong tù ngục, cho đến đoạn mạng. Đối với pháp nghĩa vi diệu do ta đã nói bèn phỉ báng, khinh miệt, hủy hoại, chướng lấp, ẩn giấu, chẳng cho lưu truyền). Tốt-đổ-ba (Stupa) dịch là tháp, hoặc chùa miếu, cùng với Tăng Kỳ vật (vật dụng của Tăng chúng thường trụ) đều bị cướp đoạt. “Rewarding Monks with Wonderful Objects” is to plunder belongings to temples and pagodas. “Như thị chư nhân, giai đương trụy đọa Vô Gián địa ngục, thọ chư kịch khổ” (Những kẻ như thế, sẽ đều đọa lạc địa ngục Vô Gián, chịu các nỗi khổ tột cùng): Đấy chẳng phải là vấn đề nhỏ nhặt, nhất định phải chịu khổ cùng cực, xoay vần trong đường ác, khó có lúc thoát ra. It's very difficult to escape!

(Kinh) Thời, Kim Cang Tạng Bồ Tát phục bạch Phật ngôn: - Thế Venerable! Nfor all sentient beings, the one who has attained the Dharma of Forbearance, he has accepted and practiced the Ten Virtuous Karmas, advised all sentient beings to learn, has great power, has received the throne of the Kshatriya, has received the seed to win great wealth, has the wealth and honor of the seed, has the special fate, and has attained the means. saved, the spirit is exempted from falling into the Infinite Hell, meeting the evil beasts, and living in the realms of suffering?
(Sutra: At that time, Vajragarbha Bodhisattva said to the Buddha: - World-Honored One! If you Sentient beings who have not yet attained the Dharma of Forbearance, nor accept and practice the Ten Virtuous Karma Paths, and advise sentient beings to diligently accept and learn from them, and by powerful force, hold the throne of Kshatriya empowerment, enjoy all kinds of great karmic wealth, and other types of rich and noble positions, are there any other conditions and means to save them, to prevent them from falling into the Hell of No Intermittent and evil destiniess, and suffering from sufferings? perhaps?)

Is there any reason to save them? “The spirit period is exempt from falling into the Unintermittent Hell, reaching the evil beasts, and receiving the realms of suffering?” (Does it prevent them from falling into the Unintermittent Hell and evil destiniess, suffering from suffering?)

(Kinh) Thế Tôn cáo viết: - Diệc hữu biệt duyên, đắc phương tiện cứu, vị hữu chúng sanh, xử Sát-đế-lợi quán đảnh vương vị, cập dư chủng chủng phú quý tôn vị, tuy phục vị đắc thành tựu Pháp Nhẫn, Thập Thiện Nghiệp Đạo, nhi hữu tín lực tôn kính Tam Bảo, ư Phật sở thuyết tam thừa tương ứng chư xuất yếu pháp, hạ chí nhất tụng, chung bất báng hủy, chướng tế, ẩn một, bất linh lưu bố. Ư Phật xuất gia chư đệ tử chúng, trì giới, phá giới, hạ chí vô giới, thế trừ tu phát, bị ca-sa giả, giai bất não loạn, chủy khảo, trích phạt, xâm đoạt y bát, cơ nghiệp, tài sản, thoái linh hoàn tục, khóa thuế, dịch sử, hệ bế lao ngục, nãi chí đoạn mạng, diệc bất xâm đoạt Tốt-đổ-ba vật, cập Tăng Kỳ vật, giá chế, tồi phục chư bạo ác nhân, bất linh não loạn chư xuất gia chúng, bất linh xâm đoạt Tam Bảo tài vật. Ư Phật sở thuyết tam thừa tương ứng chư xuất yếu pháp, cung kính thính thọ. Ký thính thọ dĩ, tinh tấn tu hành pháp tùy, pháp hành. Ư ngã tam thừa hiền thánh đệ tử, cung kính cúng dường, thân cận, thừa sự. Ư Đại Thừa trung, thệ nguyện kiên cố, chung vô nghi nan, thoái khuất chi tâm, diệc thường khuyến đạo an trí chúng sanh, linh ư Đại Thừa tín thọ, tu học. Thử Sát-đế-lợi Chiên-đồ-la vương, cập dư chủng chủng phú quý tôn vị Chiên-đồ-la vương, quá khứ chư Phật, giai cộng thính hứa xử đế vương vị, cập dư chủng chủng phú quý tôn vị, tuy phục thọ dụng chủng chủng quốc độ, thành, ấp, tụ lạc thắng đại tài nghiệp, nhi đắc miễn đọa Vô Gián địa ngục, cập dư ác thú. Ngã diệc thính hứa xử đế vương vị, cập dư chủng chủng phú quý tôn vị, tuy phục thọ dụng chủng chủng quốc độ, thành, ấp, tụ lạc, nhi đắc miễn đọa Vô Gián địa ngục, cập chư ác thú. Nhược chư hữu tình, dục đắc sám hối, trừ diệt nhất thiết chư ác nghiệp chướng, linh vô dư giả, ư ngã sở thuyết như thị pháp môn, đương cần tu học, vật linh phế vong, hữu năng như thử hiện tiền đại chúng, tàm quý sám hối chư ác nghiệp giả, tiên thế sở tạo nhất thiết ác nghiệp, giai đắc tiêu diệt, vô hữu di dư.
(Kinh: Đức Thế Tôn bảo rằng: - Cũng có duyên khác để phương tiện cứu độ, tức là có chúng sanh ở ngôi vị Sát-đế-lợi quán đảnh vương và các địa vị sang cả phú quý khác, tuy vẫn chưa thành tựu Pháp Nhẫn và Thập Thiện Nghiệp Đạo, nhưng có tín lực, tôn kính Tam Bảo. Đối với các pháp xuất thế trọng yếu tương ứng với tam thừa do đức Phật đã nói, dẫu chỉ một bài tụng, trọn chẳng hủy báng, chướng lấp, ẩn giấu, chẳng ngăn cấm lưu truyền. Đối với các vị đệ tử xuất gia của Phật, dẫu là trì giới, phá giới, thậm chí kẻ chẳng có giới, cạo bỏ râu tóc, đắp y ca-sa, đều chẳng não loạn, đánh đập, tra khảo, trừng phạt, cướp đoạt y bát, cơ nghiệp tài sản, ép buộc hoàn tục, đánh thuế, lao dịch, giam cầm trong tù ngục, cho đến đoạn mạng, cũng chẳng cướp đoạt vật từ tháp và vật dụng của Tăng Kỳ, ngăn trở, chế phục, dẹp yên những kẻ bạo ác, chẳng cho chúng nó não loạn các vị xuất gia, chẳng để cho chúng nó cướp đoạt tài vật của Tam Bảo. Cung kính nghe nhận các pháp xuất thế trọng yếu tương ứng với tam thừa do đức Phật đã nói. Đã nghe nhận rồi bèn tinh tấn tu hành pháp tùy, pháp hành. Đối với các đệ tử thuộc tam thừa hiền thánh của ta, cung kính cúng dường, thân cận, thừa sự. Trong Đại Thừa, thệ nguyện kiên cố, trọn chẳng có tâm ngờ vực, lui sụt, cũng thường khuyên dạy, đặt yên chúng sanh, khiến họ tin nhận, tu học Đại Thừa. Vua Sát-đế-lợi Chiên-đồ-la ấy và các vua Chiên-đồ-la thuộc địa vị sang cả phú quý được quá khứ chư Phật đều cùng cho phép ở ngôi vua và các địa vị sang cả phú quý khác, tuy lại thọ dụng các thứ đại tài nghiệp thù thắng nơi quốc độ, thành, ấp, xóm làng, mà thoát khỏi đọa vào địa ngục Vô Gián và các đường ác. Ta cũng cho phép họ ở ngôi vua và các địa vị sang cả phú quý khác, tuy lại thọ dụng các thứ quốc độ, thành, ấp, xóm làng, mà thoát khỏi đọa vào địa ngục Vô Gián và các đường ác. Nếu các hữu tình muốn được sám hối, trừ diệt hết thảy các ác nghiệp chướng, khiến chẳng còn sót, thì đối với pháp môn do ta đã nói như thế này, hãy siêng năng tu học, đừng bỏ phế, quên mất. Có kẻ nào hổ thẹn, sám hối ác nghiệp như hiện tiền đại chúng thì hết thảy ác nghiệp đã tạo trong đời trước sẽ được tiêu diệt, chẳng còn thừa sót).

Phương tiện thiện xảo nhằm cứu độ họ. Có các chúng sanh ở ngôi vị Sát-đế-lợi quán đảnh, hoặc là các thứ địa vị sang cả phú quý khác, không nhất định là địa vị nào, nói chung là các địa vị cao sang phú quý, tuy chẳng thành tựu Vô Sanh Pháp Nhẫn, hoặc chẳng thành tựu [các môn] Pháp Nhẫn khác, hoặc chẳng thành tựu Thập Thiện Nghiệp Đạo, nhưng kẻ đó có tín tâm. Chỉ cậy vào sự tin tưởng, ngưỡng mộ, cung kính, tôn kính Tam Bảo. Đối với các pháp xuất thế trọng yếu tương ứng với Thanh Văn Thừa, Độc Giác Thừa, và Đại Thừa, họ cung kính nghe nhận. Pháp xuất yếu chính là phương pháp quan trọng nhất để xuất ly sanh tử, là đạo pháp thiện xảo phương tiện trọng yếu nhất. “Hạ chí nhất tụng” tức là chỉ nói một bài kệ tụng. Các điều khác chẳng nói, chỉ biết nói “nhất thiết hữu vi pháp, như mộng, huyễn, bào, ảnh, như lộ diệc như điển, ưng tác như thị quán” (hết thảy pháp hữu vi, như mộng, huyễn, bọt, bóng, như sương cũng như chớp, hãy nên quán như thế): Bài kệ tụng ấy tuyệt diệu thay! Đó chính là yếu nghĩa của toàn bộ kinh Kim Cang. Quý vị nói với người khác, “hết thảy các pháp hữu vi đều là khổ, đều là không, vô thường huyễn hóa”, ta còn tham đắm chi nữa? Họ liền chứng đạo, giải thoát, công đức của quý vị to lớn!

In the time of Dharma, it was like that, just listening to a verse recited immediately enlightenment. One of the five monks who was first saved by the Buddha was Bhikkhu Ma Thang (A Thuyet Thi, Aśvajit). Sariputta saw the majesty of Bhikkhu Ma Thang and asked: "Who is your master? What Dharma does your master teach?" Bhikkhu Ma Thang replied: “I will only tell you two sentences: All actions are impermanent, they are dharmas that arise and pass away”. Sariputta immediately attained Arahatship. That's a poem consisting of only two sentences! The Sixth Patriarch Hui Neng heard others chanting the Vajra Sutra to the words "If you don't stay anywhere, give birth to a mind" (don't stay anywhere to give birth to your mind), he was immediately enlightened and accomplished, just one sentence! However, the person who chants the Vajra Sutra is not enlightened at all, the person who listens to the sutra is enlightened! I preach the sutras here, I am not enlightened, you are enlightened; That is your merit, I also have a share.

Người như thế, đức Phật cũng chấp thuận cho họ hưởng thụ các của cải ấy. Why? Vì kẻ đó chẳng hủy báng, không ẩn diệt, tức là không hủy báng, không ẩn diệt thánh pháp, không ngăn cấm lưu truyền. Đối với các vị đệ tử xuất gia, trì giới, phá giới, cho đến kẻ chẳng có giới, chỉ cần cạo bỏ râu tóc, đắp y ca-sa, người đó chẳng não loạn, đánh đập, tra khảo, trừng phạt, cướp đoạt y bát là tài sản cơ nghiệp của họ. “Thoái linh hoàn tục, khóa thuế, dịch sử, hệ bế lao ngục, nãi chí đoạn mạng” (Buộc họ hoàn tục, đánh thuế, bắt làm phu phen, bắt giam vào tù, cho đến đoạn mạng): Kẻ đó sẽ chẳng làm [những chuyện ấy]. That is King Sat-di-li's faith. Còn như đoạn mạng, “diệc bất xâm đoạt Tốt-đổ-ba vật, cập Tăng Kỳ vật” (cũng chẳng cướp đoạt vật dụng của tháp thờ và vật dụng của Tăng chúng), kẻ đó chẳng làm. As for the property of Tot-do-ba or temples, that person has nothing to do with it, nor does he plunder it. Người đó có thể ngăn trở, chế phục, dẹp tan những đứa bạo ác, cũng chẳng để cho chúng nó não loạn người xuất gia, cũng chẳng để chúng nó cướp đoạt tài vật của Tam Bảo. Vua Sát-đế-lợi có quyền lực, đối với các pháp xuất yếu tương ứng với tam thừa, đều có thể cung kính nghe nhận. Having heard and received it, you can still act according to it, practice diligently, practice the dharma and practice the dharma.

What is dharma practice, dharma practice? For example, regarding the dharma of birth and death, that person does not speak, just depends on things, seeing that they are corrupted, why are they corrupted? Impermanence! That's called discretion. That person does not know the Buddhadharma, but can know its meaning, that is called "according to the Buddhadharma". What about going against Buddhism? The Buddha said impermanence, that person then interpreted it as cessation, saying that was what Śākyamuni Buddha himself said. Regarding the sentence “all actions are impermanent”, [the wrong understanding] impermanence does not exist. This is not according to the dharma. In the same saying, if you follow suit, you can attain enlightenment and have immeasurable merit and virtue; If you don't obey, you have boundless pity. That is depending on the dharma. We often misunderstand it, so we say that person does not follow this dharma. As for the essential dharma corresponding to the three vehicles spoken by the Buddha, please respectfully listen and accept it. Once you have heard and accepted it, you can “practice diligently”, that is “the dharma, the dharma practice”. Depending on the three vehicles, we say Mu, Mu in the meaning of “revealing the Wonderful Existence”. Tathagata's stores of merit are not empty. “Emptiness” is “the eradication of all afflictions”, the Tathagata's store of merit is not empty. Actually seeing the Dharmakaya, the Tathagatagarbha also did not. But depending on the dharma, depending on how you say it, "I respectfully make offerings to, be close to, and serve you" (for my disciples of the three vehicles of the three vehicles, I respectfully make offerings to you, be close to you, and serve you).

But from beginning to end, with regard to the Mahayana vow, there is absolutely no doubt, no danger, or retreat, that mind has never doubted, that is "a mind with no doubts, no retreats" (absolutely no mind of doubt or retreat), not because of the difficulty of the Dharma, not because of the long path of practice. Embrace fear, retreat to Nhi Thua! The Mahayana is solid, "Heron always needs the path, calms sentient beings, the Mahayana faithfully accepts and practices" (also often diligently guides and calms sentient beings, makes them believe, receive, and practice the Mahayana): Causes all sentient beings to believe in the Mahayana dharma, practice well, and study well. "Try King Kshat-de-li Chien-dala, update the rich race and honor the position of King Chien-tà-la, the Buddhas of the past together listen to the promise" (King Kshat-de-loi Chien-tà-la and other rich and luxurious king positions were all approved by the Buddhas of the past): Speaking of this evil king, it is also allowed for him, as long as he changes, does not do evil anymore, [Buddhas] allowed him to be king. In the past, all Buddhas allowed this. "Having access to all kinds of riches and noble positions, despite being able to enjoy all kinds of great wealth and karma in countries, cities, hamlets, gathering joy and great wealth" (And other types of luxurious positions and wealth, even though still enjoying all kinds of great wealth and great karma in countries, cities, hamlets, hamlets, villages): All the wealth in the country, that person can enjoy without falling into the Avīci Hell (Relentless Hell). This is allowed by the Buddha, so you will not fall into other evil destiniess! I also "promise to grant you the throne, access to all kinds of riches and noble positions, and even though you accept all kinds of kingdoms, cities, hamlets, and pleasures, you will be exempted from falling into the Infinite Hell and the evil beasts" (allowing that person in the imperial position and other rich and noble positions, while still enjoying all kinds of kingdoms, cities, hamlets, and pleasures, to escape from the Infinite Hell and the evil destiniess), that is, the evil king only needs to repent. Repentance is also promised!

In India, Devadatta and King Ajatasatru, one person harmed Buddha, one person killed his father, committed the crime of disobedience, both deserved to fall into hell. Later, King Vo Yem Tuc repented, protected the Buddha Dharma, protected the Three Jewels, and the Buddha also approved his repentance and achieved purity. Therefore, sentient beings can repent and eliminate all negative karma and karma.

“You should practice diligently as if you are talking about the dharma method, you need to study it” (For the dharma method I said so, you should study diligently): I mentioned those twenty dharmas, you must practice them well, on the one hand is to practice the dharma of the Ten Good Karmas, we can carry out the dharma of the Ten Good Karmas! Actually, the Ten Good Karmas are the main path of Dharma and Forbearance, everyone should understand a little. The Ten Good Karmas are the merits you perform, both shallow and deep. [For example, with] “don't kill”, not only do I not kill, but I also advise everyone not to kill. Those Ten Good Karmas will not be ordinary Ten Good Karmas. Not only do I not drink alcohol, but I also advise all sentient beings not to drink alcohol. Why not drink alcohol? Please tell them clearly. Do not kill, do not steal, etc. Those are the Five Precepts.

There are Dharma friends who are afraid of receiving the Five Precepts, saying, "If you are afraid of receiving the Five Precepts, what should you do?" If you commit it, of course it's a mistake. If you have committed a crime, repent. Whenever you commit a crime, immediately repent. But do you understand the merit of receiving the Five Precepts? If you accept the Five Precepts, you will not lose your human body, do you know that or not? You don't know this! Only think about the disadvantages, why not consider the advantages? When you receive the Five Precepts, there will be twenty-five guardian deities protecting you. If you try to break the precepts, they will stop you and prevent you from breaking them. Now that you have not received the precepts, for the five types of sins, [whenever you violate them], you will still receive the same punishment! If you kill someone, don't you commit a crime? Can you get away with it or not? You have taken the precepts, then killed someone, confronted the Buddha, repented, recited sutras for blessings, used other powers to help you, do not give rise to wrong knowledge or wrong views.

If you have received the precepts and break them, what will you do? That view is not accurate. Why violate? Even if you do not accept these precepts, if you break them, you are still guilty. The Buddha established the precepts and taught you not to violate those precepts. I again talk about a kind of virtue of morality. The precepts have the power to bless, that is, the blessing makes you not do anything. Killing, stealing, prostitution, I think there is no living being who does not commit it, but the country still accepts it. Just like the responsibility belongs to the job that person must perform. You say it's killing animals, killing pigs, killing goats, what crime? Who blames that person? In a husband and wife relationship, if it is said to be a violation of the precepts, all human beings will be cut off! Can we say that or not? No way! Impossible! That person (the person who has received the precepts) has the power to bless. It's not like saying [take the precepts, fearing that you will] violate them. You must consider from the perspective of the merit of receiving the precepts. [Just like] studying Buddhism, I heard that there are so many hells, [so I thought to myself] "It would be better if I didn't study Buddhism!" True or not? I don't even know about hell, I don't believe in it [there is hell, you have to pay retribution], but you still have to pay for the crime you have committed! If I don't believe, will I not be guilty? There is no such convenience! If you don't believe, you still have to suffer the crime. However, the Buddha said it is beneficial [because people who hear the consequences of all kinds of sins will be afraid and not dare to commit crimes], do not misunderstand the meaning. It is not that I urge you to accept the Five Precepts. If you feel "I can't take the precepts", there's still no need to take the precepts. However, you must think about the merit and blessings of receiving the Five Precepts [for consideration]!

Later, I thought back, since after becoming a monk and having received the bhikkhu precepts, I said: "It's too dangerous! Opening it up is a mistake. Two hundred and fifty precepts, one precept at a time, eighty-four thousand majesty, that much in the Vinaya and Precepts." At that time, I really wanted to renounce the precepts and return to the world, I couldn't bear it! This cannot be done, that cannot be done! Regarding the four postures, whatever you do is arbitrary, in temples, when you first become a monk, with gestures and movements, there is nothing wrong with making mistakes! I remember when I was praying, there was still no light at that time. In the dark, the bathroom is too far away. The bathroom also has no light, so you can't go. Waking up at night to urinate, what should I do? The visiting teacher placed a few urine containers under the window for everyone to deal with there. At that time, the visiting teacher said: "This person must have just come to pray." I said: "This guest teacher has supernatural powers. How does he know that it's me?" It turned out that because I was peeing, I wasn't peeing properly. Does anyone know what that means? Urinating cannot make a sound. Whenever there is a sound, it will alarm others! Eating, urinating, and all actions, there is no place without the Precepts. How can a newly ordained monk who has just become a novice monk keep it

can it all be correct?

“Repentance eliminates all evil karma, the spirit has no residue, the ego teaches the method” (Repentance eliminates all evil karma, leaving no residue, for the method I said so), if you practice skillfully, then “the first world created necessarily evil karma, "The stage of attaining the destruction of non-existence" (all evil karma created in previous lives is destroyed, there is no residue left), that person repents before the Buddha and there is no residue left. Now that we have heard the Mahaparody of the Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra, when you bow, you immediately bow three times, chanting silently: "I listened to the Mahabodhisattva Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra, the Buddha preached the chapter on Repentance, I have fulfilled all [those sins]. I also make the same vow, hoping the Buddha will bless me, hoping Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will bless me." You will also be complete like those people. If I say so, you can't believe it! No mistake!

VI. The Path of Good Karma - Chapter Six

(The sixth chapter: The Ten Paths of Karma)

(Sutra) At the ear of the time, Vajragarbha Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat said to the Buddha: “Venerable World-Honored One! Sat Ma Ha Tat ha, Thanh Van, attaining the non-enlightenment? Van ha, attaining the non-enlightenment? Tathagata disciples, weak in the dharma weapon, weak in the dharma weapon, in the summer will necessarily be able to practice and practice, attain the Mahayana dharma of non-enlightenment, often attain advancement, non-existence, gain wisdom, win blessings, often attain growth? Do the Dharmas, Dharmas, and Earth beings quickly attain freedom, and attain enlightenment without non-existence? Good intellectuals, according to your actions? Do Van Ha always attain the Buddha's view, visit the Bodhisattvas and Sravakas, do not abandon the Dharma, and make offerings to the Sangha? Do you always strive diligently, with a mind that is not satisfied?
(Sutra: At that time, Vajragarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva said to the Buddha: "Venerable World-Honored One! How can the Bodhisattva Mahasattva not make mistakes with the Sravaka Vehicle? How can he not make mistakes with the Sravaka Vehicle with the Sravaka Vehicle? How can he not make mistakes with the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle? How can he not make mistakes with the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle with the Sravakayana? How can he not make mistakes with the Mahayana? How can he not make mistakes with the Mahayana Sutra Jāla? How can the seed of the Three Jewels always be radiant? How can one not make mistakes with the monastic disciples of the Tathagata, whether it is a dharma weapon or not a dharma weapon, even with all those who wear a robe and shave off their hair and beard? How can one be constantly promoted and not fall back in the Mahayana dharma? How can one's sharp wisdom and superior blessings be constantly increased? How can I constantly meet with good wise men to follow them? How can I constantly see all the Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, and Sravaka disciples, constantly listen to the Dharma, and constantly make offerings to the Sangha? How can I constantly be diligent in seeking good roots, so that my mind will not be bored with the Bodhisattva's vows?")

This chapter teaches about the Way of Good Karma. Having repented, he practiced. After repenting and eliminating karma, what will you practice? Cultivate good karma. Vajra Treasury Bodhisattva Mahasattva is the originator. He turned to the Buddha to request: "Venerable World-Honored One! I still have questions." Bodhisattva Mahasattva is the great Bodhisattva among Bodhisattvas. When he wants to propagate the Dharma to benefit sentient beings, if he meets the Sravaka's ability, to the Sravaka Bodakāra, he will not speak of the Single Enlightenment Dharma, nor will he speak of the Mahayana Dharma. The Dharma meaning of each Dharma has clear limits, it is not arbitrary! Next, for each type of Bodhisattva Jāla sentient beings, what kind of dharma weapon they have, what energy they have, we will tell them that dharma, without making any mistakes.

Now we preach the Dharma, regardless of whether it is true or not, we preach this sutra, even if it is not fundamental, they will come and listen. Even if you have the right base, come and listen. This is called “[preaching the Dharma] without the right foundation”. If the foundation is not right, it will be very difficult to make no mistakes with the Sravaka Vehicle, or not make mistakes with the Single Sense Vehicle, not make mistakes with the Shravaka Vehicle, not make mistakes with the Bodhisattva Vehicle, that is, not make mistakes with the three vehicles. If you speak according to the basis, [speaking the dharma] is not in accordance with the basis, is not in accordance with [the nature of each type of] Pudgala (sentient beings), [you should] speak the Shravaka dharma, say it into the Single Enlightenment dharma, or say it into the Mahayana dharma, that is called "enlightenment" (wrong). Whenever there is a mistake, the speaker will be responsible for cause and effect.

Nowadays, in the Dharma-Ending Age, lacking the ability to observe skillfully, when teaching the Dharma, one must make a vow, wish to repent, and make a vow: "I am an ordinary being, without attaining sainthood, preaching the Dharma will definitely make mistakes. Regardless of whether one considers the basis or the Dharma, one will make mistakes!" If you have received the Bodhisattva precepts and developed a great mind, [if you are afraid of preaching the Dharma wrongly and then do not preach the Dharma] then it will destroy the nature of the Three Jewels. You have to consider two sides: Which is important, which is not important! Even though it is a mistake for them (those who listen to the Dharma), they can still sow good roots. If absolutely no one speaks, the dharma no longer exists, whether it is possible to meet without mistakes or not, they cannot know!

Personally, every time I have the opportunity to preach, I pray to Buddha or Bodhisattva for blessings, or chant sutras, or repent, and pray to Buddha or Bodhisattva for blessings, so that what I say does not go against the Buddha's will. In other words, bless me when I preach the Dharma to have accurate knowledge. What kind of knowledge will be accurate or inaccurate? Based on the Dharma taught by the Buddha, that knowledge will be righteous. The Buddha has three dharma seals [for the Dual Vehicle dharma, which is impermanence, suffering, and non-self], and also has one dharma seal [for the Mahayana dharma, which is the True Form]. When preaching the Dharma, do not depart from the True Form, to each sentient being say "not separate from the True Form", making sentient beings know the principle of "all dharmas are mind-only". When speaking about the Shravaka Vehicle dharma, you must definitely know the dharma of the Four Noble Truths, i.e. Suffering, Origin, Cessation, and Path; Those are the Four Noble Truths. The dharmas of the Seven Factors of Enlightenment, the Eightfold Path, the Five Faculties, the Five Strengths, the Four Foundations of Mindfulness, the Four Right Efforts, the Four Fulfillments of the Mind, the thirty-seven Paths, and the three vehicles all exist in common. Whatever you say is fine, in the end you cannot go beyond the three vehicles. Don't say right view becomes wrong view, [if it turns into wrong view], it will be crazy and make a mistake. The Shravaka Vehicle, the Single Enlightenment Vehicle, and the Mahayana are three vehicle dharmas that respond to the base of the three vehicles, as well as the three vehicles of the Mahayana Bodhisattva. There are no mistakes in dharma, no deviations, no chaos or discord; As for Bo Dat Gia La, that is, for those who [listen to the Dharma], there is no mistake! What kind of person is that? It is the Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat, the great Bodhisattva who can absolutely do it!

Furthermore, how to make the nature of Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha of the Three Jewels flourish and be always full, so that the nature of Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha of the Three Jewels will be forever unbroken and forever in the world? How to distinguish whether the monastic disciples of the Tathagata are or are not Dharma objects? Even for someone who wears a piece of kasa, does he not make a mistake? The “worldless” person is inferior to dharma objects and non-dharma objects, because he impersonates a monk. That person was originally a criminal. He found a piece of casa and put it on his body, hoping to end the disaster and escape danger. He did that. For that type of person, they don't make mistakes!

As for the Mahayana dharma, let that dharma flourish forever, do not regress from the Mahayana to the Second Vehicle. There are people who, if the Mahayana dharma is spoken to them, they will courageously move forward, following the Mahayana dharma to practice. There are people who feel that practicing the Mahayana Dharma to save sentient beings is too difficult, because sentient beings are stubborn and difficult to tame. Don't say that ordinary people save sentient beings, even Thanh Van who has attained Arhatship wants to save sentient beings. Therefore, they were afraid and fell from the position of the Second Vehicle and entered Thien Khong Dinh. There are many similar cases, even an Arhat like Sariputta, with the highest wisdom, still retreats to the Second Vehicle like that! He wanted to develop the Bodhi mind, but as soon as he did, he retreated. This story is probably known to everyone: As soon as Sariputra developed the Bodhi mind, Emperor Thich Thien appeared to test him. He appeared as a little girl, sitting and crying on the side of the road. Venerable Sariputta came before the girl and asked: "Don't feel sorry for yourself. If you have any difficulties, I can help you solve them. Tell me." The little girl said: "What I want, You can't solve it. You don't have such a great Bodhi mind!" He said: "I have just developed Bodhi mind." The little girl said: "Okay! I'll tell you. My mother now has a special illness. I'm looking for medicine. There is medicine, but there's no drug carrier." "The drug carrier is not difficult, just find it, or buy it." The girl said: "You can't buy it! This drug carrier needs the eyeball." Venerable Sariputta said: "I have just developed the Bodhi mind. Now that we meet, I should develop a great mind. Okay! I will give away an eye!"

He immediately gouged out one eye and gave it to the girl. The girl said: "This eye is not right!" “Why isn't it right?” “I needed my left eye, but You plucked out my right eye.” Venerable Sariputta was upset: "Why didn't you say it earlier? Okay! If I wanted to develop a great mind, I would have also gouged out my left eye. I'll give it to you both." The little girl took it, smelled it, then commented: "This eye is so fishy! How could it be put in medicine?" Throw it flat on the ground, step on it with your foot, and as soon as you step on it, you hear a loud bang! Sariputta immediately became discouraged and said that the Bodhisattva path is difficult to practice. When encountering such beings, there is no way to withdraw from Bodhi mind!

Actually, Arhats all have supernatural powers. There was an Arhat leading a novice on the road. That novice monk saw a sparrow in the field eating worms on the ground. The worms were exposed by the plowshare and the sparrows immediately pecked at them and ate them. He then raised his mind: "All sentient beings are suffering! I must develop Bodhi mind to benefit all sentient beings." At that time, he was carrying his teacher's robe and bowl, his bag was full. That Arhat called out the mantra: "Stop!" The disciples stopped. "Little novice monk, come here, give me the bag to wear." After the teacher put it on, the disciples didn't know what was going on, so they continued on. That novice monk thought again: "How can I save sentient beings? The Bodhisattva path is very difficult to practice, it's long and far away! I should still pray for the end of birth and death. I must pray for birth and death first and then speak again!" As soon as the mind was focused like that, the teacher put down the bag and shouted: "Stop! You still wear this bag." The first time, the second time, the disciple still didn't feel anything and continued walking. That novice monk thought: "No way! You have to become a Buddha, you have to develop a great mind, you have to be thorough!" You have no intention of retreating to the level of the Second Vehicle, no way! You should still develop great Bodhi mind, don't hesitate! The teacher shouted again: "Stop! Stop!" He stopped and "gave the bag to the teacher to wear". The young novice monk realized something was wrong and asked: "Master! Are you mentally ill? You are crazy! One moment I wear it, another moment you wear it. What's going on?" The teacher said: "You have already developed the mind of Bodhisattva, you are a great Bodhisattva, I am only an Arhat. So I don't dare to send the Bodhisattva to take care of it for me, it is better to give it to me! You have just developed the mind, then withdrawn the mind, regressed again, hoping to end birth and death. I have already finished birth and death, you have not yet, you just created the mind. Okay, it is still for you to wear. Handing over, handing over again is like that. Because you have just raised the mind to think, I know now”.

Arhats like that are very difficult to find! Why? He has Free Mind Access, there is no need to enter Concentration. There are Arhats in daily life who have complete powers like that! There are Arhats who need to practice Concentration for the Six Insights to appear; There are flavors that don't need it but can still appear. Those who are like that are all Great Arhats, just like in the one thousand two hundred and fifty (Buddha's) Permanent Sui Sangha, the top ten great disciples[29] are always in Samadhi.

Therefore, making Mahayana progress without regressing is very difficult! Everyone develops Bodhi mind every day, but every day they do not do Bodhi work, then that developed mind is very fake, just copying and developing it from others! When repenting, you also make a great vow “to save all sentient beings”, as well as “to suffer on behalf of sentient beings”. It is okay for you not to encroach on the benefits of sentient beings, but “to suffer on behalf of sentient beings”, how can you do it? At any time, we all, without exception, always invade the interests of sentient beings! Can we suffer for sentient beings? No! It's the same with politics, it's the same with economics, whatever you do, think about where all your benefits come from? From living beings! It all belongs to living beings, it's very difficult!

Bhikkhus, bhiksunis who become monks, should be very good! The four disciples, novice monks, novice nuns, if they reach the enlightenment, it is good. If you have not yet attained enlightenment, the things you enjoy are other people's blood and sweat! Even among them, there are also things that are fraudulent, and there are also illegal things! How do you eliminate these disasters? Why is it prescribed that monastics have two paths, light and dark? Aim to destroy the ears! If you don't practice anything else, go to the main hall and recite the exercises morning and night to pay off your debt, and you can avoid accidents! Why do all four disciples have daily exercises? Regardless of whether you recite a book of Pho Mon Pham, reciting a book of Pho Mon Pham is to dedicate it to others. So, when you eat, wear, walk, and live, you live in a house that other people have [made offerings to, built], your food is offered by others. You don't earn any money yourself! Must understand this principle! We need to always develop Bodhi mind! If you can always develop Bodhi mind, your wisdom can increase. Such outstanding merit and virtue will often increase. Where do superior merit and sharp wisdom come from? Must rely on the Three Jewels. The Three Jewels are the seeds of everything. How can we make our own sharp wisdom and outstanding blessings constantly grow and not decline? That's a problem!

Vajragarbha Bodhisattva asked the Buddha: How to maintain these things? “Is it necessary for the Clouds to be Concentrated, the Dharanis, the Rings, the Grounds?” (How to deal with all the Concentrations, the Da-lanis, the Rings, the Grounds?) That is speaking according to the Ten Grounds and Ten Rings in the Avatamsaka Sutra, we do not go into detail, just outline a few things. Quickly achieve freedom, without regressing. In all Concentrations, one can be at ease: If you want to enter Concentration, then enter Concentration; if you want to exit Concentration, then exit Concentration. From this position of Concentration, enter the position of Patience. From Ren to First Ground, from First Ground, Second Ground, to Ten Ground. "Van Ha often attains enlightenment with good wise men, and acts accordingly?" (How can I often meet good wise men, and act as I please?): How can I forever be inseparable from good wise men and follow the teachings of good wise men?

“The Van Ha often attains the inseparable view of all Buddhas, including the Bodhisattvas and Shravaka disciples?” (How can one constantly see all the Buddhas, and the Bodhisattvas and Sravaka disciples?): Those Sravaka disciples have attained enlightenment, until “never abandoning writing, dharma, and never leaving close relatives and offerings.” Sangha" (never separate from listening to the Dharma, never leaving close proximity to make offerings to the monks): Sangha here is the ordinary monk. Ordinary monks also include people like the Buddha taught in the previous section, [for those] who wear a piece of ka-sa, are fake monks, we still consider them as holy monks.

“Van Ha, are good roots always diligent?” (How to be diligent in good roots?): Seeking good roots is often diligent. Diligence is not being lazy, cultivating our good roots. How can we cultivate good roots? The more good roots grow, the better, the more the better. In my mind, there is no boredom, no boredom, no satisfaction! What we lack is our inability to be diligent. Regardless of whether you worship, whether you listen to the sutras, or whether you recite the sutras yourself, these are all superior karma; but always find an excuse! "I'm busy today, I'll excuse myself. I'll make up for it tomorrow!" How to compensate? Every piece will be cut off! If you stop for a day, if you stop for two days, if you stop for a long time, that person will no longer think of doing it!

People say: “Learning the Dharma is like a boat swimming against the water, if you don't move forward, you will inevitably fall back”. That boat, when rowing against the current, does not continue to move forward, it will be pushed back by the water, and will be swept back down by the waves! Practicing at home is like that, "Thuc mountain is endless, you need to follow the path" (Thuc mountain is endless, you must diligently set out on the path)[30]. The sea of ​​suffering has no shore. Human life is in a great sea of ​​suffering, you must be diligent. Like going to school. Going to school is like climbing a mountain, there is no road! You only need to seek knowledge, wish for rich morality, and have to be diligent; let alone practicing the Dharma beyond the world? There is never a moment of satisfaction in the mind. Having reached the goalless state, having reached the Eighth Bodhisattva Grounds, one will depend on one's mind, there will be no diligence, and there will be no leisure!

“Does the clouds and rivers often have Bodhi vows, the mind is not satisfied?” (How to be constant with the Bodhi vows, the mind is not bored enough?): Generate many Bodhi vows, if like the ten great vows of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva, they will be completely included. “Ten” means endless repetition. Every Bodhisattva who makes a vow is boundless. That is to say, the great Bodhisattvas, always make vows, forever and ever, their minds never get bored, but they also never get bored, they think that's enough! Vajrayana Bodhisattva asked the Buddha, "How can I achieve what I have asked above?" When Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas benefit sentient beings, how can we eliminate those mistakes? The Buddha then answered him.

(Sutra) At the ear, the World-Honored One reported to Vajragarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva: - Good man! Bodhisattva Mahasattva of the Ten Chakras. If the Bodhisattva Mahasattva becomes a ten-fold cycle, if the Sravaka Vehicle attains non-falling out,, if the Sravaka Vehicle-Buddhistakāla attains the first non-falling-out, u in the Solitary Enlightenment Vehicle attains non-falling-out, u in the Solitary Enlightenment Vehicle-Gāla attains non-falling-out, u in the Mahayana attains infallibility-free, u in the Mahayana-Buddhācāla-Gāla attains non-falling-out, always capable of naturally realizing the Three Jewels. The disciples of the Tathagata who became monks, weak in seeing the dharma weapon, weak in the non-dharma weapon, the summer will are bound to have a ca-sa, the world's cultivator has achieved the loss of enlightenment. According to the Mahayana Dharma, there is often advancement and advancement, with no regression. Gaining wisdom, winning blessings, often achieving growth. With absolute Concentration, the Da-lanis, the Rings, the Earths, quickly attain freedom, without any regression. Always attain enlightenment and enlightenment with good knowledge, and act according to your will. Always attaining the view of all Buddhas, meeting Bodhisattvas and Shravaka disciples, not separating from literature and dharma, not being close to each other, and making offerings to the Sangha. All of you with good roots, always strive diligently, with a mind without attachment. Often, Bodhisattva vows and has a mind of non-attachment. Usually, it is necessary to first create evil and unwholesome karma, but the holy vajra, the wisdom of the Dharma, decays, disappears, the spirit has no residue, and does not receive retribution. The wing does not create new evil or good karma, the mind is free from attachment, and has the ability to attain the unsurpassed Dharma wheel. It is often necessary to practice the Seven Jewels of Enlightenment, the mind is entwined with non-aversion. TThe ability to eliminate all sentient beings' afflictions and illnesses, the mind is entwined with non-aversion. Nall sentient beings are just exist.
(Sutra: At that time, the World-Honored One told Vajrayana Bodhisattva Mahasattva: - Good man, there are ten chakras of Bodhisattva Mahasattva. If Bodhisattva Mahasattva achieves those ten chakras, there will be no mistake in the Sravaka Vehicle, there will be no mistake in the Sravaka Vehicle, there will be no mistake in the Pratyekayana, there will be no mistake in the Pratyekayana, there will be no mistake in the Mahayana Sutra, it will often cause the Three Jewels to flourish With the monastic disciples of the Tathagata, whether it is a dharma weapon or not a dharma weapon, even for all those who wear a robe and shave off their hair and beard, they do not make mistakes. With the Mahayana dharma, they are always promoted and do not retreat. Wisdom is sharp, blessings are superior, and in all the Concentrations, the Dharmas, the Rings, and the Grounds, they are quickly freed and do not retreat Good knowledge, to follow accordingly. Always see all the Buddhas, Bodhisattvas and Sravakas, never leave listening to the Dharma, never leave close to the Sangha, always diligently seek, the mind is not tired of the Bodhisattva vows, always not tired of all the evil karma that has been done before, using the solid and sensitive holy wisdom to destroy and destroy it, so that there is no residue left. not receive retribution. Not even creating new evil karma, the mind is not tired, can quickly attain the supreme Dharma wheel, constantly practicing the Seven Enlightenment treasures, the mind is not tired and can often eliminate all diseases and afflictions for living beings, the mind is not tired of relying on it to survive.

You asked these questions, if you want not to make mistakes, learn these ten principles. [By studying this wheel, with regard to] the three vehicles of sentient beings, all of them will be able to make no mistakes, and the nature of the Three Jewels will be forever radiant. At the same time, "the disciples of the Tathagata who have become monks, weak-eyed dharma weapons, weak non-dharma weapons, their summer will are bound to have a ka-sa piece, the world of cultivating the false, attaining non-enlightenment" (for the monastic disciples of the Tathagata, whether it is a dharma weapon, or not a dharma weapon, even for all those who wear a piece of ka-sa, shave off their hair and beard, there is no mistake), in order to teach them not to make mistakes, they must rely on the ten chakras. hey. The previous scriptures still did not mention the ten chakras. They waited until they finished talking about the merits of that decade before talking about the ten chakras.

“Of all the Concentrations, Dharanis, Rings, and Grounds, quickly attain freedom, without any regression” (Of all the Concentrations, Dharanis, Rings, and Grounds, quickly attain freedom, without regression), isn't that what you asked? The Buddha then repeated the original [question] again, using the ten chakras to solve the problems the Bodhisattva asked, that's the meaning!

It is also possible to “ often attain enlightenment with good knowledge, depending on the action. TAchieve the Buddha's view without separation, follow the Bodhisattvas, Shravaka disciples, do not abandon the Dharma, and make offerings to the Sangha. Good roots, Always diligently seek, the mind is not satisfied. Often the Bodhi seed of vows, the mind is not satisfied" (often meet good wise people, follow accordingly. Often see all Buddhas, and Bodhisattvas, Thanh Van disciples. Never leave listening to the Dharma, be close to, make offerings to the Sangha. For good roots, always diligently seek, the mind is not bored. Often with the Bodhisattva vows, the mind is not bored): Hanh and may not be bored enough. Virtue and vow are two things that are inherently combined, virtue is vow, vow is virtue, but speaking from our side, they are separated. Sometimes we make empty vows, the vows are completely empty, there is no conduct to coordinate with the vows. Sometimes we have virtue, but we don't have a vow, don't know how to make a vow, that person's vow is very small, not compatible with the dharma!

Every time the first or full moon day comes, there are a lot of people burning incense, or a lot of people worshiping, and they immediately do it. Even though we do it, we don't know how to make a vow, and we don't know how to use visualization. That person lights a stick of incense as a stick of incense, offers a plate of flowers as a plate of flowers, does not know how to use the power of prayer to increase more, nor does he know that flowers are the cause. When we offer flowers, we pray that we will attain Bodhi, flowers are the cause of Bodhi, we pray that we will attain Bodhi. That person doesn't think like that, doesn't have that kind of mind, basically doesn't know!

Everyone who has studied Buddhism for a long time already knows it. Remember, when you make offerings to Buddha, is each thought using the Bodhi mind, applying Samantabhadra's offering (the offering of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva) or not? With fellow Dharma friends, we also make offerings together, which means we make offerings everywhere. Make offerings to all the Buddhas in the ten directions, make offerings to all the dharmas in the ten directions, make offerings to all the saints and monks. Whether domestic or foreign, Tibet, India are included in it, even the sages and saints in the Western world of Sukhavati Lien Tri Hai Hoi are included in it. Have you ever thought about how big your mind is? No matter how big you think, the merit will be that big. Vows and conduct are like two legs of each person, one leg is shorter, or the other leg is not enough, it will not be able to achieve great results. These are all reminders of Vajrayana Bodhisattva's words.

Buddha taught: If you rely on the ten reincarnations of Bodhisattva Mahasattva, what you have asked will be achieved. In the things [mentioned] next, [there are things] that are not part of His question. Like “pray for all kinds of vows, the mind will not be bored enough” is still the question of Vajrayana Bodhisattva. The Buddha reiterated, it is possible to satisfy [that wish], but what follows is not: "It is always necessary to create evil and unwholesome karma" (Often for all evil and unwholesome karma that has been created before): Unwholesome evil karma, that is, unwholesome karma created in the past. That's how evil was created. How to repent for that evil? How to eradicate? “Using the holy Vajra Dharma wisdom to be strong and sensitive” (Using the holy Vajra wisdom to be firm and sensitive), that is, the Vajra Prajna Paramita, we often refer to it as the Vajra Sutra. The wisdom of Vajra Prajna Paramita is the wisdom of Prajna. Prajna wisdom is as solid as diamond, undamaged by everything. Sharp as diamond, not broken by anything else. Wisdom from the Prajnaparamita Dharma can destroy all the evil and unwholesome karma that has been created, "spirit without residue" (leaving nothing left over). Not only was it destroyed, but there wasn't even anything left! Destroy all living things, destroy everything, nothing remains, nothing is left, no retribution!

For the karma created in countless past lives, if you rely on this decade, immediately, those solid karmas are destroyed. What are you using? Using Prajna wisdom, Prajna wisdom is solid, and also "does not receive retribution". "The wing does not create new evil or unwholesome karma" (Does not create new evil or unwholesome karma): Old karma has been repented, no new karma is created! Why? Relying on the ten wheels of Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat, relying on those ten wheels, will not create, can quickly "realize the unsurpassed Dharma wheel". By following those ten chakras, you will quickly attain Buddhahood, be able to turn the great wheel of Dharma, and diligently practice the Seven Factors of Enlightenment, that is, "The Seven Factors of Enlightenment", your mind will not get tired! "Can often eliminate all sentient beings' afflictions and illnesses, the mind is free from attachment" (Can often eliminate all sentient beings' illnesses and afflictions, the mind is not tired or tired). Our illnesses and afflictions are too many, eighty-four thousand afflictions. The Buddha spoke eighty-four thousand methods to treat total afflictions and basic afflictions. The total affliction is ignorance. "All sentient beings can only survive" (All sentient beings rely on it to survive), that is due to the ten cycles of Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat. If all sentient beings want to achieve the Dharmakaya of wisdom, depending on that Dharmakaya, the Dharmakaya will always exist, [then they must rely on the ten chakras], that is the meaning. This passage is intended to say that Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat completes the ten chakras and relies on those ten chakras to fully maintain the Dharmakaya's wisdom life, but still does not explain what the ten chakras are. To be honest, everyone knows the Ten Chakras, it is also the Ten Good Karmas.

(Sutra) Good man! Like the King of the Wheel of the Wheel, he is filled with seven treasures. Every action, the precept of the path, the remaining treasure of the latter, the four great continents, has the universal ability to eliminate all sentient beings' impurities in body and mind, and the universal ability to give birth to all sentient beings with a peaceful body and mind. Bodhisattva Mahasattva dressed like this, accomplished the ten cycles, attained the Shravaka Vehicle of non-enlightenment, and preached the will that all sentient beings only exist. Good man! Like a great highway, all four wheels are complete, many people have many branches, traveling on the highway. When the sky is exposed, the soil, roots, leaves, herbs, roots, elements, limbs, leaves, flowers, and fruits develop, the phase will deteriorate and cannot be used. Bodhisattva Mahasattva, dressed in a heron like this, accomplished the ten cycles, was able to destroy all afflictions, all sentient beings, all dharma obstacles, and the spirit did not receive retribution.
(Sutra: O good man! Like the Wheel-Turning King full of seven treasures, whenever he moves, the wheel guides him. The path ahead, other treasures follow, traveling throughout the four great continents, can completely eliminate all impurities in the body and mind of all sentient beings. Likewise, Bodhisattva Mahasattva, achieving ten rounds, does not make mistakes with Thanh Van Vehicle, in general, all living beings rely on it to survive. Like a large vehicle with four wheels, many people sit on it, traveling on the big roads. Pebbles, roots, stems, branches, leaves, flowers, and fruits of herbs on the road are crushed by the wheel, all are broken, can no longer have any effect. Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat is also like that, achieving the ten cycles, all can destroy afflictions, obstacles of sentient beings, all dharma obstacles that cause no retribution).

guide the way. Among the Holy Wheel-Turning Kings, whenever Iron Wheel King departs, the iron wheel naturally appears, due to good fortune. There is Dong Luan Vuong in charge of two continents, Dong Luan is present. When [Ngan Luan Vuong] governs three continents, the silver wheel appears. When [Golden Wheel King] rules over the four great continents, the golden wheel appears. Whenever he left, a golden wheel appeared. Here, [the main scripture] talks about the golden wheel jewel.

“Four Great Continents” i.e. Nam Thiem Bo Chau (Jambu-dvīpa), Northern Cau Lo Chau (Uttara-kuru), Tay Niu Ha Chau (Apara-godānīya), and Dongsheng Than Chau (Pūrva-videha), all four great continents can be patrolled can eliminate all impurities in the body and mind of sentient beings, and can give birth to peace in body and mind for all sentient beings in the four great continents. The Holy King Turning the Wheel has that merit. He went to the four great continents, preached the Dharma to the four great continents, and used the king's orders to establish policies in the four continents, making those sentient beings happy.

“Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat is dressed like this” (Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat is the same): That is an example. First give an example, then preach the Dharma, which is also in harmony with the Dharma and the example. I say Bodhisattva Mahasattva, “accomplishes the ten cycles” like the Holy King Turning the Wheel. When Bodhisattvas practice the Bodhisattva path, the ten chakras appear. Using the ten chakras, you will not make mistakes in the Shravaka Vehicle, in general, it is correct as Vajrayana Bodhisattva said. "The theory is that all sentient beings can only survive" (broadly speaking, all sentient beings depend on it to survive), that is, broadly speaking, as the previous text just mentioned, it will not be repeated!

“Good man, like a great highway” (Similar to a large horse-drawn carriage): “Great highway” is a large carriage. “Full four wheels” (All four wheels), current vehicles all have four wheels. “Many people have excess branches, traveling on the highway” (Many people sit on it and roam on the main road): Driving on the road, the soil, tiles, gravel, herbs, branches, leaves, flowers, fruits “the wheel of the wheel” (being crushed by the wheel), will all be crushed. “The stage must be destroyed” (Everything is broken), that is, the Bodhisattva has achieved these ten wheels, no matter what wheel it is, it has this function: Destroy all obstacles on the road. Even though afflictions block obstacles, without being turned around by afflictions, the use and effects of afflictions are no longer there, they are all destroyed. Bodhisattva Mahasattva is like that, able to "achieve the ten karma, be able to completely destroy all afflictions, all sentient beings, all dharma obstacles, the soul will not receive retribution" (achieving ten karma, all can destroy the afflictions, all sentient dharma obstacles, all dharma obstacles, causing no retribution): Overturning cause and effect, all dharma obstacles, and obstacles are not attached, have no Emptiness, causing no retribution: retribution means that person has personally realized emptiness and receives no retribution. But everyone should regularly visualize those ten cycles. Saying "fixed karma cannot be changed" is talking about the law of cause and effect. Whatever cause you have created, you must definitely receive that reward.

If it is moved, there will be no cause and effect, the law of cause and effect does not exist. Therefore, concentration karma cannot be changed, the power of Samadhi to bless is the power of concentration to bless. What Concentration power strengthens? That Concentration is “all dharmas are Emptiness”. There is no fixed karma, and there is no cause and effect. Having said that, it is very easy to fall into Nihilism, many people create karma. That's called "being wrong" (having mistakes). You can say that to Mahayana Bodhisattvas, but to Sravakas, to those wearing a piece of ka-sa, to dharma objects that are not of the Mahayana dharma type, [especially to] those who are not dharma objects, even less can you say that! To tell them that would be a mistake. If you want not to make mistakes, you must say "dharmas are born of causes and conditions, what I say is Emptiness, which is also a disguise, which is also the meaning of the Middle Way". That is a different kind of realm talked about in another type of scripture. And here we are talking about the three vehicles in general, talking about the three vehicles in general.

Therefore, it is said that all afflictions and hindrances no longer exist, the dharma hindrances no longer exist, the hindrances of afflictions no longer exist, the hindrances of Contemplation and afflictions no longer exist. Dharma obstacles no longer exist, Dharma Clinging and Ego Clinging no longer exist. Dharma Acceptance means that the Second Vehicle has Dharma Acceptance. Arhats all have the Dharma. They say: “The Self does not exist, the Self is Emptied, afflictions are non-existent, but dharma is non-empty”. They think that the dharma taught by the Buddha is empty. That is called Dharma Obstacles, meaning that they have been limited by the Dharma, and here all the obstacles have completely disappeared. Why not receive retribution? Emptiness arises due to dependent dharmas; Therefore, there is no obstacle and no retribution.

(Sutra) Good man! Like a sword wheel, a talented driver, capable of beheading enemies with details, versatile and incomparable. Bodhisattva Mahasattva dressed like a heron, achieved the ten cycles, was able to completely break the five beasts of prison, the great suffering of birth and death, forever ending all afflictions and evil karma, the spirit did not receive retribution. Good man! Just as a fire disaster arises, the five days appear, transforming the four great continents, the river, the sea, the water world, the new year, without ever drying up. Bodhisattva Mahasattva dressed like this, accomplished the ten cycles, all four causes, all afflictions, all sentient beings, all dharma obstacles, basic suffering, all stages dry up. Good man! Just as wind and disaster arise, strong winds from all four directions, when they are cut down, all worlds, large and small mountains, up to all great earths, will all disperse. Bodhisattva Mahasattva dressed like this, accomplished the ten cycles, the four islands of the world, the arrogance of the mountains, without any corruption. All sentient beings have afflictions and afflictions, all sentient beings have obstacles, all dharma obstacles, the basic retribution of suffering, are completely eliminated.
(Sutra: Hey good man! Like a sharp sword just drawn, it can cut off heads and Bodhisattva Mahasattva is also like that, achieving ten rounds, can destroy all the great sufferings of life and death in the five realms of prison, forever end all negative karma, so that he will not receive retribution, good man! Like when the fire rises, all four continents, all rivers, seas, and wet places, will not dry up In the same way, Mahasattva attained all four causes, all afflictions, all sentient beings, all dharma obstacles, the basis of suffering, all dried up. This good man! Just like when the wind arose, strong winds rose from all four directions at the same time, in all the worlds, large and small mountains, and great lands, all were destroyed in the same way, achieving the ten chakras The four inversions, arrogance, arrogance, there is nothing that cannot be broken. The afflictions, the obstacles of sentient beings, all dharma obstacles,

the basic suffering of all living beings, all are destroyed).

The Buddha gave another example. “Like loi sword wheel” [meaning] that wheel is like the sharpest precious sword. The precious sword "the most talented driver" (just pulled out), very quickly, as soon as it was swung, severed the enemy's head and limbs, rendering them useless. That is the meaning of the sentence “spirit has no use”. There are topics in the novel that were written based on [examples] in Buddhist scriptures. I read a novel where a person's search for a master often fails. Because he failed forever, he was called Thien Bai (thousand times failed). He respected him as his teacher. What did he learn from him? There is nothing strange or special, that is, [learning so that] whenever you draw the precious sword, you will quickly draw it, swing the sword with a bang, and it's done in one shot! I think that effort is what we monks call “attention”. Wherever the mind goes, the dharma goes there. Where the heart is, the sword is there, swinging the sword to take the opponent's head, has that meaning. He drew his sword so quickly that the enemy had no way of seeing him strike, nor of him drawing his sword! Talking about moves, he doesn't have any moves, just one move like that! What trick is that? Swing your sword, your skull will fall, are you still waiting for me to see what you will do? I cleverly blocked a blow, there's no such thing, it's just a sword strike, you can't block it! If you understand this principle, you will know immediately!

What is used here is the sword of wisdom, that is, your wise mind. When you reach that place, the darkness is destroyed. Without wisdom, if you want to do expedient things, you will be bound even tighter. Therefore, people with wisdom will be more convenient and more liberated. Therefore, “with wisdom, the means are liberated; without wisdom, the means are unlucky” (with wisdom, the means are liberation. Without wisdom, you will be bound by the means). If you don't have wisdom, don't create chaotic means. Messing around means you have a problem with your mind! People with wisdom can use it no matter how casually they want it! You practice the Eight Trigrams Sword, or the Tai Chi Sword, whatever type of sword you practice, they will pull out the sword and cut your skull off in one shot, without waiting for you to use it! How do you develop it? There is basically no other way to execute! That's what it means.

Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat “accomplished the ten karma”, that power is so great that it can destroy the great suffering of birth and death in the five realms of prison, birth and death are immediately destroyed. “Eternally cut off all negative karma and afflictions” (Permanently cut off all negative karma and afflictions). Bodhisattva Mahasattva has eliminated all those disturbing karmas, making it impossible to receive retribution. Karma is retribution, “karma” is the retribution of karma, if karma is destroyed, there is no more, there is no retribution! When fire disasters arise in this world, when feeling karmic retribution, one sun appears, two suns appear, three suns appear, four suns appear, five suns appear. A sun appears, we feel it is summer. As soon as the sun shines at noon, you can't stand it. If it is a solar year, increase it five times! The [normal summer temperature is] thirty-nine degrees, three times five is fifteen, three times nine is twenty-seven, that is, [five times thirty-nine] will be one hundred and seventy-seven degrees. One hundred and seventy-seven degrees down, you evaporate, can you survive? Therefore, rivers, seas, places with water, and wet places all dry up.

“Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat attains the 10 cycle of enlightenment” (Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat also achieves ten cycle), eliminating the four causes and afflictions of all sentient beings. The four basic afflictions are the four causes. The four basic afflictions are ego ignorance, ego view, ego pride, and ego love. That's basic. But to talk a little more deeply, it will be the afflictions of View, the afflictions of Thought, the afflictions of Tran Sa, and the afflictions of Ignorance. These kinds of afflictions are the cause and result, and there are many of them. All afflictions and negative karma are eliminated, shallow or deep, down to the subtle, down to the seed, the seed of affliction uses ignorance as the basis. Because of the realization of Emptiness, we have understood and talked about the dharma obstacles, karma obstacles, and suffering obstacles of all sentient beings. Feeling suffering is the retribution of suffering, the retribution and the cause have also disappeared. That's the fruit!

“Everything is dry” (Everything is dry), like the five suns appearing. The five suns are meant to visualize that your wisdom has been extinguished and your afflictions and afflictions have dried up. Waiting until Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat achieves the ten cyclic existences, the entire ocean of afflictions and suffering of birth and death will dry up. The four mountains of madness, arrogance, and arrogance in the world have all collapsed. Reversal of views (inverted views) can be said to be “self-ignorance, self-arrogance, self-love, self-view”. [It is said that it is] crazy, because it is not a self, but attachment is a self. That's crazy! Ignorance is ignorance, turning ignorance into wisdom, turning wrong knowledge into right view, turning into wisdom, turning pride into patience, turning self-love into compassion. Great compassion turns into wisdom and love. "The afflictions and afflictions of all sentient beings, the hindrances of all sentient beings, the hindrances of all dharmas, the basic sufferings of suffering, are completely destroyed" (The hindrances of afflictions, the obstacles of sentient beings, all dharma obstacles, the basic sufferings of all living beings are dissolved

destroy), all completely eliminated.

(Sutra) Good man! Like the lion king, with a loud roar, all the beasts are startled, flying, subdued, and emotionless. Bodhisattva Mahasattva dressed in a heron like this, achieved the ten rings, the Dharma sound is one shaking, the desire is not necessarily heretical, heretical, evil knowledge, all levels of sutras, lost speech, emotionless and hostile.
(Sutra: O good man! Like the king of lions roaring, all beasts and beasts They were all scared, they were flying and falling, they ran for cover, not daring to move at will. Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat was also like that, achieving the ten wheels, the sound of the Dharma was resounding, until all heretics, heretics, evil intellectuals, etc. were all scared, forgot all about speaking and arguing, and did not dare to oppose).

“Like a lion king roaring at once” (Like a lion king roaring once), “all the beasts were startled, flying in fear, unconsciously moving” (all the beasts were frightened, fell down while flying, ran for cover, not daring to move) cover), “flying” (falling in flight) refers to flying birds. The lion's roar shocked them and they all flew away. “Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat dressed like this, achieved ten cycles, the dharma sound was one shock, the most determined heretics, heretics, evil knowledge were all levels of sutras, lost seven words” (Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat was also like that, achieved ten cycles, the sound of the dharma was resounding, until all heretics, heretical schools, evil knowledge, etc. were all frightened, forgot to speak and argue): When they intending to argue with you, [you] use the correct Dharma sound to speak, they want to open their mouth but cannot open it. Wrong knowledge and wrong views are all destroyed. That is the meaning of the sentence "indifferent to resistance" (not daring to resist), "hostile" is to oppose, "to resist" means to argue, oppose, that is to argue, defend with you.

(Sutra) Good man! When the Heavenly Emperor Thich Dau A To Lac was fighting together, the heavenly army interfered, held on to the vajra, and the four beasts fought against the enemy, the As To Lacs were startled and dispersed. Bodhisattva Mahasattva dressed like this, accomplished the ten cycles, completely reversed the views of heretics, heretical schools, evil knowledge, and the horrors were dispersed. Good man! Such as Nhu Y Pearl, with high wisdom, powerful and wonderful treasures, bestowed as alms to all poor sentient beings. Bodhisattva Mahasattva dressed like a heron, accomplished the ten cycles, treated the pure precepts, the great dharma universe, and gave alms to countless sentient beings. Good man! Like the dark part of the night, the world is gloomy, filled with no views, lost in the right path. From the full moon, all the dark ones are eliminated, all the seven-paths are on the right path. Bodhisattva Mahasattva dressed like this, accomplished the ten cycles, weakened sentient beings, ignorant and dark, because they tried to be ignorant of the seven eightfold holy path. The Bodhisattva preaches the true Dharma, eliminates ignorance, gives birth to the Dharma of light, reveals and manifests the eightfold noble path, destroys all defilements, and eliminates all suffering.
(Sutra: Good man! Like Thich De Thich and A To Lac when about to fight, the army of heaven Surrounded, holding diamonds, rushing into battle with the enemy, the Ato Laces were frightened and fled. In the same way, the Bodhisattva Mahasattva, who achieved the ten karma, all the heretical views, heretics, evil knowledge, etc., were frightened and fled. Good man! The Ruyi gem placed on the high platform can pour out all kinds of wonderful treasures, giving to all poor and needy living beings. Bodhisattva Mahasattva is also like that, achieving the ten karma, placing it on the pure precepts, pouring out a great rain of dharma, giving it to all countless sentient beings! Just like in the dark night, the world is dark, completely blind to the right path. As soon as the full moon rises, all the darkness is eliminated, all those who are lost can see the right path. Bodhisattva Mahasattva is also like that, if the living beings are ignorant and dark lost the path of the eight-fold noble path. Bodhisattvas, because of them, proclaim the true Dharma, eliminate the darkness of ignorance, give birth to the bright Dharma, reveal and manifest the eight-fold noble path, causing the destruction of all taints and the end of suffering).

“ Good man, like the Heavenly Emperor Thich Dau A To Lac, in times of mutual desire, the heavenly army interferes, clings to the vajra, the four beasts battle the enemy” (Hey good man! Like the Thich De Thich and A To Lac, when they are about to fight, the heavenly army surrounds them, holding the vajra in their hands[31], rush into battle with the enemy), that is, enter the battle of Asura (Asura).

“Asu Lacs, the sutras disperse” (Asu Lacs are frightened and flee), Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat is the same. If “achieve the ten circles, completely reverse the views of heretics, heretical studies, evil knowledge, be startled and disperse. Good man! Nhu Y Chau has high wisdom” (achieve the ten rounds, all heretical views are reversed, heretical views, evil knowledge, etc. are frightened and run away. Hey good man! Nhu Y Pearl is placed on a high platform), again for example, Nhu Y jewel is placed on a very high place. If it's dry, put the jewel on a high place, and it can release all kinds of rain. That rain is a wonderful rain of precious gems. Give alms to all poor and needy sentient beings and they will be saved.

“Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat is dressed like this, achieving the ten cycles, on the pure precepts” (Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat is the same, achieving ten cycles, on the pure precepts): Maintaining pure precepts. Pure precepts are like high places. The rain of great dharma dance is a sermon, not a precious treasure, it is even better than a precious treasure. Dharma preaching is the rain of dharma, meaning it rains out the dharma that sentient beings love. Rain can eliminate disasters and turn the great wheel of dharma. “Dharma dance” is a word that visualizes teaching the Dharma to them, addressing all sentient beings to say, what dharma should be used to save them, then tell them that dharma.

“Good man, like the dark night part” (Hey good man! Like in the dark night), the sky is dark, like at that time, the world is dark, “dark night” means darkness. “Do not see at all” (Cannot see at all): In the dark, our eyes lose their effectiveness. Our eyes see light and do not see darkness. At that time, you can't see anything, can't see enough to know which way to go, and immediately get lost on the right path. Wait until the full moon, “full moon” is the full moon on the full moon day. When the moon is full, it will eliminate darkness, all darkness will disappear. You will see the road clearly. The one who cannot see is the one who is lost, unable to find the right path, at that moment he sees, the light shines, that person will find the right path.

Bodhisattva Mahasattva is the same, achieving the ten karma, if sentient beings are ignorant and dark, have lost the eight limbs of the holy path, and do not follow the right path. In this way, the Bodhisattva will proclaim the true Dharma, eliminate the darkness of ignorance, give rise to the light of the Dharma for that person, and reveal and manifest the eight noble paths. “Spirit to cut off the taints” (Causes to cut off the taints), including the taints of the three realms, up to the taints of the two deaths, the taints of the Change of Birth and Death. These things are all “suffering” (on the edge of suffering), also “storms end with suffering”. This includes all Bodhisattvas. The Bodhisattva is still in the suffering of Birth and Death, there is still Tran Sa and Ignorance, they will all be eliminated!

(Sutra) Good man!
