Just as the great sun appears in the world, all the cats grow, all the stages grow, all the flowers are filled with glory, all the filth is eliminated, all the seeds, fruits, medicine, all the stages mature, the snow mountain flows away, all the rivers are full, gradually turning the spell, filling the ocean. Bodhisattva Mahasattva, dressed as a heron, accomplishes the ten cycles, with the teachings of alms giving, subduing, tranquility, Thi La, patience, right effort, calm concentration, Prajna, expediency, compassion, eloquence, merit, and prosperity, to all sentient beings, proclaiming the Dharma, due to the Dharma's majesty, the spirit of all sentient beings, the race of monks with the highest good roots and the cat price of all stages of growth, the race of monks with the wonderful conduct of flowers and flowers of all stages of growth. glory, all kinds of afflictions, evil karma, bad deeds, all stages of elimination, good destination of Nirvana, all the cups, fruits, medicines, all stages of maturity, wrong views, all stages of destruction, all races of right faith, precepts, precepts, equanimity, wisdom, up to the river of concentration, without any abundance, all the way to the great sea of Nirvana, all sentient beings can mock at will, animals enter the fearless branch of Nirvana into.
(Sutra: O good man! Like a great solar palace appearing in the world, all the rice All the seedlings grow, all the flowers and leaves are luxuriant, all rot and filth are eliminated, all kinds of grains, fruits, medicinal herbs, all are ripe, the snow mountains melt, the rivers overflow, flowing into each other one after another, filling the ocean in the same way, achieving the ten cycles, he only increases almsgiving, subduing, tranquility, poetry. Laity, patience, right effort, tranquility, Prajna, expediency, compassion, eloquence and merit, all are blazing, proclaiming the Dharma for all sentient beings. Because of the Dharma's magnificence, all sentient beings' virtuous rice roots grow, all kinds of flowers and leaves and wonderful monks' virtues flourish, all kinds of afflictions, evil karma, and evil actions are all eliminated, and all kinds of grains, fruits, and herbs are well directed. At Nirvana, everything is ripe, the mountains of wrong views and arrogance are all melted away, all kinds of rivers of right faith, Precepts, Literature, Equanimity, Wisdom and Concentrations are overflowing, one after another filling the great ocean of Nirvana, allowing sentient beings to enter the citadel of Nirvana as they please.

“Sun Palace” is the solar palace. “Diên” means “palace”. “Great Sun Palace” is a palace that appears in the sun. If all living things are not nourished by sunlight, rice seedlings will not be able to grow. The rising sunlight does not say “great sun”, but says “great sun hall”, does not say “moon export” (rising moon), but says “full moon” (full moon). Like a “greenhouse”, it allows all seeds to grow. “All flowers, all leaves, all flowers are glorious” (All flowers, leaves, all are luxuriant), blooming, blooming lushly, all stench is eliminated, becoming fragrant. "The grains, fruits, medicines, all are ripe" (The grains, fruits, medicines, all are ripe), the grains and crops all bear fruit, "medicines" are herbs.

“Mounted Snow” (Melting Snow Mountain): At that time, the five suns [appeared together], the thousand-year-old Snow Mountain also melted. The Southern Ocean and Northern Ocean are no longer there. A snow mountain has just melted, causing the rivers to overflow, watering them, causing all things to grow. After that, the river flows into the sea. Therefore, living things grow together well. Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat is also like that.

“Achieve the ten chakras, rely only on the highest almsgiving, subdue, tranquility, Thi La, patience, right effort, Tinh Lu, Prajna, expediency, compassion, eloquence, merit, and complete prosperity” (Achieve the ten chakras, rely on the superior almsgiving, subdue, tranquility, Thi La, be patient, right effort, Tinh Lu, Prajna, expediency, compassion, eloquence, merit, all are blazing): Giving alms is giving Prajna. “Taming” is to tame our mind, taming is also contemplation. Like the Four Foundations of Mindfulness, when we first begin to practice Concentration, use the Book of Contemplation. The book of contemplation can tame your scattered mind. It tames the scattered mind and prevents drowsiness. Then, achieving tranquility, one will enter Concentration. Stillness is Only. Thi La has the meanings of “prevention, purity”. Thi La is Gender. “Patience”: If you want peace and joy, you must first be patient. If you are patient, a hundred things will disappear. You have to pray for patience, patience is not easy, especially for powerful people. Forbearance is not easy!

Once upon a time, there was a Prime Minister. When he became Prime Minister, his son was still at home. That Prime Minister is very good. If it weren't for the good, his son would have gone on a rampage long ago. Because his land was partly occupied by his neighbors. The neighbor built a wall, taking up a lot of his house's land. Therefore, the son immediately wrote a letter to his father, asking him to send a letter to the district magistrate in his hometown, asking the district magistrate to return the land. How did the Prime Minister answer his son? “Thousand miles of mail delivery just for the wall”, so far away you write a letter just because someone else built a wall and took up a few meters of land! “Give him a few meters of land?” (Is it okay to give someone a few meters?): Just give him a few meters of land, what's the need to fight? “The Great Wall is still there” (The Great Wall is still there), have you seen it, the Great Wall is still there. “I don't see the current Qin Shi Huang” (Thuy Hoang has now disappeared). Who is who? Thirty years of Ha Dong, thirty years of Ha Tay, what is yours and mine? Water engulfs, fire burns, everyone ceases to exist!

overlay. If you have been deceived, you should be happy! That's how we pay the debt. What should not belong to him, [which he deceived me], is that he owes me, I should not give rise to the idea of ​​debt collection! If you want to collect your debt, you still have to be born in this world. Where can you go to collect your debt? That person is the seed of hell, he deceives and lies to others, he will come to this world to suffer! Do you also follow him into this world to pay his sins? Forget it, give him alms. That is almsgiving, that is patience. If you can endure anger for a while, you can avoid disaster for a hundred days! It is necessary to meditate on this every day. Otherwise, if something happens to you, how can you endure it? Right? I can't even endure one sentence! That person insulted me, either talking about family members, or talking about myself, saying a lot of bad things about you, regardless of whether you are there or not. Whenever there is one, after hearing it, you will be very happy. That person is my wise friend. Bow your head and pay respect to him three times. Oh my! You pointed out that mistake to me, I thank you, I have eliminated my karma, I must repent. That person will not be able to speak anymore! If that person tells the truth. The Diamond Sutra teaches others to slander and insult you. After you have endured it, you were originally destined to fall into hell. Because of that karma and karma, [the crime of falling into hell] will immediately disappear. It is also a serious tribulation but the reward is light, so you should also be patient. Be patient, be diligent, study diligently and diligently, learn useful things, don't be very diligent and hard-working about useless things!

For the sake of profit, we cannot sleep day and night, racking our brains to think, how can we achieve it? How to win elections? Who do we attract? No one knows how much money we spend. That is not bribery to get elected, it is also avoiding bribery by spending money to buy votes! Is there such a thing as convenience? There is none! Diligent, hoping for peace, Tinh Lu contemplates and observes, whatever he looks at, he must observe accurately. Prajna is Fundamental Wisdom, means is skillful, compassion is great compassion. That is the great Bodhisattva's mind of benefiting sentient beings, his eloquence is unhindered. You must learn to be eloquent; If you don't study, how can you become eloquent? If you have wisdom, you will have eloquence. If you don't have wisdom, what will you argue?

“merit”: “merit” is virtue. “Virtue” is when you do such things, it is achieved in the mind, it must arise from the mind. That is an inconceivable merit that will burn brightly. “Xi prosperous” means a prosperous and great situation. “For all sentient beings, preaching the Dharma, due to the majesty of the Dharma, the souls of all sentient beings, all races, have increased their good roots and good roots at all levels” (Because of the living beings, proclaiming the Dharma. Due to the majesty of the Dharma, it causes all kinds of rice seedlings to increase the good roots of all sentient beings). The examples just mentioned above are all used to combine to form.

“The strains of the superior monks are blessed with flowers and leaves, all the flowers and leaves of the superior monks are all luxuriant): Blooming very lushly. “All kinds of afflictions, evil karma, evil deeds, are completely eliminated” (All afflictions, evil karma, evil deeds are all eliminated): All cease. “The good beast of Nirvana” (Skillfully moving towards Nirvana), that is a very good direction. Fruits and seeds are unborn and immortal, “all grains, fruits, and medicinal herbs are ripe” (all kinds of grains, fruits, medicinal herbs, all are ripe): That is accomplished. The good karma of grains, fruits, and medicinal herbs has been achieved and one can enter Nirvana. Wrong views and arrogance are like high mountains, “all stages disappear” (all melt), like melted ice mountains. Our afflictions are karma, like a mountain that dissolves. "The spirits of all sentient beings can mock at will and enter the fearless city of Nirvana" means that all sentient beings can attain immortality, immortality, birthlessness, immortality, reaching ultimate Nirvana.

(Sutra) Good man! What is the name of Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat of the ten cycles? Good man! If you try the Ten Wheels, there is no residual Dharma, and you will understand the Ten Good Karmas. Accomplished as a ten-wheeled effort, attained the title of Bodhisattva Mahasattva. With all evil, the ability to liberate, all good dharma can be achieved at will, the speed to reach the great Nirvana Sea, the great skillful means of wisdom, the maturity of all sentient beings, the spiritual world to reap the benefits and peace. The reason why it's fake? Good man! In the past, all the Buddhas, World-Honored Ones, completely abandoned the ten evil karma paths, and praised and praised them as the result of the Ten Good Karmas. The theory of the Ten Virtuous Karmas is based on the teachings of the Ten Good Karmas, the one who protects the one, the fate is the same, the end is not violated, the plan must necessarily be victorious, as previously said.
(Sutra: Hey good man! What are the ten chakras of Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat? Hey good guy! Men! Those ten wheels are no other dharma, you should know that it is the Ten Virtuous Karma Paths. By achieving such ten types of wheels, Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat can be liberated from all evil, all good dharmas can be achieved at will, can quickly fill the great ocean of Nirvana, using the light of wisdom and skillful means to mature all living beings, causing them to achieve benefits and peace So? Good man! All the Buddhas and World-Honored Ones in the past all stayed away from the Ten Evil Karmas, and all praised and praised the results achieved by the Ten Good Karmas. Therefore, if one can arbitrarily guard one thing in the Ten Virtuous Karmas mentioned above, until one's death, without committing any violations, one will definitely achieve all the retributions as mentioned in the previous section.

“ Good man! VThe ten chakras of Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat? What is the decade? “Phi Du Phap Ye” [meaning] there is no other method! “True knowledge is the Ten Good Karmas” (You should know that it is the Ten Good Karmas): We sometimes do not carefully guard our body, mouth, and mind, thinking it is a trivial matter. This is not a small thing, but the basis for becoming a Buddha, the basis of all good karma. The Buddha spoke like that for half the time. In the previous part, he gave many examples, but also preached the Dharma. Now, what is the Ten Wheels? The Ten Good Karmas are ten types of wheels. [By completing] those ten cycles, one will be called Bodhisattva-Mahasattva. The ten wheels are complete, you are a great Bodhisattva among Bodhisattvas, liberated from all evil!

“All good dharmas can be achieved at will” (All good dharmas can be achieved at will): Achieving the Ten Wheels is of course achieved. Regarding verbal karma, such as saying we don't lie, don't say harsh words, don't scold others, don't say embellishments, don't tease others, don't say words without reason, don't say double words, and don't stir up gossip. We often talk about ten karma like that, but you advise every sentient being to do the same, that is a great Bodhisattva. Even if we don't keep it well, how can we advise others? We must set an example ourselves! To give an example, our own capacity is not enough, so what should we do? Eyes see less, ears hear less, mouth speaks less, at least say words less separate from the Three Jewels. When we disciples discuss with each other, we talk about many things related to Buddhism. Paragraph Or how? How to prove Truth? That's what I think. Doctors tell us to exercise a lot and walk a lot. When walking, when concentration has not been achieved, when walking, it is easy to get distracted. Think about it, when you are still you don't get scattered, or when you walk you don't get scattered? I also know that my friends advised me with good intentions: "Master, let me take you out to walk around a little, do a little activity. If you stay in your room all the time, you will get sick very quickly!" That's not true, getting sick belongs to karma. If you have karma, you will get sick, but if you don't have karma, you won't! Everyone advises you, your friends advise each other, you should calm down and apply the practice of Tinh Lu a lot. You don't know who is good and who is bad. You say to me, if you say it well, "Okay! Okay! If I listen, then listen, I still won't agree with you"!

What is it like to be swept away by you? My ears turn to your words! Let's go! The more you go, the more you let go. If it's not going to the supermarket, it's going to the park to look around. So who will go there? People are idle, have money, and indulge their five desires. We capture our bodies and minds. Our body, mind, and mouth are always taking pictures, always only seeing the scene. Without such great concentration, the mind will move according to the scene. We still cannot reach “a mind that can change states”. The mind can change realms and immediately resemble Tathagata. “The mind is moved by the scene” is a living being. Among the Dharma friends, you should guard your body, mouth, and mind as much as you can, and let loose less. It's too late to escape. Why do you still want to get there? That place is a bustling place!

Speaking of which, I remind everyone a little, I can only accept your good intentions. You don't know, your teacher doesn't have that great spiritual power, he won't go to that place! Where is the atmosphere nice? In your mind, the best atmosphere. If you are quiet, the atmosphere will be the best. When it comes to our own body, mouth, and mind, we must absolutely preserve one thing. Out of ten karma, you can keep one karma and not violate it at all. Even until the end of your life, I will not violate that precept. If you do not kill, have never killed, and do not take advantage of others, you will definitely achieve victory. What retribution? You don't get sick, you don't have a short life, you don't suffer from that karma. If you don't steal, you won't lose anything for many lifetimes. I tested this myself. Since I became a monk, until now, no one has stolen my things. Our room door was never locked, no matter what, my room was never locked. Before, I made a vow that whoever wants to take something, I will give alms. I can do it by myself, but not with two or three people living together!

Everyone must know: “If you hide it carefully, it will lure thieves, beautify it to lure prostitutes), you will also feel it. You wear beautiful makeup, others crave it. The more carefully you hide it, the easier it is to lose it. The safety deposit box was also broken open. Rent a safe at a post office or bank; the New York area has lost a lot of safes. It's absolutely not like using a key to open it, they have an electric tool that naturally cuts it open. Don't you put all your [precious] things in a safe? Okay! All lost. I read the newspaper and saw many times [news of safe deposit boxes being broken], how can I keep them safe? Not stealing other people's things is to preserve them well. Not only will it not be lost in one lifetime, but it will not be lost forever. Thieves steal, fire burns, kings confiscate, bandits plunder, can you preserve it or not? Your skull cannot even be protected, let alone anything outside your body, how can you protect it? If you practice the Ten Good Karmas, you will preserve them. I don't steal other people's things, nor do others steal from me. I absolutely believe that is so.

I have never killed others, nor have others hurt me, nor killed me. That's called karma, this is not easy! If we can believe urgently and everyone will make an effort, that is truly where our efforts are worth. If you achieve the Ten Good Karmas, "you will attain the name of Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat. All evil can be liberated" (called Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat, can liberate all evil things). Complete liberation from all negative karma. Evil is about fruit, we can not be bound by others. How not to be tied down? Achievement of the Ten Virtuous Deeds. The Ten Virtuous Karmas have reached their ultimate conclusion. Killing, stealing, lust, greed, anger, ignorance, lying, embellishing words, double-talking, speaking evil words, the ten evil karmas are completely pure, then you will be accomplished, Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat.

Even advising all sentient beings to do the same, because you are filled with great wisdom, free from all evil, all good dharmas can be achieved at will, can quickly fill the ocean of Nirvana, attaining the true “no birth, no death”. Use the light of wisdom and great skillful means to mature all sentient beings, allowing them to achieve benefits and peace. Why do I say that? Why is that? It has the meaning of asking and provoking: Where is the morality? How did all the Buddhas become Buddhas? They are far away from the ten evil karma paths and do not dare to approach them. “Giai all praises and praises the Ten Good Karmas” (All praise and praises the Ten Good Karmas), if a small retribution is achieved, it is a heavenly retribution. The Ten Good Karmas are "speaking the Bodhi path with the mouth, remembering the Bodhi path in the mind, and practicing the Bodhi path with the body". Greed, anger, and ignorance are gone, there will be Precepts, Concentration, and Wisdom, and there will be no such retributions. It can often be said like that, you must praise the Ten Good Karmas, stay away from the Ten Evil Karmas, only then can you achieve the Ten Good Karmas.

“To attain the karma of the Ten Good Karmas, to try to protect the Ten Good Karmas”, [meaning] although it is not possible to preserve all ten things, only one thing needs to be preserved, “to the point of death, the end is not transgressed” (until the end of life, ultimately not transgression), one can preserve absolutely pure. I will never steal from others in my entire life, or I will never lie to others in my entire life, or I will never tell a lie in my entire life. Lying includes deception. If we accidentally say the wrong thing, we dream, or we misunderstand due to feelings, then we say we have attained the fruition, and in those cases it is not a violation of the precepts. Regarding all precepts, if you are not for fame and profit, but for the Bodhi path, what you have done will become a matter of the Bodhi path, not a matter of the three paths of karma. Then, by maintaining a good karma until your death, without committing any transgressions, you will definitely achieve the ultimate revenge. You must understand this, “one is everything, if you penetrate one door, all ten evil karma will disappear”. Because of your strong, sensitive mind, all those things (bad karma) are gone.

(Sutra) Good man! Bodhisattva Mahasattva has the ability to completely destroy life, avoid killing, that is, giving away evil, all sentient beings have no sutras, no blessings, and the spirits of living beings are not born with sorrow and pain, and are afraid of fear. By testing the good roots, quickly reaching maturity, possessing the pre-sacrifice of circulating the five animals, a river of birth and death, human killing and birth, creating body, speech, mind, evil karma obstacles, afflictions and afflictions, all sentient beings, all dharma obstacles, life life obstacles, self-action, teaching others, seeing and writing are happy. Due to the temptation to abandon the cycle of killing, the stage will inevitably develop and decay, will be destroyed without residue, and will not receive retribution. In the present body, all human beings are of the same level, with love and affection, without any worries, at peace in body and mind, and with a long life. At the same time, the body and mind do not feel any urgent pain or suffering, the love for one's wife and relatives is disturbed. At the end of his life, he will not be able to declare the King of Flames, he will only have a pleasant view, he will achieve good dharma, he will be precepted, he will be endowed with virtue, he will be truly blessed, he will be a wise man, he will be happy in body and mind, and will be deeply trusted.
(Sutra: O good man! If Bodhisattva Mahasattva can reach the end of his life, far away Abstaining from killing, that is, giving to all sentient beings without fear, causing sentient beings to not be sad or suffering, to be free from hair-splitting fear. Therefore, that good root quickly matures, in all the times of rotation in the five paths, previously submerged in the river of birth and death, due to killing, creating evil karma in body, speech, mind, afflictions, obstacles of sentient beings, all dharma obstacles, life-threatening obstacles, self-doing, teaching. People, seeing, hearing, rejoice. Due to this cycle of "abstaining from killing", all [those hindrances] are crushed, destroyed without any residue, and do not suffer retribution. In this present body, the heavens and people are all dear to each other, do not worry, have peace in body and mind, and have a long life. When the person is about to die, his body and mind are not oppressed by sorrow, and when he is about to die, he does not see the terrifying messenger of King Yama Ma mind, subdue and accomplish all good dharmas, complete the precepts, be rich in virtue, have a true Field of Merit (puṇyakṣetra), do good knowledge, be happy in body and mind, and give rise to deep reverence and faith).

You do not kill living beings, “all life” means from birth to death, never killing living beings. After hearing the Dharma, I do not kill living beings and stay away from killing living beings. “Meaning to give evilly to all sentient beings without fear or fear” (That is, to give to all sentient beings without fear): The Ten Good Karmas here are different from [The Ten Good Karmas mentioned in other sutras, in that not only] do not kill living beings, but also have to be contemplated. Not only not killing, but also giving alms “not killing” to living beings. Why are living beings afraid? Who is not afraid of death? Living beings are also afraid of death. If you catch a sparrow, it will fly away quickly. When the pig knows it is about to be slaughtered, it will scream loudly. If you use all your strength to pull it, it will hold back and not go, because it knows it is about to die and is terrified! “The souls of sentient beings do not give birth to sorrow and suffering, and are free from fear and fear” (Causing sentient beings to not give birth to sorrow and suffering, and to be free from hair-splitting fear): When we are frightened, our hair will stand on end and we will break out in a cold sweat, everyone has that experience. There are people who have not been afraid all their lives, and have never raised a hair, but are aware of this, even though they are not afraid! If caught, there are people who are very tough, even if caught, it's okay! If I get shot to death, it's just a small matter, twenty years later I will return. That is called “Sa Ba world”, living beings are stubborn, difficult to tame, fearless, very cruel, that's why there is fear. There are people who have accomplished good karma, and because of their good karma, they are not afraid. Those are the two extremes. That's talking about good karma.

“Due to trial, good roots can quickly mature” (Therefore, good roots can quickly ripen): All “pre-offerings circulating in the five animals, a river of birth and death” (when rotating in the five paths, submerged in the river of birth and death before), “pre-offerings” are the past. In the past, having circulated in the river of birth and death, "human killing" means that because of killing living beings, "created body, speech, mind, evil karma obstacles, afflictions, sentient obstacles, necessarily dharma obstacles, life life obstacles, self-action, teaching others, knowledge and writing depending on joy" (creating body, speech, mind, evil karma obstacles, afflictions, sentient obstacles, all dharma obstacles, life obstacles, do it yourself, teach others to do it, see and hear it happily.) Why is life span long or short? This is due to the karma of killing. In the karma of killing, including the body, that is, sometimes killing, or using your foot to kick another person to death, all count [as the crime of killing in the body]. Use your mouth to bite others to death, use your head to butt others to death. There are people who have learned the practice of “knife and mace initiation” (swinging a hammer to hit the head without getting hurt, i.e. iron head strike), can use the head to butt another person to death, any part of your body can kill someone. Body, speech, and mind can all create negative karma. When he was about to be killed, he still cursed, when he was about to die, he still shouted slogans, believed this, supported that. That is speech karma. About to die but still creating karma!

All obstacles are eliminated. Due to the negative karma created in the body, speech, and mind, all afflictions and all sentient beings are entangled with each other and are unclear. Father, mother, children, husband and wife, love relationships, are all sentient beings. There are many obstacles to sentient beings! All dharma obstacles, dharma obstacles refer to all dharmas. You slander all dharmas, using verbal karma to slander them. As for the three vehicles, they are all slandered, your karma is even greater. “Barrier of life span”: If you want to practice the path, but your life span has ended, you will not be able to practice successfully! We preach the sutras and also make vows. Before preaching, he made a vow: This sutra should not be interrupted halfway, should not fall ill, should not be interrupted for a few days, nor should the teaching be half dead. So that's it, I can't preach! That's called “halfway interruption”, that's karma. When you want to do good deeds, hope to atone for your mistakes, without waiting for you to finish atonement, your life is already over, there is no time left. That is an obstacle!

You yourself kill like that, teach others to kill, do it yourself, teach others. If you don't kill yourself and incite others to kill, that's called “causing disaster to others”. I have a grudge against someone else and want to kill that person, but I'm afraid of breaking the law, so I either use money or instigate a schism. It ignited the anger so much that the person became angry, then added a bit of truth, there was hatred between the two people, so they killed him. If you were by your side and saw the effect, you were able to report it, but you didn't take action at all, which is also a very big crime. The sin of teaching others to kill is as great as the sin of killing yourself. Hiring murderers, hiring hired killers, thinking that you yourself are not guilty, only in the future will you know, when you receive retribution, you will know! When you see someone else killing pigs, sometimes you go and watch the excitement, don't watch the killing, [because], seeing and hearing depends on your joy, you also have a part, just go and watch!

Therefore, we say “receive the Eight Precepts without intending to see or listen” because of this meaning. If it's none of your business, why are you here to watch the excitement? Those who see will have their share, you must understand! Especially at the execution site, many people go to see it, you will have a part! In that case, don't go, just be happy when you see and hear! “Due to the attempt to stay away from killing living beings” (Due to this cycle of “keeping away from killing living beings”): Must stay away from killing living beings. Instead of killing it, you must always crush it. “Develops and destroys, destroys without residue” (Crushes, destroys without remaining): Use the wheel of non-killing, which means “not killing” in the Ten Virtuous Wheels to crush all killing and its karma. If so, you will “not receive retribution”.

“In the present incarnation, the heavenly beings are kind, friendly, without any hesitation” (In the present body, the gods and humans are all friendly, without worry): I do not worry or doubt you, because I know you will not hurt others, because you are afraid of breaking the precepts. Worrying that you will fall into hell in the future, it's not that you don't want to do it, it's that you don't dare to do it. Why don't you dare do it? Afraid of falling into hell, afraid of suffering in hell, so I don't dare to kill. We see flying birds, or small animals, that we want to raise for play, or raise dogs, raise cats, raise small birds, raise parrots, raise barracudas, you catch them and put them in cages, in the future, you will also be locked up. No matter how long you lock them up, you will have to pay twice as much, they will not be happy at all. Do you think they are happy? It's like we're locked up in prison, maybe in my past life, I raised animals and kept them locked up for a long time, it's probably like that. You see a tiger trapped in a zoo, locked in a cage, anxiously walking back and forth in there. Wild animals are used to living in forests and mountains. We hope for our own freedom, but we limit the freedom of other animals. Just think about that retribution!

“All dharma hindrances, life hindrances, self-creation, teaching others, knowledge of writings, rejoice” (All dharma hindrances, life hindrances, self-doing, teaching others, seeing and hearing are happy to follow): In the present time, gods, humans, etc. are all friendly, without doubt. “Body and mind are at peace”, life span is also long. When about to die, the body and mind are not affected by “urgent suffering” (pressing sorrow and suffering), mindfulness is present, and rebirth in Ultimate Bliss is also assured. "If you love your wife, your relatives will be disturbed, you will die at the end of the day" (Wife and children will love you, relatives will surround you. When you die), there is no phenomenon of King Yama's terror!

(Sutra) The final sign of life, rebirth in the middle, all the bases are complete, the members are complete. Depending on the place of birth, one will be disease-free, long-lived, virtuous, intelligent, peaceful, and happy. Enlighten the mind, become good, attain the precepts, be rich in virtue, be truly blessed, practice good knowledge, follow the practice, abandon the dharma of killing, be able to cut off evil and unwholesome dharmas, be able to completely overcome good dharmas, be diligent in seeking Mahayana Dharma, be diligent in cultivating Bodhisattva vows, gradually enter the profound ocean of wisdom, and finally attain Supreme Bodhi. To live in Buddha's land, to be free from all weapons, to have no "resentment, harm or fight" in the name, to be free from chaplains, to be at peace, to be happy, to be free from illness, to have a long life for sentient beings, to be reborn in a different country. The Tathagata himself is immeasurable and boundless, and all sentient beings are willing to preach the Dharma. The final Nirvana, the nine pillars of the Dharma, benefit and bring immeasurable peace to sentient beings. Good man! The name Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat is the first to stay away from killing all living beings.
(Sutra: Having died, being reborn as a human, the senses are perfect, the body is complete. Birth Wherever he is, he will not be sick, live a long life, be virtuous, intelligent, peaceful, and happy. Again, he will meet a person who is pleasing to his heart, will be subdued, will achieve all good dharmas, will be rich in virtue, and will be filled with true blessings, practicing good knowledge, and abandoning the dharma of killing, he will be able to cut off all evil and unwholesome dharmas, will be able to achieve all the supreme good dharmas, can pray for all Mahayana dharmas, and can practice all the vows of the Bodhisattva. Slap, gradually entering the vast ocean of wisdom, until he attains the Supreme Bodhisattva, where he is free from weapons, without the name of "resentment and fighting", free from fear, peaceful, and happy. All sentient beings are free from illness, live long, and are born in that world. The Tathagata himself has an unlimited, limitless lifespan, because after he enters Nirvana, the Dharma lasts for a long time, with benefits and peace to immeasurable sentient beings. This is called the first vow of "abstaining from killing" of Bodhisattva Mahasattva.

“After the end of life, rebirth in the middle, all the organs are complete, all parts are complete, depending on the place of birth” (After death, still reborn as a human, all organs are perfect, all members are complete, born anywhere), not even sick or suffering, live long, appearance is correct, everyone likes it I like it, and I'm also smart and clever. “Peace, happiness” (Peace, happiness) can also meet pleasant people, meet good knowledge, meet good dharma, meet “precepts, rich virtue, true field of blessings” (one with full precepts, rich in virtue, field of true blessings) to be good knowledge for you, according to them “studying the dharma of abstaining from killing living beings”). That is the first step, “not killing” in the Ten Good Karmas, until there is no thought of killing. No matter how you bathe, no matter what you do, for the insects in your own body, you must protect them. This is very subtle, very difficult!

“Ability to cut off all evil and unwholesome dharmas, capable of necessarily achieving superior good dharmas” (Can cut off all evil and unwholesome dharmas, can achieve all superior good dharmas). Can achieve all Mahayana teachings. Why can we hear the Mahayana Dharma but not believe it? There are obstacles. It is also possible to practice “all Bodhisattva vows” (all Bodhisattva vows). How do Bodhisattvas make vows? “The beast shop enters the deep and vast sea of ​​wisdom”, which means gradually entering the deep and wide sea of ​​wisdom. Therefore, “attained Supreme Bodhi”, and became Buddha. “In the Buddha Land, away from weapons”, [meaning] where you live, there are no weapons. Not only are there no weapons, even the names “harm, fight” are absent. “Excellent chaplains” (Eliminate all fears): Do you still have a feeling of panic? No!

“Peaceful, happy, absolutely disease-free, sentient beings will live long in this country” (Peaceful, happy, all sentient beings will not get sick, live long, and be born in that realm): Those who are not sick and live long will be born in your country. Tathagata's lifespan is limitless and boundless, unlike Śākyamuni Buddha's only one hundred years. “The sentient beings, like to preach the Dharma” (Because the sentient beings preach the Dharma in accordance with their basic abilities): Which of their abilities should be used to attain salvation, then tell that person that Dharma. This will make the Dharma last for a long time, benefit and bring peace to countless sentient beings, and make countless sentient beings achieve happiness. Hey good man! That is called the first “abstaining from killing” of Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat, that is, not killing. Bodhisattva Mahasattva must achieve this morality of "not killing"!

(Sutra) Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat achieves the cycle of testing Trying to, u Shravakayana attained non-enlightenment, u Sravakayana Bodhisattva Jāla attained non-enlightenment, u Pratyekayana attained non-enlightenment, u Pratyakāyayana Sutra Jāla attained non-enlightenment, u Ky Mahayana attained non-enlightenment, u Ky Mahayana Sutra Jāla attained non-infallibility, constantly capable of naturalizing the Three Jewels. The disciples of the Tathagata who became monks, weak in seeing the dharma weapon, weak in the non-dharma weapon, the summer will are bound to have a ca-sa, the world's cultivator has achieved the loss of enlightenment. U Mahayana Dharma, often attains advancement, no regression, gains wisdom, wins blessings, often attains growth. With absolute Concentration, the Da-lanis, the Rings, the Earths, quickly attain freedom, without any regression. Often attaining enlightenment and enlightenment of good knowledge, according to their actions. Tobtained the Buddha's view without separation, with Bodhisattvas and Shravaka disciples, without separation from Dharma, without separation from close friends, and to make offerings to the Sangha. If you have good roots, always diligently seek, your mind is not satisfied, always with the Bodhi seed of vows, your mind is not satisfied.
(Sutra: Bodhisattva Mahasattva by achieving this cycle, do not make mistakes towards With the Sravaka Vehicle, not making mistakes with the Sravaka Vehicle, not making mistakes with the Pratyekayana, not making mistakes with the Sravakayana, not making mistakes with the Mahayana, not making mistakes with the Mahayana, the Three Jewels can often flourish for the monastic disciples of the Tathagata, whether it is a dharma weapon, or not a dharma weapon, even for all those who wear a piece of kasa. If you shave off your hair and beard, you will not make any mistakes. With the Mahayana dharma, you will always be promoted and will not be regressed. You will always be able to see all the Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, and Sravakas in all the Dharmas, the Dharmas, the Dharmas, and the Earths Approaching and making offerings to the Sangha. For good roots, always diligently seek, the mind is not tired of Bodhisattva vows, the mind is not tired of achieving the retribution as mentioned above.

This passage is all about repeating and repeating what was said in the previous section, hoping that we will consider it more: Not just the language and writing, but hoping that we will do it. You are sick, looking for a doctor is useless! Just don't kill, stop killing; until release. Not only not killing, but also saving sentient beings. We say "it's okay to eat a little meat", it's okay to have a lot! Even though you don't kill, you approve of killing and praise killing. If we say "killing is okay, eating meat is useless", say "animals are for us to eat. Fish, turtles, shrimp, crabs are for humans to eat"; I said: "Each of you is left to be eaten by sun bears, tigers, leopards, and wolves!" Can we say that or not? Just because of that fate, you can be eaten by them. Without cause and effect, you can't eat it! Don't create karma! That is the first “don't kill” of the Ten Chakras.

These ten virtues can be viewed by everyone. In general, from "not killing" to the last thing is "not deluded". The Ten Goods are the opposite of the Ten Evils. Why do we have to say that over and over again? Everyone sees that all the scriptures are exactly the same, that is, no killing, no stealing, no sexual misconduct, no embellishing, no lying... The text changes a little, but everything else is exactly the same. The Buddha's intention is to make sentient beings pay more attention, to make us contemplate more, to think more. Saying it once won't work, saying it ten times will. That's the meaning! This is the reason why He repeated it.

Teaching this sutra, it is impossible to say every single thing, that would be too repetitive. Too much repetition will create a feeling of boredom. When we listen to the Diamond Sutra, we will feel it more directly and satisfactorily, and will want to hear it. Such types of sutras have nouns that are a unique feature of that sutra, so it's okay for everyone to understand the meaning. We'll still explain it all at once, and in the next chapters, we won't explain each thing in detail!

(Sutra) Phuc, good man! Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat, who is able to exhaust all forms of life, abandons and does not hold on to evil, means giving evil to all sentient beings who have no sutras, no attachments, no heat, no disturbances. Self-attachment such as Dharma wealth, joy and happiness, never hope to seek illegal wealth. By testing good roots, one quickly achieves maturity. Possessing the five animal circulations of money and offerings, a river of birth and death, non-attachment of cause and effect, creating body, speech, mind, evil karma obstacles, afflictions, obstacles of sentient beings, necessarily dharma obstacles, protection of resources, self-action, teaching others, knowledge of writings, depending on joy. Because of trying to abandon the wheel of evil, the stage will inevitably develop and decay, will be destroyed without residue, and will not receive retribution. U appears in the middle of heaven, all people are of the highest level, the stage is friendly, there is no need to worry, the mind and body are at peace, and the resources are abundant. At the same time, the body and mind do not feel any urgent pain or suffering, the love for one's wife and relatives is disturbed. At the end of his life, he could not see the envoy of the Demon King Yama. Only agreeable views, attain good dharma, be virtuous, rich in virtue, true field of blessings, good knowledge, happy body and mind, profound respect faith.
(Sutra: Come, good man! If Bodhisattva Mahasattva can live until the end of his life, Abandoning "not giving but taking", that is, giving to all sentient beings without fear, without enthusiasm, and without being disturbed. For the wealth obtained in accordance with the law, happily accepting it is enough, without wishing for illegal wealth. Therefore, in all the times of rotation in the five paths, sinking in the river of birth and death before, due to not giving and taking, creating evil karma in the body, mouth, mind, afflictions, and sentient beings. Obstacles, all dharma obstacles, obstacles in money, doing things for yourself, teaching others to do things, seeing and hearing are happy. Due to this "separate and do not give but take" mentality, [those karmic obstacles] will be crushed, broken without receiving retribution, in the present life, the heavens and people are all friendly, there is no worry, body and mind are at peace, wealth is complete, body and mind are not oppressed by sorrow, wife, children and relatives are surrounded around, I did not see the terrifying messenger of King Yama Ma, I only saw someone who was satisfied, subdued and accomplished good dharma, full of precepts, rich in virtue, a true Field of Merit (puṇyakṣetra) to become good knowledge, happy in body and mind, giving birth to deep reverence.

This is the second thing in the Ten Virtuous Karmas: Do not steal. “Never hold on to anything” means that other people don't give it to you, so you just take it. That is Tao (theft). If after you listen to the Dharma, you can “all your life” (for the rest of your life) not steal, “your body” is your body, “your life” is invisible, but your body is tangible, that is until you die, until you die, you will not violate the precept “not giving but take”, nor violate the precept of stealing! When we receive the Five Precepts, we just need to not steal. If you do not violate that precept, you are pure. The merit you gain will not be stolen by others, until you make no mistakes with that precept. But there is a deeper meaning, because Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat completes all ten cycles, not just "not stealing" as with ordinary people. The meaning of each dharma from Small to Great, from ordinary people to the Buddha status, the meaning [in each status] is different, the nouns are the same, but we [as ordinary people], if we don't kill, we absolutely cannot kill. Whenever you kill, you violate the precepts, and it is also said in the sense of “murder”.

[The precept of not] stealing is not stealing all human material things, not stealing things that have owners. If that item has an owner [and arbitrarily uses it], it will be a violation of the precept of theft. Ownerless objects are difficult to speak of. Like mountains and forests, we think they have no owner, but actually they have an owner, that is, the country. Within the borders of that country, [everything] is considered to have an owner. On the road, if someone drops something, we don't steal it, but someone else drops it. I see objects, whether it is money, or something else, you pick up, when we have received the precepts, the Five Precepts, or other precepts [and picking up those things], is not considered a violation of the precept of stealing. But for monks and nuns, it is not possible, because they are not allowed to hold gold, silver, treasure, or money. If you hold it, it is also a violation of the precepts. Bodhisattva is even worse, in this world, there is nothing without an owner. If we say that something was dropped by living beings and we picked it up, the Bodhisattva also violates the precept "not giving but taking".

At the same time, Bodhisattvas must contemplate that they themselves do not steal, and also hope that all sentient beings do not steal. I do not kill living beings, I uphold the precept "not killing" to the end, and I give that precept as alms to living beings. We absolutely cannot think about this. Not stealing, not only do we not steal, but we also hope to give alms to sentient beings, what kind of alms is that? Giving alms makes them not afraid, not afraid, not impatient (hot-tempered, restless). If we steal something from them, or take it away, they will lose it and will definitely feel restless and impatient. Or if that item is related to their life, they will feel afraid. For example, stealing official documents, or stealing land contracts, or stealing someone else's income report, is no problem for you, but that person may suffer huge losses. Not only is the mind not at peace, but the body is also not at peace. After they lose it, search everywhere! There are many types of theft, robbing other people's things, which is called Thuong (robbery) and also includes Dao (theft). Stealing is called Dao, which means tyranny. Or if you cleverly devise all kinds of methods to deceive and defraud, you will also violate the precept of theft. If we talk about Theft, there are many types. Or use very clever language and methods, [claiming] "I didn't steal from you, but you gave it to me", but still count it as a thief. Because that is cheating, lying, or borrowing and not paying back, it is also considered theft. The crime of theft [of that kind] is even more serious. When it comes to the precepts of stealing, the precepts are very detailed and very subtle, but here, the scriptures don't say [so detailed]!

Buddha said that Bodhisattva Mahasattva “to the end of his life” (until the end of his life), should not steal. People don't give it, they can't take it. On the contrary, we do not steal, but also hope to give alms to sentient beings! What kind of alms? Make them not afraid, not excited, and not disturbed. As for your own legally acquired wealth, just like we work to make money, or whatever it is, that's the money we should have. Whenever you achieve it, you should be happy and satisfied, not greedy. “Non-abiding” means “still pursuing”. On the other hand, if it's illegal wealth that we shouldn't have, don't seek it, and don't expect it either. Not only do we personally not do it, but we also don't think about it in our mind, and we shouldn't even mention it with our mouth. There are things that can be deceived by the mouth, and there is this situation. By not stealing like that, good roots ripen very quickly, because there is no reason to steal, there is no heart to steal.

Thus, the karma created in the past, the pre-sacrifice, the post-sacrifice (future), the intermediate sacrifice is the present, the past is the pre-sacrifice. Due to the crime of theft, you should enter the five paths. The five main paths are hell, hungry ghosts, animals, gods, humans, and Asuras [included in the other four paths, except hell]. Because of stealing, the cycle of birth and death in it, birth and death are like a long river, forever submerged in it, unable to escape, "a river of birth and death" (sinking in the river of birth and death), surrounded in the river of birth and death! Because of not giving and taking, it creates body karma, speech karma, mind karma, evil karma, “obstacles of afflictions, obstacles of sentient beings, necessarily dharma obstacles, barriers of resources, self-action, teaching others, knowledge of knowledge depending on the joy” (obstacles of afflictions, obstacles of sentient beings, all dharma obstacles, obstacles in wealth, doing it yourself, teaching others, seeing and hearing depending on joy): That is the karma you created in the past. That karma, because of stealing, creates evil karma in body, speech, and mind, that is, we rob, use our body to rob, or use our mouth to deceive, or use our thoughts to show off. The evil karma created in body, speech, and mind is all of the theft type. Anything of this kind is theft. Because of that, you cause trouble for yourself, cause trouble for others, and prevent your karma from cultivating the path.

If our business is not favorable, or resources are not favorable, tools necessary for life are lacking, you should not resent heaven or people, but resent yourself, the past has created those karma, so you have those obstacles. For all dharmas, you cannot enter and are blocked. Your wealth is not complete. Therefore, those obstacles immediately arise. Not only do you steal yourself, or teach others to steal, do it yourself, teach others to steal, even when you see others stealing, you are excited, happy, and happy when you see and hear, not depending on good karma, but depending on bad karma.

If you now stay away from the sins of "not giving but taking", not stealing, you will be very far away from it. “Departing” means not creating anything anymore. “Giai will develop into ruin” (Everything is crushed): Because of the wheel in the present, what wheel is it now? It is the morality of "separate and do not give but take". In the past, due to ignorance, confusion, and karma, I did such things. From now on, if we vow not to steal, it is also true that we will not steal, which means that now we will not create or destroy past karma, eliminate it, and not receive any retribution. Therefore, one should repent. Completed repentance; After that, I won't do it anymore!

“In the present body, the heavenly beings are friendly, the world is friendly, there is no mistake” (In the present body, the heavens and people are all friendly, there is no doubt or concern): Others have no doubt or concern towards you. Whenever you lose something, they won't suspect you took it, that's what it means. They don't doubt or worry, they lose things, they absolutely don't doubt you, they don't suspect you're dirty. Otherwise, if there are a few people in this house, if someone loses something, they will be suspicious: "There are only a few people in this house. If it's not Truong Tam, then it must be Ly Tu." But because you don't have this karma, they won't suspect that you are that kind of person!

There is also a thief who stole things from the devil. We can still steal something from demons, but we can't even steal things from gods. That's not true! In temples, any objects, money, in temples worshiping local people, you should not take them, it is an insult to ghosts and gods. Whatever is in the temple, whatever the master gives you, you can take, it is private property. But if he takes something belonging to the Three Jewels, or takes an object belonging to the ten permanent directions as a gift, he commits a sin, but you do not. In the Buddha hall, the master gives you something, you don't make a mistake, and he doesn't make a mistake either. He said those things belonged to him, not the permanent ten directions. Why does he have to live in a monastery and not in a big temple? There is a reason for this, he is afraid of committing a crime! In the temple, you have to think carefully about every move you make. That's from the Three Jewels, even if you eat the wrong piece, you won't be able to eat it! Because of that, people won't doubt or worry about you, and your body and mind will be at peace. If you don't steal, you won't be in dire straits. You feel the result, complete wealth. When you die, your body and mind are not oppressed by sorrow and suffering, you feel very light and at ease.

Of those ten chakras, whichever one is accomplished, the others are less important! The strong cannot oppress the weak! The ten chakras have been accomplished, even if one has been accomplished, at the time of death, you will not see King Yama Ma's envoy. In the above passage, there is a sentence "to love one's wife, to disturb one's relatives" (to be loved by one's wife and children, and surrounded by relatives): That is "to live together with one's wife".What is "one's wife"? Died in his own house, died in his own house, his body was buried in the house. That is called “living in the right bed” . Dying outside and transferring your body back cannot be considered “living in the right bed”. In the past, the ancients said: You create a lot of karma, do a lot of bad things, dying outside, will not be considered “living in the right bed”. [Currently] dying at home is very difficult, in the past it was very difficult. Currently "full life in the main bed" is very rare, because the majority of people in hospital receive life together. When you were about to die, you didn't see King Yama La, nor did he send anyone to retrieve your soul, it was impossible. Only see people who please you, or see light, or smell good. If you believe in Buddha, you will see the holy image. You do not believe in Buddha, but because you are a person who does not steal, you will receive good gods, protect the dharma, and see good gods. As long as you [see someone] of your liking, then you will achieve harmony in your good dharma, these are people who are completely good in dharma, full of precepts, rich in virtue. “Regulating good dharmas” (Regulating and achieving good dharmas) means following good dharmas.

“Complete precepts, rich in virtue” (Complete precepts, rich in virtue) is to maintain pure precepts and have majestic virtue. Or the real Field of Merit (puṇyakṣetra), the meritorious field of the Sangha, or the meritorious field of lay people, or the meritorious field of Upasaka, Upasaka, good knowledge for you. When you die, you will be able to see them. You see, "body and mind are happy, deeply reverent" (body and mind are happy, give birth to deep reverence): Because of that kind of feeling, when you die, you will be "reborn in the human world" (reborn among humans), or be born in heaven.

(Sutra) The final sign of life, rebirth in the middle, all the bases are complete, the members are complete. Depending on the place of birth, you will be blessed with great wealth, decency, intelligence, peace, joy, and no data in addition to the five treasures. Enlighten the mind, achieve good dharma, practice the precepts, be rich in virtue, be truly blessed, be a good knowledge, follow the practice of "separate from non-attachment", be able to completely cut off all evil and unwholesome dharmas, be able to completely overcome good dharmas, be diligent in seeking Mahayana Dharma, be diligent in cultivating Bodhisattva vows, gradually enter the profound ocean of wisdom, and finally attain Supreme Bodhi. In the Buddha Land, they are adorned, guarded, maintained, protected, protected, and unsurpassed. Separated from self, ego, without attachment to life, must be serious with sentient beings, reborn in a strange country. The Tathagata himself has an immeasurable life span, and all sentient beings like him preach the Dharma. The final Nirvana, the nine pillars of the Dharma, benefit and bring immeasurable peace to sentient beings. Good man! The name Bodhisattva Mahasattva, the second one, is completely free from all evil.
Not making mistakes with the Sravaka Vehicle, not making mistakes with the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle, not making mistakes with the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle, not making mistakes with the Mahayana, not making mistakes with the Mahayana Sutra, can often flourish for the monastic disciples of the Tathagata, whether it is a dharma weapon, or not a dharma weapon, even for all those who wear a piece of ka-sa and shave off their beards. hair, do not make mistakes. With regard to the Mahayana dharma, one is always promoted and does not retreat. Wisdom is sharp and blessed, and one is always increased. In all the Concentrations, Dharmas, and Grounds, one can quickly become free and not retreat. Often one can meet good knowledge and follow it accordingly. One can always see all the Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, and Sravakas Approaching and making offerings to the Sangha. When it comes to good roots, the mind is always diligent in seeking it, and the mind is not tired of Bodhisattva vows.

People belonging to the three vehicles, Pudgala are people and sentient beings. Shravaka Vehicle, Single Enlightenment Vehicle, Mahayana. Those three types of people receive and uphold the three-vehicle dharma. You preach the dharma to them and teach them, and they will not make mistakes. They will also not make mistakes and will speak according to the dharma. That is Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat. He (Vajragarbha Bodhisattva) asked Bodhisattva Mahasattva how to achieve the great Bodhisattva path? How to save sentient beings? The Buddha immediately told him that the Vajrayana Store had ten chakras. Having finished talking about these ten wheels, in the next part, there are also the Ten Armor Pillar Wheels. Those are also the things Bodhisattvas must do. Therefore, when you see the Ten Chakras, it is a reminder that the Great Collection of Ten Chakras specializes in the Ten Chakras.

Gradually progress in the Mahayana dharma, until becoming Buddha. From then on, there was no turning back. "Wisdom, winning blessings, always attaining growth", [meaning]: Sharp wisdom, wisdom like diamond, superior merit, forever growing; At the same time, one can also achieve Precepts, Concentration, and Wisdom. Staying away from stealing, staying away from "not giving but taking", that is Precepts. When you practice Concentration, all samadhi can be achieved. Until you become a Buddha, you will attain the Ten Rings and the Ten Grounds, you will also be able to achieve freedom and not be regressed, you will often meet good and knowledgeable people to follow as you please, and you will often meet famous masters to point out and guide you. You act according to what he says, whatever he does, you do the same, act in accordance with it, not against it. Constantly seeing all Buddhas, constantly seeing all Bodhisattvas, constantly seeing all Shravakas, constantly seeing Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, and Shravaka disciples, constantly seeing the Dharma incessantly. Where you live, there are always Dharma preaching associations, where you can often listen to the Dharma, and you can also get close to and make offerings to the Sangha. These are Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha, the Three Jewels, you are always inseparable, always close to you.

“Good roots, always diligently seek, the mind is not satisfied” (Always diligently seek the good roots, the mind is not bored with enough): This is cultivating merit, cultivating good roots, diligently not being lazy, not satisfied, that is, not feeling that doing good is enough. For evil, not a single thought arises. It is a thought to become Buddha. "Often the Bodhisattva vows, the mind is not satisfied" (Usually for the Bodhisattva vows, the mind is not bored): Develop the Bodhi mind, practice the Bodhisattva practice, develop the Bodhisattva vow, do not get tired of it, achieve the retribution as widely said in the previous section.

(Sutra) Phuc, good man! Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat, who is capable of exhausting all forms of life, abandoning desires and evil deeds, that is, giving away desires and drifting, necessarily causes sentient beings to have no business, no attachments, no disabilities, no harm, no heat, no disturbances. If you miss your wife, stay happy and stay with your children, and never hope for illegal sexual desires. By testing good roots, one quickly achieves maturity. Possessing money and sacrifices that circulate the five animals, a river of birth and death, evil human desires, creation of body, speech, mind, evil karma obstacles, affliction obstacles, sentient obstacles, necessarily dharma obstacles, seven family obstacles, self-action, teaching others, knowledge of literature, depending on joy. By trying to stay away from desire and evil conduct, the phase will inevitably develop, will be destroyed without residue, and will not receive retribution. U appears in the middle of heaven, all human beings are of the same level, they are friendly, have no worries, are at peace in body and mind, and are virtuous. At the same time, the body and mind do not feel any urgent pain or suffering, the love for one's wife and relatives is disturbed. At the end of his life, he could not see the King of Flames, only his views were agreeable, he became wholesome, he had precepts, he was rich in virtue, he had a true field of good fortune and good knowledge, he was happy in body and mind, he was deeply trusted. After the end of life, the human body is reborn, the roots are complete, and the body is complete. Depending on the place of birth, your relatives will be virtuous, intelligent, peaceful, and happy. Enlighten the mind, become a good person, attain the precepts, be rich in virtue, have a true field of blessings, practice good knowledge, follow the practice, abandon desires and wrong actions, be able to cut off all evil and unwholesome dharmas, be able to be completely superior to good dharmas, be sure to seek Mahayana Dharma, be able to practice the Bodhisattva's vows, gradually enter the profound ocean of wisdom, and finally attain Supreme Bodhi. Living in Buddha's land, free from women, free from sexual desires, the first holy life of sentient beings will be born in a foreign country. All sentient beings are born and transformed, and the fetus is impure and unclean. The Tathagata himself has an immeasurable life span, and all sentient beings like him preach the Dharma. The final Nirvana, the nine pillars of the Dharma, benefits, brings peace, and immeasurable sentient beings. Good man! The third Bodhisattva, Ma Ha Tat, is far removed from desire and evil conduct.
(Sutra: Come here, good man! If Bodhisattva Ma Ha He can abstain from sexual desires until the end of his life, that is, he has given "no fear, no jealousy, no harm, no heat", as well as "no disturbance" to all living beings drifting in the stream of desire. Staying in the happiness of his wife, not wishing for illegal lust. Therefore, the good roots are quickly matured In the past, due to sexual desires, evil karma is created in the body, speech, mind, afflictions, obstacles of sentient beings, all dharma obstacles, family obstacles, self-doing, teaching others to do, seeing and hearing for joy. Due to this wheel of "abstaining from evil desires", [those obstacles] will be crushed, destroyed without any residue, and in the present body, the heavens and humans are all friendly, without doubts, worries, and peace of mind and body When he was about to die, his body and mind were not oppressed by sorrow and suffering. When he was about to die, he did not see the terrifying messenger of King Yama Ma, but only saw people who were well-pleased, who had attained good dharma, were rich in virtue, had a true field of good knowledge, were happy in body and mind, and were born with deep faith. full of relatives, virtuous, intelligent, peaceful, happy, meet pleasant people again, achieve subjugation of all good dharmas, have enough precepts, be rich in virtue, have a true field of good fortune to practice good knowledge, follow that person to study, abandon evil desires, can cut off all evil and unwholesome dharmas, can achieve all superior good dharmas, can pray for all Mahayana dharmas, can practice all Bodhisattva vows, gradually enter the deep ocean of wisdom, until When he attains Supreme Bodhi, he lives without women and is free from sexual desires. All sentient beings are born in that land and are not in a foul, impure womb. Because the Buddha preaches the Dharma according to his foundation, the Dharma will last a long time, benefiting and bringing peace to countless sentient beings called the third wheel of "abstaining from evil desires" of Bodhisattva Mahasattva).

[Keeping the precepts not to] commit sexual misconduct, “means giving away lustful desires, necessarily to sentient beings without fear, without fear” (i.e. giving without fear to all sentient beings drifting in the stream of desires), like the precept of stealing, it is also giving alms to sentient beings. All those who are immersed in lust, greedy for lust, those living beings are immersed in the three evil destiniess. Give alms to all living beings who are drifting, comfort them, make them fearless, fearless, just like in the previous section [said]. “No harm, no harm, no heat” (No jealousy, no harm, no heat), nor disturbance. “Dwelling on the love of one's wife, remaining happy and content with one's children” (Abiding in a place of joy and contentment with one's wife): The relationship between husband and wife is the right path in the human world, so having received the Five Precepts or taking [at home] the Bodhisattva Precepts, will not cause obstacles to the right path in the human world. If you have accepted the Bodhisattva precepts, you should not [have sexual relations]. Bodhisattvas of Faith must abandon all desires. We feel that getting married, having children, raising children, and continuing the family line are normal things in the human world, but is that true? That's not right!

For example, when I was at Chanh Giac Pagoda in Zhongnanhai in Beijing, a university professor came to Beihai Park to visit, saw a pagoda, and immediately walked in. There was a temple in the park, he felt very strange. It may have been his first time entering. The pagoda in Beihai Park was built by the Qing Dynasty emperor; Previously, the temple was not open to the public at all. Because, that temple is specifically for lamas to live in, not for monks to live in. At that time, the emperors all took refuge in lamas, borrowed the strength of the Mongols, and borrowed the strength of the Tibetans to help the border [settle].

That professor came there, saw us monks, he did not revere the Buddha statue, nor did he worship, and warned us in a loud voice: "If everyone were like you, there would be no one left in the human world, we would be extinct!" He told me a lot, I just raised the issue related to what I'm talking about today (ie the story of ending desire). At that time, I replied to him: "It's okay for them to all be like us, they've all cut off desire, they're extinct. [You think] it's not okay for them to all be like us, but I can say a few things, for example, the world of Ultimate Bliss has no women, they're not extinct, people in the ten worlds all go there." I said: "The Great Brahma is not extinct! In that heaven, there is no female form, nor are there any women, only the six heavens in the world of Desire exist, but the Great Brahma absolutely does not exist. The worlds of the ten directions are all born there, they are not extinct." He replied: "I didn't see that story, I don't believe it. I only believe what I see in front of my eyes. Only when I have the truth will I believe it. Those things are not true, they are all stories made up by Buddhists!" I said: "I'm telling the truth. It's not okay to be all like us, so is it okay to all be like your professor?" "What's wrong? I can teach others." I said: "Do you eat or drink? Do you wear clothes or not? Where do your clothes come from? Are they made by professors? Or are they made by scholars? Is the food you eat grown by professors like you? It's impossible for them all to be like me. But if they were all like you, it wouldn't be possible! If they were all like you, this world wouldn't exist, everyone would starve to death! You don't need to wear clothes, and you also don't need to eat. If you still want to come and play here, it's impossible!”

Suppose that this world is all like Buddha, that is impossible! It can only be said to be Buddhahood. Just like Buddha, this world will not exist, the whole will be pure. This is absolutely impossible. That is making a fundamental mistake [during argument]. No matter what dharma you mention, if it is all one dharma, nothing exists, there is only one dharma to attain emptiness. Everyone has perfect emptiness, but [ordinary people] cannot realize it! People who attain [emptiness] are very few, so [those who attain emptiness] become Buddhas. Something rare is precious! Among humanity, whenever there is an Arahant who overcomes afflictions and attains Bodhi, he will be extremely noble, with such significance.

This Bodhisattva until the end of his life can leave [desires and evil deeds], because Bodhisattvas are lay Bodhisattvas and ordained Bodhisattvas, so they leave desires and evil deeds. If all [living beings] were Bodhisattvas, they would all be righteous in their actions and would not be able to commit evil deeds. But if you have no thoughts of desire, then towards all sentient beings, you have made offerings and alms to them "without fear, without jealousy, without harm". Evil desire is jealousy, which is caused by sexual misconduct and killing. Whenever this precept is broken, the precept of killing is also broken, and the precept of drinking alcohol can also be broken, and the precept of stealing can also be broken. Killing, stealing, sexual misconduct, lying, just breaking one thing will have a connection, it can also break all five precepts. Therefore, don't be jealous. “There is no heat, no disturbance, no self-love, no joy, no joy” (There is no heat, no disturbance, you can stay happy with your wife), you should be happy [with what you have]. Desire is something that has no limits!

“Chung does not seek illegal lust” (Thong does not seek illegal lust), that is, does not desire illegal lust. It's not legal, it's just the [marriage] procedures, it's called "illegal lust". Currently, there is no way! Every day when you look at the press, [you will see] too much illegal lust. If a Bodhisattva can, until the end of his life, always stay away from [evil desires]; Due to this, good roots can definitely ripen! During all the previous times of rotation in the five paths, submerged in the river of birth and death, due to lust and evil actions, evil karma was created in the body, speech, mind, afflictions, sentient obstacles, all dharma obstacles, family obstacles, [all kinds of obstacles will be eliminated]. Having a family means having obstacles.

Everyone sees the word Gia, above there is a word like a treasured parasol (ie Mien,), locked tightly, with no way to escape. What are you waiting for? Waiting to be slaughtered, waiting to die in the house. Nowadays, actually dying at home is still “true”, if you die outside then “adventure” (drifting).

“ Do it yourself, teach others, and learn according to your joy. Do try to stay away from desire and evil conduct” (Do it yourself, teach others to do it, see and hear, rejoice. Due to this cycle of “separation from desire and evil conduct”), when you watch TV, you encounter negative thoughts. That scene, you must make a vow, vow for all sentient beings to end evil desires, you must make a vow. You look at those scenes, look at the animal world, you say, how different are humans and animals? They are all worried about finding food and killing each other. A few days ago, I watched TV and learned that sun bears eat fish. Sun bears[32] in the Arctic rely on fish to survive. There is nothing, the sky is ice and the ground is snowy, he has to catch fish. That's called mutual slaughter. Pay network debt for each other. When you see these things, you shouldn't be happy! You say, between humans and between animals, what is the difference? There was a proverb in ancient China: “Human beings are so different that beasts pretend to be lucky” (Human beings are very different from beasts). Few! According to human reason, in the realm of the five desires, we should have one right and two right, and should not go too far. The word Dam has three water dots, Dam means excessive, [in the original meaning] it rains too long, without stopping. After a long time of rain, it becomes damp. Lust means "excess", the more excessive, the smaller the difference from animals!

You can observe, pigeons, sparrows, mice, their desires truly have no limits. Must know this! Due to "abstaining from the wheel of desire", will inevitably develop and decay, will perish without residue, and will not receive retribution. In the middle body, all the people of the celestial class share love and affection, without any hesitation" (all are crushed and destroyed with nothing remaining, receiving no retribution. In the present body, the heavens and humans are all friendly, there is no doubt or concern): Gods and people have no doubts or worries towards you. You have left thoughts of desire, women do not have to be wary of you, because violence will absolutely not arise. Because you yourself realize that you have left desire, all women will not give rise to the mind of lust for you, because "electric light", the magnetic field emitted from your spirit does not correspond and does not have any effect on them.

This problem is huge. The Ten Good Karmas, to put it simply, are human and natural vehicles. To put it more seriously, the Thanh Van Vehicles have not been able to do it either, they can only do a part of it. Even Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas can only do part of it. Only Buddha and Buddha can ultimately achieve the Ten Virtuous Karmas, each Dharma is like that. The retribution achieved will be that in the present body, all human beings and gods will be friendly and will not doubt or worry about you, and your own body and mind will also be at peace. “The wife is pure and honest”, according to the Buddhist scriptures, seems to have a strong male ideology. [If you are attached to the text, you will understand] “the wife is chaste and honest” it seems that [as long as the wife is chaste and honest], regardless of the husband, the husband can arbitrarily [be promiscuous], right? Men and women are the same, both are impossible! It's often said that "the wife loses her virginity", but men have to do the same!

In the past, during the Warring States period, Mr. Liu Ha Hui's brother[33] of Lu, a non-dual person (a man who was faithful to only one woman). Since ancient times, people have suggested that men should be faithful to their wives and should not be flirtatious with other women. A woman should not have sex with any other man [besides her husband]. Sometimes it means being pure all your life, never getting married all your life. A lot of ancient people were like that. Some people, when criticizing, said that such people are stupid and have no wisdom. [They argue] "Eating, drinking and sexual desire are the nature. Yet such a person does not understand even eating, drinking and sexual desire; that is stupidity", [not knowing] that only a saint can do that! A person like Lieu Ha Hui, [a woman] sits in her lap but her mind is still not confused, “Man of Lu”[34] is such a man in the country of Lu! He has a non-dual body and maintains purity throughout his life. That's not an easy thing! Must understand this principle!

When you are about to die, your body and mind will not be oppressed by suffering, your beloved wife, children and relatives will surround you. At the end of his life, "not seeing the king of Diem La, only seeing and agreeing to become good, virtuous, rich in virtue, true field of blessings, good knowledge" (not seeing the fearsome messenger of King Yama La, only seeing people who please, subdued to achieve good roots, full of precepts, rich in virtue, true field of blessings to become good knowledge): This passage is similar to the text in the previous part. Thus, "he will practice and learn to abandon desire and evil conduct" (depending on that person and learn to abandon desire and evil conduct), this sutra is different. In the previous passage, it was “separation without attachment” (separation without giving but taking), but here it is separation from desire, everything else is the same. In the first paragraph of the previous section, it is “separation without killing” (abstaining from killing). “The ability to cut off all evil and unwholesome dharmas, the ability to completely overcome good dharmas, the ability to necessarily seek the meaning of Mahayana dharma, the ability to cultivate the Bodhisattva vows, to gradually enter the vast ocean of wisdom” (Can cut off all evil and unwholesome dharmas, can achieve all superior good dharmas, can seek all dharmas of Mahayana meaning, there is can practice all the Bodhisattva vows, gradually entering the vast ocean of wisdom): Gradually one can become a Buddha, “never mind attaining Supreme Bodhi” (until attaining Supreme Bodhi). “In the Buddha land, there are no women”, [meaning] if you are born in that Buddha land, if you maintain the “no sexual misconduct” precepts in the Five Precepts, you will be born in a Buddha land without women.

“Away from lustful desires, complete in the first-order holy conduct” (Away from lustful desires, complete in the first-order holy conduct): The first-order holy conduct is pure conduct. People born in that Buddha land are completely pure and holy, and are free from sexual desires. The world of Ultimate Bliss is like that. The world of the Eastern Medicine Master Lapis La Light Tathagata, and the world of Immovable Tathagata in the upper direction, are also the same. All pure Buddha lands are like that.
