Then there will be no more birth [in the womb], all birth is transformed. The Brahma world is all transformed beings, the Pure Land world is the lotus transformed birth. Thus, there will be no situation where "in the mother's womb, the fetus is dirty and impure". Buddha Tathagata in that world has an immeasurable lifespan. "If sentient beings preach the Dharma as they please, the final Nirvana, the Dharma will last for a long time, it will benefit and bring peace and happiness to countless sentient beings" (Because the sentient beings preach the Dharma according to their fundamental basis. After the Buddha entered Nirvana, the Dharma will last for a long time, benefiting and bringing peace to countless sentient beings), the meaning as mentioned in the previous section is complete. That is "good man! The third wheel of Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat forever abandoning desire and evil conduct" (this good man! That is called the third wheel of Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat "abstaining from desire and evil conduct"). That is the third cycle.

(Sutra) Phuc, good man! Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat, who is able to exhaust all forms of life, separates the words from the stem, all sentient beings always have love and respect, the words that come from the stage become the ultimate quality, all words are respected and worshiped, there is no doubt. By testing good roots, one quickly achieves maturity. Possessing the pre-sacrifice that circulates the five animals, a river of birth and death, causes of empty speech stem, creation of body, speech, mind, evil karma obstacles, hindrances of afflictions, hindrances of sentient beings, necessarily dharma hindrances, obstacles of faith in speech, self-action, teaching others, seeing and writing depending on the joy, due to the trial of leaving the empty stem of speech wheel, the stage will gradually develop and decay, bad destruction without residue, and no retribution. U appears in the middle of heaven, all people are of the same level, the stage is friendly, there is no worry, the body and mind are at peace, words and words are born, others trust and serve. The same life and the same time, the body and mind are not worried about urgent suffering. Because of his beloved wife, his relatives are disturbed. At the end of his life, he could not see the King of Flames, he only had a pleasant view, he achieved good dharma, he had precepts, he was rich in virtue, he had a true field of blessings, he became a good knowledge, his body and mind were happy, he was deeply respected. In the final destiny, rebirth in the middle, all the bases are perfect, all parts are complete, depending on the place of birth, the place of speech becomes the truth, upright, intelligent, peaceful, and happy. Achieving enlightenment, achieving good dharma, attaining precepts, rich virtues, true fields of blessings, cultivating good knowledge, following the practice, abandoning false speech, being able to completely cut off all evil and unwholesome dharmas, being able to be completely superior to good dharmas, constantly seeking the Mahayana Dharma, constantly cultivating the Bodhisattva vows, gradually entering the vast ocean of wisdom, and finally attaining Supreme Bodhi. Living in Buddha's land is necessarily true, separate from false illusions, the wonderful fragrance of pure things is dignified, without delusion, without attachment, the mind is upright, hoping for the pure good dharma of sentient beings to be reborn in a strange country, the pure fragrance is marvelous and adorned, and is adorned with dignity. The Tathagata himself has an immeasurable life span, and all sentient beings like him preach the Dharma. The final Nirvana, the nine pillars of the Dharma, benefit and bring immeasurable peace to sentient beings. Good man! The name Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat, the fourth, is far removed from the stem and speech wheel.
(Sutra: Come here, good man! If Bodhisattva Ma Ha Slaps can stay away from false words for the rest of their lives, all sentient beings will always love and respect them, the words spoken will become true and reasonable, listeners will respect, obey, and not doubt. Therefore, all good roots can quickly ripen in the body, speech, mind, afflictions, obstacles of sentient beings, all dharma obstacles, obstacles that make the words unreliable caused by false words when circulating in the five paths, sink. In the river of life and death in the past, doing it yourself and teaching others to do it, because of this cycle of "abstaining from false words" will be crushed and destroyed without any residue, without receiving retribution. In the present body, the heavens and people are all friendly, there is no doubt or concern. The body and mind are at peace, the words spoken, and others will believe and obey. When death is about to happen, the body and mind are not oppressed by sorrow, and their loved ones and relatives are surrounded At the end of his life, he did not see the terrifying messenger of King Yama Ma, only saw a lovely person, accomplished in subduing good dharmas, full of morality, rich in virtue, filled with true good knowledge, happy in body and mind, born of deep reverence. Having passed away, he was reborn as a human being, with all organs complete, born anywhere, sincere, truthful, upright, intelligent, peaceful, happy. Full of precepts, rich in virtue, true blessings, good knowledge, following that person in practice, abandoning false words, able to cut off all evil and unwholesome dharmas, able to achieve all superior good dharmas, able to pray for all Mahayana dharmas, able to practice all Bodhisattva vows, gradually entering the deep ocean of wisdom, until attaining the Supreme Bodhisattva world, that person is in, all true, free from falsehoods, adorned with all things All sentient beings are not flattered, do not deceive, and are upright in their conduct. They hope that pure and good dharma will be born in that world. The Tathagata's own fragrant and precious clothes will have an unlimited life span, because after the Buddha's attainment of Nirvana, the Dharma will last a long time, benefiting and innumerable sentient beings. That is called the fourth wheel abandon false speech" by Bodhisattva Mahasattva).

“Fake” are empty and false words, “stubborn” are words that deceive people, they must be avoided. "All sentient beings love and respect each other, and all words become true and correct" (All sentient beings love and respect each other, all words become true and reasonable). “Luong” means “like reason” (right reason), Truth is reason, and Luong is “like reason”. All words are true, and that truth is in accordance with the nature of dharma. The words we say are not truthful, not reasonable, not the truth, and contain elements of deception and seduction. Lies include many things. For us, as long as [the words] are not for fame and profit, not for our own benefit, [even if they are not truthful] are still temporarily acceptable; But for Bodhisattva it is impossible. Bodhisattva's requirements are very strict: Bodhisattvas are only allowed to lie if they are practicing the Bodhisattva path!

For example, when Buddha was a monk, an azalea was injured by a bird trapper. That azalea flew to Buddha. Buddha immediately hid it in his chest. The bird trapper went there to look, saw such a person, and asked: "I just trapped a bird, did you see it?" “I don't see it.” That's not called lying. He hid the azalea in his chest, but still said he couldn't see it. This does not violate the precepts, for the benefit of sentient beings, it is the Buddha's skillful means. The dharmas spoken by the Buddha are all means. Therefore, in the Vajrayana Sutra, the Buddha told Subhuti: “Knowing the self teaches the Dharma, like the Buddha's example, the above Dharma is followed by letting go, but in the case of non-dharma” (Know that the Dharma I have said is like a boat. The Dharma should still be let go, let alone non-dharma). That's the means, because it's the skillful means of saving sentient beings, that's why it's said like that. Actually, there are not all dharmas. All dharmas are not established, that is called “emptiness, false speech”. For the benefit of sentient beings, the same is said about the precepts of killing, stealing, and sexual immorality. We worship the statue of De Lam Avalokiteshvara (Avalokiteśvara holding a basket), De Lam Avalokiteshvara[35] is Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara incarnated as a woman, married to another person. Did he break the precepts or not? Breaking the precepts! He was for the benefit of those sentient beings, but the day he got married, he died. Married, completed the wedding ceremony, that night He died. One day, teach that person to recite the Universal Gate chapter, or recite a few chapters. Later, he also taught them to recite the Lotus Sutra by heart. That guy named Ma studied the Lotus Sutra all day from morning to night. He married him, but that night he died. The guy named Ma saw this and realized that human life is so impermanent, what is the use of being so beautiful? No matter what, he must die. He also became a monk, which means Bodhisattva saved him! The Great Bodhisattva practices misdeeds. Acting against good conduct means it is not good conduct, it is against Buddhist precepts. Even though the practice is against, it is truly right, truly right! He does it according to reason, understanding this principle is enough. If not, there's still a lot of enchantment. Such beings, others respect them, they depart, do not deceive, and only speak the truth. In that way, other people have no basis for doubt or concern about that person's words, so they don't doubt, they have that good root, which is ripe.

“Obstacles of believers”: Because others do not believe, that person's speech will be hindered. If a person [tells a lie] and makes others criticize him, even if he says it a hundred times, I still won't believe it. This is very difficult! That means you tell too many lies, lie too much, who can still believe you? It's still possible to deceive others once, twice, three times, five times, ten times, thirty times. But you say it a hundred times, because you tell lies, say it and then don't do it, use a bad check, then your life is over! There is no way to do business anymore!

Because the good roots have matured, even in the past, when circulating in the five paths, submerged in the river of birth and death, one uttered lies, giving rise to all kinds of obstacles, [those obstacles due to the good roots "giving up lies"] will all disappear. The "stay away from lies" will be completely crushed, stay away from [those hindrances], and will no longer speak false words. “Destruction without residue” (Destroyed with no residue left), for [karma] previously created, there will be “no retribution. In the present body, all the heavenly beings, the celestial ranks are friendly” (not receiving retribution. In the present body, the heavens and humans are all friendly): Everyone is friendly to you; Because, if you are very honest, no matter who you do business with, they will always want to interact with you. In short, no one is honest, but everyone expects others to be honest. Do you understand the meaning of this? I think every Dharma friend understands. You have seen and heard, always hope others do not deceive us, we can deceive others. That's everyone's mentality. If you hope that "everyone deceives me, I will never deceive others. Whoever deceives me, I am willing to be deceived" is a great Bodhisattva.

All sentient beings kill me, I can endure, I am willing to make offerings to sentient beings, but I do not mind harming any sentient being, including ants. I was in New York, where there were cockroaches and rats. A disciple asked: "What to do about cockroaches and ants?" You can't beat them, you can't sprinkle them with boiling water, and you can't sprinkle medicine. Trusting Buddha, I said: "You preach the Dharma to him." “Can it understand or not?” I said: "I preach the Dharma to you, there are also things you don't understand! I looked at the sutras, there are places where the sutras say I don't understand, there are many things I don't understand! Don't just say it because you don't understand it. Try it, it will be truly spiritual." That person said: "Really spiritual". There are no more [cockroaches and ants] in that person's house!

There are many things like this, if you believe in them, they will be successful. If you don't believe, nothing is spiritual. Whenever you believe, you become spiritual. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra teaches: Reciting my name is okay, but you still do not recite it! Reciting? I feel like I can't recite like that every day! Recite ten thousand sentences every day, but you can't do it! But my friend, there are many people who can do it! "Why can't I do it? There's no time!" Those are all excuses! Faith is not enough! “I preach the sutras and that's enough!” Always blame other reasons for not being able to do it! If you really can't relax, no matter what the obstacle is, I will recite His name ten thousand times a day, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will guide you. To recite ten thousand hours, it still takes three years. Sometimes when you lose your mind, you recite a hundred thousand words! So, if we recite a thousand sentences every day, how long does it take to recite one hundred thousand sentences? Every day recite a thousand verses, a month it's thirty thousand verses, a year it's more than thirty thousand verses. If you want to recite one hundred thousand sentences, you have to recite for three years. When you are diligent and courageous, you immediately recite one hundred thousand sentences. After reciting, relax again for three years, then three years later, recite another hundred thousand verses. It's okay to do it that way, that's how we plan. At the end of a year, I meditate, reciting a hundred thousand sentences, or more. Saying "reciting one hundred thousand sentences", actually reciting one hundred and ten thousand sentences, why? There are times when false thoughts arise, reciting more than 100,000 hours to supplement the chants mixed with false thoughts. Do you know? When we recite sutras, we have to recite a little more, it's okay to raise false thoughts! Then, you add, this can really add up. When reciting, we recite a thousand sentences, you have to recite another hundred sentences. Because in there, false thoughts have arisen, or the rosary is counted incorrectly, and sometimes the numbers are not counted accurately. Reciting more or less, the above obstacles will be eliminated.

To stay away from falsehood, what should you do to overcome it? Speak the truth. When speaking, you absolutely have to think for a moment before speaking. Don't open your mouth to say nonsense, think for a moment before speaking. As soon as people ask a question, they immediately answer. It's easy to make mistakes. [People criticize] “every time you open your mouth, you spit out” because of this meaning. Destroy the retribution in the past, you will not receive retribution anymore. "In the present incarnation, all humans are in the same heavenly class, the stage is friendly, there is no hesitation. Peace of mind and body, words and words, respect and worship of others" (In the present body, the heavens and people are all cordial, without doubt or concern. Peace of mind and body, words spoken, others respect and obey): Others believe what you say, follow what you say. Or if everyone obeys your words, that is your trust. Everyone in the country believes that this President speaks the truth, and they will absolutely follow the policies he has said. The policy set by the country will not become "double talk, all deception!"

The killing is too heavy, the country will not last long, it cannot last a hundred years. The Yuan Dynasty had the shortest existence, [the reign of] Ly Tu Thanh was even shorter, eighteen days! On the eighteenth day, the Manchus entered the gate and chased him away. He told all lies and killed too many people. [He who abandons lies], when he dies, his body and mind are not oppressed by sorrow, his wife, children, and relatives are surrounded by love. When he was about to die, he did not see the terrifying messenger of King Yama Ma. His beloved wife, children and relatives surrounded him. Everyone there spoke the truth and sent him off, making him truly reluctant. This is very important. When about to die, facing the threshold of love, if you cry, that person's consciousness will be captured by you, and it will be very difficult to escape!

Learn to leave false speech. Surely people say: "Do you still have to study after giving up false words?" Because people don't study the precepts. By studying the precepts, [you will know] that each precept must be studied. How does one commit the crime of speaking falsely? How to avoid committing the crime of speaking falsely? The cause of false speech, the condition of false speech, [constitutes the conditions to judge whether or not you have violated] the false precepts [or not]. Furthermore, deceiving for the sake of fame and fortune, deceiving others and causing loss is a violation of the precepts. Arbitrarily deceiving a child [when it cries], probably because it is not a violation, is not considered breaking the precept of false speech. However, if you trick young children like that, what's wrong with it? A child learns from its parents and will lie when it grows up! Because from a young age, parents have learned the same thing, simply comforting their children: "Don't cry, I'll give you cake or candy." Wait until he doesn't cry, and if he wants to receive it, he won't have it. If a child knows how to be deceived, he will also deceive you. It's okay to understand this principle! You must study, if you don't study you won't understand! Learn how to stay away from false words. To stay away from false words, speak the truth a lot. “The ability to completely cut off all evil and unwholesome dharmas, the ability to completely achieve superior good dharmas, the ability to necessarily seek the meaning of Mahayana dharma, the ability to practice all the Bodhisattva vows, to gradually enter the deep and vast ocean of wisdom” (Can sever all evil and unwholesome dharmas, can achieve all superior good dharmas, can seek all the meaning of Mahayana dharma, can practice all Bodhisattva vows, gradually entering the deep and wide ocean of wisdom), gradually can achieve Buddha.

“ I strive to attain Supreme Bodhi. Sin the Buddhaland” (Until I attain Supreme Bodhi. The Buddhaland he resides in): In that Buddhaland, “all true” (all true), There is no Buddha land that is not real, but this Buddha land of Śākyamuni Buddha is not real, why? Because this incarnation [in this world] is not pure, but is an evil life with five impurities. Buddha said this world is not real, it is illusory. Śākyamuni Buddha is in this Buddha realm to specialize in saving those who speak false words; Therefore, He came here. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva specializes in hell, other Buddha lands do not have hell. The Pure Land or other worlds have no hell, no three realms. Not only are there no three paths, there are also no six paths, there are only reincarnated people. Those people are all Bodhisattvas. Gradually enter the vast ocean of wisdom and attain Supreme Bodhi. The Buddha land that person lives in is completely true, free from lies, adorned with pure, fragrant and mysterious objects. Sentient beings do not flatter, do not deceive, are completely virtuous, have righteous conduct, and wish for pure good dharma, then they can be born in that land.

We all speak lies, is it pure or not? When you do good deeds, are you really doing good deeds? We think we are doing good deeds, doing good things, but in there, there are always many impure, impure things mixed in! For example, about liberating captive animals (life release), each person has a different way of thinking. Even though it is not pure, it still has merit. Is liberating captive animals (life release) pure or not? Not pure. Why? What's in your mind, you know right away! We do everything with conditions attached! For example, to lend money to others, you must have evidence, or to borrow money from the bank, or to use real estate as collateral, you all need to have something! We all always need something guaranteed, longing for a return. I release the animals and see those animals swimming back, I feel very happy, as if they came back to repay me, I always have that expectation. If it doesn't come back to report and just leaves, [will mumble]: "It's a heartless, meaningless thing. I saved it, but it's still heartless and meaningless!" There are many stories like this. We do everything, but our mind is always mixed with many things. Reciting a sutra, reciting sutras, reciting Buddha's name, there are many mixed things in it. Then, make a wish to pray for this, pray for that. "Bodhisattva! You bless someone for me", just like when you pray, Buddha or Bodhisattva must bless! Wait until Buddha and Bodhisattva have finished blessing, the matter is over, there is no need to look for Buddha or Bodhisattva anymore! Like that! After that [something happened], he hugged Buddha's feet again. That is the mind of living beings, that is not pure. If you wish for pure good dharma, the sentient beings born in that realm must be pure. If you want to be born in the Buddha realm, you must think pure, don't speak false words, don't lie!

Do not make mistakes with the Sravaka Vehicle, Don't make mistakes with the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle, don't make mistakes with the Pratyekayana, don't make mistakes with the Mahayana, don't make mistakes with the Mahayana Bodhisattva Jāla, they will be able to flourish the nature of the Three Jewels for the monastic disciples of the Tathagata, whether it is a dharma weapon or not a dharma Even those who wear a kasaya and shave off their beards and hair do not make mistakes. The good roots wear a different layer of ca-sa than the good roots of maintaining pure precepts, and are not the same as those who break the precepts, their good roots are different. You only wear one piece of ka-sa, why are you wearing it? It all has a cause; All dharmas have causes. Breaking the precepts also needs to be considered according to the cause, what cause? What fate? Whenever there is a cause, it will become a transgression. There is another cause, it will become unviolated.

(Sutra) Phuc, good man! Weak Bodhisattva Demon Ha Slaps, able to endure punishment, separate from gossip, always love and respect all sentient beings, speak from the spirit in harmony, respectfully and respectfully, without any doubt. Through trial, good roots quickly reach maturity. Possessing money and offerings in the cycle of the five animals, a river of birth and death, separation of causes and words, creation of body, speech, and mind of evil karma, hindrances of afflictions, hindrances of sentient beings, necessarily dharma hindrances, impurities of harmonization, self-action, teaching others, seeing and writing according to joy, due to the trial of "far separating from cockroaches" the wheel, the stage will inevitably develop and perish, with no residue, no retribution. U appears in the middle of heaven, all people are of the same level, the group is friendly, has no worries, is at peace in body and mind, speaks words, and is in harmony. At the same time, the body and mind do not feel any urgent pain or suffering, the love for one's wife and relatives is disturbed. At the end of his life, he could not see the King of Flames, he only had a pleasant view, he achieved good dharma, he had precepts, he was rich in virtue, he had a true field of blessings, he became a good knowledge, his body and mind were happy, he was deeply respected. After the end of life, the human body is reborn, the roots are complete, and the body is complete. Depending on the place of birth, the language is harmonious, dignified, intelligent, peaceful, and joyful.
(Sutra: Come here, good man! If Bodhisattva Ma Ha Slaps can, until the end of their lifespan, stay away from gossip, all sentient beings will always love and respect each other. The words they speak will make everyone in harmony. When they hear and obey, they will not doubt or worry. Therefore, good roots can quickly be matured in all the cycles of the five paths, immersed in the river of birth and death in the past. Due to separation from gossip, evil karma is created in the body, speech, mind, afflictions, obstacles in sentient beings, and all dharmas. Obstacles, obstacles to harmony, self-doing, teaching others to do, seeing and listening to rejoice, due to this cycle of "abstinence from words and separation", [those obstacles] are all crushed and destroyed, without receiving retribution. In the present body, the heavens and people are all friendly, there is no doubt or worry, the body and mind are peaceful, the words spoken make everyone in harmony, the body and mind are not oppressed by sorrow, and the wife and children are loved and his relatives surrounded him. At the time of his death, he did not see the terrifying messenger of King Yama Ma, but only saw a person who was pleasing to the eye, had achieved good dharma, was full of virtue, had a field of true blessings, made good knowledge, had joy in his body and mind, and was born with deep reverence. After his death, he was still born in the human race, his organs were perfect, his body was complete, his speech was harmonious, righteous, intelligent, peaceful, and happy.

“Separation of language” is double talk, causing separation. People who are separated will change, hate each other, can they still love each other? If we avoid gossip and do not stir up gossip, when people come into contact with each other, they will respect each other, and the words spoken will be peaceful, not violent. Stirring up separation will not result in harmony. In front of Truong Tam, we tell Ly Tu's crimes, in front of Ly Tu, we tell Truong Tam's crimes, there are too many stories that cause schisms. Among monks, between monastics, it is called “breaking the Sangha harmony”, and among ordinary people, schism is called “sparking schism”. But there are people who [do so] to gain benefits for themselves, and there are people who stir up fights for others, but that person doesn't gain any benefit themselves, they're just very happy, like to see others fight, like to stir up fights for others. This type of retribution, when suffered, will be very tragic, it is like that between people, it is like that between countries. Separation of indirect language, bad language: "Evil language of Luc Nguyet cold merchant", [meaning] the weather in June is extremely hot, you speak too much to stimulate others, that person is sensitive, even if it's very hot, he can't sweat, his skin gets goosebumps, he freezes! If you speak pleasant words, even though the weather is cold, "good words will be the best words in the world". That means the weather is cold, your mind feels very comfortable. It's okay to understand this principle. Therefore, we should not say words of separation.

Come here, good man! If Bodhisattva Mahasattva can stay away from indirect speech until the end of his life, then all sentient beings will be friendly to each other, speak only words of harmony, and everyone will respectfully obey. Listening to what you say, it's all "this person is good, this person has never been rude before". Don't say one thing in front of this person, and another thing in front of that person. In a conference, whether the Republican Party or the Democratic Party of the United States, or the Democratic Progressive Party and the Kuomintang of Taiwan, or even a new party, what are their actions? Stir them into discord so that we can benefit in the middle! If my vote is more, your vote will definitely be less. I'm in power, you have to listen to me, I don't need to listen to you! That's the purpose, it's very clear! It's only when you leave the conference and look in from the outside [that you see it], but you won't see it in the conference! What is it? Separate each other, harass each other!

Today, just opened a conference at the National Assembly, the first meeting was full of fighting. Every day, the spark of separation has become mature, the problem is difficult to resolve, as soon as the meeting opens, there is a dispute, as soon as the meeting starts fighting, how can it be good? Say "I am for the people, I am also for the people. You vote for me, in the future, I will give you benefits like this, like that." After everyone voted for them, they went to the National Assembly, forgot about their votes, forgot about the people's interests, and worried about disputes! We preach the Mahaparinirvana Sutra of the Ten Wheels, wanting to talk about the Ten Good Wheels and the Ten Evil Wheels. If everyone breaks the Ten Evil Wheels and practices the Ten Virtuous Wheels, not only in this world, but even Asuras and gods will not fight each other. No need to fight, no need, that would be great! Currently, it is possible to stay away from those obstacles. Otherwise, we won't be able to stay away! Because separation from broken speech creates evil karma in the body, speech, mind, afflictions, sentient beings, all dharma obstacles, obstacles to harmony, either do it yourself, or teach others to do it, seeing and hearing is rejoicing. When we see others fighting, we should not be happy. Seeing the struggle, I felt bored and detached. Why do that? No matter what reason they come up with, it's not a reason! You already want to fight, then there is no reason to fight. What reason is there anymore? Still wanting to find a reason, finding that reason itself is wrong! Does morality need to rely on fighting to be resolved? Therefore, it is legitimate for people to use missiles to attack you, what is the reason? "I will hit you because I have the power." That's not called justice, that's called “power”.

Speaking of equality, we see that Śākyamuni Buddha is the most equal, he treats everyone equally, [everyone] can become a Buddha. Buddha said, you and I are exactly the same, your nature is available, you have the same Body as me, everyone is the same, but I have eliminated karma, you still have karma. [Removing] karma means getting rid of obstacles in language. If you separate from indirect speech, karma will be eliminated. That is the cycle of “leaving separation from indirect speech” that has crushed and destroyed those obstacles. “When destroyed, there is no residue, no retribution” (Destroyed, no residue remains, no retribution). The Buddha preached this passage from the perspective of ordinary people, from ordinary people to Sravakas, Bodhisattvas, and achieving Buddhahood, all started from being human. Therefore, each passage of scripture begins with the story of being human.

(Sutra) Pleasant enlightenment, attainment of good dharma, precepts, rich virtues, true Field of Merit (puṇyakṣetra) with good knowledge, robe Cultivate the separation of dissociative speech, be able to cut off all evil and unwholesome dharmas, be able to completely overcome good dharmas, be diligent in seeking the absolute meaning of Mahayana Dharma, be diligent in cultivating the Bodhisattva's vows, be diligent in penetrating the profound and vast ocean of wisdom, and be determined to attain Supreme Bodhi. The Buddha's residence is necessarily strong and difficult to destroy. All the beautiful and wonderful things are solemn. Unconditioned, without edges, good and harmonious, avoid chanting, hope for pure essence, good dharma with sentient beings, come to life in a strange country, always cultivate harmony and respect, listen to the Dharma. The Tathagata himself has an immeasurable lifespan, and for all sentient beings, he preaches the Dharma. The final Nirvana, the nine pillars of the Dharma, benefit and bring immeasurable peace to sentient beings. Good man! The fifth Bodhisattva Mahasattva is completely separated from the wheel of nonsense. Bodhisattva Mahasattva accomplished the cycle of trials, u Sravakayana attained non-falling in, u Ky Sravakayana Bodhisattva Jāla attained infallibility, u Solitary Enlightenment Vehicle attained non-familiarization, u Pratyakāyayana Bodhisattva Jāla attained non-falling out, u Ky Mahayana attained non-falling out, u Ky Mahayana Bodhisattva Jāla attained non-falling out, the natural nature of the Three Jewels. The disciples of the Tathagata who became monks, weak in seeing the dharma weapon, weak in the non-dharma weapon, the summer will are bound to have a ca-sa, the world's cultivator has achieved the loss of enlightenment. According to the Mahayana Dharma, there is often advancement and advancement, with no regression. Gaining wisdom, winning blessings, often achieving growth. With absolute Concentration, the Da-lanis, the Rings, the Earths, quickly attain freedom, without any regression. Always attain enlightenment and enlightenment with good knowledge, and act according to your will. Always attaining the view of all Buddhas, meeting Bodhisattvas and Shravaka disciples, not separating from literature and dharma, not being close to each other, and making offerings to the Sangha. All of you with good roots, always strive diligently, with a mind without attachment. Usually Bodhi seed vows, the mind is free from attachment. Sin attaining retribution, preaches like money.
(Sutra: Again meeting a pleasing person, subduing and achieving good dharma, full of precepts, rich in virtue, true Field of Merit (puṇyakṣetra) Following that person's practice and practice, leaving behind all evil and unwholesome dharma, can achieve all the superior good dharmas, can pray for all Mahayana dharmas, can practice all the Bodhisattva's vows, gradually enter the vast and deep ocean of wisdom, until he attains the Supreme Bodhisattva, everything is solid, solid, indestructible, adorned with beautiful and mysterious objects. Sentient beings who do not oppose, do not compete, and are skillful in reconciling disputes and lawsuits, wishing for pure goodness, will be born in that world. They will always cultivate peace and respect, and listen to the Dharma. The Tathagata himself will have an unlimited lifespan, because after the Buddha attains Nirvana, the Dharma will last a long time, benefiting countless sentient beings! That is called the fifth wheel of separation from the Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat, by achieving this cycle, does not make mistakes with the Sravaka Vehicle, does not make mistakes with the Sravaka Vehicle, does not make mistakes with the Pratyekayana, does not make mistakes with the Mahayana, does not make mistakes with the Mahayana Bodhisattva, can often flourish for the disciples of the Tathagata Whether it is a dharma weapon or not, even those who wear a robe and shave off their hair and beard do not make mistakes. With the Mahayana dharma, they are always promoted and do not retreat. In all the Concentrations, Da-la-ni, and Grounds, they quickly become free and do not retreat All Buddhas, Bodhisattvas and Sravaka disciples, never leave listening to the Dharma, never leave closeness, and make offerings to the Sangha, always diligently seek, and never tire of the Bodhisattva vows, and achieve the results as mentioned above.

To be a human being, to regularly meet good and knowledgeable people, what is the point of meeting them? Learn to separate from indirect language. Study so that you don't say things that cause separation. Stimulating cockroaches causes quite a lot of harm. If you stab others, you are also stabbing yourself! You constantly stir up other people, no one says good things to you. Isn't that retribution? If one breaks away from dissociative speech, one can cut off all evil and unwholesome dharmas, one can achieve all superior good dharmas, one can pray for all Mahayana dharmas, one can practice all the Bodhisattva's vows, and gradually enter the deep and wide ocean of wisdom until one attains Supreme Bodhi and one will become a Buddha. The land that person lives in is “necessarily secure, indestructible” (everything is solid, tight, difficult to destroy). Interruption cannot be destroyed!

Our internal mechanism is not perfect, and disruptions can easily arise. It was you who fought, until someone outside sparked a schism, and the fighting will be even more ferocious! You don't want to be inferior, you keep arguing every day because you don't want to be inferior, don't blame anyone else! Not even one evil thing exists, one can achieve all the superior good dharmas, one can achieve the Mahayana dharma, all of these things can be achieved. We eliminate bad karma, eliminate bad karma, it will be good karma, so we can penetrate the sea of ​​wisdom, until we attain Supreme Bodhi. The Buddha realm we live in will be solid, tight, "difficult to destroy. Cthe place of beauty and wonder is adorned with things. Unconditioned, without edges, good and harmonious, avoiding chanting, hoping for pure essence" (hard to destroy. Adorned with beautiful and mysterious objects. No opposition, no competition, skillful in reconciling disputes and lawsuits, hoping for pure essence): “Pure” has the same meaning as “pure”.

When Bodhisattva Mahasattva teaches and transforms all sentient beings, he makes no mistakes with the dharma and with everyone. The Dharma is not wrong, but it is also not wrong with people, it does not recognize the wrong foundation, it considers the Lesser Vehicle to be the Mahayana. For those who are not disgusted with the Five Contradictions, do not believe in Buddha Dharma, but speak Mahayana Dharma, then the speaker commits a mistake and must receive retribution.

(Sutra) Phuc, good man! Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas, who are capable of exhausting punishment and suffering, avoid harsh and evil speech, necessarily love and cherish all sentient beings. The speech is cheerful, the writing is respectful, and there is no doubt. Through trial, good roots quickly reach maturity. Possessing the pre-sacrifice that circulates the five animals, a river of birth and death, the gross cause of evil speech, the creation of body, speech, mind, evil karma obstacles, afflictions and afflictions, obstacles of sentient beings, necessarily dharma obstacles, good obstacles, self-action, teaching others, seeing and writing according to the joy, due to the trial of leaving the wheel of coarse and evil speech, the stage will inevitably develop and decay, with no residue, and no retribution. U appear in the body, all people are heavenly, the stage is friendly, there is no hesitation, the body and mind are at peace, words are born, the stage is joyful. The same life and the same time, the body and mind are not worried about urgent suffering. Because of his beloved wife, his relatives are disturbed. At the end of his life, he could not see the King of Flames, he only had a pleasant view, he achieved good dharma, he had precepts, he was rich in virtue, he had a true field of blessings, he became a good knowledge, his body and mind were happy, he was deeply respected. After the end of life, the human body is reborn, the roots are complete, and the body is complete. Depending on the place of birth, the language is soft, virtuous, intelligent, peaceful, and joyful.
(Sutra: Come here, good man! If Bodhisattva Ma Ha He can stay away from harsh words for the rest of his life. All sentient beings love and respect him. The words he speaks make everyone happy. When he hears them, he respects them and obeys them, without doubt or concern. Therefore, in all the times of the five paths of birth and death, due to harsh words, evil karma is created in the body, speech, mind, afflictions, obstacles in sentient beings, and all dharmas. Obstacles, obstacles in overcoming good deeds, doing things yourself, teaching others, seeing and listening are happy, due to this cycle of "abstaining from harsh words", [those karmic obstacles] are all crushed, destroyed, no longer left, no retribution. In this life, the heavens and humans are all friendly, there is no doubt, there is no worry, the body and mind are peaceful, the words spoken make others happy, the body and mind are not oppressed by sorrow, the wife and children are loved surrounded by relatives. When he was about to die, he did not see King Yama Ma's terrifying messenger, only a person who was satisfied, achieved good dharma, was full of virtue, filled with true blessings, made good knowledge, was happy in body and mind, and had deep faith. Having passed away, he was reborn as a human being, his organs were perfect, his body was complete, his speech was soft, upright, intelligent, peaceful, happy).

“Crude speech” is saying evil words, words that are hard to hear! When cursing others, the words that come out are often dirty. If you are a Sichuan person, every time you open your mouth, you say “how to Lao Tzu”. What is “The Lao Tzu Way”? “Old Tzu's Way” [36] is their catchphrase, they call everyone “junior” (little ones). I argued with my teacher about this, he said it was their habit. I said: "Habits? Why don't they dare to call Buddha "junior", but the World-Honored One? They see the king, how dare they call him "junior"! What habit is that? Habits can be changed, their catchphrase, even when they see everyone, they call them "you son" (turtle). I said: "They see local officials, see the scene." murder, don't dare call those people turtles!” As for all habits, [if you think] it doesn't matter if you change them or not, they're broken! All living habits, or harsh words, just leave them as they are, assuming there is no problem! When Buddhist scriptures teach about precepts, not talking [in detail] like that will not do. At that time, whatever the [precepts] say, [any violation] is counted as a transgression. The precepts must speak as the truth, stating the truth. Except for the precepts, one cannot say harsh words.

Do not speak harsh words, speak soft words. Speak softly, say loving words, making others like to listen. Soft is a very gentle tone, don't speak harshly, or be loud or grumpy, your face will turn red, your eyes will be wide open. You haven't said anything yet, people can see that you're already upset. If you utter the words, of course it's even worse. There are many things like this, all of which are signs of not being dignified and not being intelligent. When a person is angry, his appearance is extremely unsightly!

(Sutra) Pleasant enlightenment, attainment of good dharma, precepts, rich virtues, true Field of Merit (puṇyakṣetra) with good knowledge, robe Cultivate and abandon harsh and evil speech, learn to cut off all evil and unwholesome dharmas, achieve the most superior good dharmas, constantly seek the meaning of Mahayana Dharma, diligently practice the Bodhisattva vows, and gradually enter the deep and vast ocean of wisdom, until you reach the Supreme Bodhisattva. In the Buddhaland, it is impossible to be far away from the mind, the race is wonderful, the mind is gentle, the mind is at peace, the Dharma is clear, full of wonder. Concentrate on reciting wisdom, transgress sound thoroughly, do good to sentient beings, and give birth to a foreign country. Usually, the language is soft and the wings are similar to encourage attack. The Tathagata himself has an immeasurable lifespan, and for all sentient beings, he preaches the Dharma. The final Nirvana, the nine pillars of the Dharma, benefit and bring immeasurable peace to sentient beings. Good man! The title of Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat the sixth “is far from coarse and evil speech” wheel. Bodhisattva Mahasattva accomplished the cycle of trials, u Sravakayana attained non-falling in, u Ky Sravakayana Bodhisattva Jāla attained infallibility, u Solitary Enlightenment Vehicle attained non-familiarization, u Pratyakāyayana Bodhisattva Jāla attained non-falling out, u Ky Mahayana attained non-falling out, u Ky Mahayana Bodhisattva Jāla attained non-falling out, the natural nature of the Three Jewels. The disciples of the Tathagata who became monks, weak in seeing the dharma weapon, weak in the non-dharma weapon, the summer will are bound to have a ca-sa, the world's cultivator has achieved the loss of enlightenment. According to the Mahayana Dharma, there is often advancement and advancement, with no regression. Gaining wisdom, winning blessings, often achieving growth. With absolute Concentration, the Da-lanis, the Rings, the Earths, quickly attain freedom, without any regression. Always attain enlightenment and enlightenment with good knowledge, and act according to your will. Always attaining the view of all Buddhas, meeting Bodhisattvas and Shravaka disciples, not separating from literature and dharma, not being close to each other, and making offerings to the Sangha. All of you with good roots, always strive diligently, with a mind without attachment. Usually Bodhi seed vows, the mind is not satisfied. Sin attaining retribution, it is said to be like money.
(Sutra: Again meeting a pleasing person, achieving subjugation of good dharma, full of precepts, rich in virtue, true Field of Merit (puṇyakṣetra) Becoming a wise person, following that person, cultivating and abandoning harsh words, can cut off all evil and unwholesome dharmas, can achieve all superior good dharmas, can pray for all Mahayana dharmas, can practice all Bodhisattva vows, gradually enter the deep ocean of wisdom, until he attains the Supreme Bodhisattva in which he is, far away from all unpleasant sounds, all wonderful things, wish-fulfilling, gentleness, all things. The voice that pleases, the voice that gathers the Dharma, fills that world. All sentient beings are full of wisdom, clear and pure, and are born in that world. They often use soft words to encourage and encourage each other. Because the Buddha preaches the Dharma in accordance with the foundation, the Dharma will last a long time, benefiting and bringing peace to countless sentient beings. This is called good man! The sixth "stay away from harsh words" of Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat. Because Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat achieves this wheel, he will not make mistakes with the Sravaka Vehicle, will not make mistakes with the Sravaka Vehicle, will not make mistakes with the Single Enlightenment Vehicle, will not make mistakes with the Mahayana, will not make mistakes with the Mahayana Sutra Jāla The monastic disciples of the Tathagata, whether it is a dharma weapon or not a dharma weapon, even those who wear a robe and shave off their hair and beard, do not make mistakes with the Mahayana dharma, they are always promoted and do not retreat. In all the Concentrations, the Da-la-ni, the Rings, and the Grounds, they are quickly freed, not regressed, and often meet good friends. Consciousness acts according to it. Always see all the Buddhas, Bodhisattvas and Sravakas, never leave listening to the Dharma, never leave close to and make offerings to the Sangha, always diligently seek, the mind is not tired of the Bodhisattva vows, the mind is not tired of achieving the results as mentioned above.

“Enlightenment pleasantly, become good dharma, practice precepts, be endowed with virtue, a true field of blessings with good knowledge, rely on one's practice” (Once again meet a satisfactory person, achieve subjugation of good dharmas, complete precepts, be rich in virtue, a true Field of Merit (puṇyakṣetra), follow that person to practice): How must we study to be able to leave behind harsh words? This story is different, different from the previous ones. The sounds of “superior wonderful species” (the most wonderful things), born in the world of Ultimate Bliss, even the chirping of birds are all preaching the Dharma, are there still harsh words? Since it doesn't exist, all [living beings] with subdued emotions, gentleness, soft speech, and wonderful sounds, are all reborn in that Buddha land.

“Usually use soft words to encourage each other” (Usually use soft words to advise and encourage each other), you must practice diligently. What is considered wisdom? What can cause sentient beings to gain benefit? Until “sharp, unhindered by all dark obstacles”. That is wisdom. That is the sword of wisdom, the sword of wisdom that cuts down demons! Vajra Prajna Paramita is [that wisdom]. That wisdom is as solid as diamond, sharp as diamond, and can eliminate all the Or. That is called “benefit”. It can be said that beneficial wisdom is diamond wisdom, also called Prajna wisdom. What is “Winning Blessing”? No attachments. Bodhisattva does all things, saves all living beings, but has no merit. Subhuti was surprised, doing so much without any merit? Bodhisattva creates merit, but without attachment, that is the greatest merit. When we do all the good things without attachment, those good things become very big. Benefits and merit can be explained in many ways, and are often increased.

(Sutra) Fu th, good man! Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas are able to take the full punishment and avoid impure speech. All sentient beings always love and respect them. They speak from the same level of meaning and benefit, and are respectful and respectful, without any doubts. By trying good roots, one can quickly reach maturity. Possessing a pre-sacrifice that circulates the five animals, a river of birth and death, the cause of impure speech, creation of body, speech, mind, evil karma obstacles, hindrances of afflictions, hindrances of sentient beings, necessarily dharma hindrances, hindrances of beneficial meaning, self-action, teaching others, seeing and writing according to the joy, due to the trial of leaving the impure speech wheel, the stage will inevitably develop, disappear with no residue, and receive no retribution. U appears in the middle of the heavens, everyone is friendly, has no worries, is at peace in body and mind, speaks words, and becomes righteous. At the same time, the body and mind do not feel any urgent pain or suffering, the love for one's wife and relatives is disturbed. At the end of his life, he could not see the King of Flames, only his views were agreeable, he became wholesome, he had precepts, he was rich in virtue, he had a true field of good fortune and good knowledge, he was happy in body and mind, he was deeply trusted. In the final destiny, rebirth in the middle, all faculties are perfect, all parts are complete, depending on the place of birth, speech will be beneficial, correct, intelligent, peaceful and happy.
(Sutra: Come, good man! If Bodhisattva Mahasattva can live until the end of his life, Abandoning impure words, all sentient beings will always love and respect each other, the words spoken will be beneficial, listeners will respect and obey, without doubt or concern. Therefore, the good roots will quickly ripen in the five paths, immersed in the river of birth and death in the past, due to impure words, evil karma will be created in the body, speech, mind, afflictions, obstacles in sentient beings, all dharma obstacles, obstacles to benefit. Because of this "stay away from impure words", [those karmic obstacles] are crushed, destroyed, do not receive retribution. In the present body, the heavens and people are all friendly, do not have doubts or worries, and the words spoken become beneficial. When the person is about to die, the body and mind are not surrounded by sorrow and suffering. When dying, the terrifying messenger of King Yama Ma is not seen Satisfied, achieving subjugation of good dharma, complete morality, rich in virtue, true field of blessings, good knowledge, joy in body and mind, giving birth to deep reverence, having passed away, being reborn as a human, with perfect organs, complete body parts, wherever one is born, one speaks beneficially, righteously, intelligently, peacefully, happily.

Impure is the last item in speech karma. [We have discussed] broken speech, harsh speech, broken speech, the fourth type of speech karma is impure speech, which is also dependent speech. “Proverbs” is uttering useless words. “Unclean” means “impure”; To be more exact, it's just our usual type of gossip and chatter! If there are a few people sitting together, chatting, it will be like this: You can talk about anything, that's impurity! Because people who speak impure words are not respected by sentient beings, sentient beings do not want to respect them, because they speak without “meaning” (meaning, benefit), that is, as we say “the language is bland, the face is boring!” If one avoids impure speech, [speech] will have meaning. All sentient beings want to be close to, respect, and love that person. That way, you will be free from impure words. What he or she says is moral and beneficial to sentient beings. Others who hear it will respect you and will not be suspicious or worried. If you talk and people keep having to "extract" [bragging, nonsense, useless things], then think about it, what meaning do your words have? That is "wrong doubt" (doubt, worry), we cannot completely believe what you say, and doubts will arise regarding your words. If you stay away from impure language, it will help you quickly become mature, what kind of maturity is that? Mastering pure karma. In the past, having rotated in the five paths, immersed in the river of birth and death, that retribution was related to impure speech, and at the same time created a lot of [karma in] body, speech, mind, "karma of thoughts" (due to thoughts of karma), has that meaning!

[If you] read the Pham Hanh chapter [of the Avatamsaka Sutra] you know that “speech” is speech karma, and has the same meaning. “Mind” is mental karma, “body” is physical karma. Body and physical karma are different, because words have no meaning, causing the karma you have done and all the effects of your body, speech, and mind to become obstacles. When you educate, save sentient beings, and study with sentient beings, [the karma created in body, speech, and mind] all become obstacles, which means others do not want to care about you. Because of that obstacle, whether it's because you yourself utter impure words, teach others to speak impure words, or hear others utter impure words, you all praise and rejoice. In tea houses, taverns, restaurants, and ballrooms, there are too many languages ​​of this type. Regarding this matter, you should not develop the attitude of "seeing, hearing as you please", you must stay away! If one stays away from impure speech, this cycle will be accomplished. Abstaining from impure speech and karma has ten wheels. This is the last of the ten rounds. Due to this cycle of crushing impure speech, all your impure speech karma in the past will be destroyed without any residue, without retribution. Not receiving retribution belongs to the “previous sacrifice” (past), while “present sacrifice” (present) is “the middle incarnation, the gods and humans of the same level are close together” (in the present body, the ranks of gods and humans are all close together).

If heaven and people are close to you, then as for you personally, they will not have to worry, speculate, or scrutinize your words, but will believe sincerely and earnestly, and your body and mind will also be at peace. All words “turn into meaning” (all become meaningful), are not meaningless and useless words. All words make it possible for all sentient beings to gain benefits. If when you are about to die, your body and mind will not be bound by grief, sadness, or suffering, nor will you be overwhelmed or oppressed by tribulations. Suffering has a pressing nature that makes your body and mind not at peace. When the body and mind achieve peace, there will be no oppressive nature. Every individual hopes that when he dies, his six relatives, beloved wife and children will all surround him. These words seem very simple at first glance, when many people die, their wife and children are not present, or they die in a car accident, or they die in a foreign land. Being able to “live in peace”, when you die, your dearest person is by your side, that is also very happy, and it is also very comfortable to die. Even though we still parted ways in the end, it was still a very nice parting. You also don't see the terrifying messengers of King Yama Ma, Black Impermanence, or Bach Impermanence. They are soul-catching messengers, they are soul-catching messengers. You can't see it either.

If you see those people while you are about to die, you will panic. However, you see all the good knowledge that pleases you, all the things that are in accordance with the good dharma, you see all the true fields of merit, full of precepts, rich in virtue, making your body and mind very happy and very happy. At the same time, towards that good and knowledgeable person, there was deep reverence. That way, when you leave, it will be a very good one. If you do not practice, just because of this one act of abandoning impure words, because you have accomplished this karma, you can still be born as a human, and you will not [have to fall into a miserable situation] as mentioned in the Ten Evil Karma Wheels of the previous section, that is, whenever you are born as a human, your senses are lacking, your limbs are incomplete! But it will be born in the human race, with all the senses perfect and all four limbs complete. “Depending on the place of birth, speech is bound to be beneficial” (Wherever you are born, your words will certainly bring benefits): Wherever you are born, wherever you go, your speech can benefit others. Everyone has a joyful mind, your appearance is “correct, intelligent, peaceful, happy”.

(Sutra) Pleasant enlightenment, good deeds, precepts, rich virtue, true field of blessings, virtuous knowledge, diligently practice and learn to avoid impure speech, be able to cut off necessarily evil and unwholesome dharmas, be able to completely overcome good dharmas, be diligent in seeking Mahayana Dharma, be diligent in cultivating Bodhisattva vows, gradually enter the profound ocean of wisdom, and attain Supreme Bodhi. To reside in the Buddhaland, far away from all meaninglessness and gain sound, the wonderful Bodhisattva treasury of the species, the great dharma sound of the continent transforms the country, achieving boundless great wisdom and great vows, skillfully expounding the Dharma of all kinds, such as the world of sentient beings will be born in a different country. The Tathagata himself has an immeasurable life span, and all sentient beings like him preach the Dharma. The final Nirvana, the true dharma of nine abidings, benefits and brings peace and happiness to countless sentient beings. Good man! The name Bodhisattva Mahasattva, the seventh, completely abandons the impure wheel of speech. Bodhisattva Mahasattva accomplished the cycle of trials, u Sravakayana attained non-infallibility, u Sravakayana Bodhisattva Jāla attained non-enlightenment, u Solitary Enlightenment Vehicle attained non-enlightenment, u Pratyakāyayana Bodhisattva Jāla attained non-infallibility, u Ky Mahayana attained non-enlightenment, u Ky Mahayana Sutra Jāla attained non-enlightenment, constantly capable of naturalizing the Three Jewels. The disciples of the Tathagata who became monks, weak in seeing the dharma weapon, weak in the non-dharma weapon, the summer will are bound to have a ca-sa, the world's cultivator has achieved the loss of enlightenment. According to the Mahayana Dharma, there is often advancement and advancement, with no regression. Benefits and blessings often increase. With absolute Concentration, the Dharanis, the Rings, the Earths, quickly attain freedom and no regression. Tto attain enlightenment and enlightenment of the good knowledges, act according to their own accord. Tordinarily attain the undivided view of all Buddhas, visit the Bodhisattvas and Shravaka disciples, do not separate from literature, dharma, and close relationships, and make offerings to the Sangha. All of you with good roots, always diligently seek, the mind of non-aversion. Tof the Bodhi seed of vows, the mind of non-gossip. Achieve retribution, spread the word like money.
Being a good person of knowledge, following that person, cultivating and abandoning impure words, can cut off all evil and unwholesome dharmas, can achieve all superior good dharmas, can pray for all Mahayana dharmas, can practice all Bodhisattva vows, and gradually enter the deep and wide ocean of wisdom, until he attains the Supreme Bodhisattva world. He is far away from all meaningless sounds, and the loud sounds belong to the highest and wonderful Bodhisattva Treasury throughout the world. country, achieving infinite great wisdom, being able to skillfully explain and explain all kinds of Dharma. Such sentient beings will be born in that country. The Tathagata himself will have an unlimited lifespan, and after the Buddha entered Nirvana, the Dharma will last a long time, benefiting countless sentient beings! This is called the seventh wheel of "stay away from impure words" of Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat This cycle of completion, not making mistakes with the Sravaka Vehicle, not making mistakes with the Sravaka Vehicle, not making mistakes with the Pratyekayana, not making mistakes with the Pratyekayana, not making mistakes with the Mahayana, not making mistakes with the Mahayana, can often flourish the Three Jewels for the monastic disciples of the Tathagata, whether it is a dharma weapon, or not a dharma weapon, up to all. All those who wear a robe and shave off their hair and beard do not make mistakes. With the Mahayana dharma, they often advance and do not retreat. Their sharp wisdom and superior blessings are often increased. In all the Concentrations, Dharmas, and Grounds, they quickly become free and do not retreat. They often meet and practice according to their will Do not give up listening to the Dharma, do not leave the Sangha, make offerings to the good roots, always diligently seek, the mind is not tired of Bodhisattva vows, the mind is not tired of achieving the results as mentioned in the previous section.

This is to say that you are reborn in the human world, just like when you die [mentioned] in the previous section, you will also meet good and satisfactory intellectuals. He has subdued evil dharmas, has no evil dharmas, has transformed them into good dharmas, is fully pure in his precepts, has abundant merit and virtue, and has wisdom. “True field of blessings” refers to the field of blessings in this world. A true field of blessings refers to one's own real field of blessings, not an illusory field of blessings. Such a wise person comes to be your physician. What will you learn from them? Learning to avoid impure language means not saying meaningless words. That is the comparison between the Ten Evil Karmas and the Ten Good Karmas. Study the Ten Good Karmas well, the Ten Evil Karmas will immediately turn into the Ten Good Karmas. Studying the Ten Good Karmas, the Ten Evil Karmas will no longer exist and will be stopped.

In the past, we thought that the Ten Good Karmas were just blessings for humans and heaven. If we go one step further, using the Ten Good Karmas as the basis to move forward, all good dharmas can grow, all evil dharmas can be separated. You can achieve all the superior good dharmas, including the Four Noble Truths, the twelve conditions, and the Six Paramitas. At that time, if you seek the Mahayana Dharma, you can practice Bodhisattva vows, develop Bodhisattva vows, practice Bodhisattva conduct, and gradually enter Prajna wisdom, penetrate the deep ocean of wisdom, until you become Buddha and attain Supreme Bodhi. Thus, in the Buddha realm you are in, you will be far away from all meaningless sounds and will not hear meaningless languages. Thus, [the sounds heard] all belong to the sublime Bodhisattva Treasury, always hearing the wonderful Dharma meanings, all belong to the category of Mahayana Bodhisattvas. “Great Dharma sounds throughout the entire country” (Great Dharma sounds throughout the entire country): Such Dharma sounds throughout the entire country, throughout the Buddha land you are in. That land is not a small continent, but a Buddha world, [such as] our Sa Ba world, the entire Dharma sounds throughout the Sa Ba world. “Achieving boundless great vows and wonderful wisdom” is just talking about Mahayana. Sometimes, the Buddha speaks of the Mahayana while implying the Second Vehicle. [The main sutra says] “Such sentient beings are born in that realm” to imagine what that land looks like? That Buddha land is extremely solemn and completely belongs to the Mahayana. The same is true of the World of Ultimate Bliss. When you get there, you will go straight to Buddhahood, but in that lotus pond there are also Sravakas, there are also Pratyekabuddhas, all of whom are entering the Mahayana. They are not at all the Sravakas who cut off the seed of Bodhi in the Sa Ba world, but the Sravakas who have the seed of Bodhi.

What about Buddha's lifespan? Tathagata himself has an immeasurable lifespan, “Tathagata” is Amitābha Buddha in the world of Ultimate Bliss, with an immeasurable lifespan. Each Buddha in the immeasurable pure Buddha lands has an immeasurable lifespan. “The sentient beings are willing to preach the Dharma” [meaning] what faculty they have, then tell them the Dharma [commensurate with] that faculty. After the Buddha in that world entered Nirvana, “the true Dharma is nine-dwelling, benefiting and immeasurable sentient beings” (the true Dharma lasts for a long time, benefits and brings peace to immeasurable sentient beings). There is no Statue of Dharma and the End of Dharma, the Dharma forever abides in the world.

“For good roots, always diligently seek, the mind is not satisfied” (For good roots, always diligently seek, the mind never gets tired of having enough): Cultivate good roots, never get tired of having enough, until you become Buddha. “Often the Bodhisattva vows, the mind is not satisfied” (Often the Bodhisattva vows, the mind is not bored enough): Hundreds of thousands of millions of vows, hundreds of thousands of millions of practices, forever not enough. Therefore, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is still making vows, Ten Ground Bodhisattvas are still making vows, they are making vows to benefit sentient beings. “Achieving extensive retribution as mentioned in the previous theory” (Achieving extensive retribution as mentioned in the previous section): These things have been said for the seventh time, a total of ten times.

Physical karma includes killing, stealing, sexual misconduct, verbal karma includes speaking nonsense (lies, deception), that is, lying. The nouns translated in this sutra have a few changes, “empty stem” is false language, “interrupted language” is double loss. He (Dharma Master Huyen Trang) does not use the title "two-tongue" but calls it "ly cockroach". He called evil speech “coarse and evil speech”, called abusive language “filthy speech”. Although the names are different, the meaning is the same. Everyone should know: Although the nouns in the sutras are different, their meaning is the same. There are also three cycles below, [the words used in those three cycles] are all duplicates.

(Kinh) Phục thứ, thiện nam tử! Nhược Bồ Tát Ma Ha Tát năng tận hình thọ, viễn ly tham dục, nhất thiết chúng sanh thường sở ái trọng, kỳ tâm thanh tịnh, ly chư nhiễm trược. Do thử, thiện căn tốc đắc thành thục. Sở hữu tiền tế luân chuyển ngũ thú, một sanh tử hà, nhân tham dục cố, tạo thân, ngữ, ý, chư ác nghiệp chướng, chư phiền não chướng, chư hữu tình chướng, nhất thiết pháp chướng, chư vô tham chướng, tự tác, giáo tha, kiến văn tùy hỷ. Do thử viễn ly tham dục luân cố, giai tất triển hoại, tồi diệt vô dư, bất thọ quả báo. Ư hiện thân trung, chư nhân thiên đẳng, giai cộng thân ái, vô sở sai lự, thân tâm an lạc. Kỳ tâm thanh tịnh, ly chư nhiễm trược. Tương mạng chung thời, thân tâm bất vị ưu khổ bức thiết, sở ái thê tử, quyến thuộc vi nhiễu. Lâm mạng chung thời, bất kiến khả bố Diễm Ma vương sứ, duy kiến khả ý, thành điều thiện pháp, cụ giới, phú đức, chân thật phước điền vi thiện tri thức, thân tâm hoan duyệt, thâm sanh kính tín. Ký mạng chung dĩ, hoàn sanh nhân trung, chư căn viên mãn, chi thể cụ túc, tùy sở sanh xứ, kỳ tâm thanh tịnh, ly chư nhiễm trược, đoan chánh, thông minh, an ổn, khoái lạc. Phục ngộ khả ý, thành điều thiện pháp, cụ giới, phú đức, chân thật phước điền vi thiện tri thức, y bỉ tu học ly tham dục pháp, năng đoạn nhất thiết ác bất thiện pháp, năng thành nhất thiết thù thắng thiện pháp, năng cầu nhất thiết Đại Thừa pháp nghĩa, năng tu nhất thiết Bồ Tát nguyện hạnh, tiệm thứ thú nhập thâm quảng trí hải, nãi chí chứng đắc Vô Thượng Bồ Đề. Sở cư Phật độ, địa bình như chưởng, chúng bảo sung mãn, chủng chủng bảo thụ hàng liệt trang nghiêm, chủng chủng bảo y, bảo trang nghiêm cụ, bảo tràng, phan, cái, kim, ngân, chân châu, la võng đẳng thụ, xứ xứ giai hữu, thậm khả ái nhạo, viễn ly kiêu mạn, nhan mạo đoan nghiêm, chư căn vô khuyết, kỳ tâm bình đẳng. Như thị hữu tình lai sanh kỳ quốc, vô tham công đức, viên mãn trang nghiêm. Như Lai tự thân thọ mạng vô lượng, vị chư hữu tình như ưng thuyết pháp. Bát Niết Bàn hậu, chánh pháp cửu trụ, lợi ích, an lạc vô lượng hữu tình. Thiện nam tử! Thị danh Bồ Tát Ma Ha Tát đệ bát viễn ly tham dục luân dã.
(Kinh: Lại này thiện nam tử! Nếu Bồ Tát Ma Ha Tát có thể cho đến hết thọ mạng, xa lìa tham dục, hết thảy chúng sanh sẽ thường yêu mến, kính trọng. Tâm vị ấy thanh tịnh, lìa các nhiễm trược. Do vậy, thiện căn có thể mau chóng thành thục. Trong những lúc luân chuyển trong năm đường, chìm trong sông sanh tử trước kia, vì tham dục đã tạo các nghiệp chướng ác nơi thân, ngữ, ý, các phiền não chướng, các hữu tình chướng, hết thảy pháp chướng, các chướng ngại đối với vô tham, tự làm, dạy người khác làm, thấy nghe tùy hỷ. Do cái luân “xa lìa tham dục” này, [các nghiệp chướng ấy] đều bị nghiền nát, tan diệt chẳng còn sót, chẳng nhận lãnh quả báo. Trong thân hiện tại, các hàng trời người đều cùng thân ái, chẳng ngờ vực, lo ngại, thân tâm yên vui. Tâm vị ấy thanh tịnh, lìa các nhiễm trược. Khi sắp mạng chung, thân tâm chẳng bị ưu khổ bức bách. Vợ con yêu mến và quyến thuộc vây quanh. Khi lâm chung, chẳng thấy sứ giả đáng sợ của vua Diễm Ma, chỉ thấy người vừa ý, điều phục thành tựu thiện pháp, đủ giới, giàu đức, phước điền chân thật làm thiện tri thức, thân tâm vui sướng, sanh lòng kính tin sâu xa. Đã mạng chung rồi, lại được làm người, các căn viên mãn, chi thể trọn đủ. Sanh ở bất cứ chỗ nào, tâm cũng thanh tịnh, lìa các đắm nhiễm, ô trược, đoan chánh, thông minh, an ổn, vui sướng. Lại gặp người vừa ý, điều phục thành tựu thiện pháp, trọn giới, đủ đức, phước điền chân thật làm thiện tri thức, nương theo người ấy tu học pháp lìa tham dục, có thể đoạn hết thảy các pháp ác bất thiện, có thể thành tựu hết thảy thiện pháp thù thắng, có thể cầu hết thảy pháp nghĩa Đại Thừa, có thể tu hết thảy nguyện hạnh của Bồ Tát, dần dần tiến nhập biển trí sâu rộng, cho đến chứng đắc Vô Thượng Bồ Đề. Cõi Phật người ấy ở, đất bằng phẳng như lòng bàn tay, các thứ báu đầy ắp, các thứ cây báu bày hàng trang nghiêm, các thứ áo báu, vật trang hoàng báu, tràng, phan, lọng báu, các thứ cây được phủ lưới mành vàng, bạc, chân châu v.v… thật đáng yêu thích, nơi nơi đều có. Xa lìa kiêu mạn, vẻ mặt đoan nghiêm, các căn chẳng khuyết, tâm người ấy bình đẳng. Hữu tình như thế sanh vào nước ấy, công đức “chẳng tham” viên mãn trang nghiêm. Bản thân Như Lai thọ mạng vô lượng, vì các hữu tình thuyết pháp đúng với căn cơ. Sau khi đức Phật nhập Niết Bàn, chánh pháp tồn tại lâu dài trong cõi đời, lợi ích, an lạc vô lượng hữu tình. Này thiện nam tử! Đó gọi là luân thứ tám “xa lìa tham dục” của Bồ Tát Ma Ha Tát).

Lìa tham dục rất khó. Lìa tham dục đến mức lìa tham dục rốt ráo, chính là đoạn trừ vô minh. Tham dục chia ra rất nhiều tầng cấp. Khi nghiệp của chúng ta rất nặng, khi duyên niệm Tam Bảo, [làm như thế] là đúng, nhưng rốt cuộc, duyên niệm Tam Bảo cũng trở thành chướng ngại. Duyên niệm Tam Bảo vẫn là hữu pháp, nếu đạt đến cái Không rốt ráo (tất cánh Không), thiện pháp lẫn ác pháp đều chẳng có. Thiện pháp Tam Bảo, Tam Bảo là học Giới, Định, Huệ, vì cung kính Tam Bảo mà học Giới, Định, Huệ, trừ diệt tham, sân, si, đối trị tham dục. Tham, sân, si đã chẳng còn, quý vị cũng đừng chấp trước Giới, Định, Huệ. Nếu vẫn chấp trước, sẽ thành bệnh, thuộc loại bệnh chấp trước. Chẳng hạn như chúng ta lập một gian Phật đường, nếu chúng ta thỉnh một bức tượng Phật, cung kính tột bậc, vốn chỉ có một bức tượng vẽ trên giấy được thờ tại đó, vẫn [cung kính] y hệt, cho đến cúng mấy vạn đồng, hoặc là mười vạn đồng đều biểu thị tôn kính. Trong ấy có thiện tham niệm. Có những lúc chúng ta cũng giống như vậy, tham niệm kiểu này rất nặng, phải khắc phục tham niệm ấy; [nếu không], niệm Phật, lạy Phật, luôn mong số lượng cho nhiều, chẳng cầu nội tâm thanh tịnh.

“Buddha” is Enlightenment. The meaning of Enlightenment is to eliminate. Always think that the greater the number of chants, the greater the Buddha's blessing will be. Reciting the holy name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva for ten thousand sentences is not possible, reciting ten thousand sentences is not possible, then reciting one hundred thousand sentences, there is a discount in that. I recite those ten thousand sentences, and there are many delusions in them. I recite one hundred thousand sentences, and there are also false thoughts in them. Thus, my one hundred thousand sentences have been discounted into ten thousand pure thoughts, ten thousand sentences discounted into one thousand pure thoughts, ten thousand sentences discounted into one thousand pure thoughts, one thousand extracted into one hundred, it should be like that! If one hundred pure thoughts were not possible, ten hours would be fine, having one pure recitation would be inconceivable. That is the meaning of “using a lot to achieve a little”.

There is a lot of desire for desire, [using] true Prajna wisdom will completely cut off [that mind of desire], ultimately pure, but at present it is still not possible. Because in order to treat this desire, when you leave the attachment and impurity, the good roots are ripe. Therefore, in the past, when circulating in the five paths, sinking in the river of birth and death, because of desire as a condition [that created karmic obstacles]; That is the basis of birth and death. The Ten Wheels mentioned in the Mahabodhi Sutra are all equal. Impure language is dependent language, the precepts are very light. There's nothing wrong, even when we're just standing there chatting, each chat contains gossip. When you go to the Buddha hall, looking at your friends, you always see that this is not right, that is not right, discussing others, that is duality. Or you don't discuss it with anyone, just hang around there. Hovering back and forth is not in accordance with Buddha Dharma, it is not in accordance with reason! Anything that has nothing to do with Buddhism is called impure speech. It's very easy to make this mistake!

In fact, for us, the most difficult thing to break is desire. Because you leave desire and desire, your body and mind are at peace, your mind is pure, and you are free from all defilements and impurities. When he was about to die, his body and mind were not oppressed by sorrow, and his beloved wife, children, and relatives surrounded him. At the time of your death, you will not see King Yama Ma's little devil, or the impermanent Black and White envoy will not come. “Only the pleasing view” (Seeing only pleasing people), [those] who make the mind happy can be seen, not seeing those who do not like it. “Enlightenment is pleasant, becomes good dharma, has precepts, is endowed with virtue, is a true Field of Merit (puṇyakṣetra) with good knowledge, diligently studies, abandons desire and desire” (Only seeing people who please, subdue and achieve good dharma, complete precepts, rich in virtue, true Field of Merit (puṇyakṣetra) to do good knowledge, rely on that person to study the dharma of leaving desire and desire): This is learning the dharma of leaving desire and desire with good knowledge, and can also eliminate all evil and unwholesome dharmas, which can be achieved. All good dharmas are superior, one can pray for all Mahayana dharmas, one can practice all Bodhisattva vows, and gradually enter the deep and wide ocean of wisdom. Only the Mahabodhi Sutra says that, other sutras have no such meaning!

Desire is a fundamental affliction, even more serious than impure and harsh speech. Killing, stealing, and prostitution are just in the present life, greed includes them all. The ten karmas all have desire as the root. Think about it, everyone speaks impure words. Once you get used to it, if you get used to it, it will become a habit. Due to the habit of being greedy, wherever you stand, you have to say something even if there is nothing wrong. There are people who talk too much, no one listens to them, so they stay at home talking to themselves. There is such a thing! We call those people “demonicists”. What is “ghost theory”? No one talked to that person, that person talked to himself. Especially the elderly ladies are especially talkative! You hear them whispering all day long! That is the basic habit.

The Great Collection of the Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra treats the Ten Evil Karmas equally, the text is exactly the same, other sutras are not like that. This sutra talks about the Ten Evil Wheels, that is, the Ten Evil Karma Wheels. The Ten Virtuous Karmas and the Luan were completely mentioned in the previous section, so it's enough to say it once! Why is this sutra said over and over again, every time, ten times in the same way? That's because you're afraid you won't pay attention. That is the Buddha's great kindness. If you lecture to disciples at the Buddhist Institute, you cannot teach like that. In every course at the Buddhist Institute, all lectures are about meaning, and rarely are lectures on sutras. There is a lot of time to explain the meaning, but a little time to preach the sutras. Lectures on the treatises, Commentary on Mahayana Photography, Treatise on Solemn Contemplation, Treatise on Mahayana Origination of Faith, Treatise on Great Wisdom, Treatise on Yogācāra on Earth. Lectures, no sutras, very few sutras. The Sutras are meant to teach you how to do them, while the Treatises are meant to argue and reveal wisdom. The Buddhist Institute is about learning understanding, the Zen Hall is not like that. Zen Hall means you don't talk much and do your research, that's fine. You don't talk much about reciting Buddha's name, just reciting Amitābha Buddha is enough! When you study the precepts, you practice all day long, showing off the precepts, studying every day. How do you keep the precepts pure? In a forest, or in a large temple, in addition to the Learning Precepts Hall, the Buddha Recitation Hall, the Meditation Hall, and the Study Hall, there is also Nhu Y Lieu[37]. When you are afraid, you can enter Nhu Y Lieu.

The things preached in the Ten Rings Sutra are preached specifically for the masses in the Great Assembly. In that dharma assembly, from Bodhisattvas to ordinary people, there are all. Many ordinary people make this mistake. Therefore, the Buddha had to remind again and again, again and again. Normally, the Buddha advised that three times is enough, but the Great Collection of Ten Wheels of Kṣitigarbha Sūtra is ten times, using identical language and words, all expressed equally to repeat, because of this meaning! Is it true that if you say it ten times, you will remember it? If you don't put your mind into it, it will still be the same a hundred times! Learning Dharma must be learned from the heart.
