That's looking in the mirror. Please look to see how many of the Ten Chakras you have. Some people get it all, some people only get two or three rounds. Then you are a wise person. If you know that your own karma is not heavy, you can compare it a bit, all the text in this passage is similar. In the previous section it was said twice; From now on, no more talking!

Say “The ability to attain the ultimate good dharma, the need to seek the Mahayana Dharma, the need to practice the Bodhisattva vows, to gradually penetrate the deep ocean of wisdom, the will to attain Supreme Bodhi. The Buddha's land of peace is like a palm tree, the assembly is full of treasures, the lineages are protected, the ranks are dignified, the lineages protect the robes, the treasures are dignified, jewels, phan, pearls, gold, silver, true pearls, all kinds of trees, the land of friendship" (can achieve all the supreme good dharmas, can pray for all Mahayana dharmas, can practice all the vows of the Bodhisattva, gradually enter the deep and wide ocean of wisdom, until he attains Supreme Bodhi. The Buddha land in which he lives, the land is as flat as the palm of his hand, full of all kinds of treasures, all kinds of precious trees are decorated in rows, all kinds of precious robes, Decorative treasures, corollas, phantoms, parasols, treasures, all kinds of precious trees covered with nets made of gold, silver, pearls, etc. are everywhere). That is the world of Ultimate Bliss, all pure Buddha lands are like that.

“Even adorable” (Extremely adorable), what else do you want! Because you must abandon desire and destroy the wheel of desire, then you can achieve this retribution!

“ Far away from arrogance, dignified in appearance, flawless in all faculties, equanimity in mind. Like all sentient beings, one will be born in a different country” (Away from arrogance, arrogance, dignified appearance, flawless in faculties, equal in mind. Such sentient beings are born in that realm): All sentient beings in that land are like that. So, not arrogant, not arrogant. Each person's appearance is not much different, no one is ugly or anything, but they all have a dignified appearance. There are several types of beauty. A beautiful person who has virtue will be respectful to everyone who sees them. They will not have the heart of contempt or the mind of insult! Speaking of virtuous women, in the past, we talked about noble ladies. Whenever they had merit, they were also very dignified, and also very beautiful! But compared to a beautiful prostitute, it absolutely cannot be said to be similar, no one would ever feel contempt for them!

Once upon a time, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva was the same as a Brahmin girl, and the same was the case when she was the Light Eye. Anyone who sees them will be respectful. Even the ghosts saw her and felt respect. That is virtue (virtue). As we see Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva and see a beautiful woman, they are absolutely two different states of mind! We see Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara, regardless of whether you believe in Buddha or not, you will be respectful towards him, without complacency or arrogance. Don't say Buddha, Bodhisattva, just like the gods, Ma To (Thien Hau Nguyen Quan)[38] is a little girl, the ancestral temple in Bo Dien, Phuoc Kien province. The statues of Ma To in that district were painted so beautifully that no one dared to be contemptuous of him. There is also a story at the temple of Nine Thien Huyen Nu Nuong Nuong, King An Tru[39] came to offer incense at that temple. [Seeing] the statue of Nine Thien Huyen Nu[40] was so skillfully carved, the king was born with a polluted mind and a greedy mind. That god is angry, but not the Bodhisattva! Cuu Thien Huyen Nu immediately sent the nine-tailed fox spirit [to destroy An's house], the nine-tailed fox spirit immediately transformed into Dat Ky. Due to one thought [of craving, King Tru] buried the country!

People with virtue and perfect merit; Therefore, the six senses are complete. "The appearance is dignified, the senses are flawless, the mind is equal" (The appearance is dignified, the senses are flawless, the mind is equal), the meaning implied here is "that person has no desires". That is the merit of that person, the land where he is born is [adorned by] the merit of not being greedy, that is “solemn perfection”. The merit of not being greedy, “not being greedy” is itself a merit. “not saying impure words” is itself a merit. Tathagata in that Buddha land has an immeasurable lifespan. All the Tathagatas in the lands mentioned in all ten cycles have an immeasurable lifespan. [speaking of an immeasurable lifespan] is not [referring to the lifespan of] the Sambhogakaya, but [the lifespan of the] Nirmanakaya.

“For sentient beings like to preach the Dharma. After Nirvana, the Dharma is nine-dwelling” (For all sentient beings, preach the Dharma with the right foundation. After the Buddha entered Nirvana, the Dharma lasts for a long time): There is also no Statue of Dharma and End of Dharma.

(Sutra) Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat accomplished the test of samsara, Śāvārṇa, attained non-enlightenment, Śārāvāra The Mahayana Sutra Vehicle attains the unenlightened state, the Single Enlightenment Vehicle attains the unenlightened state, the Single Enlightenment Vehicle Mahayana attains the unenlightened state, the Mahayana attains the unenlightened state, the Mahayana Sutra Mahayana attains the unenlightened state, and is always capable of naturalizing the Three Jewels. The disciples of the Tathagata who became monks, weak in seeing the dharma weapon, weak in the non-dharma weapon, the summer will are bound to have a ca-sa, the world's cultivator has achieved the loss of enlightenment. According to the Mahayana Dharma, there is often advancement and advancement, with no regression. Gaining wisdom, winning blessings, often achieving growth. With absolute Concentration, the Da-lanis, the Rings, the Earths, quickly attain freedom, without any regression. Always attain enlightenment and enlightenment with good knowledge, and act according to your will. Always attaining the view of all Buddhas, meeting Bodhisattvas and Shravaka disciples, not separating from literature and dharma, not being close to each other, and making offerings to the Sangha. All of you with good roots, always diligently seek, the mind of non-aversion. Tof the Bodhi seed of vows, the mind of non-gossip. Obtaining retribution is like money.
Not making mistakes with the Sravaka Vehicle, not making mistakes with the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle, not making mistakes with the Pratyekayana, not making mistakes with the Mahayana, not making mistakes with the Mahayana Sutra, can often flourish for the monastic disciples of the Tathagata, whether it is a dharma weapon, or not a dharma weapon, even for all those who wear a piece of kasa and shave off their beards. hair, do not make mistakes. With regard to Mahayana dharma, one can often advance and not be regressed. Sharp wisdom and superior blessings are often increased. For all the Concentrations, Dharmas, and Earths, one can quickly become free and not retreat. Often one can meet with good knowledge and follow it accordingly. One can always see all the Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, and Sravakas Being close to and making offerings to the Sangha. When it comes to good roots, the mind is always diligent in seeking it, and the mind is not tired of Bodhisattva vows.

Here we only talk about separation from the wheel of desire; After that, there are two more rounds left!

(Sutra) Fu th, good man! Bodhisattva Mahasattva, able to exhaust all forms of life, is far away from anger and hatred, is bound to be cherished by sentient beings, has a pure mind, and is free from impurities. Through trial, good roots quickly reach maturity. Possessing the five animal circulations of money, a river of birth and death, causes of anger and suffering, creation of body, speech, mind, evil karma obstacles, afflictions, obstacles of sentient beings, obstacles of necessarily dharma, obstacles of ignorance, self-action, teaching others, knowledge of writing, depending on joy. By trying to leave the wheel of anger and anger, the stage will inevitably develop and perish, will be destroyed without residue, and will not receive retribution. In your presence, all the people of heaven and earth are friendly and have no hesitation. Let the mind be pure, free from impurities. At the same time, the body and mind do not feel any urgent pain or suffering, the love for one's wife and relatives is disturbed. At the end of his life, he could not see the envoy of King Yama. Only agreeable views, attain good dharma, practice precepts, be endowed with virtue, have a true field of blessings and good knowledge, rejoice in body and mind, and be deeply reverent. In the final destiny, rebirth in the middle, all organs are perfect, all parts are complete, depending on the place of birth, the mind is pure, free from defilements, upright, intelligent, peaceful, happy.
(Sutra: Come, good man! If Bodhisattva Mahasattva can reach the end of his life, far away Abandoning anger, all sentient beings will always love and respect him, his mind will be pure, free from impurities. Therefore, during the cycle of the five paths, immersed in the river of birth and death in the past, due to anger, evil karma has been created in the body, speech, mind, afflictions, obstacles of sentient beings, all dharma obstacles, obstacles of ignorance, self-doing, teaching others, seeing and hearing according to joy Leaving this "anger", [those karmic hindrances] are crushed and destroyed, leaving no residue, receiving no retribution. In the present body, all human beings and gods are friendly, without doubt or worry. The mind is pure, free from defilements. When about to die, the body and mind are not oppressed by sorrow and suffering, loved by wife and children, and surrounded by relatives. When dying, there is no sight of King Yama Ma's terrifying messenger, only a pleasing person, subdued and achieving good dharma, full of precepts, full of virtue, true field of blessings, good knowledge, happy body and mind, giving birth to deep devotion. After death, reborn as a human, perfect organs, complete body, wherever one is born, the mind is pure, free from defilements, upright, intelligent, peaceful, happy).

This passage has an additional sentence, which is to destroy “obstacles of ignorance”. Anger is big and small. If someone is angry or angry, many people will be in trouble! Like a king, minister, or general, due to one wrong thought, they will create a lot of karma. Like General Bai Qi of the Qin Dynasty, when the Qin state fought with the Zhao state, he ordered to dig a tunnel to bury alive the forty thousand prisoners of the Zhao state he captured in the battle of Truong Binh! He himself suffered endless retribution! One year, the Shanghai press reported that there was a pig with the name “Bai Qi” written on the skin under its belly. That's what Buddha and Bodhisattva just showed us to warn us. There was also a man named Trinh, we won't say his name, he was a specialist, had a secret, swallowed tens of thousands of taels of white silver, and was also turned into a pig. The sow was pregnant that time and gave birth to three piglets. All of them had names written on their stomachs, one was Bach Khoi, the other was the name of a guy named Trinh, and the other pig also had the name of a person who had lived in the Shanghai area. That is karmic retribution, under the belly, there is a name written in red, clearly written as Bach Khoi. What is it? That is retribution. Shanghai newspapers published it to educate people.

How many years have passed since then until now, that time is still very short, he still has to receive retribution. A successful war, tens of thousands of dried remains. Not only were there 10,000 skeletons, there were also 400,000 people at that time. From ancient times until now, no matter where we are, we have never killed soldiers. If we surrender, that's it, let go of our weapons and that's it! He used tricks to deceive and bury them alive. In fact, if one is really desperate, it is very difficult to fight! After tricking them into putting down their weapons, he dug a tunnel and buried them alive. Of course he has all kinds of karma! I still remember a poem: “Oh Nha That Ky Mau” (The black crow has lost its mother), when the black crow dies, it means the old crow dies, the young crow loses its mother. “Long time holding on to the forest” (For many years keeping the old forest), in the past, I was in that forest. "Da da never leaves, only repays mother's kindness" (Every night does not leave, only thinks of repaying mother's gratitude): Every night it cries like that, refusing to fly away. “In possession of fake Ngo Khoi” (Once upon a time there was Ngo Khoi), there was a guy named Ngo Khoi[41], not Bach Khoi. “Mother is buried, her grave never returns” (Mother passed away, did not visit her grave): His mother died, and he did not even visit her grave. "I admire my ancestors, their mind is not like a bird's" (Alas! That type of person's mind is not as good as a bird's). Comparing between humans and animals, sometimes humans are still no different from animals! When I was in prison, there was a doctor whose biological son raped his mother and was sentenced to eighteen years in prison. In the past, that crime was punished by “five horses dismembering” (five horses tearing the body apart), or “five oxen dismembering” (five buffaloes tearing the body apart). That is a great sin, worse than being an animal! Horses absolutely will not mate with their mother horses, and when goats are about to drink milk, they will definitely kneel and kneel to drink milk. That is gratitude.

Whenever evil karma is mentioned, it is mixed with afflictions. Affliction is greed and anger. Our Buddhism focuses on anger the most. All the merit you have accumulated, “one thought of anger arises, burning down the forest of merit”. Whenever you get angry, do you think it's just a bout of anger? Especially you must treat anger, it can bring you a lot of disasters. Regarding anger, you think that getting angry is useless! Families often have disagreements between husband and wife because of one or two angry outbursts, or as in the present day, because of hatred, they kill each other, and the family falls apart. Regarding the importance of a single thought of anger, I must emphasize it a little for everyone's reference. The other things are the same as the scriptures in the previous section. That's talking about the courtyard. You see people getting angry, you see people fighting, many people gather to watch the excitement. Don't watch that excitement! If you crowd around to watch, you might get hurt or they'll hit you by mistake, so don't watch the excitement!

(Sutra) Pleasant enlightenment, attainment of good dharma, precepts, rich virtues, true Field of Merit (puṇyakṣetra) with good knowledge, robe Cultivate and abandon the dharma of hatred and dharma, be able to cut off all evil and unwholesome dharmas, be able to completely overcome good dharmas, be able to seek the absolute meaning of Mahayana dharma, be able to practice all the Bodhisattva vows, and gradually enter the profound and vast ocean of wisdom, until you attain Supreme Bodhi. Living in the Buddhaland, far away from impurities, impurities, wind and clouds, away from dust and dirt, all coarse and ugly objects, all treasures are dignified, even lovable, far away from arrogance, appearance is dignified, all roots are flawless, mind is always calm. Such sentient beings will be born in different countries. Compassionate merit, complete and dignified. The Tathagata himself has an immeasurable life span, and all sentient beings like him preach the Dharma. The final Nirvana, the nine pillars of the Dharma, benefit and bring immeasurable peace to sentient beings. Good man! The name Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat, the ninth generation, leaves anger behind.
(Sutra: Again meeting a pleasing person, subduing and achieving good dharma, fulfilling precepts, rich in virtue, true Field of Merit (puṇyakṣetra) Becoming a wise person, following him, cultivating, leaving behind all evil and unwholesome dharmas, can achieve all the superior good dharmas, can pray for all the Mahayana dharmas, can practice all the Bodhisattva's vows, gradually enter the deep ocean of wisdom, until he attains Supreme Bodhi, he is far away from all filth, wind and clouds, burned with earthly structures and gross things, and is adorned. Dignified with precious treasures, far away from pride and arrogance, with a dignified appearance, with all the senses intact, and with a calm mind, such sentient beings will be born in that world. The Tathagata himself will receive an immeasurable life span, and after the Buddha enters Nirvana, the Dharma will last a long time, benefiting countless sentient beings. This is called the ninth wheel of separation from anger Khue” of Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat).

“Enlightenment pleasingly, become a good dharma, have good precepts, rich in virtue, a true field of blessings, a good knowledge” (Once again meet a pleasing person, tame and achieve good dharma, fulfill the precepts, be rich in virtue, a true Field of Merit (puṇyakṣetra) to become a good knowledge): Relying on that good knowledge, “studying to let go of anger and hatred law”. If you want to leave the Dharma of anger and suffering, what should you do? Must be patient. Based on your daily practice, when you are about to get angry, enter the Buddha hall. Or at a time when there is no Buddha hall, you yourself have to sit still. If you are already sitting still, you can recite Buddha's name, and you can also recite sutras. Whenever you recite, your mind will be clear and your anger will calm down! When you're angry, don't deal with work. When your mind is not comfortable, don't respond to anything, you must definitely overcome it. You practice gradually like that, that is also the way to practice.

Having been patient again, Truong Cong was patient[42], wrote one word Forbearance but could not endure it, then wrote another word, still unable to endure, wrote another word. Must be patient! Forbearance is very difficult! [Forbearance is] above the word Tam, there is a sharp sword (sharp knife), it's very painful! Rings have such great power! Especially when afflictions arise, you will create karma. It's not just your body that creates karma! [anger] arises in the mind, it will come out through the mouth, cursing others. If you curse as much as you can, then beat him, beat him and then swing a knife, or open a gun, adding to his life's debt, and he will be locked up in prison. At that time, you will not have time to regret, and you will still have to pay for your life. You must be patient, every cycle is like that. But for this yard, there's a little more to say. It's very difficult for you to leave it. People who get used to the habit of getting angry will find it very difficult to break away!

Furthermore, whenever anger, resentment, in the family, it is especially easy to arise [this is the most likely]: You are angry with your child and scold him every day. Whatever it does, you immediately use it and reprimand it. Just like that, even if they are biological parents, the child will still be considered a grudge! Either it will grow up and leave you, or it will still want revenge. I have encountered many cases of revenge! No need to say too much, when others make mistakes, don't get angry, forgive others. You often think like that, once or twice it doesn't work, just try many times, gradually you will get it. Because someone else is not you, even though [that person] was born from you, they still don't have the same mind as you. Your way of thinking and their way of thinking must be different, you must be patient with this. By learning to leave the dharma of anger like that, you can practice all the vows of the Bodhisattva, gradually entering the deep ocean of wisdom, until you attain Supreme Bodhi.

The Buddha land that person resides in, “is far away from all impurities, dust and clouds, is exposed to the worldly structure, all coarse things, they are dignified, even lovely to mock” (away from all dirt, wind, clouds, impurities, impurities, gross things, [and] obtains the solemn and lovely treasures" like). It is a matter of protecting the ecological environment, [the current environment] is dirty, turbid, especially polluted water. The wind blew, [the dirty things] were lifted into the air, and in the air turned into dark clouds. Anything that is black is mixed with impurities. “Distilling” means when the sun rises, it will heat up and they will evaporate immediately. After evaporating, it falls to the ground and turns into coarse objects. If those rough objects fall into water or food, they will also be poisoned. The gas of resentment is more intense than any toxic thing, that is, as we just said “wrath, resentment”. Anyone who encounters resentment is afraid of it. If this country slaughters people on a large scale, like a great battlefield, tens of thousands of people die, hundreds of thousands of people die, that kind of resentment rushes into the air, condensing into a kind of resentment that whoever passes by that place, if they don't avoid or touch it, the gods will have no way to save them!

The venom of sentient beings is extremely intense. Many Buddhist scriptures that study this thing say resentment is more severe than anything else. Therefore, that person [by staying away from anger] has transformed the coarse things that were created by the elements, transforming those things into “dignified treasures, even worthy of ridicule” (dignified treasures, very lovable). “Away from pride and arrogance, the appearance is dignified, the senses are flawless, the mind is always at peace” (Away from arrogance, arrogance, the appearance is dignified, the senses are not defective, the mind is always at peace). Adding “calmness”, which means that the mind is always calm, always quiet, peaceful, not scattered, and has no troubles, only then can concentration be achieved. Why are our hearts restless? Even though I don't get angry, the root in it is the negativity that wants to flare up, but can't. Or by suppressing it, it won't erupt, and your mind will feel restless and uncomfortable! Therefore, the mind must always be calm, don't be sad, don't be restless. Such is the state of that person (who has left anger and hatred)! Everyone whose mind is always calm, far from arrogance, will be born in that realm, all of them are “compassionate, meritorious, complete and dignified”. The opposite of anger is compassion. Therefore, towards all living beings, we must be compassionate. People who practice Compassion will not get angry, nor will they get angry!

There is another type of Bodhisattva appearing: "Your temper is too hot, I am hotter than you! If you mess up again, I will kill you!" Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara) in Han is very compassionate; In Tibet he is not like that. He appears like the demon king, the Horsehead Vajra (Hayagriva)[43], or Dai Minh Vajra, manifesting many Vajra signs. General Kim Cang is very fierce. That is true compassion, subduing their afflictions. If we want to overcome their afflictions, we can't do it! We can only be patient, we still don't have that power!

(Sutra) Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat accomplished the test of samsara, Śāvārṇa, attained non-enlightenment, Śārāvāra The Mahayana Sutra Vehicle attains the unenlightened state, the Single Enlightenment Vehicle attains the unenlightened state, the Single Enlightenment Vehicle Mahayana attains the unenlightened state, the Mahayana attains the unenlightened state, the Mahayana Sutra Mahayana attains the unenlightened state, and is always capable of naturalizing the Three Jewels. The disciples of the Tathagata who became monks, weak in seeing the dharma weapon, weak in the non-dharma weapon, the summer will are bound to have a ca-sa, the world's cultivator has achieved the loss of enlightenment. According to the Mahayana Dharma, there is often advancement and advancement, with no regression. Gaining wisdom, winning blessings, often achieving growth. With absolute Concentration, the Da-lanis, the Rings, the Earths, quickly attain freedom, without any regression. Always attain enlightenment and enlightenment with good knowledge, and act according to your will. Always attaining the view of all Buddhas, meeting Bodhisattvas and Shravaka disciples, not separating from literature and dharma, not being close to each other, and making offerings to the Sangha. All of you with good roots, always strive diligently, with a mind without attachment. Always, Bodhi, the race of vows, the mind of non-attachment. Sin attaining retribution, preaches like money.
Do not make mistakes with the Sravaka Vehicle, don't make mistakes with the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle, don't make mistakes with the Pratyekayana, don't make mistakes with the Mahayana, don't make mistakes with the Mahayana Bodhisattva, can often flourish for the monastic disciples of the Tathagata, whether they are dharma weapons, or not, even for all those who wear a piece of kasa, shave off their hair and beard. All of them do not make mistakes. With regard to the Mahayana dharma, they are often enhanced and do not retreat. The wisdom and merit are always increased. In all the Concentrations, the Dharmas, and the Grounds, they are quickly at peace and do not retreat. They often meet the good knowledge and follow it. They often see the Buddha and the Sravakas base, often diligently seek, the mind is not bored enough. Often with Bodhisattva vows, the mind is not bored. Achieve the retribution as extensively in the previous section).

A person who studies the Three Vehicles Dharma, or learns the Second Vehicle Dharma, if both the Dharma and the person are not "enlightened", that means they are not mistaken. "If one preaches the Dharma, one can often bring forth the Three Jewels' nature" (Depending on the appropriate foundation, one can preach the Dharma, one can often flourish the Three Jewels): For the monastic disciples of the Tathagatas, no matter which Buddha realm they are in, the vast majority are talking about this land of ours. "Weak dharma weapon, weak non-dharma weapon" (Whether it is a dharma weapon, or not a dharma weapon), the world of Ultimate Bliss does not have "non-dharma weapon", of course referring to this [Sa Ba] realm. In all countries similar to ours, "the summer solstice is bound to be covered with a piece of ka-sa, the world of cultivating one can attain enlightenment" (even for all those who wear a piece of ka-sa, shave off their hair and beard, do not make mistakes): Not only is there no mistake regarding the three vehicles, but even for someone who only wears a piece of ka-sa, that person must have good roots, must have a cause and condition, one must observe the past of that person. that.

(Sutra) Fu th, good man! Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas are capable of exhausting their life and abandoning wrong views. All sentient beings will always cherish their love, their minds will be pure, and they will separate from evil. Through trial, good roots quickly reach maturity. Possessing the five animal circulations of money, a river of birth and death, wrong views of human beings, creation of body, speech, mind, obstacles of evil karma, obstacles of afflictions, obstacles of sentient beings, obstacles of necessarily dharma, obstacles of right views, self-action, teaching others, seeing texts depending on joy, due to trial, far away from wrong views, the wheel of attachments, the stage will inevitably develop, disappear without residue, and receive no retribution. In the middle of the body, all human beings are of the same level, with love and affection, without any worries, with a peaceful body and mind, a pure mind, and no distinction between evil and evil. At the same time, the body and mind do not feel any urgent pain or suffering, the love for one's wife and relatives is disturbed. At the end of his life, he will not be able to declare the King of Flames, he will only have a pleasant view, he will achieve good dharma, he will be precepted, he will be endowed with virtue, he will be truly blessed, he will be a wise man, he will be happy in body and mind, and will be deeply trusted. In the final destiny, rebirth in the middle, all bases are perfect, all parts are complete, depending on the place of birth, the mind is pure, separate from evil, upright, intelligent, peaceful, happy.
(Sutra: Come here, good man! If Bodhisattva Ma Ha A person who is able to stay away from wrong views until the end of his life will be loved and respected by all sentient beings. His mind will be pure and free from evil discrimination. Therefore, in all the times of rotation in the five paths of life, he will be immersed in the river of birth and death in the past. Due to wrong views, he will create evil karma in the body, speech, mind, afflictions, obstacles in sentient beings, all dharma obstacles, right views, and teach others. Others, seeing and hearing are happy. Due to this wheel of "abandoning wrong views", all [those karmic hindrances] are crushed, destroyed, and do not receive retribution. In the present body, the gods and humans are all friendly, without doubt or worry, the mind is pure, and when about to die, the body and mind are not surrounded by sorrow and grief King Yama Ma, only sees people who are satisfied, subdues good dharmas, is full of morality, is rich in virtue, is a true blessed person, makes good knowledge, is happy in body and mind, gives birth to deep faith. After death, he is reborn as a human, his organs are perfect, his body is complete, wherever he is, his mind is pure, free from evil and discrimination, righteous, intelligent, peaceful, happy).

“Forbidden, good man! If Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat can end his life and leave wrong views” (Come again, good man! If Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat can until the end of his life, stay away from wrong views): Ignorance is also ignorance. People without wisdom will develop wrong views. Buddha said that those who destroy views cannot be saved. “Views” are attachments. There are people who don't let go of attachments! You speak good dharma to them, they have no way to listen! "Wrong knowledge, wrong view": If that person, because he has attained Divine Eye Insight, sees a cow being born to heaven, then says: "Being a cow is the best! After death, he can be born to heaven!" That person doesn't understand what that cow's previous life was like, and doesn't know cause and effect. That person's supernatural powers can only see this life, not eighty thousand great kalpas, nor countless great kalpas, but only see what is in front of him, so he says that cows have great merit. Therefore, every day that person bows to cows and does not believe in Buddha. In front of the Buddha statue, that person does not bow, but can bow to six cows!

When I went to Calcutta in India, there was a road with probably a thousand cows, scary big, several times bigger than us! The cow's head has a pearl attached and is covered in colorful cotton fabric. There are also people who use yellow silk to form a ball and wear it around the cow's body. The cow walks on the street, wherever the house goes, roughly that house brings it food to fill it up, and the cleanest filtered water for it to drink. The whole road worships cows. If you don't know, or if you bump into a cow, that's okay! People on that street will risk their lives for you. When I arrived there in 1940, at that time, World War II had not yet ended, India was not yet independent, still dominated by Britain. The British also did not dare to touch the cows, because they knew they would bring trouble. If they drive through that neighborhood, they will drive in a roundabout way, not straight on that road. If they cannot avoid driving through that road, they will drive slowly, wait for the cow to pass and the road is clear before driving. If the cow hasn't passed by yet, you can't chase it away. That is the wrong knowledge and wrong view of pagans, there is no way! If it were a little more realistic, in this country of ours, there are too many people who believe in wrong knowledge and wrong views! There are billions of people in this world who believe in wrong knowledge and wrong views, but there are quite a few right views and right views. Continent has thirteen billion people, how many people have right knowledge and right view? Even among monks and nuns, there are still very few people with right knowledge and right view.

But in the Ten Wheels, speaking according to common wrong views, they are all the same

each other, that is, stupidity, which is ignorance in greed, anger, and ignorance. Every day we see things incorrectly, judge incorrectly, are foolish, and cannot understand "emptiness of dependently arising dharmas". That is foolishness. All dharmas arise from “dependent origination of emptiness”, we must hope to return to dependent origination of emptiness; That is the most basic thing in studying Buddhism. That will be able to destroy your wrong views. If you stay away from wrong views, the retribution you will achieve will be ripe, that is “leaving the wheel of wrong views”.

As for wrong discrimination, if you have no power of Concentration, no wisdom, in your mind you think and discriminate, it's all wrong knowledge and wrong views. That wrong knowledge and wrong view is not at all the wrong knowledge and wrong views of pagans, but in your mind, whatever is not peaceful, whatever is not pure, it belongs to wrong knowledge and wrong views. A little deeper, there will be not seeing the nature of the Dharma, the mind is beyond the path, the mind is beyond the Bodhi path, thinking about things that are not the Bodhi path, that is called "wrong view". That's talking about things that don't follow the Buddha's teachings, that can't end Suffering, Origin, Cessation, and the Path, that can't rely on the Four Noble Truths to practice, that can't rely on the dharma of the twelve causes and conditions to practice, that can't rely on the dharma of the Six Dharmas to practice, these are all wrong views. If you stay away from evil discrimination, in your mind there will be no wrong views, always rely on right view, rely on Buddha's teachings to practice, then leave evil discrimination, what good results will there be? When you die, your body and mind will not be suffering. "If you love your wife, your relatives will be disturbed. At the end of your life, you will not be able to announce the envoy of King Yama Ma" (Loved by your wife and children and surrounded by relatives. When you die, you will not see the terrifying messenger of King Yama Ma), only see the person who pleases you, subdues and achieves good dharma, completes the precepts, is rich in virtue, and has a true field of blessings to make good knowledge for you. “The body and mind are happy, giving birth to deep devotion” (The body and mind are happy, giving birth to deep devotion): In this way, there will be a peaceful, leisurely transition into the world. After death, he was reborn among humans.

(Sutra) Achieving enlightenment, achieving good dharma, morality, rich virtue, true field of blessings, good knowledge, practice Constantly practice learning to abandon evil and see the dharma, be able to completely cut off all evil and unwholesome dharmas, be able to completely overcome good dharmas, be diligent in seeking the absolute meaning of Mahayana Dharma, be diligent in cultivating all Bodhisattva vows, gradually enter the ocean of Mahayana, and attain Supreme Bodhi. Staying in the Buddhaland, far away from all the Sravakas, Single Enlightenment of the two vehicles of human beings, far away from all the demons, far away from all heretical sects, far away from the solemn, even lovable and mocking people, far away from all delusions of good and evil, Permanent Views, Breaking Views, ego, ego views. Such sentient beings will be born in different countries, will have a long life, will enjoy the one taste, will attain the status of Mahayana. The Tathagata himself, with an immeasurable life span, teaches the Dharma to all sentient beings. After the final Nirvana, the true dharma has nine pillars, benefits, peace, countless sentient beings, the holy teaching is one taste, there is no handle, the system is prosperous, free from all obstacles. Good man! The title of Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat, the tenth, is far removed from evil views.
Precepts, rich in virtue, true blessings and good knowledge. By following that person and cultivating the dharma of abandoning wrong views, he can cut off all evil and unwholesome dharmas, can achieve all the supreme good dharmas, can pray for all Mahayana dharmas, can practice all the vows of the Bodhisattva, and gradually enter the ocean of Mahayana, until he attains the Supreme Bodhisattva world, far away from all people and dharmas belonging to the two vehicles of the Sravaka and Pratyekabuddhas. Stay away from all the heavenly demons, stay away from all heretical factions, all the precious ornaments that are so lovely, stay away from all the illusions and attachments to good and evil, the Eternal View, the Ending View, the self, and my view (self view). Such sentient beings are born in that country, have a long life, enjoy a Buddha, that is, the Tathagata himself has an unlimited life, because the living beings preach the Dharma in accordance with the basis. The Dharma lasts a long time, benefits and brings peace to countless sentient beings, the holy teaching never opposes or conflicts, flows brightly, and is free from all obstacles. That is called the tenth wheel of separation.

wrong view" of Bodhisattva Mahasattva).

“Enlightenment pleasantly, become a good dharma, have good precepts, rich in virtue, a true Field of Merit (puṇyakṣetra), a good knowledge” (Once again meet a pleasing person, subdue and achieve good dharma, have enough precepts, be rich in virtue, a true Field of Merit (puṇyakṣetra) to become a good knowledge): It refers to that good knowledge, how to practice to leave wrong views, practice this method how. “Ability to completely cut off all evil and unwholesome dharmas, ability to achieve necessarily superior good dharmas, ability to seek the absolute meaning of Mahayana Dharma, ability to practice all Bodhisattva vows, gradually enter the great ocean of Mahayana, one will attain Supreme Bodhi” (Can cut off all evil and unwholesome dharmas, can achieve all superior good dharmas, can pray for all Mahayana dharmas, can cultivate all Bodhisattva vows, gradually enter the sea the entire Mahayana, until attaining Supreme Bodhi): Thus, the Buddha realm in which that person is "far away from all Sravakas, Pratyekabuddhas of the two human dharmas, far away from all the heavenly demons, far away from pagans with the party, they are solemn, even likable" (away from all people and dharmas belonging to the two vehicles of Sravakas and Pratyekabuddhas, away from all followers of heavenly demons, away from all pagan cliques, all precious things very dignified and lovely): Only by leaving the wheel of wrong views can we talk about "leaving all dharmas of the Second Vehicle, Thanh Van and Single Enlightenment", and the other nine wheels do not exist. That is called “right view”.

Because here it is talking about wrong views, "far away from all false attachments to good and bad, Permanent Views, Ending Views, self, ego views. As with sentient beings, they will be born in a different country" (away from all false and false attachments to good and bad, Permanent Views, Ending Views, self, and my view. Such sentient beings will be born in our country): To be born in that Buddha land is not ordinary, to be far away from all demons and evil views. That person will be far away from all illusions and attachments to good and evil. If we wish to be reborn in the Pure Land, do you still wish to predict our lives and fortunes? The Contemplation Sutra is completely different. You want to use the Contemplation Wheel to ask: "Can I be born in the Pure Land?" You contemplate for a while, Ksitigarbha Contemplation Wheel will say: "If you want to be born in the world of Ultimate Bliss, you still have to work hard." If you say "it's possible to be reborn", then you have a firm grasp of [the story of rebirth], and you have to put in more effort, but the chances of such contemplation are very few!

The Contemplation Wheel will rarely immediately say: "You can be reborn", but if you want to ask which way you were born from in the past, and which way will you be reborn when you die, the Contemplation Wheel will give the correct answer. If you are afraid, [afraid that you] will be born in the three evil realms, practice quickly! Don't you sow [the wheel of contemplation] every day? Every day you bow, every day you sow, and bow to a certain level, the three evils will rotate, and you will be able to be reborn. That form of the wheel is different from good, evil, misfortune, good fortune, Permanent View, Ending View, ego, self-view, self-view, all of which belong to wrong view. Get rid of attachments to good, evil, misfortune, and false blessings. Good, bad, bad, and blessed cannot be argued as fixed, it is always changing! Especially for disciples of the Three Jewels, for those who study the Dharma, it will always change. Human appearance is always changing. If you pay attention and observe a person's appearance, you will see that in one day, it changes several times. If a few days later, look at that person again, his appearance will change again. You see that person is very boring, has an obnoxious appearance, and speaks boringly. Two days later, looking back at that person, you will feel joy, because that person has practice. Currently, if a person meditates and recites Buddha's name for a few days, when the corresponding recitation comes, his appearance immediately changes. “Turning” is not like in the world, having a rosy face, or being white, or being good-looking, it's not like that. That kind of virtuous person will impress you and make your heart happy. You see an old monk or an old lama, his appearance is very ugly, very dirty, but when you meet him, you will have a heart of reverence and special reverence towards him. That is due to his virtue!

Must leave everything, leave Permanent View and End View. Perpetual View refers to Permanence, that is, always thinking that there is immortality, or "even after death, one can still be born as a human", not believing in hell, hungry ghosts, or animals. That is wrong view. After being born, I will definitely be born in heaven, which heaven will I be born in? Born to God, born to Brahma. You still have a place separate from God and Brahma, you don't go there to become the Great Brahma God, you can only be a citizen of heaven. Those are all incorrect views. Permanent View, Enduring View, or Ego View, Ego Clinging Ego View, Ego View are things or people that we are attached to. Nga Kien and Nga So Kien are two things. The Self is the ability to see (the subject sees), and the Self's View is what is seen by the Self. Such sentient beings are born in that country, in that land there are no people with wrong views, “long life span, enjoying one taste” (long life span, enjoying one taste): What kind of taste is enjoyed? Mahayana. "The Tathagata himself, with an unlimited life span, preaches the Dharma to all sentient beings. After Nirvana, the Dharma lasts for a long time, it benefits and brings peace to countless sentient beings, the holy teachings are one to one" (The Tathagata himself has an unlimited lifespan, for all sentient beings to preach the Dharma according to the foundation. After the Buddha entered Nirvana, the Dharma lasts for a long time, benefits and peace to countless sentient beings, one holy teachings to one person). This is the disagreement, in the previous part it was “like teaching the Dharma” (preaching the Dharma according to the basis), this is the disagreement: The Buddha taught one person, there is no debate about Mahayana, or debate about Shravakayana, or Pratyekabuddhayana, the nature of the Three Jewels are all Mahayana. “Xi prosperous circulation” (Circulating radiantly), all are Bodhisattvas, all obstacles are absent. “Good man! This is Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat's tenth wheel of staying away from wrong views” (Hey good man! That is the tenth wheel of "leaving wrong views" of Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat).

(Kinh) Bồ Tát Ma Ha Tát thành tựu thử luân cố, ư Thanh Văn Thừa đắc vô ngộ thất, ư Thanh Văn Thừa Bổ Đặc Già La đắc vô ngộ thất, ư Độc Giác Thừa đắc vô ngộ thất, ư Độc Giác Thừa Bổ Đặc Già La đắc vô ngộ thất, ư kỳ Đại Thừa đắc vô ngộ thất, ư kỳ Đại Thừa Bổ Đặc Già La đắc vô ngộ thất, thường năng xí nhiên Tam Bảo chủng tánh. Ư chư Như Lai xuất gia đệ tử, nhược thị pháp khí, nhược phi pháp khí, hạ chí nhất thiết bị phiến ca-sa, thế tu phát giả, đắc vô ngộ thất. Ư Đại Thừa pháp, thường đắc thăng tấn, vô hữu thoái chuyển. Lợi huệ, thắng phước, thường đắc tăng trưởng. Ư nhất thiết Định, chư Đà-la-ni, chư Nhẫn, chư Địa, tốc đắc tự tại, vô hữu thoái chuyển, thường đắc trị ngộ chư thiện tri thức, tùy thuận nhi hành. Thường đắc bất ly kiến nhất thiết Phật, cập chư Bồ Tát, Thanh Văn đệ tử, bất ly văn pháp, bất ly thân cận, cúng dường chúng Tăng. Ư chư thiện căn, thường tinh tấn cầu, tâm vô yếm túc. Thường ư Bồ Đề chủng chủng hạnh nguyện, Lục Ba La Mật Đa, tâm vô yếm túc. Sở đắc quả báo, quảng thuyết như tiền.
(Kinh: Bồ Tát Ma Ha Tát do thành tựu luân này, chẳng phạm sai lầm đối với Thanh Văn Thừa, chẳng phạm sai lầm đối với Thanh Văn Thừa Bổ Đặc Già La, chẳng phạm sai lầm đối với Độc Giác Thừa, chẳng phạm sai lầm đối với Độc Giác Thừa Bổ Đặc Già La, chẳng phạm sai lầm đối với Đại Thừa, chẳng phạm sai lầm đối với Đại Thừa Bổ Đặc Già La. Thường có thể hưng thịnh chủng tánh Tam Bảo. Đối với các đệ tử xuất gia của các đức Như Lai, dù là pháp khí, hay chẳng phải là pháp khí, cho đến đối với hết thảy những kẻ khoác một mảnh ca-sa, cạo bỏ râu tóc, đều chẳng phạm sai lầm. Đối với pháp Đại Thừa, thường được thăng tấn, chẳng bị thoái chuyển. Trí huệ nhạy bén và phước thù thắng thường được tăng trưởng. Trong hết thảy các Định, các Đà-la-ni, các Nhẫn, các Địa, mau được tự tại, chẳng bị thoái chuyển. Thường được gặp gỡ các thiện tri thức, tùy thuận hành theo. Thường được chẳng lìa thấy hết thảy Phật, và các Bồ Tát, Thanh Văn đệ tử. Chẳng lìa nghe pháp, chẳng lìa thân cận, cúng dường chúng Tăng. Đối với các thiện căn, thường tinh tấn cầu, tâm chẳng chán đủ. Thường đối với các thứ hạnh nguyện Bồ Đề, Lục Ba La Mật Đa, tâm chẳng chán đủ. Đạt được quả báo như trên đã rộng nói).
(Kinh) Thiện nam tử! Nhược Bồ Tát Ma Ha Tát thành tựu như thị Thập Luân, năng tốc chứng đắc A Nậu Đa La Tam Miệu Tam Bồ Đề. Sở dĩ giả hà? Ư quá khứ thế, nhất thiết Như Lai, Ứng Chánh Đẳng Giác, giai tất viễn ly Thập Ác Nghiệp Đạo, giai tất xưng dương, tán thán như thị Thập Thiện Nghiệp Đạo sở đắc quả báo, vị dục trưởng dưỡng nhất thiết chúng sanh lợi ích, an lạc Bồ Đề đạo cố, vị dục trừ diệt nhất thiết chúng sanh nghiệp phiền não khổ, linh vô dư cố, vị dục khô kiệt tam ác thú cố, vị dục thiệu long Tam Bảo chủng cố, vị dục đoạn trừ tam giới hữu cố, vi dục vĩnh đoạn Uẩn, Giới, Xứ cố, vị linh nhất thiết tốc nhập vô úy Niết Bàn thành cố, quảng thuyết như tiền, viễn ly thập chủng bất thiện nghiệp đạo, sở đắc quả báo. Thị cố, thiện nam tử! Nhược bất chân thật hy cầu như thị Thập Thiện Nghiệp Đạo sở chứng Phật quả, cập bất chân thật hạ chí thủ hộ nhất thiện nghiệp đạo, nãi chí mạng chung, nhi tự xưng ngôn: “Ngã thị chân thật hành Đại Thừa giả, ngã cầu Vô Thượng Chánh Đẳng Bồ Đề”. Đương tri như thị Bổ Đặc Già La, thị cực hư trá, thị đại vọng ngữ, đối thập phương giới Phật Thế Tôn tiền, cuống hoặc thế gian, vô tàm, vô quý, thuyết Không đoạn kiến, dụ cuống ngu si, thân hoại mạng chung, đọa chư ác thú.
(Kinh: Này thiện nam tử! Nếu Bồ Tát Ma Ha Tát thành tựu mười luân như thế, có thể mau chứng đắc A Nậu Đa La Tam Miệu Tam Bồ Đề. Vì cớ sao vậy? Trong đời quá khứ, hết thảy Như Lai, Ứng Chánh Đẳng Giác thảy đều xa lìa Thập Ác Nghiệp Đạo, thảy đều xưng dương, tán thán quả báo đạt được do Thập Thiện Nghiệp Đạo như thế, vì muốn trưởng dưỡng lợi ích cho hết thảy cúng sanh, an lạc Bồ Đề đạo, vì muốn trừ diệt nghiệp phiền não khổ chẳng còn sót thừa cho hết thảy chúng sanh, vì muốn khô cạn ba đường ác, vì muốn tiếp nối hưng thịnh chủng tánh Tam Bảo, vì muốn đoạn trừ tam giới hữu, vì muốn đoạn vĩnh viễn Uẩn, Giới, Xứ, vì khiến cho hết thảy mau vào tòa thành Niết Bàn không sợ hãi. Nói rộng thì như quả báo đã đạt được do xa lìa mười thứ bất thiện nghiệp đạo đã nói trong phần trên. Do vậy, thiện nam tử! Nếu chẳng chân thật mong cầu Phật quả được chứng bởi Thập Thiện Nghiệp Đạo như thế, và chẳng chân thật tối thiểu là thủ hộ một thiện nghiệp đạo cho đến khi mạng chung, mà tự xưng là: “Ta là người thật sự hành Đại Thừa. Ta cầu Vô Thượng Chánh Đẳng Bồ Đề”. Hãy nên biết Bổ Đặc Già La như thế là kẻ hư dối tột bậc, là đại vọng ngữ, đối trước mười phương thế giới Phật Thế Tôn mà dối gạt, mê hoặc thế gian, không hổ, không thẹn, nói Đoạn Kiến rỗng tuếch, dụ dỗ, lường gạt kẻ ngu si. Thân hoại, mạng chung, sẽ đọa vào các đường ác).

Đây là nói chung. Quá khứ chư Phật có thể thành tựu Thập Luân, Bồ Tát Ma Ha Tát chứng đắc A Nậu Đa La Tam Miệu Tam Bồ Đề rất nhanh chóng. Vì sao phải nói như vậy? Vì hết thảy các đức Như Lai sở dĩ có thể thành Phật, thành tựu Chánh Giác, là do xa lìa Thập Ác Nghiệp. Do vậy, thảy đều xưng dương, tán thán quả báo đạt được do Thập Thiện Nghiệp Đạo như thế. “Vị dục trưởng dưỡng nhất thiết chúng sanh, lợi ích, an lạc Bồ Đề đạo cố” [nghĩa là] khiến cho đạo Bồ Đề của chúng sanh có thể trưởng dưỡng, dần dần tăng trưởng, nuôi dưỡng dần dần. “Vị dục diệt trừ nhất thiết chúng sanh nghiệp, phiền não, khổ, linh vô dư cố” (Vì muốn trừ diệt nghiệp, phiền não, khổ chẳng còn sót cho hết thảy chúng sanh): [Cái nhân của] nghiệp là Hoặc (phiền não). “Nghiệp” [ở đây] là nói đến các nghiệp do quý vị đã tạo. Phiền não là Hoặc, Khổ là cái quả [của nghiệp]. Do phiền não mà tạo nghiệp, vì tạo nghiệp mà gặt lấy khổ quả. Như vậy thì [do tu Thập Luân], sẽ khiến cho chúng chẳng còn thừa sót, thanh tịnh ba món Hoặc, Nghiệp, Khổ, khiến cho chúng thanh tịnh. Đồng thời, khiến cho ba đường ác khô kiệt. Vì phải khô kiệt ba đường ác thì mới có thể “thiệu long” (tiếp nối hưng thịnh) chủng tánh Tam Bảo. “Thiệu” là kế thừa, “long” là rạng rỡ, to lớn. Không chỉ tiếp tục kế thừa, mà còn khiến cho chủng tánh Tam Bảo Phật, Pháp, Tăng phát dương quang đại. “Vị dục đoạn trừ tam giới hữu cố” (Vì muốn đoạn trừ tam giới hữu). Tam giới có sanh tử, có phiền não, có khổ não, có nghiệp, [cho nên gọi là Hữu], đều đoạn tuyệt các thứ đó. Lại còn mong đoạn tuyệt, tức là vĩnh viễn đoạn dứt Ngũ Uẩn, Thập Bát Giới, Thập Nhị Xứ. “Vị linh nhất thiết tốc nhập vô úy Niết Bàn thành cố, quảng thuyết như tiền viễn ly thập chủng bất thiện nghiệp đạo, sở đắc quả báo” (Vì khiến cho hết thảy mau chóng vào tòa thành Niết Bàn không sợ hãi, nói rộng là như quả báo sẽ đạt được do xa lìa mười loại bất thiện nghiệp đạo trong phần trước). Nói xong lại tổng kết một lượt. Trong phần trên, đối với mỗi luân đều đã nói rồi.

“Thought, good man! Weaknesses do not truly hope like the Ten Good Karmas Path to attain Buddhahood, not truly protect the most good karma” (Therefore, good men! If you do not sincerely hope for Buddhahood to be realized by such a Ten Good Karmas, and do not at least truly protect one good karma path): Even a good path of karma cannot be truly protected. “Until death” (Until death): If you don't do that, you're lying! “Nhi says to herself: - I am a true practitioner of Mahayana” (But claims to be: “I am a true practitioner of Mahayana”): Regarding the Ten Good Karma Paths, even a path that you cannot do, still say that you truly practice Mahayana, or say that you pray for the Supreme Bodhisattva! Bo Dac Gia La speaks like that “extreme falsehood” (ultimate deceit, deceit), lies, deceit, “great false language”, the ultimate lie. “Towards the world-Honored Buddha of the ten directions, the world, without shame, without preciousness, preaches the view of no annihilation” (In front of the Buddha-world of the ten directions, the World-Honored One deceives, deceives the world, is not ashamed, not ashamed, speaks of an empty view of annihilation): What is the standard of that empty Annihilation View? Ten Good Karmas! Using [those false words] to "seduce the foolish" [i.e.] deceive, seduce, and deceive those who have no wisdom, to the point of saying "do like that, say like that" you are the most foolish person. That person said it himself. If "the body perishes and death occurs", that person will fall directly into the evil destinies as quickly as an arrow, and be born straight into the evil destinies.

(Sutra) Good man! If you are weak in speech, or in listening to literature, without practicing the Ten Good Karmas, you will be able to attain Bodhi, attain Nirvana, in the middle kalpa, or in just one moment of thought, you will be able to reach the Buddhas of the ten directions, save the earth, the world, and count the number of sentient beings, reach the stage of Perfect Enlightenment, enter Nirvana, and yet there will be no visible things. The reason why it's fake? The Ten Good Karmas reveal the original Mahayana, the Bodhi cause, and the eternally solid Nirvana. Good man! If one develops the mind and vows, without practicing the Ten Good Karmas, one can attain Bodhi and attain Nirvana. In the middle kalpa or one moment of thought, the spirit of the ten directions can reach all Buddhas on the earth and the earth to count the number of sentient beings, attain the stage of Perfect Enlightenment, and enter Nirvana, but there is no visible matter. The reason why it's fake? The Ten Good Karmas, in this world, overcome the retribution of fundamental merit. Good man! If you do not practice the Ten Good Karmas, set the sutras of the ten directions, all Buddhas will save all the worlds of kalpas, call yourself Mahayana, or preach, or hear, or make a wish, or make a vow, you will not be able to attain Bodhi and Nirvana, and you will not be able to escape the suffering of birth and death. Good man! Mainly due to practicing the Ten Good Karmas, the worldly friends of the Kshatriyas, Brahmins, rich aristocrats, the Four Great Kings, the Land of Neither Perception, Neither Non-Perception, or the Sravaka Vehicle, or the Single Enlightenment Vehicle, the Supreme Bodhisattva, will practice the Ten Good Karmas of different types.
(Sutra: Good man! If you only talk, and only listen, it is not practicing the Ten Virtues The Path of Karma, which can achieve Bodhi, nirvana, in one lifetime, or in one thought, can cause all sentient beings as many as particles of dust or like the number of people in the land of all Buddha realms to attain Enlightenment, enter Parinirvana, there is no such thing. Why is that? The Ten Good Karmas are the root of Mahayana, the cause of Bodhi, the solid ladder to achieve Nirvana. Dear good man, if only through the strength of the mind and the vow, without practicing the Ten Virtuous Karmas, one can attain Bodhi and nirvana, either in one lifetime or within the span of a single thought, one can cause sentient beings as many as the dust particles in all the Buddha realms to attain Enlightenment and enter Parinirvana, then why is this the basis of the supreme merit and retribution in the world? If you do not practice the Ten Good Karmas, even if you go through countless kalpas in all the Buddha realms in the ten directions, calling yourself Mahayana, or speaking, or listening, or just making a vow, you will not be able to attain Bodhisattva, nor will you be able to help others escape the suffering of birth and death. Brahmins, noble and wealthy lineages, etc. The Four Great Heavens, up to the Land of Neither Perception nor Non-Perception, or the Shravaka Vehicle, or the Single Enlightenment Vehicle, up to the Supreme Bodhisattva, are all due to practicing the Ten Virtuous Karma Paths according to each different level).

“Good man! If you are weak in speaking, not listening to literature, if you do not practice the Ten Good Karma Paths, you will attain Bodhi and attain Nirvana” (Good man! If you only talk and only listen, you will not be able to attain Bodhi and Nirvana by practicing the Ten Good Karma Paths); that is impossible! Suppose we say it like this, if we only discuss, listen and accept, without practicing the Ten Good Karmas, we can attain Bodhi and Nirvana; That's impossible! Or “in the middle kalpa” (in one kalpa), heard like that, or in the space of a single thought, [heard like that] that “can be able to reach the Buddha world of the ten directions and measure the number of sentient beings, reach the stage of Enlightenment, enter nirvana, and yet have no world” (can cause all sentient beings as many as motes or like calculating the number in the earth of all Buddha realms to be able to attain enlightenment. Enlightenment, entering Parinirvana, there is no such thing): To say it like that would be impossible! In other words, if you don't practice the Ten Good Karmas, you won't be able to say anything!

If you build a building on the sand, it will collapse. The Ten Good Karmas are the basis of everything. Why say that? The Ten Good Karmas are the root of the Mahayana. “The cause of Bodhi, the vision of Nirvana is so solid” (It is the cause of Bodhi, it is the solid ladder to realize Nirvana): Like the steps to climb to a high platform, each step, step by step, forms a ladder. The Ten Good Karmas are the ladder. “If one fails to develop the mind, develop the power of vows, without practicing the Ten Good Karmas, one can attain Bodhi, attain Nirvana, even in one mid-life, or one moment of thought, one can be a spiritual being in the ten directions, reach all Buddhas in the earthly world, count the number of sentient beings, reach the stage of Perfect Enlightenment, enter Bat Nirvana, but there is nothing to see” (If only by the power of generating the mind and making the vow, not by practicing the Ten Good Karmas The path that can attain Bodhi, nirvana, or in one lifetime, or in the space of a single thought, can cause sentient beings as many as microscopic particles, in all the Buddha realms on earth, to attain perfect enlightenment and enter parinirvana, then there is no such thing): That is big talk, empty talk, very false, empty! In other words, it is all through practicing the Ten Virtuous Karmas that one can attain the supreme result.

“ Of course there is no visible thing. Sis that a fake? kalpas" (But there is no such thing. Why is that? The Ten Good Karmas are the basis of the retribution of outstanding merit and virtue in this world and beyond. Good man! If you do not practice the Ten Good Karmas, even in the dust of eons you will experience all the Buddha realms in the ten directions): The time is too long, the passage of [time] is equal to the number of dust particles in the ten directions, that is, the ten directions of the Buddha realms will be ground into particles, each particle of dust will be considered as one. life, how long? After spending such a long time, speaking so loudly, claiming to be Mahayana, or listening, or speaking for yourself, or just making a wish, just taking an oath to wish to become Buddha, you still cannot attain Bodhi. Not only can you not attain enlightenment yourself, but you hope to help others escape the suffering of birth and death, can you do it or not? No way!

Good man! Because of practicing the Ten Virtuous Karmas, the world still has Sat-de-li kings, Brahmins, scholars, and wealthy aristocrats. Where do rich people come from? By cultivating the Ten Virtuous Karmas. There are also the Four Great Heavens, “the Land of Neither Perception nor Non-Perception” (up to the Heavenly Land of Neither Perception nor Non-Perception), all the celestial beings, either the Sravaka Vehicle, or the Single Enlightenment Vehicle, “the Patience of the Supreme Bodhisattva, is due to practicing the Ten Good Karmas of different types” (up to the Supreme Bodhisattva, are all due to practicing the Ten Good Karma Path, different qualities): Different levels, different results, up to different human retributions, up to different saintly retributions. That is cultivating the Ten Good Karmas, it depends on how you practice! Different methods of practice will lead to different positions. But you must practice the Ten Good Karmas to achieve wealth in heaven and man, until you attain the status of Sravaka, Pratyekabuddha, Bodhisattva, and even Buddha. Otherwise, it will be absolutely impossible to achieve!

(Sutra) Thi co, good man! Those who are weak in desire and quickly fulfill the Supreme Bodhisattva vow, if they practice according to the Ten Good Karmas, the Path will be dignified and free from the ten evils and doubts, can they fulfill the vow of the Supreme Perfect and Level Bodhisattva. We wish to quickly realize the Mahayana realm, quickly attain Supreme Bodhi, quickly fulfill all good dharma vows, and firstly protect and maintain the Ten Good Karmas. The reason why it's fake? The Ten Virtuous Karmas have the power to establish all the basic merits and virtues of good dharma, and in this world they overcome the consequences and retributions. Thi tries, to practice the Ten Virtuous Karmas.
(Sutra: Therefore, good man! If you want to quickly satisfy Supreme Bodhi, You should practice the Ten Good Karmas in order to dignify yourself, so that you will not be one who abides in the ten evil and unruly ways but can fulfill the great aspiration of the Supreme Bodhisattva like that. If you wish to quickly attain the Mahayana realm, quickly attain the Supreme Bodhisattva level, and quickly satisfy all good wishes, you should first uphold the Ten Good Karmas The result is superior to the world and beyond the world. Therefore, you should practice the Ten Good Karmas).

Having made the Bodhisattva vow, if you want to satisfy that vow, “practice the Ten Good Karmas to adorn yourself” (you should cultivate the Ten Good Karmas like that to adorn yourself), only then can you realize it, dignify yourself, “free from the Ten Evils, dislaws Those who have doubts, can fulfill the great vow of the Supreme Bodhisattva" (not by abiding in the Ten Evils, not keeping the rules and regulations, but can satisfy the great vow of the Supreme Bodhisattva), if they do not practice the Ten Virtues, they will be the Ten Evils. “If you wish to quickly realize the Mahayana realm, quickly attain Supreme Bodhi, quickly fulfill all good dharma vows, first wish to protect and uphold the Ten Good Karma Paths” (If you wish to quickly realize the Mahayana realm, quickly attain Supreme Bodhi, quickly satisfy all good dharma vows, first of all, you should uphold the Ten Good Karma Paths), that is the basis of all dharmas. "The reason why? The Ten Good Karmas have the ability to establish all the basic merits and virtues, the worldly world overcomes the retribution" (Why is that? The Ten Good Karmas are the basis to put all the virtues and good dharmas in place, are the cause of the revenge effect that overcomes the world and transcends the world): If you want to achieve the victory of retribution, the Ten Good Karmas is its cause. If you practice deeply, you will realize the results. “Your Majesty, please practice the Ten Good Karmas” (Therefore, you should practice the Ten Good Karmas), the Buddha said ten times but still lest sentient beings forget!

Therefore, he repeated this meaning, having said it ten times in the previous section, the Buddha still did not feel reassured. Therefore, whatever Dharma the Buddha spoke, he ultimately advised this Bodhisattva and that Bodhisattva that, in the Dharma-Ending Age, if his disciples did not believe, you must shoulder the responsibility of saving them. This set of sutras is entrusted to Void Store Bodhisattva, some sutras are entrusted to Manjushri Bodhisattva, some sutras are entrusted to Maitreya Bodhisattva. Maitreya Bodhisattva is Buddha's successor, so the Buddha spoke to Maitreya Bodhisattva the most. Therefore, when Maitreya Bodhisattva becomes Buddha, in the three Dragon Flower Assembly, he will save sentient beings in the Dharma-Ending Age, saving no one. Maitreya Bodhisattva has made a vow, He will save you.

(Sutra) At the time of the ear, the World-Honored One repeatedly revealed the meaning, and recited and wrote: - Desires eliminate suffering, attain greatness. Bodhi, cultivating the ten virtuous wheels, diligently taking care of things and being careless. Conveniently, the three vehicle dharmas, up to the Bodhisattva Jāla, must be a householder, attaining the stage of non-enlightenment. Believe in practicing the Mahayana, benefit everyone, attain enlightenment in the Pure Land dharma, and quickly attain great Bodhi. Weak abandonment of killing, all love and respect, always free from illness and long life, always mocking the harmless dharma. Nof all places of birth, constantly mocking Buddha's actions, often realizing the Buddha, Dharma, Sangha, quickly attaining Supreme Enlightenment.
(Sutra: At that time, the World-Honored One displayed this meaning again, then recited verses: - Want to To eliminate suffering in all realms, attain great Bodhi, practice the ten good wheels, diligently, do not let go of the Dharma of the three vehicles, and the Bodhisattva Buddha, all monastics do not make mistakes. Believe in, practice Mahayana, benefit all beings, attain enlightenment in the Pure Land, and quickly attain great Bodhi. If you abandon killing, all will love and respect you sick, live long, always like the harmless Dharma. Being born anywhere, always liking to follow Buddha, often meeting Buddha, Dharma, Sangha, quickly attaining Supreme Enlightenment).

Even though the Buddha said this principle ten times, it still does not give peace of mind. Finally, he recited verses again, repeated them again, and gave instructions again. Especially with regard to the Ten Good Karmas, "desires to eliminate suffering, attain great Bodhi, practice the Ten Virtuous Wheels, diligence, carelessness", [meaning]: If you want to eliminate all sufferings [in the realms], if you want to attain Buddhahood, you should practice the Ten Virtuous Karmas, be diligent, diligently practice, don't be careless! “Conveniently, the three vehicles of dharma, up to the Bodhāraṇa” [meaning] regarding the three vehicles, i.e. Sravaka, Pratyekabuddha, Mahāyāna, up to the Bodhāraṇa [of those three vehicles], only you can teach them without error. "If you leave the family, you will attain infallibility", [meaning]: Regardless of whether that person breaks the precepts or violates the precepts, even those who wear a piece of ka-sa, you should not deal with them, [meaning] like that. [That is] you should not punish them, you should not beat and scold them, you cannot imprison them.

“ Believe in practicing the Mahayana, benefit all beings, attain enlightenment over the Pure Land Dharma, Nirvana, quickly attain great Bodhi. Disavow killing, love all beings” (Believe in practicing Mahayana, benefit all beings, attain supreme Pure Land enlightenment, quickly attain great Bodhi. If you leave kill all living beings, love and respect all): If you are a person who truly believes in Mahayana, benefits all sentient beings, you wish for enlightenment, want to achieve a pure realm, you will be able to attain Mahabodhi very quickly. If we want to cultivate the Way, we must first have a monastery and providence for seclusion. If a Buddha wants to become a Buddha, he must have a Buddha realm himself. No matter which Buddha, he must first vow to establish a country and must understand this meaning! The world of Glamorous Light Tathagata is like that, the world of Amitābha Buddha is also like that, the world of Immovable Tathagata is like that, the world of Many Treasures Tathagata is like that, the realm of each Buddha is different.

If you want to practice Buddhism, you must have a thatched hut, and in a cave, you must have a cave. Otherwise, nothing will exist. Therefore, if all Buddhas wish to cultivate in a Buddha's Pure Land, they will attain great Bodhi; The first thing is to abstain from killing. Abstaining from killing is respected by all; You don't get sick, you live a long life, you're always happy, you like harmless dharma, you don't mind harming living beings. Killing includes many things. The dog is lying face down there, you want to pass by, thinking it is in the way, either take a kick and hit it, or kick it with your foot; That is called “the brain harms living beings”. You can go around a bit, don't think that living beings are an obstacle to your affairs, and don't harm all living beings. Why do you have to pay attention when walking on the road, don't step on the ant hill, because there are insects there, you have to be careful not to step on it to death. Children sometimes consider trampling other living beings to death as playing, catching baby sparrows, or even harming all living beings: Use hot water to pour into an ant hole, or if there are cockroaches in the stove, then pour hot water into it. Even though they all die, you always have to repay the debt. That is called "brain harming sentient beings", it will be very difficult to attain Mahayana fruition. "In all places of birth, one always mocks the Buddha's actions" (Born in all places, one likes to follow the Buddha): No matter where you are born, whatever the Buddha does, you will follow the same. So what? You will often meet Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha, and quickly attain Supreme Enlightenment.

(Sutra) Weakness and non-attachment, wise men cherish, destroy desire for birth, plan without desire for birth. Born to be extremely wealthy, capable of being a great benefactor, attaining the solemn treasures of the assembly, lovable in the pure Buddha country. Weakly abandon desires and evil deeds, eliminate impurities and afflictions, dry up greed and craving, and quickly attain the pure Buddhaland. All sentient beings, their souls are free from desire and contentment, and are peaceful in the Mahayana, so they need to practice the holy life. Weakly abandoning false speech stems, attaining the holy word through wisdom, often mocking the true truth, destroying false illusions and suffering Na mere word to attain quality, often realizing the Buddha, Dharma, Sangha, quickly attaining great Bodhi, encouraging the practice of not false speech. Weaknesses separate from indirect speech, become a good dharma weapon, often realize Buddha, Dharma, Sangha, without going back to cessation. Before attaining the immaculate saint, Da-lani treasures, attaining the profound dharma of the ocean, and quickly attaining Supreme Enlightenment. Weakness avoids harsh and evil speech, and often talks about soft and soft speech. All sentient beings love and respect them, and destroy the sins of the ancestors. The spirit of the assembly often rejoices and becomes a Bodhisattva, a Bodhisattva, and a Buddha who transcends the Tenth Ground. Weaknesses in avoiding impure language, wise people are respectful, altruistic in their speech, and possess the five merits. Always listen to the holy words, always joyfully seek the holy path, perfect the sea of ​​Buddhas, and quickly attain Omniscience.
(Sutra: Don't give but take, wise people love, destroy what is born of greed, achieve born of non-greed. Forever rich, a great benefactor, to bedignified, a lovely pure Buddha land. If one abandons evil desires, dries up the river of desire, one quickly attains the purity of Buddha's world, escapes from the mire of desire, rests in the Mahayana, makes one diligently practice the holy life, one attains holy wisdom and freedom. always like words that are true, destroy false sufferings. Ma word that proves quality, often meets Buddha, Dharma, Sangha, quickly attains great Bodhi, advises to practice without false words, becomes good dharma weapons, often meets Buddha, Dharma, Sangha, does not return to cessation, attains no defilement, the treasure of Da-la-ni, reaches the deep ocean of Dharma, quickly attains Supreme Enlightenment. If one avoids harsh words and often speaks soft words, all sentient beings will love and respect them, and destroy the sins of previous lives. If they abandon impure words, they will always be happy and become a Bodhisattva, and they will be able to complete the five actions of the Buddhas merit. Often hear and receive the holy words, always joyfully seek the holy path, complete the ocean of Buddhas, and quickly attain Omniscience).

“Weakness in renunciation of non-attachment, wise man loves love, destroys greed that gives rise to karma, plans for non-greed to give birth to things” (If you abandon “don't give but take”, wise people love and respect, destroy what is born of greed, achieve what is born of non-greed): Do not steal from others, you will be loved by wise people. Those who steal are greedy, [that is karma] born of greed, that is a matter of karma. Not being greedy, because of not being greedy, the Pure Land is born. If you don't get greedy, "you'll always be born rich" (you'll always be rich in every life), in every life, every life you'll be rich, you'll become a rich man. Greed and theft are both useless, becoming more and more poor and having nothing. The richer you are, the more you can give alms. The more you can give alms, the more blessings you will accumulate! Therefore, that person can become a great donor. “Obtained by the adorned assembly” (Adorned with precious treasures) is a pure Buddha land, ultimately reborn in a pure Buddha land. “Weakness of separation from lust and evil actions” (If you leave behind evil desires), that means staying away from all three things of killing, stealing, and lust.

The third wheel, “destroying impurities and afflictions”: The Shurangama Sutra teaches very clearly. Everyone saw Anan when he wanted to praise the Buddha, the Buddha asked Ananda how he saw the Buddha? He replied: "I see it like this, I am fed up with desire, but I don't realize the results. If I don't realize the results, then my desire still hasn't been eliminated." What did Ananda say? "The filth and pus are mixed together, and clouds and clouds can give birth to wonderful bright and golden light gathering?" (Pus and dirt are mixed together, how can they give birth to a mysterious light block of purple-yellow color?): When a man and a woman give birth to a baby, the father's semen and mother's blood are "pus and dirt", that is, mixed pus and blood. How is it possible to give birth to a mysterious mass of light like the purple-yellow mass of light on the Buddha's body? In the form of a golden Buddha, Ananda did not believe that Buddha was born from the semen of his father and blood of his mother. That is the body of merit, but the other things cannot be born! Therefore, lust cannot be born [in the golden body of Buddha], understanding this is enough. Therefore, we must abandon desire and evil conduct, [evil conduct] is what is born of afflictions and impurities. “Dry the river of desire, quickly attain the pure Buddhaland, liberate all sentient beings, the soul will be free from stagnant desires, be at peace in the Mahayana, you need to practice the holy life” (Dry the river of desire, quickly attain the pure Buddha land, save sentient beings, escape the mud of desire, rest in the Mahayana, make them diligently practice the holy life): Make all living beings pure, do not be too greedy.

“ Weakness in separating false words, attaining the holy word in wisdom, often mocking the truth of truth, eliminating false speech and suffering” (If you give up false speech, gain holy wisdom and freedom, always prefer true words, eliminate false suffering): If you leave falsehood and do not deceive others, you will be able to achieve freedom of wisdom, supreme wisdom. free, and loves words that are true, words that are true, eliminating false suffering! “ With one word and the quality of one word, one can often realize the Buddha, Dharma, Sangha, quickly attain Great Bodhi, one needs to cultivate without false speech. Weakness is separated from false speech, one becomes a good dharma weapon, often enlightens the Buddha, Dharma, Sangha, without cessation of cessation, andthe immaculate saint before. Da-la-ni treasure, attains the profound dharma of the ocean, quickly attains the Supreme Enlightenment” (One word as proof, often meets the Buddha, Dharma, Sangha, quickly attains Great Bodhi, diligently practices without lying. If one abandons false words, becomes good Dharma weapons, often meets Buddha, Dharma, Sangha, does not return to cessation, attains immaculate sainthood. Da-la-ni treasure trove, penetrates the deep source of the ocean of Dharma, quickly attains Supreme Enlightenment): Disparaging words can stir up others, spark separation, making it impossible for people to get along and work together. How can you meet Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha? That's why you don't become enlightened! If you want to attain enlightenment, attain the immaculate sainthood, if you wish to attain the treasure trove of da-la-ni, you must "attain the profound dharma of the ocean of origin, quickly attain the Supreme Enlightenment. Weakness in rejecting harsh and evil speech, often speaking soft and soft speech, love and respect for sentient beings, destroy the karma of the original world, the spirit of the assembly will always rejoice, become a Bodhisattva teacher, know the practices of the Buddhas, transcend the Tenth Ground" (understand the source of the profound ocean of dharma, quickly attain the Supreme Enlightenment. If Abandoning harsh words and often speaking soft words, all sentient beings will love and respect them, destroy the sins of previous lives, make them always happy, become a Bodhisattva teacher, know the actions of Buddhas, surpass the level of the Tenth Ground. Abandoning harsh words, there is such great merit. "If one avoids impure words, wise people love to love, speak altruistically, and plan the five merits" (If one abandons impure words, wise people love and respect them, speak for others, and attain five merits): Those five merits are the five types of merit mentioned in the Pure Land Commentary.

(Sutra) Weakness in lust, not slandering holy teachings, making offerings to ca-sa, propagating the holy three vehicles religion, is born in a pure Buddha country. The residence of the teacher, the supreme vehicle, quickly attains the highest wisdom. Weaknesses abandoning anger, one direction cultivates a compassionate mind, quickly attains enlightenment, ridiculing the holy conduct of all, attaining rebirth in the pure Buddha land, far away from all evil, abiding in attaining Bodhi, spiritually abandoning all anger. Weakness in abandoning wrong views, purely cultivating pure faith, mocking and revealing the three vehicles, making offerings to the Buddhas. Eternally free from evil beasts, enlightened by sages and saints, virtuous Bodhisattvas, and granted supreme wisdom. If I preach the Ten Good Karmas, I will overcome Bodhi and give birth to Dang Tri, Da-lani, Forbearance, and Earth. Test the wheel of great virtue, overcome evil beasts, destroy evil obstacles, and quickly attain great Bodhi.
(Sutra: If you stay away from lust, do not defame holy teachings, worship people who wear ca-sa, propagate If you follow the holy path of the three vehicles, you will be born in the pure Buddha land, the place where the master resides. By following the supreme vehicle, you will quickly gain supreme wisdom.
