In June of the 22nd year of the Republic of China (1933), Chau Van Hoan was at house number 8, Dong Ngon Tu alley in Thuong Thuc.

15. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Inspiration Records (records the premonition story of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva)

Compiled by Mage Chu Van

At that time, I preached the Ksitigarbha Sutra at the Great Vow Platform of the Ksitigarbha Hall in Chiayi in the 51st year of the Republic of China (1962). I heard that that temple had a history of three hundred and two years. A long time ago, someone returned to mainland China to worship Jiuhua Mountain in Anhui province, invited a holy statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva back, and built a temple to worship. Over the past few hundred years, the incense smoke has not stopped, and there have been many strange inductions. Among them, there is a very touching story, the writer would like to record as follows:

It happened a hundred years ago. There was a man named Lam Dang Chuong, in a place dozens of miles away from Gia Nghia village, who was a righteous person, but unfortunately, he was falsely accused and harmed by criminals and was arrested and thrown into prison. Mr. Lam's wife, seeing that her husband was unjustly imprisoned, was impoverished and poor at home, wandering everywhere, relying on people to help her, spending all the money in the house, still unable to save her husband from prison. Later, she knew she had to spend forty taels of silver to bribe the superior mandarin in order to atone for her husband's sins. While extremely helpless, Mrs. Lam had no choice but to grit her teeth and sell her only child for forty taels of silver to ransom her husband. The broker took two or three taels as a brokerage fee, leaving only thirty-seven taels. I still don't know whether I can redeem my husband or not! At the same time, every time I went to the prison to visit my husband, the prison guards cursed me and made things difficult for me, with the goal being to extort money. They say: "If you rely on the mountain, you will eat the products in the mountain. If you rely on the water, you will eat the products in the water." That's right! Going to the official place, entering the temple, it is reasonable that without money you will not be able to enter, it has always been like that! Mrs. Lam always had to smile, speak sweetly, and even give a little something; If not, don't dream of entering. “The King Yama is easy to meet, but the little devil is difficult to deal with”. This time, paying money to ransom her husband was of course no exception. At that time, the prison was right on the main road, also right where Ngo Phuong street is now. She bought some areca nuts nearby, to make some small gifts for the prison guards. Who would have thought that when she took out money to buy areca nuts, when she wrapped them up, she dropped thirty-seven taels of silver to redeem her husband without even knowing it. When I gave the money to the mandarin, I discovered that the money bag was missing. I searched all day and couldn't get it out. I was so scared that there was no blood left on my face. I was so confused that I couldn't make a sound! Selling her only beloved child, she thought she could redeem her husband, but now she has lost money, her husband cannot get out of prison, and she has only one way to die! She wasn't dead yet, still not discouraged, she continued searching, in case she couldn't find the money, the only way was to commit suicide!

The fabric street in Gia Nghia citadel is now Quang Minh street, there is a temple worshiping Tho Dia Cong. There was a beggar named Tu Luong Tu who lived there. Not only was he poor and homeless, but he was also disabled from birth. My legs are paralyzed, I can't walk, I have to use my butt to drag on the ground to move. During the day, he begged for food and lived on the streets. At night, he took the Tho Dia temple as his home. That day, while he was begging for food on the street, from afar he saw a woman buying areca nuts at a betel and areca stall. She hurriedly left, dropping her bag of money on the ground. He crawled forward, picked up the bag of money, originally wanting to chase it and give it back to the person. Feeling afraid that I can't go, I call out loud, but she doesn't listen! He opened the silver bag and counted it, there were thirty-seven taels of silver. The beggar saw such white silver and was startled, but did not have the heart to see money and become greedy; On the contrary, I felt that the woman seemed to be in a hurry, there was definitely something big going on and she couldn't just take the money away casually. In case she comes back and doesn't find the silver, she might commit suicide. I have to stay here and wait for her to return. I kept waiting, waiting for a long time, then I saw a woman with a worried face, running to look east and west on the road, as if she was looking for something. He knew that the person who had lost her property was looking for her, so he swooped up and used his hand to pull down her shirt. She thought she was a beggar asking for money, got upset, and shouted loudly: "I'm in a hurry to die, where else can I find money for you! Please get out of the way so I can find my lost things."

Tu Luong Tu's kindness was underestimated, he still softly asked: "Madam! What did you drop? So panicked, tell me, maybe I know." That sentence called her back from the hands of death. She was surprised and said: "Really?" He replied: "Of course it's true! I picked up the item. If you're right, I'll give it to you." She hastily said: "I lost a cloth bag, which contained thirty-seven taels of silver. That was the money I sold my child. My husband was falsely accused of being murdered and had to go to jail. Forty taels of silver was needed to atone for his crime. Reluctantly, I sold my child to redeem my husband. The scammer took three taels. I was still worried that I wouldn't have enough silver, but I never thought I would lose it here. So my husband can't get out of prison, and my child has also been sold! People and property are gone, I just There is still a way to commit suicide!” After finishing speaking, he cried non-stop.

At that time, some kind-hearted people came to ask this and that, Tu Luong Tu did not have the slightest doubt, saying: "Don't be miserable, I picked up the silver you dropped when buying areca nuts. Because I couldn't walk, I couldn't keep up in time, and you couldn't hear me when I called, so I'm here waiting for you to come back. Right now, the silver is in here, you try counting it." see". The beggar handed over the money and quietly left. Ba Lam found the lost money and was so happy that he forgot about the beggar. He even forgot to ask for his full name and hurried to the temple to pay. The official only knew that it was the money from selling his children, but the poor beggar saw the wealth without being confused. How can we confuse our consciences and ask for money from selling other people's children? Therefore, Thien Luong found out and emotionally released her husband, no longer needing a ransom! Because of the beggar's kindness, the mandarin was moved! After Lam Dang Chuong was released from prison, he learned that his child had been sold. Except for the three taels of silver given to the broker, he still had to invite guests and give him gifts, spending a lot of money, and looking for beggars, but he didn't know where. Later, he opened a hardware store[54] in the street selling fabrics to make a living.

Speaking of which, Tu Luong Tu returned to Tho Dia temple to sleep one night, the next day was the Qing Ming festival, then went to Dong Quach Phien Gian, which is a public cemetery outside the city to ask for pink biscuits[55] from those who come to worship their ancestors' graves. Because of the long distance and the rain, I returned late and dragged myself along the slow road. When I reached the citadel gate, the citadel gate had long been closed (at that time, Gia Nghia had four citadel gates). Reluctantly, I had to go to the nearby Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Temple outside the city to take refuge (currently at 81 Dan Quyen Street), begging the temple's benefactor to be kind enough to let me rest one night in front of the great Buddha shrine. The temple caretaker recognized the beggar named Tu and gave him a break. But he went to sleep until midnight, when he suddenly heard a scream in the main hall, like a ghost, very much like someone was killing Mr. Tu, crying endlessly. The temple caretaker thought that Tu had a mental illness. He scolded him twice but still did not shut up. He made so much noise that he couldn't sleep all night. He was extremely angry! Waking up early the next morning, he slowly chased away the beggar surnamed Tu. Seeing that he was sleeping soundly, he pulled him out of his dream and cursed: "Why don't you sleep at night, but scream like a ghost?" The beggar surnamed Tu, after waking up startled, jumped up, stood up without even realizing it, and walked in front of the temple watchman. At that moment, the temple caretaker became so frightened that he took a few steps back, stunned: "How can this paralyzed guy who slept overnight be able to walk and stand naturally?" Asking, originally, Tu Luong Tu slept at night in front of the holy statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. In his dream, he saw the Bodhisattva sending two little ghosts, one tall, one short. One ghost hugged his upper body tightly, the other grabbed his two paralyzed legs and pulled hard, causing him so much pain that he cried endlessly. But those two little devils, no matter how pitifully he screamed, continued to increase their strength and pull his disabled legs straight, causing him so much pain that he fainted. After that, I don't know why I fell asleep. "At the moment, I don't know that these disabled legs are automatically the same as normal people's legs." Therefore, I was even happier than when I picked up the silver yesterday. The temple watchman saw such a miracle appear, of course he could not scold him anymore, but was happy to follow him. He himself also knew that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva had manifested, cured his disability, bowed before the statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, shed tears of gratitude, bowed his body and bowed several times!

The beggar Since his disability ended, many people congratulated him. But because of that, he aroused trouble: When he was disabled, he could still beg to get by. Now that I'm no longer disabled, I can't beg on the streets to get by, I must be self-reliant; But he is a poor beggar. Besides begging, how can he solve the problem of food, clothing, and shelter? There is no capital to trade. In the end, there was still no way, and I came up with a way: Use a few coins from me to buy two buckets of water, and carry water for hire to make a living. At that time, there was no running water, so rich families asked someone to change the water, [that is, pay them] to carry water every day. Tu Luong Tu turned from a beggar into a person who changed countries.

After Lam Dang Chuong was released from prison, he learned about his wife dropping the money and the beggar who found it and not keeping it as his own. He also searched for that life-saving benefactor, but he didn't even know his name and couldn't find it. At that time, they lived in a very remote countryside, of course they did not know the beggar's whereabouts. Therefore, for the matter of not knowing the benefactor's full name, there is no way to repay him, so I just keep it in my heart. Two or three years later, the business of the Lam family's hardware store became more and more prosperous, and the feeling of remembering their benefactors also increased. One day, the Lam family asked Tu Luong Tu to bring water. Lam Dang Chuong has never met Tu Luong Tu, the benefactor right in front of him still doesn't recognize him. At that time, the women did not leave the door much. Whenever a man comes, the woman hides and does not leave the room door. So, several years passed, still unable to find that beggar benefactor. Just as Tu Luong Tu brought water to the kitchen, unintentionally, Mrs. Lam saw it and was very surprised: "This person's appearance is exactly like his benefactor, is it him or not? No! Absolutely not! He is paralyzed, cannot walk. But why is this person so similar to him?" Mrs. Lam wondered, answered, doubted and did not dare to make a decision for several days in a row. She told this story to her husband: "That water bearer has the same appearance as the benefactor, the same face. For some reason, he is not a paralyzed person, but carries water! Tomorrow morning, please invite him in to ask him a detailed question and see what's going on!"

The next day, Tu Luong Tu still brought water. Lam Dang Chuong specially invited him to sit down and have tea. After that, ask them their names, what they do before carrying water, and who else is in the house. Tu Luong Tu also did not hide anything, telling the truth: "It's very embarrassing to say it out loud! Three years ago I couldn't carry water, couldn't even walk. For many years I was paralyzed, dragging on the ground. At that time, I only went from house to house to beg for food. After that, during the Qingming period of that year, I slept at Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's temple at night, dreaming that Bodhisattva ordered two little ghosts to treat my injury. From then on, I was no longer disabled, so I used to carry water to earn my own living. live". At that time, Mrs. Lam came out of the room, held her husband's hand, and knelt in front of the Tu family at the same time, saying: "Benefactor! Please accept a bow from us and our wife." First of all, they did not explain everything clearly, but kept bowing side by side, making Tu Luong Tu scared to death, waving his hands continuously, constantly backing away. After Mr. Lam and his wife explained everything clearly, they learned what happened during Thanh Minh period three years ago. At that time, I also knew that by doing good deeds, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva appeared to heal his disability. Truly both surprised and delighted. They sat and talked for a while, Mr. Tu withdrew, but the Lam couple refused to let him go no matter what.

The Lam couple very sincerely told Tu Luong Tu: "At that time, grace saved us and our wife. Of course, you don't think of doing favors and asking for retribution, but we are the ones who feel the favor, we can't think like that. You are people without a house, without a wife or children, we need help in the shop. Please stay here, treat it like your family." yourself!” From then on, Tu Luong Tu did not change countries anymore, living in the Lam family's hardware store, helping them with business. In just a few years, the Lam family not only prospered in business, but also bought a lot of land and fields. They also wanted to marry Tu Luong Tu several times, but he refused and did not agree. Mr. Lam knows that he is a straightforward person, saying one thing, not saying two, just following nature.

A few years later, Lam Dang Chuong received a letter from his uncle, urging him to return to his hometown in Guangdong to inherit the family business. The couple decided to return to Guangdong to inherit their ancestral business. The property here was fully managed by Tu Luong Tu, and did not dare to say clearly that it was given to him. I just said that I asked him to manage it for me, wanting to make him believe that they would return soon. Otherwise, Mr. Tu would not take over. Tu Luong Tu still expected Lam and his wife to return, but they still refused to return. A few years later, they sent letters, expressing their intentions: They must inherit their ancestors' business and will not return. They donated all of their assets to Mr. Tu, advising him to get married and start a family soon. But Tu Luong Tu still did not get married, and did not get married for the rest of his life, still considering himself the property manager for Lam Dang Chuong. Later, Tu Luong Tu willed all the rooms in the lychee ward to donate to Tho Dia temple to thank him for his many years of support in times of hardship. When he was alive, on every first and full moon day, he went to Sacred Palace of Bodhisattva Kṣitigarbha outside the city to pay homage to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and to thank Bodhisattva for curing his disability. It is said that after his death, there were sixty first-class plots of land taken over by the local government.

The two families, Tu and Lam, on the one hand, do favors without asking for reward, on the other hand, they definitely have favors that must be repaid, both of which are worthy of imitation and reverence for future generations. It's no wonder that the people of the previous generation in Gia Nghia, whenever this matter is mentioned, get into heated discussions. It is said that provincial-level parliamentarians in Gia Nghia such as Ha Mau Thu, etc. Every spring and autumn, they all come to worship the souls of the Tu and Lam families, admiring their human attitudes. Because of this, the writer and layperson Tran Tu Khanh personally went to the private hospital on Quang Minh street to see the tablets of the Tu and Lam families, and the statue of Tho Dia Cong at that time. They also visited the site of the Tho Dia temple where the beggar family Tu took refuge at that time. Neighbors on both sides knew that the writer had come specifically to ask about this matter, and they happily spontaneously told about the past of Mr. Tu and Lam. This story shows that in addition to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's sacredness, he also promotes kindness in human nature, all of which are useful to the hearts of people in society. Therefore, I happily recorded it.

17. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's spiritual records

Khanh Hoa Sanh write

In an era where the wheel has moved to the point of space exploration, everyone uses science to deceive themselves; If anyone still discusses beliefs, or mentions any premonitions, someone will certainly scold "you are backward and superstitious", and even be labeled "conservative". But can science really solve human problems? Can humanity rely only on science to survive? Humans are not machines, it is impossible to just apply scientific principles and force them to follow certain rules and laws of motion! Experiencing this life and the encounters in human life are truly too wonderful, very unpredictable, if you rely rigidly on scientific theorems, it will be difficult to find the answer. Therefore, no matter how the times develop, religious beliefs still play an important part in human life, and we cannot deny the Bodhisattva's inspiration! Now I want to tell a story that happened in recent years, a truth I experienced myself. From this inconceivable story, we can briefly see some of the great divine power of the Bodhisattva, as well as the inconceivable faith to develop great faith and vows, respectfully worship, increase blessings, open wisdom, and soon attain Bodhi.

Tu Do village in Hoa Binh village, Taichung district is a mountainous countryside. The vast majority of residents are Cao Son people[56]. In that deep forested mountain area, there stands a temple worshiping Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, adding a bit of scenery to the monotonous high mountains, also very rare. Talking about the origin of that temple is truly something that makes everyone feel sad and teary-eyed. In the spring of the 16th year of the Republic of China (1927), right when hundreds of flowers were blooming, thousands of purple and thousands of roses, unexpectedly the Cot Thong Heat epidemic (medical name is Dengue fever, hemorrhagic fever) broke out, raging in the mountains of Hoa Binh village. In what is now called the Truc Lam tribal area in Tu Do village, it was almost completely destroyed. Only one male person was lucky enough to escape, Mr. Ngo Thien Sanh (a mountain man), now forty-seven years old, living in Tu Do village. In order to save the spirits who died from the epidemic, at that time, a special initiative was taken to build a temple to worship Ksitigarbha, and a three-meter tall statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva was carved. On the twelfth day of the twelfth month of the 16th year of the Republic of Korea, a Japanese-born monk, Dai Da Phuong Chau, abbot of Taichung Temple of the Soo Dong sect, was invited to solemnly celebrate the opening ceremony. From then on, under the protection of the Bodhisattva, that mountainous village gradually recovered its original energy and gradually prospered.

Time passes very quickly, the treasure island returns to the arms of the Fatherland, the people in the mountainous areas receive special incentives from the government, and even try their best, life becomes more and more peaceful. But a few years ago, Western religions spent huge material capital, using flour and old clothes to attract mountain people to convert. The mountain people could not resist this seduction tactic, and as a result, they completely surrendered to being God's sheep. The Sacred Palace of Bodhisattva Kṣitigarbha also rotted over time, its columns tilted, and it was about to collapse. At that time, there were people living in the plains of that land (plain people who moved to the mountains to cultivate), brothers Ngo Thinh Kim, Ngo Si Quan, Ngo Si Thanh, Ngo Si Quan[57], who resolutely initiated the restoration of the old temple, collected nearly ten thousand dong, and in less than a year, restored the temple to its original form. old. The restored ritual ceremony was fixed on the fifth day of the eighth month of the 51st year of the Republic of Korea (1962). They specially went to Thu Tuyen Pagoda in Truc Sam hamlet, Dong La village, in Mieu Lap district, asking lay people who could hold a dharma assembly to go there to celebrate the dharma assembly. The Buddhist staff were guided by the eighty-something year old Mr. Hoang Dinh Hoa, along with Tran A Han, Lai Nhan Phu, Khau A Kho, Lai Tu Phuoc, Khau Thuy Khon, Lai Thon Thuong, Lai Dien Phuoc (all of the above are living in Dong La village), Le Moc Thinh, Khau Sanh So, Ho Diem Quang (the above three are currently living in Tam Nghia village). A group of a dozen people eagerly headed to Tu Do village. I also joined them and joined their ranks.

After the Dharma assembly was completed that day, we stayed overnight, planning to return to the village tomorrow morning (August 6). Who would have known that at night the storm roared (the Tai Phong typhoon) and the rain poured down. The next day, I woke up and saw immense water everywhere, landslides, collapsed land, traffic was cut off, and everywhere in the whole [Taiwan] province suffered heavy damage. At that time, I was busy climbing the mountains and wading the stream to find my way back, but everywhere the rafts were swept away, half a step was difficult to move, so I had to entrust myself to the Sacred Palace of Bodhisattva Kṣitigarbha, hoping that the next day the situation could change for the better. Waking up on the morning of the seventh day, the flood water had not yet receded, everyone's faces were worried, looking at each other without speaking, not knowing what to do well? Not long after, everyone came to the statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva (on that day it was called "the third day of enthronement"), praying for Bodhisattva's compassionate blessings, so that we could safely go home. After praying, our group immediately began the arduous journey. Not far from Sacred Palace of Bodhisattva Kṣitigarbha, there is O Thach Khanh bridge, one end of the dyke has been eroded by flood waters for more than ten meters. Unless you use bamboo to form a temporary bridge, don't even dream of crossing it. Among the group, there was someone who was a good swimmer. He went down to try swimming, only to find out that the water was nearly a meter deep and the water was flowing fast. [If you want to cross the river], you have to cross a stretch of river of more than ten meters, which is not an easy task. As a result, I still retreated, looking at the water and lamenting. At this time, the person who welcomed us, Mr. Ngo Thinh Kim, had chopped bamboo and prepared to build a temporary bridge for us to cross. At that moment, without an appointment, we sat down and silently recited Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's holy name as many verses as possible. It's also very strange, in less than twenty minutes, the water quickly receded: From one meter of water, it receded to only about thirty centimeters. Everyone looked at the situation and saw that it was no longer dangerous, so they all rushed into the water to cross the river. I helped Mantra Hoang, over eighty years old, cross the river last. Strangely, when I crossed halfway across the river, I suddenly felt the water level begin to rise. Behind me, from Thien Cau (place name), there were seven or eight people, and there was also Vinh and his wife who also followed us across the river. After everyone safely crossed the river, they did not turn back to see if the water continued to rise or not. On the other hand, when Mr. Ngo's group cut bamboo and moved to the riverbank, we were no longer seen. The water is still big as usual, why were we able to cross it? Later, we found out that not long after we crossed the river, when Mr. Ngo's group reached the riverbank, the river water had risen to the same depth as half an hour before. This is such a strange story that it's hard for others to believe!

Buddhist scriptures say Bodhisattvas use all kinds of divine powers to save suffering beings. Water disasters are one of the great disasters of the human world. If one can wholeheartedly recite the Bodhisattva's holy name, one will certainly be liberated. This time, thanks to my own personal experience, it proves that the Buddhist language is not false. In addition to strengthening faith and respectfully worshiping to repay the grace, I hope that those who read this clumsy article will also have a heart of faith and prayer. Everyone will think of the holy name "Namo Great Vow Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva" to have great vow power, and if you ask, it will be fulfilled.

19. Buddha, Bodhisattva and I

Luong My Hoa writes

Having been married for nearly eight years, my husband and I gave birth to a son and a daughter, the daughter is active, the son is calm. Every time I look at my white baby, I suddenly remember the car accident that happened last year. The twenty-ninth day of the seventh lunar month is also the day before Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's birthday. One day, my husband and four-year-old daughter, along with a friend from Gia Nghia, sat in the front of a small truck driven by my husband from Dau Nam to Dau Luc train station. My family always drives carefully and carefully, but that day we were afraid of getting stuck in traffic because of the four o'clock train; Therefore, he especially stepped on the accelerator and sped faster. Unexpectedly, as the car approached Ba Tieu Bridge in Dau Luc, the car in front suddenly slowed down. My husband was momentarily careless, braked suddenly, and the nose of the car tilted slightly to the left, hitting the rear of the truck opposite, causing the front of our car to deform and being dragged by the truck for a distance. First, I bumped over the lunch boxes in the car, which were lunch boxes I prepared for everyone. Immediately followed by a strong concussion after being hit. In that moment of terrifying eyes, it was truly difficult to predict what the people in the car would be like! The people on the side of the road thought that we must be "a lot of evil, a little good", because unfortunate things often happen there, if not dead, then injured!

The truck stopped, and our car naturally stopped too. Stopping the car in the middle of the road, in the car we looked at each other, only my head and leg were slightly bumped, but my daughter, my husband, and my perfect friend. I was eight months pregnant at that time. While my wife opened the distorted, crooked car door, we walked out one after another. The residents actually broke into a cold sweat on our behalf. Seeing that we were not harmed, they were very surprised and asked: "The front of the car was crushed flat like that, how could you be so lucky to escape?" Seeing my big belly again, they were even more worried about me. We said as one word, answering them: "Because we often recite the Buddha's name" (my friend recited the Great Compassion Mantra, my husband and I recited the Heart Sutra and the holy name Amitābha Buddha, even my daughter recited with me). In an urgent moment, my mind immediately shouted loudly: "Amitābha Buddha!" I pray to the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas to protect and bless me, so I firmly believe: We are safe, it is definitely because of the blessings of the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas. To ensure that the fetus in the womb was safe or not, I went to the obstetrics department of nearby Dau Luc Provincial Hospital for a check-up. The gynecologist, after carefully examining using ultrasound waves, told me: "Congratulations! The fetus is very healthy (normal), and it's still a boy." At that moment, I stopped worrying. After that, my father-in-law knew that something had happened to us. He quickly went to the scene of the accident. He saw the car but did not see us. He was so scared that the old man's face turned pale. He thought to himself, "Isn't it a tragic accident?" Until my husband appeared before me

old man, I can breathe a sigh of relief!

A few days before the unfortunate incident, my left eye twitched, which was a bad omen. Unexpectedly, a few days later something happened, and I also encountered the most serious of not so serious things. That day, trying to avoid the train for the purpose of going to Nong Thien Temple in Taipei to attend the birthday ceremony of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, which was also the ordination ceremony of masters Qua Huy and Qua Thuan, was probably because we did not have the blessings! If not, I must have done something wrong there that caused me to not be able to attend. When a car accident occurs, why are the food containers crushed first and scattered to the ground, but we are all safe? Thinking back, there were originally four food boxes, two vegetarian boxes, two salty boxes. My family and daughter eat salty food, so I prepared it that way. Perhaps it was true that the gods and dharma protectors warned me. I had received the Bodhisattva Precepts as a layperson, but did not pay much attention to the rules of Buddhism, and was even less strict about formality. Before going to worship pagodas or temples, your body and mind must be pure. It is best to fast three days beforehand. If you keep your body pure, then you must be respectful to Buddha and Bodhisattva. Having been taught like that, I don't dare to act rashly anymore! Everything follows the rules.

After more than a month of unfortunate events, I actually gave birth to a baby boy, quite white and delicate. After the baby is born, the neck is very strong and rotates automatically. Here, I need to especially thank Master Qua Thuan and my sister. If it weren't for their compassionate support in reciting the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra for me, I'm afraid my child would no longer be in this world. After getting married, I gave birth to a daughter. After that, every year I got pregnant, but twice it was not safe. Therefore, it also created a habit of giving birth prematurely, making it almost impossible for me to have the courage to give birth anymore. Until last year, my sister and I went to attend Phat That at Nong Thien Temple in Taipei. On the day of Buddha's consummation, I knelt before Buddha and prayed to Buddha and Bodhisattva to give me a noble son and to be able to give birth smoothly and safely. Indeed, Buddha and Bodhisattva truly satisfy my wishes. Not long after returning, I was indeed pregnant again. Perhaps my karma is too heavy, causing me no peace. In the second month of pregnancy, I started having vaginal bleeding again. What's even worse is that you can't swallow any food, and your body loses more and more strength. Every time I walk, I feel dizzy and dizzy. It's true that I can't stand the blow! Therefore, the doctor suggested taking the baby out. Otherwise, I will lie in bed for the rest of my life, unable to do any heavy work. Girls can't hug either. Oh my God! Besides the first child, the other pregnancies were the same. It really makes me feel the depth of karma. It's often when we are at our weakest, with no strength to resist, that karma often shows up.

My sister in Keelung knew I was about to give birth prematurely, was very worried, and couldn't figure out what to do to help me. Suddenly a thought popped into her head, she called me to tell me about Xi Thanh's recent situation (Xi Thanh is Master Qua Thuan's nickname. When the children were neighbors, they both had the same surname Luong, so the relationship was like brothers). Because of my situation, Master Guo Chun was especially respectful towards the Buddha, reverently reciting a sutra of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows. Later, my sister told me about it over the phone. I remember clearly that it was afternoon, I was still lying weakly in bed, because I was afraid of the cold so both windows were tightly closed. Miraculously, a light breeze blew from the top of my head, temporarily making me feel refreshed. This is not a normal salary. I looked at the two tightly closed windows, why was there that cool breeze? A few days later, my sister called back from Keelung and asked me if my body was better? She also told me that she had called Master Qua Thuan, and he had recited a set of Ksitigarbha sutras for me. The source of the cool breeze that afternoon was because they compassionately inspired Buddha and Bodhisattva to bless me. I am very grateful to the two of you for helping me. I am even more grateful to the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas for their protection and [to] Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva for his compassionate blessings. Therefore, I immediately started reciting a volume of Ksitigarbha Sutra every day. In the sixth month, he decided to use clay to carve a dharma statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, spray-painted it with gold to worship, and it looked very solemn.

My child's solemnity and appearance are exactly like the statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva that I made. After he was born, he was immediately loved by his family and relatives. Even people who don't know it can't resist the attraction of its aura and have to admire it. In the immediate future, we have moved from Dau Nam to near Dau Luc. My husband quit his job a while ago and opened a small restaurant selling vegetarian food with me. I made up my mind that whenever a monk came to the restaurant, he would make offerings in unison. That's a little bit of our intelligence about Buddhism. In the future, if we have greater power, we pray that the whole family can make an effort to propagate Buddhism. After all, in the present era, is there anything more precious than Buddhism?

20. Giving birth in danger but still keeping one's life intact

The Landman

In the spring of the year Canh Ngo (1930), my wife became pregnant. Three months before giving birth, the fetus suddenly became motionless. Praying to gods and fortune-telling are all ineffective, and I don't dare to take medicine; But because my belly is big, I have difficulty walking, and my mind is often afraid. Because I am a vegetarian and study Buddhism, if something goes wrong, it will make the villagers laugh even more! Recall that ten years ago, there was a monk who predicted "at the age of thirty-six, you must be careful to avoid getting into trouble", which was exactly like what the astrologer said "be careful of getting into trouble". Therefore, I am so impatient, terrified, and afraid that I don't know what to do! One night, my wife turned to me crying and telling stories. Hearing those words, I was even more frightened and extremely bitter! Suddenly remembered the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra, which can protect people who encounter birth defects. If anyone makes a vow and wholeheartedly chants the sutras and recites the holy name, they will surely have a peaceful birth. As soon as that thought arose, I immediately felt happy and healthy, like ice melting. Early the next morning, the Buddha gave a detailed report. Unexpectedly, that night, my wife went into labor. The fetus was still born in the right direction, and the placenta also followed. Look, the fetus's body is already rotten, how can it turn its head down to facilitate birth? If it weren't for the Bodhisattva's compassionate power to save suffering, how could it be so? Therefore, I vow to practice Ksitigarbha to repay the Bodhisattva's kindness. Those who are suffering from the same illness in the country, please sincerely uphold and recite the sutras, liberating living beings (life release), abstain from killing, and you will surely have a peaceful birth, the Buddha's words are not false. I am a proof of that!

Vuong Can writes

For everyone, it may be a small thing not worth mentioning, but my heart still cannot suppress the joy and joy. After reciting one volume, he stood up, clasped his hands in dedication, and prayed that his resentment towards the debtor for many lifetimes would be quickly liberated thanks to that merit, helping me to have everything go smoothly in the future! While I was bowing and admiring the Bodhisattva's face, I suddenly saw that the incense stick in the incense burner was about to burn out and rolled into an oval shape. Could it be that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva gave me that feeling? Is the incense ashes rolled into an oval shape a sign that my prayers will be fulfilled? No! Don't be too attached, it's just your own delusion! Bodhisattva! I just hope the Telegraph Department will soon send someone to install a phone for me!

The next morning, I took my daughter to the health department for vaccination. After returning home, I saw a notice posted at the gate, on which was written: "Someone from the Telegraph Department just stopped by, the owner is not present, the next day he will come to install the phone." As for this sudden good news, I really don't dare to imagine it. It's been more than a month since I applied to work at that daycare, but there's been no news! Unexpectedly, they suddenly hired me. Isn't that the wonderful merit of chanting sutras? My heart filled with joy and gratitude, I went to the Buddha platform and thanked Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and the Buddhas for their blessings. Disciples now enjoy Buddha's grace, vowing from now on every month to raise money to help the poor, free sentient beings, help print Buddhist scriptures, fast on the first and full moon days of each month.

22. Record of inspiration from reading Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows

Paying homage to the Buddhas of the ten directions and three worlds, all Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas; Disciple Hui Teng (Dharma name) since the time he made up his mind to read and recite the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra and recite the holy name until now, has had six inspiring events, but has not dared to reveal them. Recently, the old layman Ta Chu Tran in Tainan had the heart to reprint Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Premonitions, and the layman Trieu A Nam sent a letter, instructing him to write down six premonition stories to benefit people. Van Khai himself knew that his wisdom was deep, his wisdom was shallow, his education was poor, his knowledge was crude, he was not good at writing, and did not dare to accept the invitation. Trieu layperson sent a letter to urge him again, but he couldn't help but respect his feelings, so I now have to use rustic words to narrate as follows:

On the thirtieth day of the seventh lunar month, the 44th year of the Republic of China (1955), early in the morning, I dreamed that my mother told me to save him. That morning, I immediately went to Thien Dao Pagoda in Taipei to attend the Ksitigarbha Dharma Assembly, reading sutras and chanting holy names along with the crowd. After consummation, he told his friends about the dream and was advised by his friends: "If we want to pray for our parents, we must make a vow to recite the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows." I immediately faced the statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, bowed, and made a vow: "From today onwards, I will dedicate myself to reading and chanting the Sutra of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows and holy name. I want to recite twenty-four sutras and recite ten thousand verses of the holy name within one month, and dedicate that merit to my mother." In the blink of an eye, the time has come, reading the sutras and reciting the holy names have all reached perfection, whether my mother will be saved or not, it doesn't matter at all! I know that my previous life's negative karma was very heavy, and if I don't make a great vow, I won't be able to do it. Therefore, make the second great vow as follows: "From the first day of the ninth lunar month, the 44th year of the Republic of China (1955) until the thirty-seventh day of the 7th lunar month, the 45th year of the Republic of Korea (1956), again make a heart to recite the Sutra of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows five hundred sets, every day recite the holy name a thousand verses, and do your best to practice the good deeds of protecting living beings (protecting lives) and releasing sentient beings." From then on, I wrote down every incident every day to urge myself not to indulge.

As in the Tathagata Praises chapter of the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra, it is written: “Universal! Such divine power, controlling the relatives, spiritually facing the Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, statues, even the mind alone tests the sutra, or requests the poisonous cause, the number of three changes, or even the seven changes. Like the evil destinies of relatives, the sutra is clear. All things will change, upon attaining liberation" (Hey Universally Expansive! You use your divine power to make those relatives, facing the statues of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, wholeheartedly read this sutra for themselves, or invite others to read it three times or up to seven times. Those relatives who are in such an evil destinies will be liberated when the number of chants is enough.) The twelfth chapter, which is the chapter of Knowledge of Literature, reads: “Revealing, Avalokiteśvara! In the future, good men, good women, desiring the future, at present hundreds of thousands of millions of equal wishes, hundreds of thousands of millions of equal things, taking refuge, worshiping, worshiping, praising the image of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, as you wish, seek, and attain success" (Again) Hey, Avalokiteshvara! If in the future, there are good men and good women who want to make hundreds of thousands of millions of wishes, hundreds of millions of millions of things in the future or the present, they should only take refuge, worship, make offerings, and praise the image of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Such wishes and wishes will all be fulfilled. I read those two chapters, tears streaming down my face. Studying Buddhism too late, reading the sutras too late, caused my parents and six relatives from many generations to cycle through the six paths, suffering immeasurable and boundless suffering. Therefore, he made a great vow for the third time: "First, disciple Hui Tang faithfully recites the sutras and chants the holy name, praying to Namo King Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva for great compassion, great compassion, great wisdom, great wisdom, great vow, great power to save my parents in many lifetimes to soon escape the cycle of suffering. The present parents will soon be reborn in the Pure Land. Second, may the Great Sage be blessed with blessings, the disciple will learn according to the Bodhisattva's words, embrace compassion, and pray Eliminate all negative karma in previous lives and this life, increase wisdom, and encounter good things; also pray for a favorable future for your two children. After making his own vow, within three or four months, Dai Si Tu gradually gave him inspirations:

1) This humble body has had a skin disease that hasn't gone away for many years, itching and discomfort, and medicine has been ineffective. After reading the sutra, the disease gradually heals.

2) After Tuong's business enterprise in Hong Kong closed, her daughter-in-law got sick again, and she decided to go to Taiwan to find another job. I received my entry passport and was about to leave when I suddenly heard that a large foreign trade company in Hong Kong needed to recruit a new employee. Luckily, I was hired and my daughter-in-law also recovered.

3) Trach worked at a foreign company in Hong Kong, and at the same time studied by correspondence at an American university, graduated with a certificate in refrigeration. On the occasion of a foreign factory in Hong Kong recruiting a refrigeration manager, Trach sent in an application, was called for an interview by the company's director, and was eventually hired. The director also said: "There are more than two hundred people with better education than you, I only choose you..." If that is not because of the Dai Si family, then what is it? Trach did not know accounting, so the board of directors invited a senior accountant to teach him for three weeks and transferred him to work at the branch in Ryukyu Islands. Isn't that also due to the Great Si's strength? Grandson Trach secretly thought of the Great Master's grace and had nothing to repay, so he vowed to recite the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra every day for the rest of his life without fail. On the 17th day of October, the 45th year of the Republic of China (1956), I read five hundred complete volumes. I thought to myself that eleven days apart, both of them had stable jobs. Wasn't it because of reading the sutra that they were inspired by the Great Master?

4) My daughter-in-law is Tinh, a graduate from Fudan University, has no job, wants to find a job but hasn't been able to. Since I took the vow to read the sutras, a trading company in Hong Kong recruited a clerical staff. At that time, [her husband] Tuong had already gone to work. Tinh had no intention of looking for a job. Because he had just recovered from his illness, he went there to see how other people participated in the selection to satisfy his curiosity. Unexpectedly, someone in the company also gave him the test. Tinh then decided to write at will. Out of more than seventeen people, he was recruited. Great Sir is sick, can you think about it?

5) On the afternoon of January 30, 1956, while reading the prayer, I suddenly thought whether my mother had been liberated or not? Then in front of the statue of the Great Being, he knelt down and prayed: "Disciple Hue Teng, I pray to the Bodhisattva to teach me whether my mother will be born in the Pure Land or not? As taught in the sutra: 'The single-minded mind alone tests the sutra, or asks for poisoned causes, three changes in number, or even seven changes, like the evil destiniess of relatives, the text of the scriptures will surely change, upon attaining liberation' (The single-minded mind reads this sutra on its own, or relies on someone else to read it, number three times, or seven times, your relatives in such an evil destinies will be liberated.) The disciple has read this sutra one hundred and thirty-one times, but has not been instructed by the Great Master, and his heart is frightened. Praying until the third day (February 2), at five o'clock in the morning, while sitting on the bed with my eyes closed, I suddenly heard my mother's voice calling my maiden name as if she were still alive: "Come here quickly! Come here quickly." I heard my mother's voice, filled with joy like crazy, saying: "Mom is back! Mom is back." Feeling boundless joy in my body and mind, I quickly turned around and went to the place where my mother's voice was heard. Suddenly discovered a large, elegant place, similar to the scene of Di Hoa Vien[58]. The road was as flat as lapis lazuli, bright as a mirror, reflecting the silhouette of a woman dressed in royal style, smiling at Van Khai. I looked closely to see who it was, thinking that this person must be my mother, so I quickly walked over, intending to pay my respects and ask for peace. As we approached, the beautiful world completely disappeared. Thinking that my mother was born in heaven, happy, cheerful, awakened, is still a dream. Even though it was a dream scene, wasn't the Great Master compassionately teaching? Endless gratitude! The next day, I met old magician

6) My wife is almost sixty this year, still has no grandchildren, and is worried and sad. I thought that the Great Master often had premonitions to bestow grace, so he made the fourth vow as follows: "Disciple Hue Dang, I pray to the Bodhisattva to reward my good children." Made that vow in March of the 45th year of the Republic (1956). In July of that year, Tuong indeed sent a letter to inform his younger brother, Trach, saying: "My sister-in-law is pregnant and has now given birth to a son named Bao Anh." Pure karma, same birth in Pure Land, same attainment of Buddhahood. Van Khai briefly narrated six stories inspired by reading the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra and reciting the holy name. The literature is rustic and crude, but it is all true words and does not dare to lie. Again: From the 30th day of the 7th month of the 44th year of the Republic of China (1955) to the 28th day of the 10th month of the 45th year of the Republic of the Republic of China (1956), I calculated that I had read one thousand five hundred and seventeen volumes of the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows, chanting the holy name without interruption. All of you who are comrades in the same religion as me, can truly believe and accept my words, should soon develop your mind, read the scriptures, chant the holy names, you will surely gain immeasurable, boundless merit that is inconceivable, you can repay your parents' kindness in this life, and you can also repay your parents' kindness in many lifetimes!

23. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva with the noble Tao An

Hanh Ngoc write

Basically, for many lifetimes up to now, I have had a close relationship with Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, so this life has such wonderful karma. Second, when my child takes the exam, he will not eat or sleep, making me feel uneasy. Furthermore, he is working at a Chinese aviation company, and I heard that everyone praises him for his good work. To be honest, it was also because of the Bodhisattva family: That child had not yet finished his military service and applied for this job. The second day after being discharged from the army, I immediately went to work. Bodhisattva knows I don't have any money saved, my child is impatient, and I can't have a job. Only the noble Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva can understand my suffering and make everything come true.

This year, when my child participates in the international student selection contest, I don't care at all, I think just let Bodhisattva arrange it! The child was busy with work, preparing to take the international student entrance exam, and quickly applied for a scholarship certificate from the United States. The story of applying for a scholarship certificate is even more mysterious! While in the army, my son met a friend named Ta. Because that person's job wasn't very good, my son introduced him to the Chinese airline company, so the two of them were like hands and feet, and had nothing to hide from each other. The guy named Ta had known his girlfriend for many years and had discussed marriage, but he did not expect her to fly to America to marry someone else. The guy named Ta was sad and unhappy. My child is enthusiastic towards others, using all kinds of methods to comfort the guy named Ta. Learn a little Buddhism from me to advise, and finally convince the guy named Ta. Unexpectedly, it happened in less than two years. The girl felt guilty and suddenly asked for a scholarship in America for the guy named Ta. My son then asked him which school in the US and which professor? The guy named Ta spoke up one after another. My son took the courage to write a letter in English and send it to an American university. That professor (American) had never met him and agreed 100 percent. He also encouraged my child to write letters in English very well and quickly sent the scholarship certificate. Isn't that a miracle?

The night before the exam, I took my child, brought a cup of water, and went to see the Venerable Dao An, asking for help from the teacher. He accepted and was extremely happy. I think there must be a certain grasp, because He rarely talks. Sometimes when asking the wrong question, He will often not speak up. I'm really afraid of that serious style, but those who are close to Him, no one doesn't say that He has overflowing compassion, generosity, and straightforwardness, making others feel close and approachable. Early in the morning when taking the exam, the child bowed three times to the Buddha, and he didn't know what he was reciting? It very sincerely drank all the water blessed by Venerable Dao An. I smiled, put the statues of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva in his pocket, and said: "Today, Bodhisattva all came to accompany me to take the exam, I will definitely be satisfied." At five o'clock in the afternoon, my child dragged his tired body, but with a smiling face, packed his luggage and hurried back to Kaohsiung to go to work. The neighbors all gave me thumbs up and praised me for having an obedient child. I really don't dare accept this title. I am very afraid that my child will be disappointed. My compassionate heart is completely devoted to the holy name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva.

On the fourteenth of July, my child suddenly returned: "Mom! I passed." He showed me the area circled in red on the newspaper. The eldest child joked: "Maybe they have the same last name." I said: "It's not such a coincidence!" My child went to the Ministry of Education for comparison and indeed passed the exam. The next day, he returned to work, and all the exit procedures were left to his brother to take care of: "I definitely have to go, my karma outside the country is very good." When you go to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, you must fill in all the document codes on an [exit] application form. The place was cramped, there were too many words, the eldest child wrote the wrong word, a gentleman standing next to me automatically erased it with an eraser and rewrote it. After finishing writing, without waiting for me to thank him, I could no longer see him. The eldest child and Van Nhan (the second child's girlfriend) were very surprised. All the preparation procedures are complete, waiting for the final step, the visa, makes me nervous. Need to deposit twenty thousand dong in the bank. A not-so-close friend of my son in Kaohsiung lent him twenty thousand dong to deposit in the bank and take the account book back. The visa has not yet been completed, my son has already resigned from his job, and it seems that he is 100% certain to fly to America. I heard that the US Embassy has a particularly difficult time issuing passports: If you have a large deposit, it is said that you came to [the US] because of greed, and if you don't have enough, you won't be able to get a visa. They use the excuse that too many test scores are due to cheating and are not worth discussing! It's true that “finding bones in tofu”, I only single-mindedly ask Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva for help.

When going to the US consulate to apply for a visa, some people have to line up from three o'clock in the morning. My child left at eight o'clock. That day, I recited two sets of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutras as if asking for help. This is the last hurdle. It's not until my child returns that I feel secure. My son said: "When I arrived, it was too late, there were so many people. In front, there was a classmate who called me and let me stand number nine in his place. Before my son left, when he came to say goodbye to Venerable Dao An, he gave him a Buddha statue and a rosary to bring back from Japan. This big step in believing in Buddha was entirely due to the teaching power of Venerable Dao An, which made my son moved, worshiped, and admired him to the core. It's really not that simple!

University in the US opens on August 26, Chinese airline tickets for August have already been booked, my children use free airline tickets, basically there is no way to get priority. My son sent a letter to say that he came to America, because he was in a foreign land and couldn't find a place to live. She spoke calmly, I listened so engrossed that I forgot everything around me. Therefore, she encountered such mysterious things, often inconceivable miracles appeared. These were not baseless myths, but the result of her practice repaying her efforts. Compared to her, I am truly a dark and inert wood and stone, without spiritual nature, my dry mind needs to be watered by the water of magic, my consciousness is weak and confused, needing wisdom to strengthen and comb out. A foolish person speaks with his mouth, a wise person acts in his mind. He craned his neck to look intently again, and after a long while said: "There's a lot of writing, I can't see the words clearly." Then he said: "I will go to a good place, don't be sad." He also recited Buddha's name continuously. When he was about to die, unable to utter a sound, his lips still moved. Because you always recite Buddha's name, you will definitely be reborn in the Pure Land!

Respectfully, in the past, sir, he used to be the editor for the monthly Novel of the Thuong Quan Thuong Department. In the writing, there were often satirical words about Buddhism. Even when chatting, it was even more common to arbitrarily criticize, laugh at, and slander Buddha! His wife had been reciting Buddha's name for more than ten years. He immediately pointed to her and said to his friends: "She wants to be born in the West, I will be born in the East." He often had an attitude of thinking he was wise, laughing and disdaining Buddhists as superstitious people. But due to good causes and conditions, due to the writings, my heart and soul became attached to me. Finally, I heard the Buddha's teachings, gained real benefits, and was invited by the Bodhisattva to guide me. Having extremely deaf ears and hearing the Buddha's name every day, he was the one most opposed to the method of reciting the Buddha's name and could not help but arouse his faith. Moreover, for several months the chanting of Buddha's name did not stop, making him unable to help but feel that ghosts, gods, Buddhas, and Bodhisattvas were often around us and became afraid. Therefore, if you sincerely repent, your karma will be implicitly eliminated. He saw a large book containing good and bad karma throughout a lifetime. That notebook does not wait for someone else to write, we just stir up our thoughts, that is, we write in it ourselves. On the notebook is the image of our mind, even heaven and hell are just a changing mind. Suffering, punishment, Pure Land, Ultimate Bliss, each matter is felt by one's own karma. In the cycle of birth and death, good and evil karma in one life is discovered. Readers should not think that being able to wake up and recite the Buddha's name at the time of death is an easy, ordinary thing and then take it for granted. The Amitabha Sutra teaches: “It is impossible because of a lack of good roots, blessings, and causes to be born in a foreign land” (It is impossible to be born in that realm due to a lack of good roots, blessings, and causes). Mr. Thiet Tieu is an honest person, courageous in doing good deeds, knowledgeable in medicine, and always thinking of helping others. That is also the true cause of achieving Pure Karma. On the Twenty-ninth day of June, the 24th year of the Republic of China (1935), recorded by Nhiep Van Dai.

I then made up my mind to recite the Ksitigarbha Original Prayer Sutra to pray. Considering that the text of the sutra was too long, his life was busy, and it was difficult to recite it completely, he silently thought about the stories in the thirteen chapters of the sutra, memorized the title of each chapter, and used it to worship the sutra as a substitute [for chanting]. Consider the previous stories clearly recorded. Looking at the hunch I personally received, I believe even more that it is true! Respectfully record this story to advise people. When that daughter is born, you will have a misfortune, but I will often visit you and protect you. You must not be afraid, your life will not be in danger. You must spontaneously make a wish and offer oil to light a lamp in front of the Buddha and Bodhisattva statues in Cuu Hoa Mountain, whatever you say is fine... You don't say, I tell you, you can offer a hundred kilos of oil to light a lamp, it can ensure the whole family is safe, when giving birth to a daughter, there will be no danger. dangerous at all". “Is twenty pounds okay?” "Okay!" The old man did not write in the thick notebook he took out, but conveniently wrote a piece of paper "Chau Duong Hue Khanh offers twenty kilograms of oil for lamps". Tell me to light three incense sticks and follow him to the yard facing southwest to perform the ceremony. The old man burned the paper and said: "Cuu Hoa Son already knows." I saw the old man walking, his steps were as light as flying, without any sound. I was very surprised, but I didn't understand why, so I just asked: "Why does the old master know my full name?" "I said I have magical powers." "I'll give the old master some money." "I don't take any money, I have never held any money in my hand. It's okay if you send pure oil. If you bring it yourself, I will personally welcome you. If I send someone to deliver it, I myself will not come out. You can tell her (pointing to Ms. Ton), she is from Chao district, Anhui province, she will know! Tell her to put it in Palace evacuated, unfortunately I lost that detail).

Miss Hua chimed in again: "You said you don't need money, asking for oil is no different than wanting money?" "Do you know something? What was your past life? I pity you, I don't want to say. Your landlady is a good person, I came specifically to talk to her, you don't need to bother! It's not early anymore. Your husband is about to get off work and will return, his temper is very hot-tempered and snappy, he will probably think of me as a mediocre monk asking for money, and will definitely scold me. Don't be angry, I'm not angry either. He has a good heart, he got angry, there's nothing else! Last year, a guy from Shanghai, pretending to be your husband's friend, cheated you of a sum of money, he scolded you, right? That money was because you owed that guy in your previous life, it's best to give it back to him. (I am often in tears and miserable because of that!)

My husband lives in Nanjing, although he often goes to Chi Na Internal Academy, he is close to his teacher, the old layperson Chau Thieu Do, who also spent money to print sutras, and once asked for an inscription to engrave on his mother's grave from Master Nghi Hoang, Au Duong Canh Vo. In the poem, there is a sentence: "Revolving in the three heavenly realms, with only the power of sutras, the State of Dao is not confused, merit is strong, I did the poem for my mother, and was born in the Pure Land". But he had never heard the sutras, had not heard the Buddha's teachings, and had not understood the meaning of the Sangha. Again, due to the concept of "eliminating superstition" at that time, the idea was confusing and contradictory. Because last year I was deceived by someone, he always thought I was easily deceived by others! After he returned, without asking the reason, he got angry and told me not to arbitrarily write down donations. Most of the time, monks make gifts for fame, but also for their own well-being and self-benefit! The old man smiled and said: "I already knew you would be angry. Don't scold me, don't scold your wife. In the future, you still need her to save you and help you. Amitābha Buddha! Amitābha Buddha!"

Miss Hua took the old man to the door. As soon as he left, he was nowhere to be seen. She came back and said to me: "As soon as the old master went out, he was nowhere to be seen again, I don't know why!" Because of this, I feel extremely sad, but I really don't understand why? I didn't dare tell my husband in detail what the old master said. However, the old man in the jade crown, his voice, his smile, every word and every word were deeply engraved in my mind. Sure enough, at that hour, on that day in August, the fifth child, Xuan Duong, was born and immediately slept quietly, never hearing a cry. Mother and child are both safe. In January of the 26th year of the Republic of China (1937), when my youngest daughter, Xuan Vien, was born, I had peritonitis and my situation was quite critical. After more than a month of treatment, the danger turned into safety. These things are completely consistent with what the old master said that day.

The resistance army [against the Japanese invasion of China] rebelled, [my family] hastily left Nanjing to return to Gan land (Jiangxi)>[59]. In January of the 27th year of the Republic of China (1938), my family followed the orders of the Ministry of Education to concurrently hold the position of principal of the third National High School. The whole family moved from Thuyjin to Dongren district, Guizhou. In the spring of the 30th year of the Republic of China (1941), my family was transferred to work as a consultant at the Examination Institute, and had to follow the Ministry of Education [of the Kuomintang government] to the second capital, Chongqing[60], my mother and I still lived in Tongren. I think I haven't taken care of my mother-in-law for nearly ten years, and I feel extremely uncomfortable. Whenever I think about it, I cry. That September, when I started to turn forty, I remembered even more and often wanted to repay my mother-in-law. Some people say that if you want to repay your kindness, you must worship Buddha and recite the Blood Tank Sutra. Ms. Van Phi Van, a Taoist, said she would come and teach me to chant, but I had to worship her as my teacher. I don't know why, I didn't really want to, I kept making appointments, but in the end I never went to her house! In March of the 31st year of the Republic of China (1942), one night I dreamed of two large monks, the first of whom wore a kasaya, leaving his left shoulder exposed, with his big ears hanging down. The second person wore a Hai Thanh shirt, both were barefoot. The second person entered the door, called my name, and asked if I still kept the Arhat necklace made of cypress wood? (This is a rosary requested by the old monk at Trung Nhac temple in Tung Son when my family was the Doc Hoc of Ha Nam province). The first person said: "Don't be impatient. In the future, when I have the opportunity, I will introduce it to you." I didn't know what to introduce, so I just said casually: "Master, please pay attention." On June 19, when Dong Nhac Temple in Dong Nhan held the Quan Yin Dharma Assembly, someone suddenly said loudly: “Take refuge in the Three Jewels, take refuge in the Three Jewels”, saying three or four times! One person asked the other who was speaking, everyone heard the voice, but did not know what taking refuge in the Three Jewels was? After asking Master Khoan Ngan, I learned what Tam Quy Y means. We wanted to ask for refuge, but the teacher didn't want to, saying: "During the Resistance War, there was no way to seek refuge, so what's the point of taking refuge? In the future, it's better to go to Putuo Mountain to take refuge." After asking for a long time, the Master reluctantly agreed, saying: "I don't want to give you refuge, I'm afraid that Buddha and Bodhisattva want to give you refuge." Therefore, the refuge ceremony will be performed temporarily. That was when I began to take refuge in the Three Jewels, and from the age of forty I would believe in Buddha and study Buddhism, and that was proven. But as for what the old master said a few years ago, at that time I completely forgot and didn't remember!

After taking refuge, Master Khoan Ngan taught me to recite the Great Compassion Mantra. I asked the teacher again to teach me how to recite the Diamond Sutra, but he refused, saying: "You don't understand, why recite?" One night, I dreamed that an old monk taught me to recite the Amitabha Sutra. After reciting, a boat flew past from nowhere. I was surprised and asked: "Why can the boat fly?" The old monk said: "That is an inconspicuous object." Looking back, I didn't see the flying boat anymore, nor did I see the old monk! In my hand, I only have a book of Amitabha Sutra. Waking up, the Amitabha Sutra does not exist; Thinking back, the appearance and charisma of the old monk he met at home in Nanjing were very similar. From then on, I often remembered the old monk from that year. The next morning, Master Khoan Ngan came, I told him about last night's dream of reading the Amitabha Sutra, I also asked what the Amitabha Sutra was about, and he explained it a bit in general. That afternoon, putting the books out to dry, Xuan Yen discovered a Buddhist sutra printed by Mr. Truong Mac Quan as a gift (none of the books in Nanjing brought with him, so I don't know why this sutra was mixed together, it was also a fateful cause). The Diamond Sutra, the Amitabha Sutra, the Infinite Life Sutra, the Heart Sutra, the Great Compassion Mantra, etc. are all there. I was happy and excited, so I devoted myself to reciting sutras and mantras. Morning and evening, I always chanted them. I was happy and not bored.

During the resistance war, my family chanted the Ma Loi Chi Thien sutra[61]; Elderly layperson Chau Thieu Do sent a letter instructing him to chant the Amitabha Sutra and the holy name of Quan Am. After arriving in Chongqing, my husband became close to Mr. Dai Quy Dao, and under his influence, his belief in Buddhism gradually solidified. He selected a number of Buddhist scriptures to advise first, then sent them to me in Dong Nhan. At home in Nam Xuong, he set up a Buddha altar and often worshiped with me. After arriving in Taiwan, due to Mr. Long Kien's introduction, he took refuge with old shaman Hu Van of Nam Hoa Pagoda, and also became a regular disciple of old layman Ly Tuyet Lu (Ly Binh Nam), listening to sutras, studying Buddhism, and was quite diligent. That's roughly speaking about his destiny to study Buddhism.

On the occasion of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's birthday in July of the 42nd Republic of China (1953), Master Tuyet (Mr. Ly Binh Nam) gave my husband dozens of paintings of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. I see that the robe, crown, and pearl necklace in the painting are no different from the hundred-year-old monk of Jiuhua Mountain that I met at home in Nanjing in the 24th year of the Republic of China (1935), but his appearance is younger and he has more staff in his hand! Therefore, remember the truths He said and the experiences from beginning to end and tell your husband. My wife was frightened, jumped up and asked: "Such a rare spiritual relic, it must be the reincarnation of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Why didn't you tell me sooner, causing me to suffer until now? Because you have developed Bodhi mind and great vows, I only know a limited amount, one virtue, one mind, following each other and cultivating together. Isn't it because you saved me and helped me?" Therefore, respectfully worship, repent deeply and earnestly.

In December, Bao Thien Temple in Taichung invited Dharma Master Bach Thanh to preach the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra. The shaman, who had his hair cut down at Cuu Hoa Mountain, when preaching sutras, often mentioned the spiritual manifestations of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. In the sutras, many times it is mentioned about the ethics of making offerings, worshiping, or creating stupas, or painting images, or lighting oil lamps. Therefore, thinking about the past, I also gave detailed clues to the magician. Also asked: "Does Cuu Hoa have an old monk over a hundred years old with such charisma?" The magician said: "I have been in Cuu Hoa for many years, I have never heard or seen an old monk over a hundred years old. He must be the reincarnation of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. He took out a thick book, on the cover there were a few large words with gold foil for her to see. He refused to open it to write down the donation, his steps were so light. It was an inconceivable kind of manifestation! Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva often has spiritual reincarnations wandering around, and many people in the surrounding areas talk about it. discuss passionately!”

Through this questioning, it can be said that quite reliable evidence has been obtained, able to prove that the story eighteen years ago was completely different from the ordinary, proving the inconceivable incarnation of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. At that time, "the fleshly eye cannot see saints, the fleshly eye cannot see Buddhas and Bodhisattvas", to the point of missing out on difficult opportunities to meet in life, not being able to ask much about cause and effect, asking for much enlightenment, and even desecrating and disrespecting dignity, to the point of committing crimes. It's true that it's too late to repent, it's hard to redeem a hundred lives! Therefore, my family and I respectfully offered twenty kilograms of clean oil before Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's throne at Bao Thien Pagoda, to make amends for the old vow. Sincerely, earnestly, deeply saddened, pouring out a feeling of sorrow, five feet planted close to the ground, sorrowfully repenting, hoping for the sea to be calm and clear, to reach Cuu Hoa mountain, "contemplation of compassion", hoping to stop karmic obstacles, and dedicate the Dharma world. May has passed by, from the time of that year's repentance ceremony until now, a year has almost ended. Respectfully write down the beginning and end of the story, honestly present it to your fellow practitioners, and respectfully quote the Buddha's verses in the chapter on Knowledge and Benefits of the Original Prayer Sutra:

Ksitigarbha's sacred power,

False desire to practice Supreme Bodhi,

(I see Ksitigarbha's majestic power,

Gioi Bao notes

Often heard that Buddhas and Bodhisattvas have no great compassion, are of the same great compassion, even though they are hated by the Five Evils and Ten Evils. The writer has been proven to be right! The writer has been studying Buddhism for two years. Before studying Buddhism, his mind was full of thoughts that only benefited him. The Ngo family's fairy mother, early on, converted and believed in Nhat Quan Dao, became a vegetarian, and worshiped all gods and Buddhas. Life is miserable, and my mother's experiences made me remember it clearly. Three days before my mother's death, her spirit was extremely vague (at that time, she was seventy-two years old). On the Twenty-eighth day of September, the year of the Republic of Korea 72 (1983), I suddenly had the urge to break free of the shackles imposed by traditional morality: "My mother is suffering from such suffering and illness, why should I pray for birth in the Pure Land for her sake? Finally, I went to Kim Son Zen Monastery and asked the refuge master, old shaman Tri Giac, to teach me with compassion: "Is it against filial piety because my mother prayed to be born in the Pure Land?" And also pray every day before Buddha:

1) Helps the mother reduce her suffering and be born soon in the Pure Land. All of my mother's pity and suffering are my responsibility to bear.

3) Allow me to be by your side, help recite Buddha's name, and help my mother give birth to the West. Although my mother had a brain disease for many years, her body was extremely strong. Then, close to my mother's ear, say each thing clearly: "Mom! You used to be a vegetarian and worship Buddha and believe in Buddha. When my mother had been in bed for seven days, when we moved her body or limbs, she was in great pain, making painful cries, and I thought about whether or not I should take her to the hospital. Gao Thanh Bach's birthday, Cao Thanh Doc Sutra, a visionary's life will last forever, he will commit a serious sin, he will be free from all sins, he will attain liberation forever. To be born in the land, he will always be satisfied with his life" (If in the future, there is a man or woman who lies on a sick bed for a long time, praying for life or death is impossible. Either dreaming of demons at night, with family members, or walking in a dangerous path, or often suffering from sleep paralysis, walking with ghosts and spirits. months, turning into wasting, coughing, and moaning in pain in sleep. He will be born in any place, always knowing his life.

During the previous ten days, we continuously recited the Buddha's name, not considering the key issue that when mother was healthy and still had not practiced the Buddha's name, fearing that it would be difficult to correspond. Now suddenly remembering the above sentence, I immediately recited the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra once for my mother. After that, chant a glass of great compassion water for your mother to drink. In the afternoon of the next day, when I turned my mother's body around to massage, I suddenly noticed that my mother did not show any pain and was in a comfortable and peaceful spirit. We continuously chanted Buddha's name without missing a beat, and often held up the statue of the Western Three Saints with both hands for our mother to see. We also told her about the many good deeds we had done in the past. Buddha and Patriarchs would lead her to the Western Pure Land. It's very strange to say it out loud. Originally a few years ago, my mother didn't understand her intentions, but now she seems to understand. Every time he said something like that, his eyes would fill with tears. A few dozen days ago, our brothers and I gathered seventy thousand dong to make offerings to the Three Jewels, and we told our mother clearly about each story. And also recite Buddha's name every day, bow to Buddha, and pray for Buddha's light to help my mother be born in the West. At eleven o'clock at night on the thirteenth day, use the apple powder that my mother likes to eat and feed him a large spoonful. Continuing to recite the Buddha's name non-stop, I felt mentally refreshed. Without thinking about going to sleep, I asked for the statue of the Western Three Saints to show my mother. Mom opened her eyes wide and looked at twelve fifty-five minutes, she breathed faster. Five minutes later, he stopped breathing and passed away without struggling. The writer, his wife and younger brother recited Buddha's name until eight o'clock in the morning, inviting a shaman to assist in chanting until noon. During interruptions, use a tape recorder to play Buddha's name. From then on, relatives continued to come and reprimand: "Why didn't you help him bathe and change his clothes early? At three-thirty in the afternoon, I bathed and changed my mother's clothes. Who would have thought that her whole body was as soft as usual, and everyone could no longer say anything! The next day, when entering the coffin (33 hours had passed), I noticed that my mother's body was still as soft as before.

For taking care of our mother's funeral, we were also criticized by some friends. The secular world always prays for excitement and beauty. The family never invited anyone to do Buddhist work, but every day the writer chanted Amitabha Sutra, Ksitigarbha Sutra, Buddha's name, etc. to dedicate to his mother.
